core_asset:顶层:4.zh: 带张力切断会撕裂，裂口顺着帆面蔓延；没接地，收卷时静电会击穿帆膜
core_asset:顶层:4.en: Cut while taut it tears, and the tear runs; unearthed, static pinholes the film as it winds

core_asset:顶层:6.zh: 快，几乎没风险，但光帆只剩废料价
core_asset:顶层:6.en: Quick and nearly safe, but the sail fetches scrap money only

core_asset:顶层:8.zh: 整船溢价 $900,000 + 船上设备和船壳

core_asset:顶层:10.zh: 小船断电、抽空燃料、舱室和货舱泄压；托架锁从船尾往船首依次解（CL-1→CL-4），先解船头侧会撬起撞门、溢价砍半；开船首门、出口路线清空、绞盘通电，整船拖出按一件结算；小船船壳一刀都别碰
core_asset:顶层:10.en: Battery off, fuel out, cabin and hold vented; the cradle locks from the stern forward (CL-1→CL-4), a bow lock first and it lurches into the door, half the premium gone; bow door open, the way out clear, winch powered: out whole, paid as one; never cut its hull

core_asset:顶层:12.zh: 不管顺序直接切：小船的设备照样能卖，但船壳一开，$900,000 的整船溢价就没了
core_asset:顶层:12.en: Cut it as it comes: its equipment still sells, but once its hull is open the $900,000 premium is gone

core_asset:顶层:14.zh: 7 列 26 箱，含居住舱、低温箱、危险品箱
core_asset:顶层:14.en: 26 CONTAINERS IN 7 BAYS, A HAB, A CRYO BOX AND A DG BOX AMONG THEM

core_asset:顶层:16.zh: 先松四根拉杆的花篮螺丝；每箱 6–9 t 要吊车；从两端往中间、每列从上往下，看着每列上方的弯曲读数走：外侧还满就卸空里侧，那一列会折弯，外侧的箱全被砸坏
core_asset:顶层:16.en: Slacken the four rods' turnbuckles first; each box is 6–9 t, crane it; from the ends inwards, each bay from the top, by the bending bar over it: empty an inner bay with the outer ones full and it kinks, every box beyond it damaged

core_asset:顶层:18.zh: 两根临时撑杆顶住外侧的列，里侧的箱就能先卸：撑杆额定 60 t（约两列满箱），撑得太靠里会超载、弯了再折；撤撑杆之前外侧要先卸掉，不然空掉的列当场折弯
core_asset:顶层:18.en: Two temporary props under the outer bays and the inner bays can come off first: a prop is rated 60 t (about two full bays), set too far in it bows and buckles; clear the outer bays before you take a prop away, or the empty bay kinks at once

core_asset:顶层:20.zh: 细矿 34 t + 矿块；破碎头、筛选机、振动驱动、皮带、皮带电机
core_asset:顶层:20.en: 34 t OF FINES + CHUNKS; CRUSHER, SCREENER, VIBRATOR, BELT, BELT MOTOR

core_asset:顶层:23.zh: 两扇放料门用开关打开，矿从门里流出边流边收钱；门口搭拱就挪开矿块；破碎头 6 t 超过抓钩，整件要吊车，切开就成废料；皮带先松张紧再拆，直接切会弹回打坏筛选机
core_asset:顶层:23.en: Open both gates by their switches, the ore pays as it runs; an arch over a gate, move its chunks; the 6 t crusher is past the grapple, crane it whole; slacken the belt before you take it off

core_asset:顶层:25.zh: 切开矿仓壁板，直接掏矿块，不用等放料：但料位线以下的破口会让细矿洒光、一分不算；矿还剩一半以上就撬门会撕裂矿仓、罚 $8,000
core_asset:顶层:25.en: Cut the hopper's walls and take the chunks, no waiting on the gates: but a hole below the heap pours the fines out unpaid; a gate forced with it half full tears the hopper, $8,000

core_asset:顶层:27.zh: 7 件：主、辅发动机，燃料箱，三件货
core_asset:顶层:27.en: 7 UNITS: TWO ENGINES, THE FUEL TANK, THREE CRATES

core_asset:顶层:31.zh: 先断电、泄压、抽空燃料再动刀；切管带油会起火，切到设备就成废料，搬运时撞到会掉价
core_asset:顶层:31.en: Power off, vent, drain the fuel before any cut; a pipe cut wet burns, equipment cut is scrap, knocks on the way cost

core_asset:顶层:33.zh: 大刀切开船体，整块往熔炉里送：快、痛快，但设备大多切坏、撞坏，按废料算
core_asset:顶层:33.en: Cut the hull into big sections and feed them to the furnace: quick and satisfying, but most equipment is cut or knocked to scrap

core_asset:顶层:35.zh: 燃料罐 T-2、水罐 T-5 + 罐里的燃料和水
core_asset:顶层:35.en: THE FUEL TANK T-2, THE WATER TANK T-5 + WHAT IS IN THEM

core_asset:顶层:39.zh: 总线还通着先从 PT-2、PT-5 把罐抽空（泵要有电）；从车尾往前拆，K-4 后面的拆完再动 K-4；罐 9 t 要吊车
core_asset:顶层:39.en: Drain both tanks at PT-2 and PT-5 while the bus is live (the pumps need it); strip from the tail, K-4 last; a tank is 9 t, crane it

core_asset:顶层:41.zh: K-4 车钩卡死承着整列的弯矩：先拆它，后半列弹开，撕坏两边；先断总线罐就抽不出来了
core_asset:顶层:41.en: K-4 holds the train's bend: undo it first and the aft train springs off, tearing both sides; cut the bus first and the tanks can't be drained

core_asset:顶层:43.zh: 防喷器、岩芯盒、底部钻具、顶驱
core_asset:顶层:43.en: THE BOP, THE CORE BOX, THE BHA, THE TOP DRIVE

core_asset:顶层:46.zh: 先拨 TQB 泄掉残余扭矩，接 PMUD 放掉泥浆，再从上往下逐节卸钻杆，每卸一节先卡上它下面的卡瓦 SLIP
core_asset:顶层:46.en: Bleed the torque (TQB), let the mud out at PMUD, then break the stands out from the top, each with the slips (SLIP) set under it

core_asset:顶层:48.zh: 带着扭矩卸钻杆会甩打砸坏钻台，带着泥浆压力会喷出污染设备，顺序错了上面的钻杆会掉下来
core_asset:顶层:48.en: Broken out with torque it whips and smashes the floor, with the mud in it blows out, out of order the stands above drop

core_asset:顶层:53.zh: 每个飞轮先开刹车冷却 CV 再拨刹车 BR，降到 300 rpm 以下才拆；导轨张紧器从尾往头逐个松；托架 6 t 要吊车
core_asset:顶层:53.en: Each wheel's brake cooling (CV) on, then its brake (BR), under 300 rpm before it comes off; the rail tensioners from the tail to the head; the cradle is 6 t, crane it

core_asset:顶层:55.zh: 飞轮还在转就拆：甩飞砸坏旁边；干刹会烧坏卡钳；张紧器先松头部，导轨会窜动甩打
core_asset:顶层:55.en: Taken still spinning it is thrown off; braked dry the caliper burns; a head tensioner first and the rail lurches

core_asset:顶层:57.zh: 4 罐低温货 + 两台制冷机
core_asset:顶层:57.en: 4 TANKS OF CRYO CARGO + TWO CRYOCOOLERS

core_asset:顶层:61.zh: 制冷机一直开着，先拨 RVH-3 给 TK3 冻住的泄压阀化冻，再逐罐接 PT 口抽走，最后才断电
core_asset:顶层:61.en: Keep the cryocoolers running, thaw TK3's frozen relief valve (RVH-3), draw each tank at its PT port, power off last

core_asset:顶层:63.zh: 先断电：罐压一路升到泄压阀放空，货没了；TK3 的阀冻着，那一罐会爆
core_asset:顶层:63.en: Power off first: the tanks climb to their reliefs and vent the cargo; TK3's valve is frozen, and that one bursts

core_asset:顶层:65.zh: 系绳两端两个吊舱里的设备
core_asset:顶层:65.en: WHAT THE TWO PODS ON THE TETHER CARRY

core_asset:顶层:68.zh: 开船坞刹车的冷却 BRK-C 再拨刹车 BRK，等它停转；拨 TEN 松掉残余张力，再切系绳；干刹打滑了就只能用 B 舱的 RCS 停
core_asset:顶层:68.en: The berth brake's cooling (BRK-C) on, then the brake (BRK), till it stops; let the residual pull off (TEN), then cut the tether; braked dry the rollers slip and only B's RCS can stop it

core_asset:顶层:70.zh: 还在转就切系绳：两个吊舱被甩飞，里面的设备撞坏
core_asset:顶层:70.en: Cut the tether still turning: both pods are thrown, and what they carry is smashed

core_asset:顶层:72.zh: 主反应堆 + 副反应堆

core_asset:顶层:75.zh: 和 NR-95 一样：四个控制鼓先拨 RL 锁住，冷到 60°C 以下，在屏蔽板的阴影里干活，激光绝不碰堆芯；整船只许人工拆
core_asset:顶层:75.en: As on NR-95: the four drum locks (RL) thrown, cooled under 60 °C, worked in the shield's shadow, the beam never on the core; the whole ship by hand only

core_asset:顶层:77.zh: 不锁鼓不躲辐射：无人机剂量超限、控制鼓滑出；激光切坏堆芯会核爆
core_asset:顶层:77.en: Locks off, no shadow: the drone's dose runs over, a drum slips; cut a core and it detonates

core_asset:顶层:82.zh: 每个舱的点火电容先拨 ARM 断开（或拔掉引线），再松发射夹；观察厅先泄压，玻璃才不会吹出
core_asset:顶层:82.en: Each pod's firing circuit off at its ARM switch (or its lead pulled) before its launch clamps; vent the observation hall before its glass

core_asset:顶层:84.zh: 点火电路还活着就切发射夹：火工螺栓点火，逃生舱被弹射出去摔坏
core_asset:顶层:84.en: Cut a launch clamp with its circuit live: the bolts fire and the pod is thrown off and smashed

core_asset:顶层:86.zh: 夹在两船体之间的预制居住舱里的 19 件设备
core_asset:顶层:86.en: THE 19 UNITS IN THE HABITAT CLAMPED BETWEEN THE HULLS

core_asset:顶层:89.zh: 居住舱先抽到 20 kPa 以下，8 个液压夹按对角顺序交替松（HC-U1、HC-L4、HC-U4、HC-L1……）
core_asset:顶层:89.en: Pump the habitat below 20 kPa, then let the eight clamps go crosswise (HC-U1, HC-L4, HC-U4, HC-L1…)

core_asset:顶层:91.zh: 有压就松夹舱体会弹出；一边先松光舱体扭转、砸坏舱里的设备，裂了的 2 号梁会断开
core_asset:顶层:91.en: Let go with air in it and it springs; one side first and it twists into its fittings, and the cracked beam 2 tears out

core_asset:顶层:95.en: KILL THE LOCKS, OPEN THE VAULTS

core_asset:顶层:96.zh: 两路电锁都要断：主电 K-M 和锁的备用电 K-LB；再在维修柜拨机械释放 MR，金库门就能打开，保险箱整件取出
core_asset:顶层:96.en: Both lock circuits dead, the main bus (K-M) and the locks' backup (K-LB); throw the release (MR) in the maintenance cabinet, open the vault, take the boxes whole

core_asset:顶层:98.zh: 不开门直接切金库墙：快，但刀口贴着保险箱，切到或撞到就掉价
core_asset:顶层:98.en: Cut through the vault wall: quick, but the cuts run beside the boxes and a cut or a knock costs

core_asset:顶层:100.zh: 酸、乙二醇、溶剂 + 总管 + 三个工艺罐
core_asset:顶层:100.en: ACID, GLYCOL, SOLVENT + THE MANIFOLD + THREE PROCESS TANKS

core_asset:顶层:103.en: SAMPLE, THEN ONE AT A TIME

core_asset:顶层:104.zh: 接口编号对不上介质：先在 SP 点取样认清；抽哪一支就只开它的阀 V，其他支路阀全关
core_asset:顶层:104.en: The port numbers say nothing of the medium: sample at SP first; open only the branch you draw, every other valve shut

core_asset:顶层:106.zh: 几支路阀都开着就抽：介质在总管里混成废液，不值钱还要付处理费；带介质切总管会洒
core_asset:顶层:106.en: Draw with several valves open: they mix in the manifold into waste, worthless and charged for; cut the manifold full and it spills

core_asset:顶层:108.zh: 冰（融水按水价）+ 两台水泵
core_asset:顶层:108.en: THE ICE (PAID AS WATER) + TWO PUMPS

core_asset:顶层:112.zh: 逐区开加热器 HT 融冰，融水积到 3 m³ 就会短路，及时从 PW 泵走；冰化到一半以下才松鞍座 PH
core_asset:顶层:112.en: Heaters (HT) zone by zone; past 3 m³ standing the meltwater shorts things, pump it at PW as it comes; no saddle seat (PH) lets go till half the ice is gone

core_asset:顶层:114.zh: 直接切冰块：裂缝顺着冰跑，冰块砸坏设备；冰没化就松鞍座，冰整块掉下来
core_asset:顶层:114.en: Cut the ice: the crack runs and the split ice hits the units; a seat let go with the ice still on drops it

core_asset:顶层:116.zh: 阵列 + 摇篮上的 3 台光学仪
core_asset:顶层:116.en: THE ARRAY + 3 OPTICS ON THE CRADLE

core_asset:顶层:119.zh: 仪器摇篮挂在主梁上：先拨 DL 解开三台光学仪的摇篮锁，再动吊挂和主梁
core_asset:顶层:119.en: The cradle hangs from the main beam: release the three optics (DL) before the hangers or the beam

core_asset:顶层:121.zh: 锁还没解就切吊挂或主梁：整组仪器砸下来
core_asset:顶层:121.en: Cut a hanger or the beam with them still locked on: the whole set comes down

core_asset:顶层:122.en: THE FURNACE CORE AND THE INGOTS

core_asset:顶层:123.zh: 炉芯 + 两个钢锭架 + 光谱仪
core_asset:顶层:123.en: THE CORE + TWO INGOT RACKS + THE SPECTROMETER

core_asset:顶层:126.zh: 换热泵 HX 一直有电，炉芯冷到 150°C 以下再吊；进料臂先给 ACC-F 泄压、拔销；炉芯 9 t 要吊车
core_asset:顶层:126.en: Keep the heat-exchange pumps (HX) powered till the core is under 150 °C; bleed the feed arm (ACC-F) and pull its pins; the core is 9 t, crane it

core_asset:顶层:128.zh: 350°C 以上断了冷却，炉芯热震开裂；带压拆进料臂会弹出砸坏分选机
core_asset:顶层:128.en: Cooling lost over 350 °C and the core cracks; the feed arm taken under pressure springs into the sorter

core_asset:顶层:133.zh: 船首门的蓄能器 ACC-D 先泄压、拔销，再开门罩和首门；然后逐条拨 LR 解轨道锁，货自己滚出来；每件 4.8 t 要吊车
core_asset:顶层:133.en: Bleed the bow door's accumulator (ACC-D) and pull its pins, open the visor and the door; then each rail lock (LR) and the cargo rolls out; 4.8 t each, crane them

core_asset:顶层:135.zh: 轨道锁扳手拧不开，只能连轨道切：货被扯伤
core_asset:顶层:135.en: The wrench can't undo a rail lock: cut the rail with the cargo on it and it is wrenched

core_asset:顶层:137.zh: 反应堆、炮塔、火控、加密机
core_asset:顶层:137.en: THE REACTOR, THE TURRET, THE FIRE CONTROL, THE CRYPTO

core_asset:顶层:140.zh: 先开注水阀 FLV 把弹库全打湿（弹药就不会殉爆，但也不值钱了），拨 LK-T 锁住推力矢量作动器，放掉电容再拆；反应堆 12 t 要吊车
core_asset:顶层:140.en: Open the flood valve (FLV) and wet the magazine (no cook-off, and no value in the rounds), lock the thrust-vector rams (LK-T), drain the capacitors, then take; the reactor is 12 t, crane it

core_asset:顶层:142.zh: 弹药还活着就在附近切：殉爆，一发带一发连锁，设备被炸坏；作动器没锁切线会猛甩
core_asset:顶层:142.en: Cut close with the rounds live: they cook off, one setting off the next, and the units are blown apart; an unlocked ram jerks when its line is cut

core_asset:顶层:144.zh: 6 架舱位无人机 + 回收无人机

core_asset:顶层:147.zh: 每架无人机先拨 PK 断开电池隔离开关（或先摘电池），升降机给 ACC-G 泄压、拔销，再从托架上拆
core_asset:顶层:147.en: Each drone's pack isolator off (PK), or the pack off first; bleed the lift (ACC-G) and pull its pins; then off the cradles

core_asset:顶层:149.zh: 电池还通着就拆托架：无人机醒来，旋翼一转把自己甩出去撞坏
core_asset:顶层:149.en: Free a drone with its pack live: it wakes, spins up and throws itself into whatever is near

core_asset:顶层:151.zh: 8 个环向线圈 + 2 个中心螺线管

core_asset:顶层:154.zh: 开泄能开关 DUMP、保持制冷（冷箱要有电、液氦要够），等储能降到 5% 以下再动线圈支架
core_asset:顶层:154.en: Close the dump (DUMP) with the cooling kept on (the cold box powered, helium in it), and touch no coil support till the energy is under 5%

core_asset:顶层:156.zh: 不泄能就断电或切支架：线圈失超，能量瞬间放出，连锁到旁边的线圈
core_asset:顶层:156.en: Power off or cut a support with the field up: the coil quenches, the energy comes out at once and runs into the coils beside it

core_asset:顶层:157.en: THE ENGINE PODS AND THE WINCH

core_asset:顶层:158.zh: 上下两台引擎舱 + 拖曳绞车
core_asset:顶层:158.en: TWO ENGINE PODS + THE TOW WINCH

core_asset:顶层:162.zh: 先拨 SUP 撑住船体（或者两台引擎舱一起拆），蓄能器泄压、拔掉绞车和拖钳的销子再拆；引擎舱 4.2 t 要吊车
core_asset:顶层:162.en: Set the support (SUP) first, or take both pods together; bleed the accumulators and pull the winch and jaw pins; a pod is 4.2 t, crane it

core_asset:顶层:164.zh: 不撑船体先拆一边：重量全压在剩下那台上，船体扭曲，引擎舱和吊架受损；带压拆绞车会弹出
core_asset:顶层:164.en: One pod off with nothing set: the hull twists under the other, it and its mounts damaged; the winch taken under load springs

core_asset:顶层:166.zh: 三罐 LNG 货 + 三个低温罐
core_asset:顶层:166.en: THREE TANKS OF LNG + THE TANKS

core_asset:顶层:170.zh: 冷机一直开着，从每个罐的 LP 口把 LNG 抽走，最后才断电拆罐；罐 7 t 要吊车
core_asset:顶层:170.en: Keep the chillers running, draw each tank off at its LP port, power off last; a tank is 7 t, crane it

core_asset:顶层:172.zh: 先断电直接切：LNG 升温沸散，货没了；泄压阀冻住的罐会爆
core_asset:顶层:172.en: Power off and cut: the LNG warms and boils away, and a tank with its relief valve frozen ruptures

core_asset:顶层:174.zh: 3 张手术台、3 个冷冻柜、空气再生器、制氧机
core_asset:顶层:174.en: 3 OPERATING TABLES, 3 FREEZERS, THE AIR REGENERATOR, THE OXYGEN PLANT

core_asset:顶层:177.zh: 隔离舱先用回收软管（带滤网）抽走空气，生物危险品逐个封存再搬，干净舱的门最后才开
core_asset:顶层:177.en: Pump the isolation rooms out through the hose's filter, seal every biohazard before it moves, open the clean rooms last

core_asset:顶层:179.zh: 隔离舱带着污染空气就开门或切开：污染扩散到干净舱，里面的设备每件掉 1/4
core_asset:顶层:179.en: Open or cut an isolation room with its air still dirty: it spreads, and every unit in a clean room it reaches loses a quarter

core_asset:顶层:181.zh: 12 个机柜（另有 8 块客户硬盘要托管）

core_asset:顶层:184.zh: 8 块硬盘先拨 CUST 锁进屏蔽舱；每个机柜先从 PT 口抽干冷却液罐，再拧下吊走
core_asset:顶层:184.en: Latch the 8 drives into custody (CUST) first; drain each rack's tank at its PT port before you unbolt it

core_asset:顶层:186.zh: 罐里还有液就吊：冷却液洒出来，旁边一排机柜短路；没上锁的硬盘取出按违约罚款
core_asset:顶层:186.en: Lift a rack wet: the fluid spills and shorts the racks beside it; a drive taken unlatched is a breach, fined

core_asset:顶层:188.en: THE FISH TANK, THE FRY TANK, THE SEED VAULT

core_asset:顶层:190.en: PUMP IT DOWN, VENT THE DOME

core_asset:顶层:191.zh: 先从 PW 口抽水，水球缩到 12% 以下才能动网罩和支架；穹顶先泄压，玻璃才不会吹出
core_asset:顶层:191.en: Pump the ball down at PW below 12% before the net or its frame; vent the dome before the glass

core_asset:顶层:193.zh: 水球还大就切网：水球炸散，鱼全死，舱里的电气被泡坏
core_asset:顶层:193.en: Cut the net with the ball still up: it bursts, the fish die, the room's electrics are soaked

core_asset:顶层:195.zh: 种子库、6 个培养架、6 块观察玻璃、培养控制台
core_asset:顶层:195.en: THE SEED VAULT, 6 CULTURE RACKS, 6 VIEWING PANES, THE CONSOLE

core_asset:顶层:197.en: THE RICH AIR OUT, HALL BY HALL

core_asset:顶层:198.zh: 三间培养舱逐个接 G-U 口抽空，富氧空气走了再动刀；观察玻璃拧螺栓拆
core_asset:顶层:198.en: Pump each culture hall out at its G-U port before any cut; unbolt the panes

core_asset:顶层:200.zh: 富氧空气还在就切：闪燃烧遍培养舱，观察玻璃也会龟裂
core_asset:顶层:200.en: Cut with the rich air in: a flash fire through the halls, and the panes craze

core_asset:顶层:202.zh: 堆芯、液氢罐、喷管、屏蔽板
core_asset:顶层:202.en: THE CORE, THE HYDROGEN TANK, THE NOZZLE, THE SHIELD

core_asset:顶层:205.zh: 四个控制鼓先拨 DL 锁住，冷却泵有电让堆芯冷到 60°C 以下；先吊起屏蔽板，在它的阴影里干活；激光绝不碰堆芯
core_asset:顶层:205.en: Lock the four drums (DL), keep the coolant pumps powered till the core is under 60 °C; lift the shield and work in its shadow; never let the beam touch the core

core_asset:顶层:207.zh: 不躲辐射硬干：无人机剂量超限、电子件故障；控制鼓没锁就吊堆芯会滑出；激光切坏堆芯会核爆
core_asset:顶层:207.en: Work in the open: the drone's dose runs over and its electronics fault; lift the core with a drum unlocked and it slips; cut the core and it detonates

core_asset:顶层:209.zh: 三个推进剂罐 + 主泵 + 罐里的推进剂
core_asset:顶层:209.en: THREE PROPELLANT TANKS + THE MAIN PUMP + THE PROPELLANT

core_asset:顶层:212.en: VALVES IN ORDER, PUMP IT OFF

core_asset:顶层:213.zh: 主泵有电时打开 MMH 罐的交叉阀，从 PR 口抽走总管；N2O4 罐单独从 LD-2 抽；增压阀 PV 一直开着、TV 和 NP 口别放空，否则罐会抽瘪
core_asset:顶层:213.en: With the pump powered open the MMH tanks' cross valves and draw the manifold at PR; the N2O4 tank on its own at LD-2; keep the pressurisation (PV) open and never vent TV or NP, or a tank buckles

core_asset:顶层:215.zh: 推进剂还在就切管：MMH 和 N2O4 碰上自燃，罐和泵烧坏
core_asset:顶层:215.en: Cut the lines with propellant in them: the MMH and N2O4 meet and ignite, burning the tanks and the pump

core_asset:顶层:217.zh: 三间冷舱的 18 个托盘 + 6 个疫苗箱
core_asset:顶层:217.en: 18 PALLETS + 6 VACCINE BOXES IN THREE COLD HOLDS

core_asset:顶层:220.zh: 先接船坞临时制冷 COLD-X（或让冷机一直有电），货全部卸完再断电
core_asset:顶层:220.en: Plug in the berth's cooling (COLD-X), or keep the chillers powered, till every pallet is out; power off last

core_asset:顶层:222.zh: 先断电：冷舱升到 −5°C 以上，疫苗解冻，只剩 45% 价值
core_asset:顶层:222.en: Power off first: the holds warm past −5 °C and the vaccines thaw, 45% of their worth left

core_asset:顶层:224.en: THE TOW WINCH, THE ENGINE, THE NAV

core_asset:顶层:227.zh: 先泄压、断电、抽空燃料；设备用维护工具拧下固定件整件取，切到就成废料
core_asset:顶层:227.en: Vent, power off, drain the fuel; unbolt each unit whole with the wrench, a cut makes it scrap

core_asset:顶层:229.zh: 船体切成大块整块送熔炉：快，但设备跟着一起熔了
core_asset:顶层:229.en: Cut the hull into big sections for the furnace: quick, but the units melt with it

core_asset:顶层:233.en: THROUGH THE DOOR, ONE BY ONE

core_asset:顶层:234.zh: 开货舱门，拧开每个货柜的固定件，逐个抓出来；最大的 CG-3 有 3.8 t，超过抓钩要吊车
core_asset:顶层:234.en: Open the hold, unbolt each container and take it out one by one; CG-3 is 3.8 t, past the grapple: crane it

core_asset:顶层:235.en: CUT THE WALL, DRAG THE ROW

core_asset:顶层:236.zh: 切开货舱壁，连着舱板整排拖出来：快，但刀口贴着货柜，切到就成废料
core_asset:顶层:236.en: Cut the hold's wall and drag the row out on its deck: quick, but the cuts run along the boxes and a cut box is scrap

core_asset:顶层:238.en: THE ARM, THE FUEL CELL, THE ENGINE

core_asset:顶层:241.zh: 燃料电池先停机、放掉电容、抽空氢氧再拆；机械臂是强制回收件，整件拧下送设备口
core_asset:顶层:241.en: Stop the fuel cell, drain the capacitor, take the hydrogen and oxygen out first; the arm is a named piece: unbolt it whole

core_asset:顶层:243.zh: 船体切成大块送熔炉：快，但氢氧还在就切会爆燃，设备跟着熔掉
core_asset:顶层:243.en: Big sections to the furnace: quick, but cut with the gas still in it flares, and the units melt

core_asset:顶层:245.zh: 储存阱 1 件（9 t，吊车整件送反物质回收架）
core_asset:顶层:245.en: THE TRAP (9 t, CRANED WHOLE INTO THE ANTIMATTER CRADLE)

core_asset:顶层:247.zh: 先接便携电源，带电吊走
core_asset:顶层:247.en: PORTABLE SUPPLY FIRST, CRANE IT LIVE

core_asset:顶层:248.zh: 约束只靠主电：先给储存阱接上便携约束电源，读数变成“双路供电”后才能断主电；拧下四颗支架螺栓、拔掉线圈引线，吊车整件送进反物质回收架
core_asset:顶层:248.en: The confinement runs on the main bus only: the portable supply on the trap first, and only once it reads dual supply may the bus go; four cradle bolts, the coils' lead, then the crane takes it whole into the antimatter cradle

core_asset:顶层:250.zh: 拉主闸、切到供电电缆或配电盘、拆掉磁体电源或电池：约束一断电，正反物质当场湮灭，船坞重建，合同失败
core_asset:顶层:250.en: The main switch, a chain cable or the switchboard cut, the magnet supply or the battery out: the moment it loses power it annihilates; the berth is rebuilt, the contract fails

core_asset:顶层:251.en: THE QUANTUM CHIP AND ITS FRIDGE

core_asset:顶层:252.zh: 量子芯片 QPU + 稀释制冷机五级冷台
core_asset:顶层:252.en: THE QPU + THE FRIDGE'S FIVE STAGES

core_asset:顶层:256.zh: 先锁隔振台、停循环、回收混合气，再停脉管，等它自己回到 250 K 以上才拆冷台：安全，但要等很久
core_asset:顶层:256.en: Lock the isolation table, stop the circulation, recover the mixture, then stop the pulse tube and wait till it is past 250 K before the stack: safe, and slow

core_asset:顶层:258.zh: 同样的顺序，停脉管后开加热器，回温快几倍；混合室还没过 30 K 就开，芯片当场裂
core_asset:顶层:258.en: The same order, heaters on once the pulse tube stops: several times quicker; on before the mixing chamber is past 30 K and the chip cracks

core_asset:顶层:263.zh: 先开货舱门和船尾门，再拨轨道锁 LK-U、LK-L：箱子顺着轨道自己滑出来；门没开就解锁，箱子撞门受伤
core_asset:顶层:263.en: Open the hold door and the stern door, then the rail locks LK-U, LK-L: the boxes run out on their rails; released into a shut door they dent

core_asset:顶层:265.zh: 扳手拧不开轨道锁，只能连轨道一起切下来：快，但箱子被扯伤
core_asset:顶层:265.en: The wrench can't undo a rail lock: you cut the rail with the box on it, quick, but the box is wrenched

core_asset:顶层:266.en: THE TOW HEADS AND THE HYDRAULICS

core_asset:顶层:267.zh: 上下两个拖头 + 液压站

core_asset:顶层:271.zh: 先断线圈电源再消磁，蓄能器泄压、拔掉拖臂的销子，最后拧下拖头；拖头 2.2 t 要吊车
core_asset:顶层:271.en: Kill the coil supply and degauss, bleed the accumulator, pull the arm pins, then unbolt the heads; 2.2 t each, crane them

core_asset:顶层:273.zh: 不消磁不泄压直接切：残磁把无人机和碎件吸过去，拖臂带压弹出，砸坏拖头
core_asset:顶层:273.en: Cut it as it is: the residual field drags the drone and loose pieces in, the arms spring out under pressure into the heads

core_asset:顶层:275.zh: 主机、电池 + 驾驶舱和电子舱的电子件
core_asset:顶层:275.en: THE ENGINE, THE BATTERY + THE COCKPIT AND AVIONICS ELECTRONICS

core_asset:顶层:279.zh: 先把舱室抽到真空再切碳纤维壳，或者用维护工具拧下壳板：都不冒烟
core_asset:顶层:279.en: Pump a room down before you cut its carbon skin, or unbolt the panels: no smoke either way

core_asset:顶层:280.en: CUT THE SKIN WITH AIR IN

core_asset:顶层:281.zh: 舱里还有空气就切碳纤维壳：快，但毒烟把电子件熏得掉价，玻璃也会起雾
core_asset:顶层:281.en: Cut the carbon skin with air in the room: quick, but the smoke spoils the electronics and fogs the glass

core_asset:顶层:283.zh: 保险箱、钢琴、酒墙、水疗、吧台、艺术品
core_asset:顶层:283.en: THE SAFE, THE PIANO, THE WINE WALL, THE SPA, THE BAR, THE ART

core_asset:顶层:286.zh: 先撬开卡死的气口 G-S，把主舱的富氧空气抽走再动刀；玻璃拧螺栓拆，别在旁边切
core_asset:顶层:286.en: Free the jammed port G-S and pump the oxygen-rich air out before any cut; unbolt the glass, never cut beside it

core_asset:顶层:288.zh: 富氧空气还在就切：闪燃烧遍主舱，收藏被烧坏，玻璃也会龟裂
core_asset:顶层:288.en: Cut with the rich air in: a flash fire through the saloon scorches the collection and crazes the glass

core_asset:顶层:290.zh: 日冕仪、两台光谱仪、仪器计算机
core_asset:顶层:290.en: THE CORONAGRAPH, TWO SPECTROMETERS, THE INSTRUMENT COMPUTER

core_asset:顶层:293.zh: 接上船坞冷却回路 COOL-S，等仪器舱降到 150°C 以下再取：仪器完好，要等
core_asset:顶层:293.en: Plug in the berth's cooling loop (COOL-S) and wait for the instrument room below 150 °C: whole, and a wait

core_asset:顶层:295.zh: 先拆已经冷下来的区，热区边等边拆：快，但从 150°C 以上的区取出的设备热损，热瓦切开会碎
core_asset:顶层:295.en: Strip the cool zones first and the hot ones as they come: quick, but units out of a zone over 150 °C are heat-damaged, hot tiles shatter

core_asset:顶层:297.zh: 环控、气泵、控制台、电池、电容、配电板、两个储物柜
core_asset:顶层:297.en: ENV CONTROL, BAG PUMP, CONSOLE, BATTERY, CAPACITOR, PANEL, TWO LOCKERS

core_asset:顶层:300.zh: 四个气囊各自接 BV 口放气，折叠贴到脊梁上，再拨 TN 松开张紧器，最后拆设备
core_asset:顶层:300.en: Let each bag down at its BV port till it folds onto the spine, the tensioners (TN) off, then the units

core_asset:顶层:302.zh: 带气割气囊：快，但气囊当场撕开塌下来砸坏下面的设备，绷着的绑带也会甩
core_asset:顶层:302.en: Cut a bag with gas in it: quick, but it rips and comes down on the units, and a taut strap whips

core_asset:顶层:304.zh: 18 片，三圈，装在 6 块背板上

core_asset:顶层:306.zh: 没放防尘罩就在附近切，镜面会被粉尘污染；支撑器没锁就取，镜片会摔裂；不从外圈往里取，外圈会崩边
core_asset:顶层:306.en: Cut near it uncovered and dust spoils the coating; taken off unlocked a segment drops and cracks; not outer ring first and the outer edges chip

core_asset:顶层:308.zh: 先把镜筒外壳拆掉，吊车才有路把块吊出去；每块约 5.4 t；同样要放防尘罩、锁支撑器、从外圈往里切；整块磕一下，3 片一起受伤
core_asset:顶层:308.en: Strip the tube's casing first, or the crane has no way out with a block; about 5.4 t each; cover, locks and outer ring first all the same; one knock hurts three segments

core_asset:顶层:310.zh: 那一角还绷着就切了帆片
core_asset:顶层:310.en: a panel cut with its corner still taut

core_asset:顶层:311.zh: 切帆片之前，先松开那一角的绞盘刹车
core_asset:顶层:311.en: Let off that corner's winch brake before you cut its film

core_asset:顶层:313.en: a panel cut through, now scrap

core_asset:顶层:314.zh: 要整帆的钱就别切帆面：用收帆电机卷
core_asset:顶层:314.en: To keep the sail's worth, don't cut the film: wind it in

core_asset:顶层:316.zh: 裂口顺着绷紧的帆面跑进了旁边的帆片
core_asset:顶层:316.en: a tear ran across taut film into the next panel

core_asset:顶层:317.zh: 一看到裂口，马上松开那一角的刹车，裂口就停住
core_asset:顶层:317.en: The moment a tear starts, let off that corner's brake: it stops

core_asset:顶层:319.zh: 帆片在张紧时被扯离帆架
core_asset:顶层:319.en: a panel pulled off while its corner was taut

core_asset:顶层:320.en: Slacken the corner before you move its film

core_asset:顶层:322.zh: 拉索带着张力被切断，弹断撕坏了帆片
core_asset:顶层:322.en: a stay cut under load snapped and tore its panels

core_asset:顶层:323.zh: 切拉索之前先松那一角的刹车
core_asset:顶层:323.en: Let off that corner's brake before you cut its stays

core_asset:顶层:325.zh: 那一角还绷着就开了收帆电机，卷筒过载
core_asset:顶层:325.en: the furling motor run with the corner still taut

core_asset:顶层:326.zh: 先松刹车，再开收帆电机
core_asset:顶层:326.en: Brake off first, then the furling motor

core_asset:顶层:328.zh: 没接地就收卷，静电击穿了帆膜
core_asset:顶层:328.en: wound unearthed: static pinholed the film

core_asset:顶层:329.zh: 收卷前先接上左下角的接地线 GND
core_asset:顶层:329.en: Earth it at GND (bottom left) before you wind

core_asset:顶层:331.zh: 飘浮的碎件打穿了帆膜

core_asset:顶层:332.zh: 收卷前把帆前面飘着的碎件清走
core_asset:顶层:332.en: Clear the loose pieces off the film before you wind

core_asset:顶层:334.zh: 在帆附近切割，熔渣熏黑了帆膜
core_asset:顶层:334.en: cutting close by blackened the film

core_asset:顶层:335.zh: 先收帆，再切帆附近的结构
core_asset:顶层:335.en: Furl first, then cut the structure near the film

core_asset:顶层:337.zh: K-4 车钩卡着弯矩就拆了，后半列弹开撕坏两边
core_asset:顶层:337.en: K-4 undone with the bend on it: the aft train sprang and tore both sides

core_asset:顶层:338.zh: 从车尾往前拆，K-4 后面的拆完再动 K-4
core_asset:顶层:338.en: Strip from the tail; K-4 only once what is aft of it is off

core_asset:顶层:340.zh: 钻杆还带着扭矩就卸，甩打砸坏了钻台
core_asset:顶层:340.en: a stand broken out with torque on: it whipped and smashed the floor

core_asset:顶层:341.zh: 先拨 TQB 把扭矩泄到 5% 以下

core_asset:顶层:343.zh: 泥浆还有压就卸钻杆，泥浆喷出污了设备
core_asset:顶层:343.en: broken out with the mud in: it blew out and fouled the units

core_asset:顶层:344.zh: 先接 PMUD 把泥浆放掉
core_asset:顶层:344.en: Let the mud out at PMUD first

core_asset:顶层:346.zh: 顺序错了或卡瓦没卡，上面的钻杆掉了下来
core_asset:顶层:346.en: out of order or the slips open: the stands above dropped

core_asset:顶层:347.zh: 从上往下逐节卸，每节先卡上它下面的 SLIP
core_asset:顶层:347.en: From the top, each with its slips (SLIP) set under it

core_asset:顶层:349.zh: 飞轮还在高速转就拆，甩飞砸坏了旁边
core_asset:顶层:349.en: a wheel taken still spinning: it was thrown into what was near

core_asset:顶层:350.zh: 开冷却刹车，降到 300 rpm 以下再拆
core_asset:顶层:350.en: Cooled brakes till it is under 300 rpm

core_asset:顶层:352.zh: 张紧器没从尾往头松，导轨窜动撞坏东西
core_asset:顶层:352.en: a tensioner let off ahead of one aft of it: the rail lurched

core_asset:顶层:353.zh: 导轨张紧器从尾往头逐个松
core_asset:顶层:353.en: The tensioners from the tail to the head

core_asset:顶层:355.zh: 导轨带着 180 kN 张力被切，甩打砸坏东西
core_asset:顶层:355.en: a rail cut at 180 kN whipped

core_asset:顶层:356.zh: 先松完张紧器再切导轨
core_asset:顶层:356.en: Every tensioner off before the rail

core_asset:顶层:358.zh: 没开冷却就刹车，卡钳烧坏了
core_asset:顶层:358.en: braked dry: the caliper burnt out

core_asset:顶层:359.zh: 先开 CV 冷却，再拨 BR 刹车

core_asset:顶层:361.zh: 低温罐压力升到爆裂（泄压阀冻住或没制冷）
core_asset:顶层:361.en: a cryo tank climbed till it burst (its valve frozen, or no cooling)

core_asset:顶层:362.zh: 制冷机一直开着，先给冻阀化冻，再抽货
core_asset:顶层:362.en: Keep the coolers on, thaw the frozen valve, then draw it

core_asset:顶层:364.zh: 还在转就切了系绳，两个吊舱被甩飞
core_asset:顶层:364.en: the tether cut still turning: both pods were thrown

core_asset:顶层:365.zh: 开冷却刹车停转，松掉 TEN 再切
core_asset:顶层:365.en: Cooled brake till it stops, TEN off, then cut

core_asset:顶层:367.zh: 系绳带着张力断开，崩伤了设备
core_asset:顶层:367.en: the tether parted under load and hurt the units

core_asset:顶层:368.zh: 停转并松掉残余张力再切系绳
core_asset:顶层:368.en: Stopped and slackened before you cut it

core_asset:顶层:370.zh: 系绳断头甩打砸坏了旁边
core_asset:顶层:370.en: a parted end whipped into what was near

core_asset:顶层:371.zh: 停转、松 TEN 后再切
core_asset:顶层:371.en: Stop it and TEN off before the cut

core_asset:顶层:373.zh: 没开冷却就刹车，滚轮过热打滑
core_asset:顶层:373.en: braked dry: the rollers overheated and slipped

core_asset:顶层:374.zh: 先开 BRK-C 冷却再刹车

core_asset:顶层:376.zh: 点火电路还活着就松了发射夹，火工螺栓点火，逃生舱被弹射出去摔坏
core_asset:顶层:376.en: a launch clamp undone with the firing circuit live: the bolts fired and the pod was thrown off

core_asset:顶层:377.zh: 松夹之前先拨 ARM 断开点火电容，或拔掉引线
core_asset:顶层:377.en: Firing circuit off (ARM) or its lead pulled before the clamps

core_asset:顶层:379.zh: 居住舱还有压就松了夹，舱体弹出砸坏里面的设备
core_asset:顶层:379.en: the clamps let go with air still in the habitat: it sprang and knocked its fittings

core_asset:顶层:380.zh: 松夹之前先把居住舱抽到 20 kPa 以下
core_asset:顶层:380.en: Pump the habitat below 20 kPa before the clamps

core_asset:顶层:382.zh: 一边的夹先松多了，居住舱扭转，砸坏里面的设备
core_asset:顶层:382.en: one side's clamps let go first: the habitat twisted into its fittings

core_asset:顶层:383.en: Crosswise, one each side in turn: HC-U1, HC-L4, HC-U4, HC-L1…

core_asset:顶层:385.zh: 裂了的 2 号梁旁边的夹还夹着就拆了梁，船体被撕开
core_asset:顶层:385.en: the cracked beam taken with a clamp beside it still holding: it tore the hull

core_asset:顶层:386.zh: 先松 2 号梁旁边的 HC-U1、HC-L1，再拆梁
core_asset:顶层:386.en: HC-U1 and HC-L1 off before the cracked beam

core_asset:顶层:388.zh: 融水积太多，带电的设备泡水短路
core_asset:顶层:388.en: too much meltwater stood about and shorted the live units

core_asset:顶层:389.zh: 融水积到 3 m³ 之前就从 PW 泵走
core_asset:顶层:389.en: Pump it at PW before it stands over 3 m³

core_asset:顶层:391.zh: 冰还没化到一半就松了鞍座，冰整块掉下来
core_asset:顶层:391.en: a saddle seat let go with most of the ice still on: it dropped

core_asset:顶层:392.zh: 冰化到一半以下再松鞍座 PH
core_asset:顶层:392.en: Melt it below half before any seat (PH) lets go

core_asset:顶层:394.zh: 裂缝两侧的鞍座还夹着就动了裂缝上的冰块，冰沿裂缝裂开
core_asset:顶层:394.en: a block on the crack moved with the seats beside it still holding: the crack ran

core_asset:顶层:395.zh: 裂缝上的冰用加热器融，别切
core_asset:顶层:395.en: Melt the blocks on the crack; never cut them

core_asset:顶层:397.zh: 炉芯还在 350°C 以上就断了冷却（或 150°C 以上吊出），热震开裂
core_asset:顶层:397.en: cooling lost over 350 °C (or lifted out over 150 °C): the core cracked

core_asset:顶层:398.zh: 换热泵 HX 一直有电，炉芯冷到 150°C 以下再动
core_asset:顶层:398.en: Keep the heat-exchange pumps (HX) powered till the core is under 150 °C

core_asset:顶层:400.zh: 进料臂带压上着销就拆了，弹出砸坏分选机
core_asset:顶层:400.en: the feed arm taken pinned and under pressure: it sprang into the sorter

core_asset:顶层:401.zh: 先给 ACC-F 泄压、拔销
core_asset:顶层:401.en: Bleed ACC-F and pull the pins first

core_asset:顶层:403.zh: 船首门罩带压上着销就拆了，弹开砸东西
core_asset:顶层:403.en: the bow visor taken pinned and under pressure: it sprang

core_asset:顶层:404.zh: 先给 ACC-D 泄压、拔销
core_asset:顶层:404.en: Bleed ACC-D and pull the pins first

core_asset:顶层:406.zh: 弹药被激光烤热或撞击引爆，一发带一发连锁，设备被炸坏
core_asset:顶层:406.en: rounds heated by the beam or knocked went off, setting off the rest, and blew the units apart

core_asset:顶层:407.zh: 动刀之前先开 FLV 注水，把弹库全打湿
core_asset:顶层:407.en: Open the flood valve (FLV) and wet the magazine before any cut

core_asset:顶层:409.zh: 作动器没锁就切了控制线，猛甩砸坏东西
core_asset:顶层:409.en: a ram's line cut with it unlocked: it jerked and hit what was near

core_asset:顶层:410.zh: 切线之前先拨 LK-T 锁住作动器
core_asset:顶层:410.en: Lock the rams (LK-T) before their lines

core_asset:顶层:412.zh: 电池还通着就从托架上拆，无人机醒来把自己甩出去撞坏
core_asset:顶层:412.en: freed with its pack live: it woke, spun up and threw itself into things

core_asset:顶层:413.zh: 拆之前先拨 PK 断开电池隔离开关
core_asset:顶层:413.en: Pack isolator off (PK) before you free it

core_asset:顶层:415.zh: 升降机带压上着销就拆了，弹出砸坏回收无人机
core_asset:顶层:415.en: the lift taken pinned and under pressure: it sprang into the recovery drone

core_asset:顶层:416.zh: 先给 ACC-G 泄压、拔销
core_asset:顶层:416.en: Bleed ACC-G and pull the pins first

core_asset:顶层:418.zh: 线圈带着储能失去冷却或动了支架，失超，能量瞬间放出，连锁到旁边的线圈
core_asset:顶层:418.en: a coil lost its cooling or a support with its energy still in: it quenched, and it ran into the coils beside it

core_asset:顶层:419.zh: 先开 DUMP 泄能、保持制冷，储能降到 5% 以下再断电、动支架
core_asset:顶层:419.en: Close the dump (DUMP) with the cooling kept on; power off and touch the supports only under 5%

core_asset:顶层:421.zh: 没撑船体就先拆了一边的引擎舱，重量压在另一边，船体扭曲
core_asset:顶层:421.en: one pod off with the support not set: the hull twisted under the other

core_asset:顶层:422.zh: 先拨 SUP 撑住船体，或者两台引擎舱一起拆
core_asset:顶层:422.en: Set the support (SUP) first, or take both pods together

core_asset:顶层:424.zh: 绞车和拖钳还带压上着销就拆了，弹出砸坏东西
core_asset:顶层:424.en: the winch and the jaws taken pinned and under pressure: they sprang

core_asset:顶层:425.zh: 先给蓄能器泄压、拔掉 WB 和 JL 销子
core_asset:顶层:425.en: Bleed the accumulators and pull the WB and JL pins first

core_asset:顶层:427.zh: 低温罐升压到泄压阀放不掉，罐体爆裂
core_asset:顶层:427.en: a cryo tank rose past what its relief valve could let go and burst

core_asset:顶层:428.zh: 冷机一直开着，先把 LNG 抽走再断电
core_asset:顶层:428.en: Keep the chillers running and draw the LNG off before the power

core_asset:顶层:430.zh: 隔离舱的污染空气扩散到干净舱，里面的设备要消毒，掉 1/4
core_asset:顶层:430.en: the isolation rooms' air reached a clean room: its equipment needs decontaminating, a quarter off

core_asset:顶层:431.zh: 隔离舱先用带滤网的回收软管抽空，生物危险品先封存，再开门
core_asset:顶层:431.en: Pump the isolation rooms out through the filter and seal the biohazards before any door opens

core_asset:顶层:433.zh: 机柜带着冷却液被吊出，液体洒了一地
core_asset:顶层:433.en: a rack lifted out with its tank still full: the fluid spilt

core_asset:顶层:434.zh: 吊机柜之前，先从它的 PT 口把罐抽干
core_asset:顶层:434.en: Drain a rack's tank at its PT port before you lift it

core_asset:顶层:436.zh: 旁边机柜洒出的冷却液让这一排短路
core_asset:顶层:436.en: fluid spilt from the next rack shorted this one

core_asset:顶层:437.zh: 每个机柜都先抽干再吊
core_asset:顶层:437.en: Drain every rack before you lift any

core_asset:顶层:439.zh: 水球炸散，鱼缸里的鱼全死了
core_asset:顶层:439.en: the ball burst and the fish died

core_asset:顶层:440.zh: 先从 PW 口抽水，水球缩到 12% 以下再动网罩
core_asset:顶层:440.en: Pump the ball down at PW below 12% before the net

core_asset:顶层:442.zh: 水球炸散，舱里的电气被泡坏
core_asset:顶层:442.en: the ball burst and soaked the room's electrics

core_asset:顶层:443.zh: 先抽水，再动网罩和支架
core_asset:顶层:443.en: Pump it down before the net or its frame

core_asset:顶层:445.zh: 堆芯还没冷下来就断了冷却或吊出，热震开裂
core_asset:顶层:445.en: the core lost its cooling or came out still hot: it cracked

core_asset:顶层:446.zh: 冷却泵一直有电，堆芯冷到 60°C 以下再动
core_asset:顶层:446.en: Keep the coolant pumps powered till the core is under 60 °C

core_asset:顶层:448.zh: 控制鼓没锁就吊堆芯，控制鼓滑出，一阵辐射
core_asset:顶层:448.en: the core lifted with a drum unlocked: the drum slipped, a burst of dose

core_asset:顶层:449.zh: 吊堆芯之前，四个 DL 锁全部拨上
core_asset:顶层:449.en: Throw all four drum locks (DL) before the core

core_asset:顶层:451.zh: 关了增压又放空了气垫，抽液时罐里成了真空，罐体被压瘪
core_asset:顶层:451.en: pressurisation shut and the ullage vented: drawing it pulled a vacuum and it buckled

core_asset:顶层:452.zh: 抽推进剂时增压阀 PV 一直开着，TV 和 NP 口别放空
core_asset:顶层:452.en: Keep the pressurisation (PV) open while drawing; never vent TV or NP

core_asset:顶层:454.zh: 总管抽空了主泵还在抽，干转受损
core_asset:顶层:454.en: the pump kept drawing a dry manifold and was damaged

core_asset:顶层:455.zh: 总管抽空就拔掉 PR 的软管
core_asset:顶层:455.en: Take the hose off PR once the manifold is dry

core_asset:顶层:457.zh: 冷舱断冷升到 −5°C 以上，疫苗解冻，只剩 45% 价值
core_asset:顶层:457.en: a cold hold warmed past −5 °C: the vaccines thawed, 45% of their worth left

core_asset:顶层:458.zh: 先接 COLD-X 临时制冷，或者让冷机一直有电，货卸完再断电
core_asset:顶层:458.en: Plug in COLD-X or keep the chillers powered till the cargo is out

core_asset:顶层:460.zh: 混合室还没过 30 K 就开了加热器，量子芯片热震开裂
core_asset:顶层:460.en: the heaters on before the mixing chamber passed 30 K: the chip cracked

core_asset:顶层:461.zh: 停脉管后先等混合室回到 30 K 以上，再开加热器 HEAT
core_asset:顶层:461.en: After the pulse tube stops, wait for the mixing chamber past 30 K before HEAT

core_asset:顶层:463.zh: 混合室还在 250 K 以下就切开或拆下冷台，芯片脆裂
core_asset:顶层:463.en: the stack cut or freed under 250 K: the chip cracked

core_asset:顶层:464.zh: 混合室回到 250 K 以上再拆冷台
core_asset:顶层:464.en: Wait for the mixing chamber past 250 K before the stack

core_asset:顶层:466.zh: 隔振台没锁，附近切割的震动传到芯片
core_asset:顶层:466.en: the isolation table floating, a cut close by shook the chip

core_asset:顶层:467.zh: 切制冷机附近之前，先拨 VI-LOCK 锁住隔振台
core_asset:顶层:467.en: Lock the isolation table (VI-LOCK) before you cut near the fridge

core_asset:顶层:469.zh: 混合气没回收就停了脉管，混合气沸散，冷台受损
core_asset:顶层:469.en: the pulse tube stopped with the mixture still in: it boiled off and hurt the stages

core_asset:顶层:470.zh: 先停循环 CIRC，接 G-MIX 把混合气抽到 20 kPa 以下，再停脉管 PT
core_asset:顶层:470.en: Circulation (CIRC) off, recover the mixture at G-MIX below 20 kPa, then the pulse tube (PT)

core_asset:顶层:472.zh: 箱子还锁在轨道上就把轨道切了，箱子被扯伤
core_asset:顶层:472.en: a rail cut with its box still locked on: the box was wrenched

core_asset:顶层:473.zh: 开门、拨轨道锁，让箱子自己沿轨道滑出
core_asset:顶层:473.en: Open the doors and throw the rail lock: the box runs out on its own

core_asset:顶层:475.zh: 箱子还锁着就动了吊挂，整组砸下来
core_asset:顶层:475.en: the hangers taken with the boxes still locked: the set came down

core_asset:顶层:476.en: Release the rails before the hangers

core_asset:顶层:478.zh: 拖臂还带着液压和销子就拆了枢轴，臂弹出砸坏拖头
core_asset:顶层:478.en: a pivot taken with the arm still pinned and under pressure: it sprang into the head

core_asset:顶层:479.zh: 先给蓄能器泄压、拔掉 PIN 销子，再拆拖臂
core_asset:顶层:479.en: Bleed the accumulator and pull the pins before the arm

core_asset:顶层:481.zh: 舱里有空气时切碳纤维壳，毒烟把电子件熏得掉价
core_asset:顶层:481.en: the carbon skin cut with air in the room: the smoke spoiled the electronics

core_asset:顶层:482.zh: 切壳之前先把舱室抽到真空，或者用维护工具拧下壳板
core_asset:顶层:482.en: Pump the room down before you cut the skin, or unbolt the panels

core_asset:顶层:484.zh: 主舱的富氧空气还在就切，闪燃把收藏烧坏
core_asset:顶层:484.en: cut with the oxygen-rich air still in: a flash fire scorched the collection

core_asset:顶层:485.zh: 先撬开 G-S，把主舱的富氧空气抽走再动刀
core_asset:顶层:485.en: Free G-S and pump the rich air out before any cut

core_asset:顶层:487.zh: 在精密玻璃旁边切割，玻璃被烤裂
core_asset:顶层:487.en: cutting beside the glazing crazed it

core_asset:顶层:488.zh: 玻璃用维护工具拧下来，别在旁边切
core_asset:顶层:488.en: Unbolt the glass; never cut beside it

core_asset:顶层:490.zh: 从 150°C 以上的区取出设备，热损掉价
core_asset:顶层:490.en: a unit taken out of a zone over 150 °C was heat-damaged

core_asset:顶层:491.zh: 接上冷却回路 COOL-S，等那一区降到 150°C 以下再取
core_asset:顶层:491.en: Plug in the cooling loop (COOL-S) and wait for the zone below 150 °C

core_asset:顶层:493.zh: 带气割破气囊，气囊撕开塌下来砸坏了设备
core_asset:顶层:493.en: a bag cut with gas in it ripped and came down on the units

core_asset:顶层:494.zh: 先接 BV 口把气囊放瘪，再切
core_asset:顶层:494.en: Let the bag down at its BV port before you cut

core_asset:顶层:496.zh: 张紧器还绷着就切了绑带，甩伤了设备
core_asset:顶层:496.en: a strap cut with its tensioner taut whipped into the units

core_asset:顶层:497.zh: 先拨 TN 松开张紧器，再切绑带
core_asset:顶层:497.en: Tensioner (TN) off before you cut its straps

core_asset:顶层:499.zh: 在镜子附近切割，金属粉尘落在没盖住的镜面上
core_asset:顶层:499.en: cutting close by dusted the uncovered coating

core_asset:顶层:500.zh: 切主镜附近的结构之前，先放下防尘罩 CVR
core_asset:顶层:500.en: Run the dust cover (CVR) down before you cut near the mirror

core_asset:顶层:502.zh: 支撑器没锁就取下镜片，镜片掉出镜座摔裂
core_asset:顶层:502.en: taken off unlocked, the segment dropped out of its seat and cracked

core_asset:顶层:503.zh: 取镜片之前，先给控制柜 MCC 供电，合上三圈支撑器锁
core_asset:顶层:503.en: Power the mirror cabinet (MCC) and lock all three rings before you take a segment

core_asset:顶层:505.zh: 里圈先取走了，外圈镜片的边没了支撑，崩了
core_asset:顶层:505.en: an inner segment taken first: the outer one's edge lost its support and chipped

core_asset:顶层:506.zh: 从外圈往里取：先取外圈

core_asset:顶层:508.zh: 船头侧的锁先开了、船尾还锁着：小船撬起撞上船首门，溢价砍半、设备磕坏
core_asset:顶层:508.en: a bow-side lock let go with one aft still holding: it lurched into the bow door, half the premium gone, its fittings knocked

core_asset:顶层:509.zh: 托架锁从船尾往船首依次解：CL-1 → CL-4
core_asset:顶层:509.en: The cradle locks from the stern forward: CL-1 → CL-4

core_asset:顶层:511.zh: 切到或拆下了小船的船壳，整船溢价没了
core_asset:顶层:511.en: its hull cut or taken off: no longer whole, the premium gone

core_asset:顶层:512.zh: 小船的船壳一刀都别碰：只切载舰的结构
core_asset:顶层:512.en: Never touch its hull: cut only the carrier's structure

core_asset:顶层:514.zh: 外侧还满着就卸空了里侧一列，箱梁折弯，外侧的箱被砸坏
core_asset:顶层:514.en: an inner bay emptied with the bays beyond it full: the wall kinked, the boxes beyond it damaged

core_asset:顶层:515.zh: 从两端往中间卸；要先卸里侧，先用撑杆顶住外侧
core_asset:顶层:515.en: From the ends inwards; to take an inner bay first, prop the outer bays

core_asset:顶层:517.zh: 从一列下面先抽了箱，上面的箱压下来受损
core_asset:顶层:517.en: a box taken from under others: the stack above sagged onto it

core_asset:顶层:518.en: Each bay from the top down

core_asset:顶层:520.zh: 拉杆还绷着就切了，弹开砸坏了箱子
core_asset:顶层:520.en: a rod cut still tight whipped into the boxes

core_asset:顶层:521.zh: 切拉杆之前先松它的花篮螺丝
core_asset:顶层:521.en: Slacken a rod's turnbuckle before you cut it

core_asset:顶层:523.zh: 矿仓在料位线下开了口，细矿洒了出去，一分不算
core_asset:顶层:523.en: the hopper opened below the heap: the fines poured out, unpaid

core_asset:顶层:524.zh: 切矿仓壁之前，先开放料门把矿放到破口以下
core_asset:顶层:524.en: Before you cut a hopper wall, run the ore out through the gates below it

core_asset:顶层:526.zh: 矿还剩一半以上就撬开放料门，一边倾泻撕裂了矿仓焊缝
core_asset:顶层:526.en: a gate forced with the hopper half full: it all went one way and tore the welds

core_asset:顶层:527.zh: 放料门用开关正常打开；要撬门，先把矿放到一半以下
core_asset:顶层:527.en: Open the gates by their switches; to force one, run the ore below half first

core_asset:顶层:529.zh: 带着张力切断皮带，皮带弹回打坏了设备
core_asset:顶层:529.en: the belt cut under tension whipped back into the line

core_asset:顶层:530.zh: 先断皮带电机、松张紧螺栓 TEN-1，再拆皮带
core_asset:顶层:530.en: Stop the belt motor and slacken TEN-1 before you take the belt off

core_asset:顶层:532.zh: 设备被激光切穿，成了废料
core_asset:顶层:532.en: the beam went through a unit: scrap now

core_asset:顶层:533.zh: 看清设备在哪：沿它四周的焊点和螺栓切，别穿过设备本体
core_asset:顶层:533.en: See where the unit sits: cut round it at its welds and bolts, never through it

core_asset:顶层:535.zh: 设备在搬运中撞上了东西
core_asset:顶层:535.en: a unit knocked into something on the way

core_asset:顶层:536.zh: 搬设备时放慢，绕开船体和别的碎件
core_asset:顶层:536.en: Go slow with a unit and keep it clear of the hull and loose pieces

core_asset:顶层:538.zh: 带压的气瓶被切开，爆裂波及了旁边的设备
core_asset:顶层:538.en: a vessel under pressure cut open: its burst hit the units round it

core_asset:顶层:539.zh: 切之前先把气瓶泄压放空
core_asset:顶层:539.en: Vent the vessels before you cut near them

core_asset:顶层:541.zh: 危险品爆燃，波及了旁边的设备
core_asset:顶层:541.en: dangerous goods went up and hit the units round them

core_asset:顶层:542.zh: 推进剂舱先放空、通风，再动刀
core_asset:顶层:542.en: Drain and vent the propellant before you cut

core_asset:顶层:544.zh: 切开带油的管子起火，烧坏了设备
core_asset:顶层:544.en: a pipe cut wet caught fire and burnt the units

core_asset:顶层:545.zh: 切燃料管之前先关阀、抽空
core_asset:顶层:545.en: Shut and drain a fuel line before you cut it

core_asset:顶层:547.zh: 镜片在搬运中撞上了东西
core_asset:顶层:547.en: a segment knocked into something on the way

core_asset:顶层:548.zh: 镜片很脆：抓着走时放慢，绕开船体
core_asset:顶层:548.en: The glass is brittle: go slow with it and keep clear of the hull

core_asset:card:2.zh: 需要吊车：船坞还没修好吊车
core_asset:card:2.en: NEEDS THE CRANE: NOT BUILT YET

core_asset:card:3.zh: 方案 A · 消磁泄压后拆解

core_asset:card:4.zh: 先断开供电线路并消磁，给液压系统泄压，再拆下拖臂销轴。最后拆下拖头进行回收。每个拖头约 2.2 吨，需要吊车。未彻底断电或泄压可能发生意外。

core_asset:card:5.zh: 方案 B · 带磁带压快拆

core_asset:card:6.zh: 跳过消磁和泄压，直接拆除连接结构。残留磁力可能吸走附近的无人机和碎件；液压系统仍有压力，拖臂可能突然弹出，损坏拖头。

core_asset:_sail_board:7.zh: 拨 %s 松开绞盘刹车再收卷
core_asset:_sail_board:7.en: %s off to slacken it before winding

core_asset:_sail_board:8.zh: 未接地：拨 %s 接地，否则收卷会被静电击穿
core_asset:_sail_board:8.en: NOT EARTHED: %s ON, OR WINDING PINHOLES

core_asset:_mirror_board:1.zh: 防尘罩没放下：拨 %s 放下，附近切割会污染镜面
core_asset:_mirror_board:1.en: COVER UP: %s TO LOWER IT; CUTTING CLOSE BY DUSTS THE MIRROR

core_asset:_mirror_board:5.zh: 拨 %s 合锁（控制柜 %s 上）

core_asset:_mirror_board:6.zh: 先给控制柜接电，再拨 %s 合锁
core_asset:_mirror_board:6.en: power the cabinet, then %s to lock

core_asset:_sail_review:1.zh: 已送设备口，放上零件架
core_asset:_sail_review:1.en: TO THE EQUIPMENT MOUTH, ON THE PARTS RACK

core_asset:_sail_review:2.zh: 还挂在绞盘上，按废料算

core_asset:_sail_review:3.zh: 光帆没有收卷，按废料只值约 %s；整帆收回最多值 %s
core_asset:_sail_review:3.en: The sail was not furled: as scrap it fetched about %s; whole, up to %s

core_asset:_sail_review:4.zh: 收成 %d 卷帆材，值 %s（满价 %s），都已送走
core_asset:_sail_review:4.en: %d rolls made, worth %s (whole sail %s), all sent

core_asset:_sail_review:5.zh: 收成 %d 卷帆材，值 %s（满价 %s）；只送走了 %s，挂在绞盘上的按废料算
core_asset:_sail_review:5.en: %d rolls made, worth %s (whole sail %s); only %s sent, the rest on the winches counts as scrap

core_asset:_sail_review:6.zh: 还有角没收：四个角都收完，光帆才值满价
core_asset:_sail_review:6.en: Corners left unfurled: all four rolled is the full price

core_asset:_sail_review:7.zh: 干净利落。下次可以同时开两个角的收帆电机，省时间
core_asset:_sail_review:7.en: Clean work. Next time run two corners' motors at once to save time

core_asset:_sail_review:8.zh: 下次试试整帆收卷：先接地，松开四个角的刹车，再开收帆电机
core_asset:_sail_review:8.en: Next time furl it: earth it, let the four brakes off, then the furling motors

core_asset:_mirror_review:2.zh: 已送走 %d 片，船上 %d 片

core_asset:_mirror_review:4.zh: 干净利落。下次可以试试按背板分块吊，省时间
core_asset:_mirror_review:4.en: Clean work. Next time try a backplane at a time: quicker

core_asset:_mirror_review:5.zh: 镜片还在船上：取下来送设备口才算钱
core_asset:_mirror_review:5.en: The segments are still aboard: they pay only once in a mouth

core_asset:_equip_board:3.zh: 船还没安全：先泄压、放空再动刀；电要留到最后断
core_asset:_equip_board:3.en: NOT SAFE YET: VENT AND DRAIN BEFORE YOU CUT; THE POWER GOES LAST

core_asset:_equip_board:4.zh: 船还没安全：先断电、泄压、放空再动刀
core_asset:_equip_board:4.en: NOT SAFE YET: POWER OFF, VENT, DRAIN BEFORE YOU CUT

core_asset:_ship_warn:1.zh: 储存阱只靠主电：断电即湮灭，先接便携约束电源
core_asset:_ship_warn:1.en: THE TRAP RUNS ON THE MAIN BUS ONLY: NO POWER, IT ANNIHILATES. PORTABLE SUPPLY FIRST

core_asset:_ship_warn:2.zh: 双路供电：现在可以断主电
core_asset:_ship_warn:2.en: DUAL SUPPLY: THE MAIN BUS MAY GO NOW

core_asset:_ship_warn:3.zh: 隔振台没锁：附近切割会震伤芯片（拨 VI-LOCK）
core_asset:_ship_warn:3.en: ISOLATION TABLE FLOATING: A CUT CLOSE BY SHAKES THE CHIP (VI-LOCK)

core_asset:_ship_warn:4.zh: 混合室 %s：回到 250 K 以上才能拆冷台
core_asset:_ship_warn:4.en: MIXING CHAMBER %s: NOT THE STACK TILL PAST 250 K

core_asset:_ship_warn:5.zh: 拖头残磁：%.0f mT。断开 K-H 后再消磁。残磁可能吸走无人机和附近碎件。
core_asset:_ship_warn:5.en: TOW HEADS AT %.0f mT: THEY PULL THE DRONE IN (K-H OFF, THEN DEGAUSS)

core_asset:_ship_warn:6.zh: 拆除拖臂销轴前，先给 ACC 泄压，再拔出 PIN，防止拖臂突然弹出。
core_asset:_ship_warn:6.en: ARMS PINNED UNDER PRESSURE: BLEED ACC, PULL THE PINS FIRST

core_asset:_ship_warn:7.zh: %s 有毒烟：电子件在掉价（接气口抽走空气）
core_asset:_ship_warn:7.en: SMOKE IN %s: THE ELECTRONICS ARE SPOILING (PUMP IT OUT)

core_asset:_ship_warn:8.zh: 舱里还有空气：切碳纤维壳会冒毒烟（先抽真空，或拧螺栓拆壳板）
core_asset:_ship_warn:8.en: AIR ABOARD: CUTTING THE CARBON SKIN SMOKES (PUMP DOWN, OR UNBOLT THE PANELS)

core_asset:_ship_warn:9.zh: %s 富氧 %d%%：附近切割会闪燃（撬开 G-S，抽走空气）
core_asset:_ship_warn:9.en: %s AT %d%% OXYGEN: A CUT CLOSE BY FLASHES OVER (FREE G-S, PUMP IT OUT)

core_asset:_ship_warn:10.zh: 仪器所在区 %.0f°C：150°C 以下再取（接 COOL-S 降得快）
core_asset:_ship_warn:10.en: THE INSTRUMENTS' ZONE AT %.0f °C: TAKE THEM BELOW 150 (COOL-S COOLS IT FASTER)

core_asset:_ship_warn:11.zh: %d 个气囊还鼓着：带气切会塌下砸设备（接 BV 口放气）
core_asset:_ship_warn:11.en: %d BAGS STILL UP: CUT ONE AND IT COMES DOWN ON THE UNITS (LET IT DOWN AT ITS BV)

core_asset:_ship_warn:12.zh: %d 个张紧器还绷着：切绑带会甩（先拨 TN 松开）
core_asset:_ship_warn:12.en: %d TENSIONERS TAUT: A STRAP CUT WHIPS (TN OFF FIRST)

core_asset:_ship_warn:13.zh: 线圈还储着 %d%% 的能：开 DUMP 泄能、保持制冷，降到 5%% 以下再断电动支架
core_asset:_ship_warn:13.en: THE COILS HOLD %d%% OF THEIR ENERGY: DUMP IT WITH THE COOLING ON, UNDER 5%% BEFORE POWER OR SUPPORTS

core_asset:_ship_warn:14.zh: 有线圈断了冷却：%.1f K，过 %.0f K 就失超（冷箱要有电、液氦要够）
core_asset:_ship_warn:14.en: A COIL HAS LOST ITS COOLING: %.1f K, IT QUENCHES PAST %.0f K (THE COLD BOX POWERED, HELIUM IN IT)

core_asset:_ship_warn:15.zh: 船体没撑住：先拨 %s，或者两台引擎舱一起拆，否则先拆一边船体会扭
core_asset:_ship_warn:15.en: THE HULL ISN'T PROPPED: SET %s, OR TAKE BOTH PODS TOGETHER, OR IT TWISTS

core_asset:_ship_warn:16.zh: 绞车和拖钳还带压上着销：先给蓄能器泄压、拔销再拆
core_asset:_ship_warn:16.en: WINCH AND JAWS PINNED UNDER PRESSURE: BLEED, UNPIN, THEN TAKE

core_asset:_ship_warn:17.zh: %s 压力 %.0f kPa：快到泄压线了（先抽 LNG）
core_asset:_ship_warn:17.en: %s AT %.0f kPa: NEAR ITS RELIEF (DRAW THE LNG OFF)

core_asset:_ship_warn:18.zh: 冷机没电：LNG 在升温沸散（冷机要一直开到抽完）
core_asset:_ship_warn:18.en: THE CHILLERS ARE DEAD: THE LNG IS WARMING (KEEP THEM RUNNING TILL IT IS OFF)

core_asset:_ship_warn:19.zh: %d 件生物危险品没封存：动之前先拨它的 SB / SF / SL 封存
core_asset:_ship_warn:19.en: %d BIOHAZARDS UNSEALED: SEAL EACH (SB / SF / SL) BEFORE IT MOVES

core_asset:_ship_warn:20.zh: 隔离舱 %s 还有污染空气：开门前用回收软管（带滤网）抽空
core_asset:_ship_warn:20.en: ISOLATION ROOM %s STILL HOLDS ITS AIR: PUMP IT OUT THROUGH THE FILTER BEFORE ANY DOOR

core_asset:_ship_warn:21.zh: %d 个机柜罐里还有冷却液：带液吊会洒、短路旁边的机柜（先从 PT 口抽干）
core_asset:_ship_warn:21.en: %d RACKS STILL IN FLUID: LIFTED WET THEY SPILL AND SHORT THE NEXT (DRAIN AT PT)

core_asset:_ship_warn:22.zh: %d 块客户硬盘没上锁：先拨 CUST 锁进屏蔽舱，否则按违约罚款

growth:顶层:8.zh: 承受的所有伤害；越低越耐用。
growth:顶层:8.en: All incoming damage; lower means tougher.

growth:顶层:10.zh: 巡航、冲刺、加速和制动同步增强。
growth:顶层:10.en: Cruise, boost, acceleration and braking improve together.

growth:顶层:12.zh: 电弧和带电拔线伤害；仍需断电。
growth:顶层:12.en: Arc and live unplug damage; isolate power first.

growth:顶层:14.zh: 材料内的实际切割速度。
growth:顶层:14.en: Actual beam travel speed through material.

growth:顶层:16.zh: 切口半径；更少材料被烧掉，仍会切断管线。
growth:顶层:16.en: Kerf radius; wastes less metal, still severs lines.

growth:顶层:18.zh: 烫伤、火焰和爆燃对无人机的伤害。
growth:顶层:18.en: Scald, fire and combustion damage to the drone.

growth:顶层:20.zh: 提高可牵引吨位；高阶同时增强最大牵引力。
growth:顶层:20.en: Raises the mass limit; advanced volumes also strengthen towing force.

growth:顶层:22.zh: 抓取、拖曳目标和断绳距离同步增加。
growth:顶层:22.en: Acquisition, towing target and snap distance grow together.

growth:顶层:25.zh: 按 X 切换单体/范围：一次抓起半径内的多件散料，各自保持质量和碰撞；每阶件数、半径、总承重和稳定性一起提高。
growth:顶层:25.en: X switches single/field: catch several loose pieces within a radius at once, each keeping its mass and collisions; each volume adds pieces, radius, total mass and steadiness.

growth:顶层:27.zh: 增加牵引阻尼并减轻无人机受到的反作用力。
growth:顶层:27.en: More tether damping and less recoil on the drone.

growth:顶层:29.zh: 牵引力更大，重物拖得更快；无人机受到的拖拽更小。
growth:顶层:29.en: More towing force: heavy loads move faster and drag the drone less.

growth:顶层:31.zh: 可见目标的读数距离；不透视未打开的舱室。
growth:顶层:31.en: Probe visible targets farther away; no seeing through sealed rooms.

growth:顶层:33.zh: 检测耗时；首级含原精密套件，可查裂纹和设备状况。读数仍会过期。
growth:顶层:33.en: Probe time; volume I includes crack and condition inspection. Readings can still go stale.

growth:顶层:35.zh: 每条软管的气体与液体回收速度。
growth:顶层:35.en: Gas and liquid recovery speed for each attached hose.

growth:顶层:37.zh: 远处接口的接管距离；已接软管照常独立工作。
growth:顶层:37.en: Connect more distant ports; attached hoses keep working independently.

growth:顶层:39.zh: 螺栓、锁、夹具、接头及控制件的操作速度。
growth:顶层:39.en: Operate bolts, locks, clamps, connectors and controls faster.

growth:顶层:41.zh: 每份维修剂的恢复量；机库维修依旧免费。
growth:顶层:41.en: Integrity restored per repair kit; bay repair remains free.

growth:顶层:43.zh: 一次扳手动作同时处理同一部件上相邻的多颗固定件。
growth:顶层:43.en: One wrench pass handles several fixings on the same unit at once.

growth:buy:1.zh: 技能书已停用：数值卷已退款，能力来自工程成果与消耗件。
growth:buy:1.en: The skill book is withdrawn: its volumes were refunded; abilities come from achievements and parts.

methods:顶层:37.en: The gantry crane lifts big pieces whole into their mouth; no cutting them small

methods:顶层:49.en: Edit the plan: Shift + the plan key skips a cut; cuts you add go into the next plan

methods:顶层:54.zh: 查裂纹和设备完好度，看懂高价值船再决定怎么下刀
methods:顶层:54.en: Find cracks and equipment condition: read a valuable ship before you cut

methods:顶层:56.zh: 剩余寿命：测设备时显示还能用几年、修缮用不用得上

txt:vault_locked_live.en: THE VAULT DOOR IS LOCKED: ITS LOCKS ARE STILL LIVE

txt:manifold_spill.zh: 总管拆早了：还有介质的支路从总管漏出来
txt:manifold_spill.en: THE MANIFOLD CAME OUT TOO SOON: THE BRANCHES STILL FULL SPILL THROUGH IT

txt:rail_drop.zh: 托着货箱的结构被拆，整组货箱跟着掉了
txt:rail_drop.en: WHAT THE BOXES HUNG FROM CAME AWAY: THEY DROPPED WITH IT

txt:core_shock.zh: 炉芯还很热就断了冷却：热冲击把炉芯震裂了
txt:core_shock.en: COOLING LOST WITH THE CORE STILL HOT: THE THERMAL SHOCK CRACKED IT

txt:core_lifted_hot.en: THE CORE LIFTED OUT BEFORE IT HAD COOLED: IT CRACKED AS IT LEFT ITS CRADLE

txt:tank_buckled.zh: 增压关着、罐顶又放了气就抽液：罐里抽成真空，罐体被吸瘪

txt:glass_hit.zh: 被飞出的玻璃碎片划伤

txt:glass_blown.zh: 观景厅还有压力就拆了玻璃：玻璃被气压推出去碎了
txt:glass_blown.en: A PANE CAME AWAY WITH THE HALL STILL UNDER PRESSURE: IT WAS BLOWN OUT AND SHATTERED

txt:beam_kink.zh: 这一列卸空了，外侧的箱位还满着：箱梁在这里折弯，外侧还在位的货柜全被砸坏

txt:prop_over.zh: 撑杆超载：扛着 %s t，过了 60 t 的额定载荷，正在弯

txt:prop_buckle.zh: 第 %s 列下的撑杆折断了：那几列的重量又压回箱梁上
txt:prop_buckle.en: THE PROP UNDER BAY %s BUCKLED: THOSE BAYS BEAR ON THE WALL AGAIN

txt:stack_sag.zh: 从下面先抽走了货柜：上面还在位的货柜压下来受损

txt:rod_snap.en: THE ROD WAS CUT WITH ITS TURNBUCKLE STILL TIGHT: IT WHIPPED LOOSE INTO WHAT WAS NEAR

txt:film_tear.zh: 帆还绷着就动了薄膜：薄膜撕开，裂口顺着缝跑到旁边

txt:stay_snap.zh: 帆还绷着就拆了撑索：索一断，角梁甩向吊舱

txt:static_zap.zh: 帆面还带着静电：放电打到了无人机

txt:dose_fault.zh: 剂量超限：无人机电子设备紊乱

txt:hull_torn.zh: 横梁 2 旁边的夹钳还夹着就拆了横梁：上体被撕开

txt:drill_whip.en: %s BROKE OUT WITH TORQUE ON IT: THE PIPE WHIPPED ROUND AND SMASHED THE DRILL FLOOR

txt:mud_blowout.zh: %s 卸开时管里还有压：泥浆喷了出来，糊了一片

txt:drill_drop_below.zh: %s 下面的卡瓦没坐上：下面的钻杆滑落井底
txt:drill_drop_below.en: THE SLIPS UNDER %s WERE OPEN: THE STRING BELOW IT DROPPED DOWN THE HOLE

txt:nb_battery.en: THE COURIER'S BATTERY IS STILL ON

txt:heat_spoil.zh: 热区还没降温就把设备取了出来：烫坏了

txt:heat_burn.zh: 这一区还有几百度：无人机在被烤

txt:glass_fog.zh: 烟雾太浓，座舱玻璃起雾了
txt:glass_fog.en: THE SMOKE HAS FOGGED THE CANOPY

txt:mix_boil.zh: 混合气还在制冷机里就停了脉管：混合气从蒸馏室剧沸跑光，蒸馏室和冷板受损
txt:mix_boil.en: THE PULSE TUBE STOPPED WITH THE MIXTURE STILL IN THE FRIDGE: IT BOILED OFF THROUGH THE STILL, DAMAGING IT AND THE COLD PLATE

txt:qpu_shock.zh: 混合室还不到 30 K 就开了加热：温差太大，量子芯片热应力开裂
txt:qpu_shock.en: THE HEATERS WENT ON WITH THE MIXING CHAMBER STILL UNDER 30 K: THE CHIP CRACKED UNDER THE GRADIENT

txt:qpu_brittle.zh: 制冷机还没回温就动了冷板：低温下的芯片一碰就裂
txt:qpu_brittle.en: THE STACK WAS TOUCHED BEFORE IT HAD WARMED: THE COLD CHIP CRACKED

txt:qpu_vibration.zh: 隔振台没锁，附近一动刀：振动传到芯片上
txt:qpu_vibration.en: THE ISOLATION TABLE WASN'T LOCKED: A CUT NEARBY SHOOK THE CHIP

txt:ring_twist.zh: 只刹一个环刹太久：整船被反扭，坞夹具超载，环毂设备受损
txt:ring_twist.en: ONE RING WAS BRAKED FAR AHEAD OF THE OTHER: THE HULL TWISTED, THE BERTH'S CLAMPS WERE OVERLOADED AND THE HUBS' EQUIPMENT DAMAGED

txt:ring_loads_live.zh: %s 环的负载还带电：消旋电机在往环内母线反送电，刹不下来（先断环内负载和滑环）
txt:ring_loads_live.en: RING %s'S LOADS ARE STILL LIVE: THE MOTOR-BRAKES ARE DRIVING BACK INTO ITS BUS AND WON'T SLOW IT (TAKE ITS LOADS AND THE SLIP RING OFF FIRST)

txt:ring_cap_full.zh: %s 环的制动电容满了：刹车没处放能量，先把电容泄放掉
txt:ring_cap_full.en: RING %s'S BRAKE CAPACITOR IS FULL: THE BRAKES HAVE NOWHERE TO PUT THE ENERGY, DUMP IT FIRST

txt:ring_brake_dry.zh: %s 环的制动器没开冷却在刹：越刹越烫
txt:ring_brake_dry.en: RING %s IS BRAKED WITH ITS COOLING OFF: THE BRAKES ARE HEATING

txt:ring_torque.zh: 两个环转速差太大：整船在被反扭，坞夹具受力报警
txt:ring_torque.en: THE TWO RINGS ARE TOO FAR APART IN SPEED: THE HULL IS BEING TWISTED, THE BERTH'S CLAMPS ARE OVERLOADED

txt:ta_turning.zh: %s 环还没锁轴承：转运气闸打不开
txt:ta_turning.en: RING %s'S BEARING ISN'T LOCKED: THE TRANSFER AIRLOCK WON'T OPEN

txt:ring_pin_aligned.zh: %s 环已盘到锁销孔：可以插锁销
txt:ring_pin_aligned.en: RING %s IS INCHED ROUND TO ITS PIN HOLE: THE PIN CAN GO IN

txt:ring_pin_miss.zh: %s 环锁销没对准孔：先开盘车把它转到对位
txt:ring_pin_miss.en: RING %s'S PIN MISSES ITS HOLE: INCH THE WHEEL ROUND FIRST

txt:ring_dump_done.zh: %s 环制动电容泄放完：制动器重新咬合
txt:ring_dump_done.en: RING %s'S BRAKE CAPACITOR DUMPED: THE BRAKES BITE AGAIN

txt:bearing_seized.zh: %s 环还在转就锁轴承：轴承咬死，环一下停住，滚子和轮辐里的设备撞坏
txt:bearing_seized.en: RING %s'S BEARING WAS LOCKED WITH IT STILL TURNING: IT SEIZED, THE RING STOPPED DEAD, ITS ROLLERS AND WHAT RODE THE SPOKES WERE SMASHED

txt:ring_brake_burn.zh: %s 环的制动器没冷却刹到过热：烧坏了
txt:ring_brake_burn.en: RING %s'S BRAKES RAN DRY TOO LONG: THEY BURNT OUT

txt:slip_arc.zh: %s 环带着负载刹车：滑环拉弧烧坏
txt:slip_arc.en: RING %s WAS BRAKED WITH ITS LOADS LIVE: THE SLIP RING ARCED AND BURNT

txt:ring_shock.zh: 环舱还有压就开了通向真空轮辐的门：气压冲击吹裂了温室玻璃
txt:ring_shock.en: A RING DOOR WAS OPENED ONTO A VACUUM SPOKE WITH THE RING STILL PRESSURISED: THE SHOCK CRACKED THE GREENHOUSE GLASS

txt:ring_fling.zh: %s 环还在转就切下了件：沿切线甩飞出去
txt:ring_fling.en: SOMETHING WAS CUT FREE OF RING %s WHILE IT STILL TURNED: IT WAS THROWN OFF ALONG THE RIM

txt:spine_tear.zh: %s 段弦杆超载：尾部重量压上来，主轴撕裂，尾段下垂扭转
txt:spine_tear.en: SEGMENT %s'S CHORDS WERE OVERLOADED: THE TAIL'S WEIGHT CAME ON THEM, THE SPINE TORE AND THE TAIL SAGGED AND TWISTED

txt:spine_strain.zh: %s 段剩下的弦杆受力很大：再切一根就要撕了
txt:spine_strain.en: SEGMENT %s'S REMAINING CHORDS ARE HEAVILY LOADED: ONE MORE CUT AND IT TEARS

txt:melt_short.zh: 融水积在带电的设备上：短路了
txt:melt_short.en: MELTWATER STOOD ON LIVE GEAR: IT SHORTED

txt:crack_run.zh: 鞍座还夹着就在裂纹上动了刀：裂纹扩展，冰体裂开
txt:crack_run.en: THE ICE WAS CUT ON THE CRACK WITH THE SEATS BESIDE IT STILL HOLDING: THE CRACK RAN AND THE ICE SPLIT

txt:ice_drop.zh: 冰还没融完就松了鞍座：冰体失去支撑，砸到发动机舱
txt:ice_drop.en: A SEAT LET GO WITH THE ICE STILL ON IT: THE ICE DROPPED ONTO THE ENGINE MODULE

txt:glass_craze.zh: 切割热量把旁边的精密罩板烤裂了
txt:glass_craze.en: THE BEAM'S HEAT CRAZED THE GLASS BESIDE IT

txt:prop_fire.zh: 推进剂被点着了：火顺着漏出来的液团烧过去！
txt:prop_fire.en: THE PROPELLANT CAUGHT: THE FIRE RUNS THROUGH THE SPILL!

txt:hyper_ignite.zh: 甲基肼碰上四氧化二氮：自燃了！
txt:hyper_ignite.en: MMH MET THE TETROXIDE: IT LIT ON CONTACT!

txt:fire_smothered.zh: 舱里的氧气烧光了，火自己灭了（燃料还在）。
txt:fire_smothered.en: THE ROOM'S OXYGEN IS GONE: THE FIRE IS OUT (THE FUEL ISN'T).

txt:doors_blown.en: THE PRESSURE BLEW THE DOORS OUT!

txt:o2_fire.zh: 富氧空气被切割引燃：整舱闪燃！
txt:o2_fire.en: THE CUT LIT THE OXYGEN-RICH AIR: THE HALL FLASHES OVER!

txt:hull_twist.zh: 船体扭了：一边的重物先拆走，另一边把船体拽歪了
txt:hull_twist.en: THE HULL TWISTS: ONE SIDE'S WEIGHT CAME OFF FIRST, THE OTHER PULLED IT OUT OF TRUE

txt:rail_locked.zh: 锁轨还锁着：货箱是轨道锁住的，不是螺栓
txt:rail_locked.en: THE RAIL IS LOCKED: THE BOX IS HELD BY THE RAIL, NOT A BOLT

txt:rail_released.zh: 锁轨松开：货箱沿轨道滑出
txt:rail_released.en: RAIL RELEASED: THE BOXES SLIDE OUT ALONG IT

txt:rail_cut.zh: 切到了还托着货箱的滑轨：货箱被一起扯坏
txt:rail_cut.en: CUT A RAIL STILL CARRYING A BOX: THE BOX IS WRENCHED WITH IT

txt:actuator_jerk.zh: %s 作动杆突然动作！控制线还带着电
txt:actuator_jerk.en: %s RAM JERKED! ITS CONTROL LINE WAS STILL LIVE

txt:mag_flooded.zh: 弹库注水：弹药不再怕热，但已经不值钱
txt:mag_flooded.en: MAGAZINE FLOODED: THE ROUNDS ARE SAFE, AND WORTH NOTHING

txt:psv_lift.zh: %s 安全阀起跳 · 货在往外排

txt:hopper_tear.zh: %s 被硬撬开：满仓矿石一边倒，矿仓焊缝撕裂
txt:hopper_tear.en: %s FORCED OPEN: THE FULL HOPPER DUMPS ONE WAY AND TEARS ITS WELDS

txt:ring_no_target.zh: 切割环要贴在龙骨、纵梁或轨道上
txt:ring_no_target.en: THE RING GOES ON A KEEL, BEAM OR RAIL

txt:ring_far.zh: 太远了：无人机要飞到 6 m 以内
txt:ring_far.en: TOO FAR: BRING THE DRONE WITHIN 6 M

txt:ring_ready.zh: 左键起爆  ·  右键 / Esc 收起
txt:ring_ready.en: CLICK TO FIRE  ·  RIGHT CLICK / ESC TO STOW

txt:ring_seek.zh: 移到龙骨、纵梁或轨道附近
txt:ring_seek.en: MOVE NEAR A KEEL, BEAM OR RAIL

txt:dv_inrush.en: TURBO PUMP ROTOR CRASHED BY INRUSH

txt:dv_leftover.en: LEFTOVERS NOT HANDLED: TAKEN AT A DISCOUNT

txt:in_valve_leak.zh: 交叉阀 %s 显示关闭但内漏：%s 一直在往支管里漏
txt:in_valve_leak.en: CROSS VALVE %s READS SHUT BUT LEAKS: %s KEEPS FEEDING ITS BRANCH

txt:in_pod_armed.zh: 救生舱 %s 的发射电路仍带电
txt:in_pod_armed.en: ESCAPE POD %s: ITS FIRING CIRCUIT IS STILL LIVE

txt:in_gate_jam.en: DISCHARGE GATE %s IS BENT AND STUCK

txt:in_psv_stuck.zh: %s 的安全阀冻结卡死，罐压已到 %d kPa，超过起跳压力
txt:in_psv_stuck.en: THE RELIEF VALVE ON %s IS FROZEN SHUT; THE TANK IS AT %d kPa, ABOVE ITS SET PRESSURE

txt:in_heater_live.zh: 冻结应急加热装置开着（自带电源），正在加热 %s
txt:in_heater_live.en: THE ANTI-FREEZE HEATER IS ON (ITS OWN SUPPLY), WARMING %s

txt:in_jacket_loss.zh: %s 的真空夹层进气，%d kPa，漏热快
txt:in_jacket_loss.en: THE VACUUM JACKET ROUND %s HAS LET AIR IN: %d kPa, IT LEAKS HEAT FAST

txt:in_wrong_valve.zh: 货舱实际压力 %d kPa；测压口 P-C01 的隔离阀 V-C01 关闭
txt:in_wrong_valve.en: HOLD AT %d kPa; TEST PORT P-C01 ISOLATED BY CLOSED V-C01

txt:in_fake_stop.zh: G-01 远程停机指令无效，发电机仍在运转
txt:in_fake_stop.en: G-01 IGNORES THE REMOTE STOP: STILL RUNNING

txt:in_hidden_tank.zh: 货舱内有一只未登记储气罐，%d kPa
txt:in_hidden_tank.en: UNDECLARED GAS BOTTLE IN THE HOLD AT %d kPa

txt:in_live_cargo.zh: %s 自带电源 230 V，接在船体插座上
txt:in_live_cargo.en: %s HAS ITS OWN 230 V SUPPLY, PLUGGED INTO THE HULL

txt:in_welded_hatch.zh: 货舱门门缝已焊死，舱门驱动不可用
txt:in_welded_hatch.en: CARGO HATCH SEAMS WELDED: THE DRIVE WILL NOT MOVE IT

txt:in_rerouted_line.zh: 冷却管 Q2 改道，走 D 舱顶板下方
txt:in_rerouted_line.en: COOLANT RUN Q2 REROUTED UNDER THE ENGINE ROOM ROOF

txt:in_second_source.zh: 尾部装有应急发电机 EG-01，独立向母线供电
txt:in_second_source.en: EMERGENCY GENERATOR EG-01 AT THE STERN FEEDS THE BUS

txt:in_hidden_damage.zh: 货舱顶板距船首约 %d m 处有结构暗伤
txt:in_hidden_damage.en: HOLD ROOF PLATE ABOUT %d m FROM THE BOW HAS A HIDDEN CRACK

txt:in_bio_breach.zh: 隔离舱 %s 负压阀失效：舱内 %d kPa，高于主廊，空气污染严重
txt:in_bio_breach.en: ISOLATION POD %s HAS LOST ITS NEGATIVE PRESSURE: %d kPa, ABOVE THE CORRIDOR, AIR BADLY CONTAMINATED

txt:in_fire_system.zh: 灭火剂储罐 FX-01 未释放，%d kPa
txt:in_fire_system.en: FIRE BOTTLE FX-01 NEVER DISCHARGED: %d kPa

nuke:_draw_ui:4.zh: 冲击掠过 · 尚未建成

nuke:_draw_card:1.zh: 堆 芯 核 爆

nuke:_draw_card:2.zh: 激光切穿了堆芯中心的核心。合同作废。
nuke:_draw_card:2.en: THE BEAM CUT THE CORE'S HEART. THE CONTRACT IS VOID.

txt:fa_rail_d.zh: 熔炉口装上导轨：现场按 M，把它沿长槽挪到无人机正下方
txt:fa_rail_d.en: THE FURNACE MOUTH ON A RAIL: PRESS M ON SITE TO RUN IT UNDER THE DRONE

txt:fa_net_d.zh: 自动收进碎屑网的碎片上限 0.1 t → 0.5 t
txt:fa_net_d.en: WHAT GOES STRAIGHT TO THE NET: 0.1 t → 0.5 t

txt:fa_berth120_d.zh: 地板、集料槽和吊臂再延长到约 120 m，83–114 m 的船从此可以接（要先有 88 m）
txt:fa_berth120_d.en: FLOOR, TROUGH AND BOOM ON TO ABOUT 120 m: SHIPS OF 83-114 m CAN BE TAKEN (NEEDS THE 88 m FIRST)

txt:fa_berth200_d.zh: 整条船坞延长到约 200 m，115–194 m 的大船从此可以接（要先有 120 m）
txt:fa_berth200_d.en: THE WHOLE BERTH TO ABOUT 200 m: BIG SHIPS OF 115-194 m CAN BE TAKEN (NEEDS THE 120 m FIRST)

txt:fa_berth620_d.zh: 整条船坞延长到约 620 m，整艘殖民舰可以进坞拆解（要先有 200 m）
txt:fa_berth620_d.en: THE WHOLE BERTH TO ABOUT 620 m: A WHOLE COLONY SHIP CAN COME IN (NEEDS THE 200 m FIRST)

txt:fa_berth_d.zh: 地板、集料槽和吊臂延长到约 88 m，58–82 m 的船从此可以接；回收口挪到中段
txt:fa_berth_d.en: FLOOR, TROUGH AND BOOM TO ABOUT 88 m: SHIPS OF 58–82 m CAN BE TAKEN; MOUTHS MOVE MID-BERTH

txt:fa_hauler_d.zh: 现场用 %s 给漂浮零件打标记，它自己送到该去的回收口（1.5 t 以内）
txt:fa_hauler_d.en: USE %s ON A FLOATING PIECE: IT TAKES IT TO THE RIGHT MOUTH (UP TO 1.5 t)

txt:fa_hauler2_d.zh: 和第一台分着搬同一张标记清单（需先有初级搬运无人机）
txt:fa_hauler2_d.en: WORKS THE SAME MARKS AS THE FIRST (NEEDS THE BASIC HAULER)

txt:fa_crane_d.zh: 船坞顶上的门式吊，12 t 以内整件吊走；用 %s 标记超过 1.5 t 的件
txt:fa_crane_d.en: OVERHEAD GANTRY: LIFTS UP TO 12 t WHOLE; USE %s TO MARK ANYTHING OVER 1.5 t FOR IT

txt:fa_port2_d.zh: 在船坞远端上方再开一个设备口，长船后半截不用绕远
txt:fa_port2_d.en: A SECOND EQUIPMENT MOUTH OVER THE FAR END: NO LONG TRIP FROM A LONG SHIP'S STERN

txt:fa_buffer_d.zh: 近端上方的停放台：放在上面的件被牵引场定住，等你或机器来取
txt:fa_buffer_d.en: A PARKING DECK OVER THE NEAR END: WHAT YOU LEAVE ON IT STAYS PUT

txt:fa_zones_d.zh: 现场按 K 划禁入区（最多 3 个），机械不进去；在区内再按 K 取消
txt:fa_zones_d.en: PRESS K TO SET A KEEP-OUT ZONE (UP TO 3) NO MACHINE ENTERS; K INSIDE ONE CLEARS IT

txt:fa_arm_d.zh: 悬臂自动把废金属送进熔炉（初级：慢、1 t 以内）
txt:fa_arm_d.en: THE BOOM FEEDS SCRAP TO THE FURNACE (BASIC: SLOW, UP TO 1 t)

txt:fa_drone2_d.zh: 搬运无人机：标记漂浮零件和回收口，它自己送
txt:fa_drone2_d.en: HAULER: TAG A FLOATING PART AND A MOUTH, IT DELIVERS

txt:fa_scan_d.en: HOVER SHOWS WHAT A PART IS WORTH

gear:fa_gas_line.zh: 气体线（净化分离 · 压缩）

gear:fa_gas_line_d.zh: 回收的混合气在加工区净化、分离成氧和氮；拆船抽回的气不再当场折现，而是成批入库。
gear:fa_gas_line_d.en: Recovered mixed gas is purified and split into oxygen and nitrogen; a ship's gas is kept as a batch, not cashed.

gear:fa_lox_tank_d.zh: 把氧液化存进 20 吨低温储罐，去交易行卖；储罐一直漏热，冷箱要有电。
gear:fa_lox_tank_d.en: Liquefies oxygen into a 20 t cryogenic tank to sell on the exchange; the tank leaks heat, the cold box needs power.

txt:rt_all_done.en: EVERYTHING ON THE ROUTE IS YOURS

txt:rt_market_after.zh: 做完主线第一单后开放
txt:rt_market_after.en: Opens after the first story job

txt:rt_tier_d.zh: 每种技能的这一卷都要攒够完成的合同和声望才能买
txt:rt_tier_d.en: Every skill's volume needs enough jobs done and reputation first

txt:rt_ship_then.zh: 条件都达到后，这种船就会出现在合同市场
txt:rt_ship_then.en: Once every condition is met, this type turns up on the contract market

txt:rt_ship_done.zh: 已经会出现在合同市场 · 拆过 %d 艘
txt:rt_ship_done.en: Already on the contract market · stripped %d

txt:rt_ship_tug.zh: 小船入门：电池、氧气、燃料管线
txt:rt_ship_tug.en: A small first job: battery, oxygen, fuel line

txt:rt_ship_s09.zh: 紧凑布局、精密设备、高价值小件
txt:rt_ship_s09.en: Compact layout, precision equipment, small valuable parts

txt:rt_ship_gr7.zh: 标准货船：货舱、货柜、冷却与燃料系统
txt:rt_ship_gr7.en: The standard freighter: hold, containers, cooling and fuel

txt:rt_ship_pod.zh: 整舱货柜，危险品要走危险品口
txt:rt_ship_pod.en: A hold of containers; hazardous cargo goes to the hazard port

txt:rt_ship_h22.zh: 外置双拖臂、液压站与蓄能器、残磁拖头
txt:rt_ship_h22.en: Twin outboard tow arms, hydraulics and accumulator, magnetised tow heads

txt:rt_ship_m14.zh: 超重设备、结构拆分、松散矿物
txt:rt_ship_m14.en: Overweight equipment, structural splitting, loose ore

txt:rt_ship_fr26.zh: 储罐温度、低温设备、热交换
txt:rt_ship_fr26.en: Tank temperatures, cryogenic equipment, heat exchange

txt:rt_ship_med47.zh: 12 个独立医疗舱、多隔离区
txt:rt_ship_med47.en: Twelve sealed medical bays, several isolation zones

txt:tm_needs.zh: 需要先完成以下区域的修缮：%s

txt:tm_onsite_note.zh: 技能书立即装配；原设备与设施下一单生效。Esc 回到作业
txt:tm_onsite_note.en: MANUAL VOLUMES FIT NOW; EQUIPMENT AND FACILITIES FIT NEXT JOB. Esc BACK TO WORK

txt:tm_onsite_no.en: NOT IN THE MIDDLE OF A JOB

txt:tm_next_d.zh: 主线开局的下一单，随时可以接；想先做旁边的合同也行，它一直留在这里。
txt:tm_next_d.en: The opening's next job: take it whenever you like. It stays pinned here while you work the other offers.

txt:tm_lock_equip.zh: 设备和设施下一单才生效：两单之间开放
txt:tm_lock_equip.en: Equipment and facilities fit next job: open between jobs

txt:tm_tile_route.zh: 接下来能解锁的船、设备和设施
txt:tm_tile_route.en: SHIPS, EQUIPMENT AND FACILITIES TO COME

txt:tm_keys_berth.zh: 1–4 应用 · ←→↑↓ 选择 · Enter 确认 · O 设置 · Esc 回首页 / 回到船坞
txt:tm_keys_berth.en: 1–4 APPS · ARROWS CHOOSE · Enter CONFIRM · O SETTINGS · Esc HOME / BACK TO THE BERTH

txt:tm_next_first_d.zh: 开局第一单由船坞指派；拆完它合同市场就开放，之后可以自己挑船。
txt:tm_next_first_d.en: The first job is assigned. Once it is done the contract market opens and you pick your own ships.

txt:tm_st_3.zh: 账本  资金 / 贷款 / 应付 ......... 正常

txt:tm_st_4.zh: 市场数据  合同报价 ............... 正常

txt:tm_next_side.zh: 开工前可以按 2 打开「船坞」修设施，按 3 打开「拆法与建设」学新拆法、修港区；带哪些部署工具，在开工时的出勤配装里选。
txt:tm_next_side.en: Before you start: 2 opens BERTH to mend facilities, 3 opens METHODS & BUILD to learn methods and build the port; the tools you take are picked on the loadout page as the job starts.

txt:tm_keys_onsite.zh: 1–4 应用 · ←→↑↓ 选择 · Enter 确认 · Esc 回首页 / 回到作业
txt:tm_keys_onsite.en: 1–4 APPS · ARROWS CHOOSE · Enter CONFIRM · Esc HOME / BACK TO WORK

txt:tm_task_full.zh: 拆完整艘船：指定设备完整送设备口，其余分类送对回收口
txt:tm_task_full.en: THE WHOLE SHIP: NAMED EQUIPMENT WHOLE TO THE EQUIPMENT MOUTH, THE REST SORTED

txt:tm_found_v.zh: 星图扫描找到 · 拖运费 %s · 已拖进港
txt:tm_found_v.en: FOUND IN THE BELT · TOW %s · TOWED IN

The cost: no cash for it, and it does not count as structure tonnes for repairs. Equipment, hazards and contaminated pieces go as usual.
