star_map:_fill:1.zh: 没有船在路上。交易行里向独立商户买卖，货船会从他们的小行星带站点起航。
star_map:_fill:1.en: No ships under way. Trade with an independent merchant on the exchange and a freighter leaves their belt station.

star_map:_detail:1.zh: 第 %d 天 · 在途 %d · 排队 %d · 靠泊 %d · 码头船位 %d

star_map:_detail:2.zh: 点一艘船看它的轨道、Δv 和货。
star_map:_detail:2.en: Click a ship for its orbit, Δv and cargo.

star_map:_detail:4.zh: 转移 %d 天 · 出发 Δv %.1f km/s · 到达 Δv %.1f km/s
star_map:_detail:4.en: TRANSFER %d DAYS · Δv OUT %.1f km/s · IN %.1f km/s

star_map:_detail:6.zh: 用抓钩拖进仓库收货口（货运区修好后吊车自动搬 3 t 以下的件）
star_map:_detail:6.en: grapple them into the warehouse receiver (the crane does pieces under 3 t once the cargo district is mended)

star_map:_detail:7.zh: 从出货台拖进它的货舱
star_map:_detail:7.en: drag them from the loading table into its hold

star_map:_draw_frame:1.zh: 日心坐标 · 第 %.1f 天 · 1 秒 = %.1f 天

star_map:_pick_hover:4.zh: 可以扫描 · 点一下选中

star_map:_find_detail:1.zh: 选一片扇区，点“扫描”。扫完会收到几个信号，有的只是石头；选一个信号“分析电磁特征”，才知道是不是船。
star_map:_find_detail:1.en: Pick a sector and sweep it. Some signals are only rock: analyse one to learn whether it is a hulk.

star_map:_find_detail:3.zh: 船坞放不下：先把船坞扩长

star_map:_fill_find:1.zh: %s 已到港 · 去船坞开工
star_map:_fill_find:1.en: %s DOCKED · START STRIPPING IT IN THE BERTH

star_map:_fill_find:4.zh: 还有 %d 片扇区太远：修好拖船站、贸易区能扫得更远。

star_map:_fill_find:7.zh: 当前扇区：%s%s　　切换扇区 ▾

star_map:_fill_find:12.zh: 分析 %s 的电磁特征（约 %d 秒）

star_map:_fill_find:14.zh: 在路上 %d 艘 · 最快约 %d 秒

star_map:_fill_find:15.zh: 在路上 %d 艘 · 最快约 %d 秒

star_map:sig_state:1.zh: 拖运途中 · 约 %d 秒到港

star_map:sig_state:2.zh: 已到港 · 在拖船区等着拆
star_map:sig_state:2.en: DOCKED · WAITING IN THE TUG YARD

star_map:sig_state:3.zh: 已到港 · 港务扣留 · 去二手船市“我的船”付清放行
star_map:sig_state:3.en: DOCKED · HELD BY THE PORT · PAY IT UNDER HULK MARKET · MY SHIPS

star_map:_done_line:2.zh: · 它那一行变成了“派拖船”按钮
star_map:_done_line:2.en: · ITS ROW IS NOW THE TUG BUTTON

star_map:next_line:2.zh: 拖船在路上，约 %d 秒到港。
star_map:next_line:2.en: THE TUG IS ON ITS WAY, ~%d s.

star_map:next_line:3.zh: 下一步：点 %s 那一行，派拖船去拖（%s）。
star_map:next_line:3.en: NEXT: CLICK %s'S ROW TO SEND THE TUG (%s).

star_map:next_line:4.zh: 下一步：%s附近找到的 %s，在下面“别的扇区找到的船”里派拖船去拖（%s）。
star_map:next_line:4.en: NEXT: THE HULK FOUND NEAR %s (%s): SEND THE TUG BELOW (%s).

star_map:next_line:5.en: THE YARD IS FULL: THIS ONE WAITS.

star_map:next_line:7.zh: 下一步：点一个信号（越强越像船），再点“分析”。
star_map:next_line:7.en: NEXT: PICK A SIGNAL (STRONGER IS LIKELIER), THEN ANALYSE IT.

star_map:next_line:8.zh: 检测到新目标进入扇区，请重新扫描。
star_map:next_line:8.en: NEW TARGETS IN THE SECTOR: SWEEP AGAIN.

star_map:next_line:9.zh: 这片没有船。约 %d 秒后有新东西漂进来，或换一片扫。
star_map:next_line:9.en: NO HULK HERE. NEW DRIFT IN ~%d s, OR SWEEP ANOTHER.

star_map:next_line:10.zh: 下一步：选一片扇区（最近的已选好），点“扫描”。
star_map:next_line:10.en: NEXT: PICK A SECTOR (THE NEAREST IS PICKED), SWEEP IT.

star_map:_tour_steps:2.zh: 它沿虚线飞到那艘船，挂上缆，拖着它沿原路回港。实线是走过的路。
star_map:_tour_steps:2.en: It flies the dashes to the hulk, takes it in tow and brings it home the same way. The solid line is behind it.

star_map:_tour_steps:4.zh: 这一行一直在倒数，现在约 %d 秒。
star_map:_tour_steps:4.en: This line counts down: about %d s now.

star_map:_tour_steps:5.en: CLOSE IT: THE TUG FLIES ON

star_map:_tour_steps:6.zh: 到港时屏幕上方弹一张卡，按 %s 打开终端，在它的卡上点“开工拆”。（只有终端打开时游戏暂停）

star_map:_tour_steps:8.zh: 没人要的废船都漂在小行星带里。左边这张图就是太阳系：中间是太阳，那一圈是小行星带，亮点是各个站。
star_map:_tour_steps:8.en: Abandoned hulks drift in the asteroid belt. This is the system: the sun in the middle, the belt around it, the stations as points.

star_map:_tour_steps:10.zh: 小行星带分成一片一片。开局只能扫离港最近的 3 片，修好拖船站、贸易区能扫得更远。
star_map:_tour_steps:10.en: The belt is cut into sectors. At first only the 3 nearest can be swept; the tug station and the trade district reach further.

star_map:_tour_steps:12.zh: 向选中的扇区发一道雷达波，约 %d 秒，不花钱。
star_map:_tour_steps:12.en: A radar sweep over the picked sector: about %d s, free.

star_map:_tour_steps:14.zh: 扫完出现几个信号，只知道强弱：可能是船，也可能只是石头。
star_map:_tour_steps:14.en: A few signals show up, strength only: a hulk, or just rock.

star_map:_tour_steps:16.zh: 点一个信号再点“分析电磁特征”（约 %d 秒）：看清是不是船、多长、漂了多少年、拖回来要多少钱。
star_map:_tour_steps:16.en: Pick a signal and analyse it (~%d s): whether it is a hulk, how long, how old, what the tow costs.

star_map:_tour_steps:18.zh: 认出是船的那一行会变成“派拖船去拖”按钮。点它，星图上看得见拖船飞过去、拖着船回来。第一趟免费。
star_map:_tour_steps:18.en: A signal analysed as a hulk becomes a tug button. Click it and watch the tug fly out and tow it home. The first is free.

star_map:_tour_steps:20.zh: 港里能停几艘等着拆的船。满了就要先拆完一艘，或扩建拖船站。
star_map:_tour_steps:20.en: How many hulks can wait at the port. Full, strip one first or extend the tug station.

star_map:tour_card:1.zh: 点一下或按空格：下一项 · Esc 跳过
star_map:tour_card:1.en: CLICK OR SPACE: NEXT · ESC SKIPS

star_map:tour_card:2.zh: 照着做，完成后自动继续 · Esc 跳过
star_map:tour_card:2.en: DO IT: THE TOUR GOES ON BY ITSELF · ESC SKIPS

star_map:tour_card:4.zh: 正在扫描，扫完会出现几个信号。
star_map:tour_card:4.en: Sweeping: a few signals show up when it is done.

star_map:tour_card:6.zh: 正在分析 %s 的电磁特征，分析完就知道是不是船。
star_map:tour_card:6.en: Analysing %s: done, it says whether it is a hulk.

star_map:tour_card:8.zh: 这片的信号都看过了，都不是船。换一片扇区再扫描。
star_map:tour_card:8.en: Every signal here is rock. Pick another sector and sweep it.

star_map:_send:2.zh: 拖运费 %s 先赊着，下次结算扣。
star_map:_send:2.en: THE %s TOW IS ON CREDIT TILL THE NEXT SETTLEMENT.

star_map:_draw_inset:3.zh: 检测到新目标 · 建议重新扫描

tow_traffic:start:1.zh: 拖船把 %s 拖回来了，停进拖船站外的泊位。它被港口扣留，付清才能开拆。按 Esc 跳过。
tow_traffic:start:1.en: The tug is bringing %s in to the tug yard. The port holds it until paid. Esc skips.

tow_traffic:start:2.zh: 拖船把 %s 拖回来了，停进拖船站外的泊位。按 Esc 跳过。
tow_traffic:start:2.en: The tug is bringing %s in to the tug yard. Esc skips.

tug_yard:block:1.zh: 拖船站泊位满了（%d / %d）：先拆掉一艘，或扩建拖船站
tug_yard:block:1.en: THE TUG YARD IS FULL (%d / %d): STRIP ONE, OR BUILD ON THE TUG STATION

tug_yard:block:2.zh: 拖船拖不动 %.0f m 的船（现在最长 %.0f m）：先修拖船站
tug_yard:block:2.en: THE TUGS CANNOT TOW %.0f m (UP TO %.0f m NOW): MEND THE TUG STATION

gear:pt_access_gate.zh: 港区航道 ↑ 通往中央转运环

gear:pt_access_hint.zh: 空船坞：%s 接单 · 沿上方青色航道前往零压港 · %s 查看全景
gear:pt_access_hint.en: EMPTY BERTH: %s CONTRACTS · FOLLOW THE CYAN EXIT TO THE PORT · %s PANORAMA

gear:pt_cargo_1.zh: 货运区的调度台复工：出场配装多一个部署工具槽。
gear:pt_cargo_1.en: The cargo district's dispatch desk back at work: one more deploy slot on a job.

gear:pt_effect_cargo.zh: 货运区支持出勤装配与物资调度。
gear:pt_effect_cargo.en: The cargo district supports field loadouts and supply dispatch.

gear:pt_built.zh: 施工队开工了：%s（%s期）。修好之前还不能用。
gear:pt_built.en: THE CREW HAS STARTED ON THE %s, PART %s. NOT USABLE UNTIL IT IS DONE.

gear:pt_power_1.zh: 接通主电网的第一回路：动力区点亮一半，高耗能设施有了电源。
gear:pt_power_1.en: The first loop of the main grid: half the district lit, power for the heavy facilities.

gear:pt_power_2.zh: 全网供电：动力区全亮，转运环有了底电。
gear:pt_power_2.en: The whole grid: the district fully lit, base power for the ring.

gear:pt_salvage_1.zh: 修复拆船区的码头结构：贸易区可以开工了。
gear:pt_salvage_1.en: The salvage district's quays repaired: the trade district can be built.

gear:pt_salvage_2.zh: 拆船区重开第二泊位的基座（第二泊位在终局版本启用）。
gear:pt_salvage_2.en: The footing of a second berth (the berth itself comes with the final version).

gear:pt_process_1.zh: 加工区复工：电弧炉、分选台和轧机可以用了。
gear:pt_process_1.en: The processing district back at work: the arc furnace, the sorting line and the mill.

gear:pt_tug_1.zh: 自家拖船 TG-1 修好：泊位 2 个，能拖 88 m 的船；TG-1 待命时拖运费半价。
gear:pt_tug_1.en: Your own tug TG-1: two berths, ships up to 88 m; half the tow while TG-1 stands by.

gear:pt_tug_2.zh: 第二艘自家拖船 TG-2：泊位 4 个，船长不限。
gear:pt_tug_2.en: A second tug, TG-2: four berths, any length.

gear:pt_trade_1.zh: 贸易港重开一条航线：完整设备多卖 10%。
gear:pt_trade_1.en: One trade lane reopened: whole equipment sells 10 % better.

gear:pt_trade_2.zh: 贸易港全开：完整设备多卖 20%，三星合同更多。
gear:pt_trade_2.en: The trade port open: equipment sells 20 % better, more three-star contracts.

gear:pt_ring_1.zh: 中央转运环通电：剩下的两台驱动带着转盘慢慢转，各区之间开始转运货物。
gear:pt_ring_1.en: The ring powered: the two drives left turn the carousel slowly, and goods start moving between the districts.

gear:pt_ring_2.zh: 装回四台驱动和冷却，转盘全速转：大型星舰可以进港（终局在下一版本）。
gear:pt_ring_2.en: All four drives and the coolers back: the carousel at full speed, and great ships may come in (the ending comes with the next version).

gear:pt_effect_power.zh: 动力区是高耗能设施的前提。
gear:pt_effect_power.en: The power district is the prerequisite of the heavy facilities.

gear:pt_effect_salvage.zh: 拆船区决定港口能停几艘船。
gear:pt_effect_salvage.en: The salvage district decides how many ships the port can hold.

gear:pt_effect_process.zh: 加工区决定废金属的价钱。
gear:pt_effect_process.en: The processing district decides what scrap pays.

gear:pt_effect_tug.zh: 拖船站坏着时每单扣 $1,500 拖运费。
gear:pt_effect_tug.en: While the tug station is down every contract pays a $1,500 towing fee.

gear:pt_effect_trade.zh: 贸易港决定完整设备的售价和合同质量。
gear:pt_effect_trade.en: The trade port decides what equipment sells for and the contracts offered.

gear:pt_effect_ring.zh: 转运环是整个港口复兴的终点。
gear:pt_effect_ring.en: The ring is where the port's revival ends.

gear:tram_title.zh: 接驳车 T-1 · 目的地

gear:tram_sub.zh: 选一站：车先开到你这里接你，再沿走廊经中央环开过去，到站自动下车。
gear:tram_sub.en: PICK A STOP: THE CAR COMES TO YOU, RUNS THE CORRIDORS VIA THE HUB AND LETS YOU OFF.

cargo_art:still:2.zh: 叉车通道 限速 5 km/h

cargo_art:plates:1.zh: 在途 %d 单 · 叉车 %d 台

cargo_art:hover_items:4.zh: 四层托盘货架，每层一排、各有用途。货物按真实库存放在对应的排上：%s。

cargo_art:hover_items:6.zh: 飞到下面的货架口按 E 只看这一侧的货；在业务终端可以改每一排的用途。
cargo_art:hover_items:6.en: E at the mouth below opens this side's racks only; the business console changes what each row holds.

cargo_art:hover_items:8.zh: 从地面舱口开到对应货架下，门架三级伸缩把货叉升到那一层，取货或上架后降下开回。出库和送料要等它把货搬到舱口。%s时开得慢。

cargo_art:hover_items:9.zh: 货运区升到 1 级有两台叉车，2 级开得更快。
cargo_art:hover_items:9.en: Stage 1 of the cargo district gives two trucks, stage 2 faster ones.

cargo_art:hover_items:11.zh: 库存有变化时，从舱口把货吊上对应的货架（或从货架吊下），吊具随起停轻轻摆动。
cargo_art:hover_items:11.en: When the stock changes it lifts the goods from the hatch up to their row (or down from it), the spreader swinging a little as it starts and stops.

cargo_art:hover_items:16.zh: 货物从下面的货场经这里进出仓库：叉车到舱口交接时舱门打开，升降台把货送上来或降下去。
cargo_art:hover_items:16.en: Goods come in and leave through here from the yard below: as a truck hands over, the doors open and the lift brings the goods up or takes them down.

cargo_art:hover_items:21.zh: 八排货架各自的用途、存量和正在进行的出入库，数据都是实时的。
cargo_art:hover_items:21.en: Each of the eight rows' use, what it holds and the moves under way, live.

cargo_art:hover_items:23.en: Change a row's use at the business console.

console_art:summary:5.zh: 动力区业务：看全港发电和用电，打开动力控制屏（单线图、仪表、电不够时谁先用、供电线路）。
console_art:summary:5.en: The power district's business: the port's power made and used, and the power control screen (lines, gauges, who comes first, the supply line).

console_art:summary:9.zh: 贸易港业务：打开交易行买入卖出，接待开船来的客人。
console_art:summary:9.en: The trade port's business: the exchange to buy and sell, and the visitors who come in.

console_art:summary:10.zh: 客人 %d 位 · 交货中 %d 笔

console_art:summary:11.zh: 飞到台前按 [%s] 打开；平时任何地方按 F8 也能开交易行。
console_art:summary:11.en: At the console press [%s]; F8 opens the exchange anywhere.

console_art:summary:14.zh: 货运区业务：公司仓库的库存、在途货物和货位。
console_art:summary:14.en: The cargo district's business: the company's stock, goods in transit, the rows.

console_art:summary:15.zh: 库存 %.1f t · 叉车任务 %d

console_art:summary:19.zh: 拖船站业务：调度自家拖船，把大船拖进港。
console_art:summary:19.en: The tug station's business: the company's tugs, big ships towed in.

console_art:summary:30.zh: 加工区业务：炉次与加工队列，钢锭变成钢坯。轧机在它自己的操作台上开。
console_art:summary:30.en: The processing district's business: heats and the processing queue. The mill is run at its own console.

console_art:summary:33.zh: 港口总览：七个区、现金、待办，船坞终端（合同与建设）。
console_art:summary:33.en: The port at a glance: the districts, cash, what to do, and the berth terminal.

district_interiors:_desk_items:2.zh: 电弧炉的操作台：投炉、熔炼、出钢，看功率和电价。挡板后的观察窗随炉火发亮。
district_interiors:_desk_items:2.en: The arc furnace's desk: charge, melt, tap; the power and its price. The viewing port glows with the fire.

district_interiors:_desk_items:3.zh: 飞到台前按 %s 打开炉体操作。

district_interiors:_desk_items:5.zh: 分选线的操作台：把混合废料分成铁、有色和弃料。急停拉绳沿着线拉过去。
district_interiors:_desk_items:5.en: The sorting line's desk: mixed scrap into iron, non-ferrous and reject. The stop cord runs along the line.

district_interiors:_desk_items:6.zh: 飞到台前按 %s 打开分选操作。

district_interiors:_desk_items:8.zh: 光谱仪读出一批料的铁和杂质含量，转盘上是样品杯。化验过的料卖价更准。
district_interiors:_desk_items:8.en: The spectrometer reads a lot's iron and impurity; the carousel holds the sample cups. An assayed lot sells at its true worth.

district_interiors:_desk_items:11.zh: 飞到台前按 %s 打开化验。

district_interiors:_desk_items:13.zh: 船坞的电脑：接合同、买装备、管船坞和成长建设。和随时按 %s 打开的是同一台。
district_interiors:_desk_items:13.en: The berth's computer: contracts, gear, the berth and its growth. The same one %s opens anywhere.

district_interiors:_desk_items:14.zh: 飞到它前面按 %s 打开。

district_interiors:_desk_items:16.zh: 主仓库在货运区，这台小终端用线缆连过去。拆回来的东西都在公司仓库里：在这里可以卖给回收站，或者留着。
district_interiors:_desk_items:16.en: The main stores are in the cargo district; this little terminal is wired to them. Everything off the ships is in the company stores: sell it to the recycling station here, or keep it.

district_interiors:_desk_items:18.zh: 飞到终端前按 %s 打开仓库。之后在哪都能按 F3。
district_interiors:_desk_items:18.en: At the terminal press %s. Then F3 anywhere.

district_interiors:_desk_items:20.zh: 拆下来留着的零件放在这里，一格一件。货运区修好后零件改放仓库货架。
district_interiors:_desk_items:20.en: The parts kept from the ships, one to a cubby. Once the cargo district is mended they live on its racks.

district_interiors:_desk_items:22.zh: 飞到架前按 %s 打开零件架。

district_panel:_ready:5.zh: 展开或收起动力区的详细数字
district_panel:_ready:5.en: Show or hide the power district's figures

district_panel:_ready:8.zh: 轧机在本区域中间，就在排烟管右边。飞到轧机下方的操作台，按 %s 打开控制界面，选择配方以后就可以开始轧制了。
district_panel:_ready:8.en: The mill stands mid-district, right of the flue: press %s at its pedestal to pick a recipe and roll.

district_panel:_ready:9.zh: 气体回收 → 气体分离 → 液氧生产 → 补给使用
district_panel:_ready:9.en: GAS LINE · RECOVER → SEPARATE → LOX → SUPPLY

district_panel:_ready:13.zh: 在船坞的仓库终端或者货架入口按 %s，就能打开仓库界面。你也可以在任何位置按 F3 打开，查看的都是同一个仓库，回收的货物会自动存放进去。
district_panel:_ready:13.en: %s at the berth's stores terminal or a rack, or F3 anywhere: the same stores page. Goods are put away by themselves.

district_panel:_ready:15.zh: 走到货架入口，按 %s 就能打开对应的货架。左侧是 A1–A4，右侧是 B1–B4。

power_station_art:hover_items:1.zh: 扩建动力区（船坞终端 → 成长与建设 → 零压港 → 动力区）。
power_station_art:hover_items:1.en: Build on the power district (berth terminal → growth → the port → power).

power_station_art:hover_items:3.zh: 留给第 3 套机组的屏蔽隔间：现在只有脚手架和盖板。
power_station_art:hover_items:3.en: The shielded bay kept for a third unit: scaffold and cover plates for now.

power_station_art:hover_items:4.zh: 动力区第 2 期装上第 3 套机组，容量从 30 MW 升到 80 MW。
power_station_art:hover_items:4.en: Power stage 2 fits the third unit: 30 MW becomes 80 MW.

power_station_art:hover_items:6.zh: 压水堆：堆芯的热把一回路的水加热到三百多度（高压不沸腾），在蒸汽发生器里把二回路的水烧成蒸汽去推汽轮机。控制棒抽出越多，堆越热。稳压器保持压力，主泵让水循环。
power_station_art:hover_items:6.en: A pressurised-water reactor: the core heats the primary water past 300 °C (kept liquid by pressure); the steam generator boils the secondary water to drive the turbine. The further out the rods, the hotter the core. The pressuriser holds the pressure; the main pump circulates.

power_station_art:hover_items:7.zh: 不用操作：棒位自动跟着全港用电走。
power_station_art:hover_items:7.en: Nothing to do: the rods follow the port's load by themselves.

power_station_art:hover_items:8.zh: 修好动力区（第 1 期）就会启动。
power_station_art:hover_items:8.en: Mending the power district (stage 1) starts it.

power_station_art:hover_items:10.zh: 蒸汽经主汽门、调节阀进高压缸、低压缸推动转子，带发电机发电。负荷一加上，转速和频率先往下掉，调节阀开大补上，几秒后回到 50 Hz。
power_station_art:hover_items:10.en: Steam through the stop and governor valves drives the HP and LP casings and the generator. A load put on drops the speed and frequency until the governor valve opens to match; in a few seconds it is back at 50 Hz.

power_station_art:hover_items:11.zh: 在业务终端的动力控制屏可以给电弧炉设功率上限、排%s时的先后顺序。

power_station_art:hover_items:13.zh: 把汽轮机排出的蒸汽冷成水，再由给水泵送回蒸汽发生器。它的热由散热回路带到外面的散热板排到太空。
power_station_art:hover_items:13.en: Turns the turbine's exhaust back into water for the feed pumps; its heat goes by the radiator loop to the radiators outside, out into space.

power_station_art:hover_items:16.zh: 氢氧燃料电池，最多 6 MW：动力区没修好时全港靠它，修好后转为备用。
power_station_art:hover_items:16.en: Hydrogen-oxygen fuel cells, up to 6 MW: the port lives on them until the power district is mended, then they stand by.

power_station_art:hover_items:19.zh: 把冷凝器里的凝结水加压送回蒸汽发生器：两台运行一台备用，振动偏高时自动切换。
power_station_art:hover_items:19.en: Pump the condensate back into the steam generators: two run, one stands by, changed over automatically when one vibrates.

power_station_art:hover_items:20.zh: 不用操作：切换是自动的，不影响供电。
power_station_art:hover_items:20.en: Nothing to do: the changeover is automatic and the supply carries on.

power_station_art:hover_items:22.zh: 推动散热回路：把冷凝器的热送到两侧吊臂上的散热板。太空里没有空气和水，热只能辐射出去。
power_station_art:hover_items:22.en: Drive the radiator loop: the condenser's heat out to the radiators on the booms. In vacuum heat can only be radiated away.

power_station_art:hover_items:23.zh: 不用操作。站外看散热板越红，排的热越多。
power_station_art:hover_items:23.en: Nothing to do. Outside, the redder the radiators, the more heat goes out.

power_station_art:hover_items:25.zh: 全港的电从这里分出去：发电机和电池泊位的电进来，再每区一条线送出去。哪个区开始用电，它的开关就合上（I），表针指着它现在用的电。
power_station_art:hover_items:25.en: Where the port's power is shared out: the units' incomer, the shore incomer, then a feeder for each district. A district starting to draw closes its breaker (I); its ammeter shows what it draws.

power_station_art:hover_items:26.zh: 全港在用 %.1f · 自家发 %.1f 兆瓦

power_station_art:hover_items:27.zh: %s时谁先用：业务终端 → 动力控制屏里调顺序，发电机不够时到供电屏买电池块。

power_station_art:hover_items:29.zh: 整座电站的读数：输出 / 容量、频率、堆热功率、蒸汽、冷凝器、散热板、电池，以及最近几次自动切换。
power_station_art:hover_items:29.en: The plant in figures: out against capacity, frequency, reactor heat, steam, condenser, radiators, shore power, and the last automatic changeovers.

power_station_art:hover_items:30.zh: 详细控制在下面的业务终端（按 B 附近打开）。
power_station_art:hover_items:30.en: The controls are at the business console below.

process_art:hover_items:2.zh: 跑在观察廊下面的桥式天车。电弧炉料仓里有废钢在等时，它从左边的料篮架吊起料篮，送到电弧炉右侧的加料口上方，料篮里的废钢随加料一点点变少，加完把空篮送回去；换模时它把模具在出钢口下的座和模具架之间对换。
process_art:hover_items:2.en: The bridge crane running under the gallery. While scrap waits in the furnace's bunker it lifts the charging basket off its stand on the left, hangs it over the furnace's side chute and lets the scrap feed in, then takes the empty basket back; on a mould change it swaps the blocks between the seat under the tap and the rack.

process_art:hover_items:3.zh: 不用操作。往电弧炉加料、排了换模，它就会去吊。
process_art:hover_items:3.en: Nothing to do: it lifts when the furnace is charged or a mould change is due.

process_art:hover_items:5.zh: 把废钢熔成钢水。三根石墨电极从炉盖伸进去起弧（满功率 24 MW），钢水到出钢温度后炉体倾转，从偏心底出钢口浇进右边座上的模具，冷却后顶出成坯。
process_art:hover_items:5.en: Melts scrap into steel: three graphite electrodes strike arcs through the roof (24 MW flat out); at tapping heat the vessel tilts and taps from its eccentric bottom hole into the mould in the seat on the right, where the pieces cool and are pushed out.

process_art:hover_items:6.zh: 在观察廊上的炉体操作台（E）打开加工队列。
process_art:hover_items:6.en: The furnace console on the gallery (E) opens the processing queue.

process_art:hover_items:8.zh: 把港区电网的高压降成电弧需要的大电流低电压，经铜母线和水冷电缆送到电极横臂。散热风扇随负载加速。
process_art:hover_items:8.en: Steps the port's high voltage down to the arcs' heavy current, through the copper bus and the water-cooled cables to the electrode arms. Its fans speed up with the load.

process_art:hover_items:10.zh: 不用操作。动力区的供电决定电弧炉能开多大功率。
process_art:hover_items:10.en: Nothing to do; the power district's supply sets how hard the furnace can burn.

process_art:hover_items:12.zh: 电弧炉的烟气经炉顶烟罩和行车梁下的排烟道进来，滤袋截住粉尘，脉冲喷吹按顺序把灰抖进灰斗，引风机把净化后的气从后墙排出去。
process_art:hover_items:12.en: The furnace's fume comes along the duct under the crane's runway; the bags catch the dust, pulses shake it down in turn into the hopper, and the fan sends the clean air out through the back wall.

process_art:hover_items:15.zh: 不用操作，跟电弧炉一起运行。
process_art:hover_items:15.en: Nothing to do; it runs with the furnace.

process_art:hover_items:17.zh: 钢坯先在加热炉里烧透，开轧时炉门升起、推钢机把它推上进料辊道；除鳞喷水打掉氧化皮，四辊轧机把它轧成钢板或型材，在出料辊道上冷却后入库。
process_art:hover_items:17.en: A billet heats through in the reheating furnace; at the pass the door lifts and the pusher sends it out onto the feed table, the descaler blasts its scale off, the four-high stand rolls it into plate or sections, and it cools on the run-out on its way to the racks.

process_art:hover_items:18.zh: 在观察廊上的轧机操作台（E）选配方、开轧；钢坯从货运区自动送来。
process_art:hover_items:18.en: At the mill console on the gallery (E) pick the recipe and roll; billets come up from the cargo district.

process_works:furnace_state:7.zh: 有料 · 等按『通电熔化』

shelf_panel:_fill:1.en: Choose what this row of racks holds: takes effect at once

trade_hall_art:_booths_moving:4.en: We have %s at %s/t, %.1f t in stock.

trade_hall_art:board:1.zh: 报价大屏 · 港内三家与小行星带商人
trade_hall_art:board:1.en: QUOTES · THE PORT'S THREE AND THE BELT'S MERCHANTS

trade_hall_art:signs:6.zh: 货单 %d 张在途 · 上一批过磅 %.2f t

trade_hall_art:signs:7.zh: 修复件 · 收 %s 还要 %.1f t

trade_hall_art:ticker:1.zh: 成交 · 今天还没有成交

trade_hall_art:hover_items:2.zh: 整个港口每样货的最高收价、最低卖价、上次成交价，每分钟记一点的走势，以及买卖两边各挂了多少吨。
trade_hall_art:hover_items:2.en: Every goods' best bid, best ask and last price at the port, its trend one point a minute, and how many tonnes are bid and offered.

trade_hall_art:hover_items:4.zh: 看准价差再去柜台或终端（F8）买卖。蓝线高过平时就是卖的好时候。
trade_hall_art:hover_items:4.en: Mind the spread, then deal at a counter or the exchange (F8). Blue above its usual is the time to sell.

trade_hall_art:hover_items:8.zh: 炉料商：卖废钢、混合金属等炉料，收钢锭。
trade_hall_art:hover_items:8.en: Furnace feed: sells scrap and mixed metal, buys billets.

trade_hall_art:hover_items:9.zh: 物流商：收成品，开货单、过磅、发运。
trade_hall_art:hover_items:9.en: Logistics: buys products, writes dockets, weighs, ships.

trade_hall_art:hover_items:10.zh: 修理工场：收钢锭做法兰、轴套、支架等修复件。
trade_hall_art:hover_items:10.en: Repair shop: buys billets for flanges, bushes, brackets.

trade_hall_art:hover_items:11.zh: 飞到柜台前按 %s：挂单、按它的报价成交。和它成交的货在下层交货码头交接。
trade_hall_art:hover_items:11.en: Fly to the desk, %s: post, or take its quote. What you deal with it is handed over at the dock below.

trade_hall_art:hover_items:13.zh: 交货码头和仓库之间的口：卖出的货从这里出来，买进的货从这里进仓。
trade_hall_art:hover_items:13.en: Between the dock and the warehouse: what you sell comes out here, what you buy goes in.

trade_hall_art:hover_items:14.zh: 不用操作；仓库里要有货，卖单才能交货。
trade_hall_art:hover_items:14.en: Nothing to do; a sale needs the goods in the warehouse.

trade_hall_art:hover_items:16.zh: 每箱货过磅，读数是这笔成交的真实吨数。
trade_hall_art:hover_items:16.en: Each crate is weighed; the reading is the deal's real tonnes.

trade_hall_art:hover_items:17.zh: 看着读数就知道这笔交了多少。
trade_hall_art:hover_items:17.en: The reading is how much of the deal has gone.

trade_hall_art:hover_items:19.zh: 给过了磅的货箱打铅封，橙色标签就是封好的。
trade_hall_art:hover_items:19.en: Seals each weighed crate; the orange tag is its seal.

trade_hall_art:hover_items:22.zh: 和港内公司成交后，对方的驳船靠进东墙下的口子，吊车把货箱吊进吊出。
trade_hall_art:hover_items:22.en: A deal with one of the port's companies brings its lighter into the port under the east wall; the crane swings the crates in or out.

trade_hall_art:hover_items:23.zh: 在柜台或终端和港内公司成交，就会看到它来交货。
trade_hall_art:hover_items:23.en: Deal with a port company at a counter or the exchange and it comes.

trade_hall_art:hover_items:25.zh: 独立商人和个体船主的小船靠在这里，廊桥接上舱门，接驳小车把客人送到业务终端旁边。
trade_hall_art:hover_items:25.en: The independent merchants' small ships berth here; the gangway meets the hatch and the cart takes the visitor to the business console.

trade_hall_art:hover_items:27.zh: 到西边业务终端按 %s：接受、还价或拒绝。急着要货的客人一分钟内不谈就走。
trade_hall_art:hover_items:27.en: At the business console in the west, %s: accept, haggle or send away. One in a hurry leaves after a minute.

trade_people:take_contract:1.zh: 这家现在没有合同可接

trade_people:_deliver:2.zh: 没能按时给%s交货（%s不够），信誉 −1。

trade_works:dock_state:2.zh: 空闲 · 和港内公司成交后在这里交货
trade_works:dock_state:2.en: IDLE · DEALS WITH THE PORT'S COMPANIES ARE HANDED OVER HERE

trade_works:lighter_state:1.zh: 不在 · 成交后来接货送货

trade_works:lighter_state:5.zh: %s 的驳船靠泊 · 舱内 %d 箱

tug_station_art:still:3.zh: 备件架 · 喷管 / 缆绳 / 电池模块 / 阀件

tug_station_art:hover_items:2.zh: 拖回来的船先停进这里：高不过 %.0f m 的船尾伸进站内，系泊臂夹住，软管抽走一部分推进剂，装上推船夹具，扫描船体。更高的船停在外面露天泊位。
tug_station_art:hover_items:2.en: Hulks towed home lie here first: one under %.0f m tall goes in stern first, is clamped, drawn off, fitted with the push frame and scanned. Taller ones wait outside.

tug_station_art:hover_items:3.zh: 不用操作，自动处理。拖船站等级越高抽得越多（现在 %d%%）：拆的时候船里推进剂更少、更不容易起火，抽出的推进剂进储罐。接单开工就把它推去船坞。
tug_station_art:hover_items:3.en: Nothing to do: it runs by itself. A better station draws off more (now %d%%): less propellant aboard to burn when you cut, and the tank fills. Start the job and it is pushed to the berth.

tug_station_art:hover_items:5.zh: 跨在船坞口上方的 40 吨龙门吊：给废船船尾装推船夹具（拖船推它进船坞时顶的就是这个），小车上的激光头扫描船体。
tug_station_art:hover_items:5.en: The 40 t gantry over the mouth: sets the push frame on a hulk's stern (what the tug bears on to push it in) and its trolley's lidar scans the hull.

tug_station_art:hover_items:6.zh: 不用操作。看它在做什么就知道船处理到哪一步了。
tug_station_art:hover_items:6.en: Nothing to do; what it does tells you how far the hulk is.

tug_station_art:hover_items:8.zh: 自家拖船的泊位：从左墙上部的拖船门飞进来，接上加注臂补推进剂、接上充电线充电，尾部吊舱经甲板舱口换下去检修。
tug_station_art:hover_items:8.en: A company tug's berth: in through the tug gate, the arm refuels it, the umbilical charges it, its aft pod is swapped through the deck hatch.

tug_station_art:hover_items:9.zh: 自家拖船满电待命时，买船拖运只收一半钱。

tug_station_art:hover_items:10.zh: 扩建拖船站（终端 → 成长与建设）多一艘拖船。

tug_station_art:hover_items:12.zh: 拖船回港时升降台把它的旧推进器吊舱换下来放到这里，探头沿喷管扫描检修，修好变成下一次的备用吊舱。
tug_station_art:hover_items:12.en: When a tug comes home the lift swaps its worn thruster pod onto this table; the probe overhauls it into the next spare.

tug_station_art:hover_items:13.zh: 不用操作；没有备用吊舱时下一艘回港的拖船要等它修完。
tug_station_art:hover_items:13.en: Nothing to do; with no spare ready the next tug home waits for the overhaul.

tug_station_art:hover_items:15.zh: 存放从废船抽出来的甲基肼，给回港的拖船加注。剧毒易燃。
tug_station_art:hover_items:15.en: Holds the monomethylhydrazine drawn off the hulks and refuels the tugs home. Toxic, flammable.

tug_station_art:hover_items:16.zh: 不用操作；回港的拖船从这里加注。
tug_station_art:hover_items:16.en: Nothing to do; the tugs home refuel from it.

tug_station_art:hover_items:18.zh: 拖船换下来的易损件：喷管、缆绳、电池模块、阀件。
tug_station_art:hover_items:18.en: What a tug wears out: nozzle bells, cable, battery modules, valve blocks.

tug_station_art:hover_items:19.zh: 电池模块 %d 块 · 喷管 %d 个

tug_station_art:hover_items:20.zh: 扩建拖船站后备件更多。

tug_station_art:hover_items:22.zh: 检修用的小件：阀件、密封圈、紧固件、线束。
tug_station_art:hover_items:22.en: Small parts for the overhauls: valves, seals, bolts, looms.

industrial_heat:command:1.zh: 关键工序必须在炉旁操作

industrial_heat:cancel:2.zh: 已投炉材料不能退回冷料；可停机保料或完成出钢

industrial_heat:cancel:3.zh: 货物缺失，需要先处理现场异常

industrial_heat:cancel:4.zh: 炉料来源记录不一致，撤回未提交

industrial_heat:cancel:5.zh: 货物缺失或受损，请先检查现场

industrial_heat:write_off:1.zh: 只能在现场报损运输中的本批货物

industrial_heat:write_off:2.zh: 货物尚未交给搬运机构，可免费撤回，无需报损

industrial_heat:write_off:3.zh: 原料损失来源记录不一致

industrial_heat:write_off:7.zh: 本批已报损，无退款；遗留实物需现场清理

industrial_heat:_receive:1.zh: 返仓来源记录不一致，未增加库存

industrial_heat:_receive:2.zh: 炉体出料记录尚未满足本批次验收

industrial_heat:_receive:3.zh: 待结清本炉电费后验收入库

industrial_heat:historical_debt:1.zh: 历史炉次账本格式错误，请保留存档

industrial_heat:historical_debt:2.zh: 历史炉次账本格式错误，请保留存档

industrial_heat:historical_debt:3.zh: 历史炉次欠费格式错误，请保留存档

industrial_heat:historical_debt:4.zh: 历史炉次欠费记录无效，请保留存档

industrial_heat:historical_debt:5.zh: 同一历史炉次的欠费记录冲突，请保留存档核查

industrial_heat:_pay_history:1.zh: 历史炉次电费待缴，可先完成其他业务筹款

industrial_heat:_pay_history:2.zh: 历史电费结算保存失败，未扣款

industrial_heat:_pay_history:3.zh: 历史炉次电费待缴，可先完成其他业务筹款

industrial_heat:_process:1.zh: 电费余额不足，已停止新增供电

industrial_heat:_process:3.zh: 电费余额不足，已停止新增供电

industrial_heat:_physics_process:2.zh: 货物缺失，等待现场处理

industrial_heat:_physics_process:3.zh: 货物受损，等待重新验收

industrial_heat:_physics_process:5.zh: 搬运通道受阻，请检查现场

industrial_sort:_ready:1.zh: 分选设备存档校验失败，保留现场与账本

industrial_sort:_ready:2.zh: 分选机构与实际来源身份不一致

industrial_sort:_ready:3.zh: 产物阶段缺少实际分选出料记录

industrial_sort:_ready:4.zh: 分选产物质量或交接记录不一致

industrial_sort:begin:1.zh: 请先结清炉子的待缴电费

industrial_sort:begin:4.zh: 请到分选操作台开始批次，等设备空闲

industrial_sort:begin:8.zh: 等待旧料或已分选货物离开设备

industrial_sort:begin:9.zh: 等待旧金属完成输送与交接

industrial_sort:begin:10.zh: 仓库未分选金属不足，待运货物不可投料

industrial_sort:begin:11.zh: 这批旧料缺少实际材料描述，不能用默认配方冒充检验；库存仍保留

industrial_sort:command:1.zh: 请等待原料到达，再在分选台操作

industrial_sort:command:2.zh: 保存失败，驱动指令未提交

industrial_sort:_prepare_transport:1.zh: 出料缓冲与搬运质量不一致，保留现场

industrial_sort:_prepare_transport:2.zh: 出料交接保存失败，货物停留原位

industrial_sort:_move_empty:1.zh: 空载搬运机构等待通道

industrial_sort:_receive:1.zh: 保存失败，分选交接未提交

industrial_sort:_process:1.zh: 分选电费余额不足，驱动已停止；补足资金后可现场重启

industrial_sort:_process:2.zh: 分选电费余额不足，驱动已停止；补足资金后可现场重启

industrial_sort:write_off:1.zh: 只能在分选台报损已发运货物

industrial_sort:write_off:2.zh: 未发运原料可直接撤回；产物尚在设备内，不可凭空报损

industrial_sort:write_off:4.zh: 分选缓冲记录无效，保留现场

industrial_sort:write_off:5.zh: 请先清空弃料出口，缓冲内实物尚未弃置

industrial_sort:_materialize_disposals:1.zh: 待交接弃料已有切割碎片，未生成整批替代货物

industrial_sort:_materialize_disposals:2.zh: 弃料现场与待交接质量不符，未生成替代货物

industrial_sort:_materialize_disposals:3.zh: 弃料交接保存失败，未生成新实体

order_settlement:select_sale:3.zh: 出售入账，本次不交付工程。
order_settlement:select_sale:3.en: Sell for cash. No engineering delivery this time.

order_settlement:select_sale:5.zh: 交付完成后：获得自有牵引锚与监测探头。
order_settlement:select_sale:5.en: AFTER DELIVERY: receive an owned anchor and monitoring probe.

order_settlement:select_sale:7.zh: 预留入库；下次带回剩余目标即可继续交付。
order_settlement:select_sale:7.en: Keep these goods reserved. Bring the remaining targets on a later job.

process_queue:line:1.zh: %s：已熔 %.1f t · 已轧钢板 %.1f t

queue_panel:_ready:2.zh: 远程 · 炉台和轧机照这个顺序取料
queue_panel:_ready:2.en: REMOTE · THE FURNACE AND THE MILL TAKE THEM IN THIS ORDER

queue_panel:_ready:3.zh: ↑ ↓ 选一批 · W / S 上下移 · Home 放到最前 · Esc 关闭
queue_panel:_ready:3.en: ↑ ↓ PICK · W / S MOVE · HOME TO THE FRONT · ESC CLOSE

queue_panel:_fill:1.zh: 没有排队的钢锭。结算时选“留着加工”的钢锭会排到这里。
queue_panel:_fill:1.en: NOTHING QUEUED. INGOTS KEPT FOR PROCESSING AT A SETTLEMENT COME HERE.

queue_panel:_fill:2.zh: 选中这一批，看它的详情
queue_panel:_fill:2.en: Pick this batch and see it

queue_panel:_fill:4.zh: 往前排一位：早一点加工

queue_panel:_fill:5.zh: 往后排一位：晚一点加工

queue_panel:_fill:6.zh: 排到最前：下一个就加工它

sort_panel:_ready:2.zh:
压块 → 撕碎 → 磁选 → 线上化验 → 电弧炉
有色料回仓库 · 电费按电网
sort_panel:_ready:2.en:
PRESS / SHRED / MAGNETS / IN-LINE ASSAY / ARC FURNACE
NONFERROUS TO THE WAREHOUSE

sort_panel:_ready:7.zh: 点击展开或收起分选台的其他操作选项
sort_panel:_ready:7.en: Show or hide the sorting desk's other keys

sort_panel:_ready:8.zh: 根据分选台当前的运行状态，执行下一步操作 [Enter]
sort_panel:_ready:8.en: The sorting desk's next step, as it stands now (Enter)

sort_panel:_ready:9.zh: （仅进行金属分选，两种产物都会送回仓库）

sort_panel:_ready:10.zh: 将这些原料送入分选线，不经过熔炉处理，分选出来的两种产物都会送回仓库
sort_panel:_ready:10.en: Send this feed to be sorted only; both outputs go back to the store

sort_panel:_ready:12.zh: 启动分选线的电机，开始进行原料分选
sort_panel:_ready:12.en: Start the sorting line's drives now

sort_panel:_ready:14.zh: 关闭分选线的电机，暂停原料分选
sort_panel:_ready:14.en: Stop the sorting line's drives now

sort_panel:_ready:16.zh: 将还没有完成分选的原料全部退回仓库
sort_panel:_ready:16.en: Send the feed not yet sorted back to the store

sort_panel:_ready:17.zh: 报废运输中的货物（不予退款）

sort_panel:_ready:18.zh: 直接报废这批运输中的货物，已经支付的费用不会退还，建议只在无法继续处理时使用
sort_panel:_ready:18.en: Scrap this batch for nothing; only when it cannot be saved

sort_panel:_next:1.zh: 完整加工流程（分选 → 化验 → 炼钢）

sort_panel:_next:5.zh: 正在分选 · 设备内剩余 %.2f t 原料

sort_panel:_next:6.zh: 黑色金属原料正在进行化验，即将送入电弧炉…
sort_panel:_next:6.en: FERROUS TO THE ASSAY AND THE FURNACE…

sort_panel:_next:7.zh: 正在将加工产物送回仓库…

sort_panel:_next:8.zh: 完整加工流程（分选 → 化验 → 炼钢）

sort_panel:_process:6.zh: 一键启动完整加工流程：系统会从仓库运来原料，完成分选后，黑色金属原料会经过在线化验并直接送入电弧炉，电弧炉自动通电。你只需要前往炉台测量温度并完成出钢，有色金属原料则会送回仓库。
sort_panel:_process:6.en: ONE PRESS RUNS THE LINE: FERROUS STRAIGHT TO THE ARC FURNACE, WHICH STARTS ITSELF; YOU SAMPLE AND TAP AT THE FURNACE DESK.

guide:_at:3.zh: 出船坞闸口就是拆船区站，按 %s 坐接驳车到加工区；也可以跟着屏幕边上的箭头飞过去。
guide:_at:3.en: Out of the berth's gate is the salvage stop: %s calls the shuttle to the processing district; or follow the arrow at the screen's edge.

guide:_sort:2.zh: 整线加工：分选 → 线上化验 → 黑色料直接进电弧炉；有色料回仓库
guide:_sort:2.en: The through line: sorted, assayed in line, straight into the arc furnace

guide:_sort:3.zh: 等原料沿吊轨运到分选线

guide:_sort:4.zh: 搬运车正从仓库把料运过来。
guide:_sort:4.en: The courier is bringing the feed.

guide:_sort:6.zh: 撤回的原料正运回仓库。
guide:_sort:6.en: The withdrawn feed is going back.

guide:_sort:9.zh: 压块 → 撕碎 → 磁选进行中

guide:_sort:10.zh: 机器自己在跑，不用守着。

guide:_sort:11.zh: 黑色料过线上化验，进电弧炉
guide:_sort:11.en: FERROUS THROUGH THE ASSAY INTO THE FURNACE

guide:_sort:12.zh: 化验位读数约 30 秒，合格的直接进炉，炉子自己通电。
guide:_sort:12.en: A 30 s reading; then into the furnace, which starts itself.

guide:_sort:17.zh: 仓库里没有可分选的金属

guide:_assay:2.zh: 只读样品、定等级，和旁边的熔炉无关：杂质 ≤ 3% 的黑色炉料整批升为等级 1 才能进炉
guide:_assay:2.en: Reads a sample and grades the lot (nothing to do with the furnace beside it): ≤ 3% impurity makes grade 1 feed

guide:_assay:4.zh: 约 30 秒，读完自动入账；不用守着。

guide:_assay:5.zh: 化验合格：整批升为等级 1 炉料
guide:_assay:5.en: PASSED: the lot is grade 1 feed

guide:_assay:6.zh: 化验不合格：杂质太高，只能按未评级卖
guide:_assay:6.en: FAILED: too much impurity, sell it unrated

guide:_assay:7.zh: 化验完成：旧料有了材料描述，可以分选
guide:_assay:7.en: READ: the old lot can now be sorted

guide:_assay:11.zh: 仓库里没有要化验的料

guide:_heat:2.zh: 把钢锭重新熔成钢水、浇成钢坯，卖给工业客户
guide:_heat:2.en: Melts grade 1 feed and casts billets for industrial clients

guide:_heat:6.zh: 填炉料吨数，按『把仓库炉料送到炉口』

guide:_heat:7.zh: 送 %.2f t 钢锭去炉口（在哪都能按）
guide:_heat:7.en: SEND %.2f t OF INGOT TO THE FURNACE (FROM ANYWHERE)

guide:_heat:8.zh: 按卡片上的按钮就开始送，你飞过去的路上料也在走；到了炉台再按『通电熔化』。
guide:_heat:8.en: The card's button starts it; the feed travels while you fly over. At the desk, strike the arcs.

guide:_heat_queue:2.zh: 在观察廊最左边：打开加工队列，把钢锭排一炉
guide:_heat_queue:2.en: At the gallery's far left: the processing queue, a heat of ingots

guide:_heat_queue:4.zh: 机器自己在跑：送料、熔化、出钢浇铸，钢坯自己回仓库。
guide:_heat_queue:4.en: It runs by itself: feed, melt, cast; the billets go back to the stores.

guide:_heat_queue:7.zh: 排上了，炉子按队列自己开炉。
guide:_heat_queue:7.en: Queued: the furnace starts by itself.

guide:_heat_queue:9.zh: 飞上观察廊，到最左边的炉体控制台
guide:_heat_queue:9.en: UP ONTO THE GALLERY, TO THE FURNACE CONSOLE AT THE FAR LEFT

guide:_clients:1.zh: 钢坯已入库：按 F3 打开仓库，可以卖给回收站或留着
guide:_clients:1.en: THE BILLETS ARE IN STORE: F3 TO SELL OR KEEP

guide:_clients:2.zh: 钢坯卖出去了，钱已到账

guide:_clients:3.zh: 钢坯卖出去了，钱已到账

guide:_clients:4.en: UNDER SELL: PICK THE BILLETS, PRESS LIST IT

guide:_clients:5.zh: 价格默认就是客户的收价，上架当场成交、钱当场到账，货由搬运车送，不用你发货。
guide:_clients:5.en: The price starts at the client's bid: sold and paid at once, delivered for you.

guide:_clients:6.zh: 点卡片上的按钮打开交易行。
guide:_clients:6.en: Use the button on this card to open the exchange.

guide:_buy_feed:3.en: Usable once it is in the warehouse.

guide:_buy_feed:5.zh: 在交易行选『黑色炉料』等级 1，点一家卖方的『购买』
guide:_buy_feed:5.en: BUY GRADE 1 FERROUS FEED FROM A SELLER

guide:_buy_feed:6.zh: 没有自己的料时，先买合格炉料开炉。
guide:_buy_feed:6.en: No feed of your own yet: buy grade 1 to run a heat.

guide:_repair:3.zh: 施工暂停：无人机离吊装区远一点
guide:_repair:3.en: WORK STOPPED: MOVE THE DRONE OUT OF THE LIFT ZONE

guide:_repair:4.zh: 吊装时无人机在 %d m 内，施工队不能吊。
guide:_repair:4.en: The crew cannot lift with the drone within %d m.

guide:_repair:5.zh: 施工队在修「%s」：还要约 %d 秒

guide:_repair:6.zh: 零件已经交给施工队了，等它修完就能用。
guide:_repair:6.en: The parts are with the crew; it works once they are done.

guide:_repair:8.zh: 跟着箭头，飞近就会记进报修。
guide:_repair:8.en: Follow the arrow: close up, it is logged.

guide:_repair:11.zh: 修好后回船坞就能看到施工。
guide:_repair:11.en: You will see the work done back at the berth.

guide:_repair:13.zh: 点卡片上的按钮打开船坞修缮页。
guide:_repair:13.en: Open the berth repairs with the button on this card.

guide:_repair:15.zh: 接一单合同挣钱，或在账本里借款。
guide:_repair:15.en: Take a job, or borrow on the ledger.

guide:_repair:17.zh: 拆下的船壳送熔炉攒吨数

guide:_build:2.en: EVERY PORT STAGE THAT CAN BE BUILT IS BUILT

guide:_build:7.zh: 点击任务卡上的按钮，打开港区建设菜单。
guide:_build:7.en: Open the port works with the button on this card.

guide:_build:9.zh: 接合同攒零件、结构吨和钱。
guide:_build:9.en: Take jobs for parts, structure and money.

guide:_transit:3.zh: 到站自动开门放你出来。
guide:_transit:3.en: It lets you out at the stop.

guide:_transit:4.zh: 坐过一次接驳车了：任何站台按 E 都能叫车
guide:_transit:4.en: YOU HAVE RIDDEN IT: E AT ANY STOP CALLS IT

guide:_transit:5.zh: 接驳车沿走廊轨道连通六区，比飞快
guide:_transit:5.en: The shuttle runs the corridors to every district

guide:_transit:7.zh: 车会先开到你这一站接你。
guide:_transit:7.en: The car comes to your stop first.

guide:_transit:10.zh: 从船坞顶上的闸口出去，站台就在闸口正上方。
guide:_transit:10.en: Out through the gate above the berth: the stop is right over it.

guide:_transit:11.en: Follow the arrow at the screen's edge.

guide:_trade:1.zh: 成交了：货会实际运进仓库，到了才能用
guide:_trade:1.en: BOUGHT: THE GOODS ARE SHIPPED IN, USABLE ON ARRIVAL

guide:_trade:3.zh: 只按这一家的价格和余量成交。
guide:_trade:3.en: Only this seller's price and stock.

guide:_trade:5.zh: 点一种货的卡片，再点一家卖方的『购买』
guide:_trade:5.en: PICK THE GOODS' CARD, THEN BUY FROM ONE SELLER

guide:_trade:6.zh: 每行是一家卖方的实际报价和余量，写着货从哪来、多久到。
guide:_trade:6.en: Each row is one seller's real offer, where from and how soon.

guide:_trade:9.zh: 买原料、卖产品、接工业客户都在这里。
guide:_trade:9.en: Buy feed, sell products, serve clients.

guide:_retain:1.zh: 这一单的结构钢会记成公司原料进仓库
guide:_retain:1.en: THIS JOB'S STRUCTURAL STEEL GOES TO THE WAREHOUSE

guide:_retain:2.zh: 打开『废金属留作原料』，再按开工
guide:_retain:2.en: SWITCH ON KEEP THE SCRAP, THEN GO

guide:_retain:3.zh: 代价：这部分回收价不付现金，也不算修缮用的结构吨。
guide:_retain:3.en: It costs the scrap's cash and its repair tonnes.

guide:_retain:6.zh: 接单后弹出的配装页里有留料开关。
guide:_retain:6.en: The switch is on the loadout page after you sign.

guide:_collect:3.en: THE FREIGHTER IS ON ITS WAY

guide:_collect:4.zh: 到港后会靠上货运区码头；星图上能看它沿转移轨道飞。
guide:_collect:4.en: It will moor at the cargo pier; follow its arc on the star map.

guide:_collect:7.zh: 货是实物：进了收货口才算入库
guide:_collect:7.en: Goods are real: stock once inside the receiver

guide:_collect:9.zh: 货运区修好了，3 t 以下的件吊车自动搬。
guide:_collect:9.en: With the cargo district mended the crane takes pieces under 3 t.

guide:_collect:11.zh: 从院子东门进去，整件放进左边 WAREHOUSE 框里松开。
guide:_collect:11.en: Through the yard's east gate; let go with the whole piece inside the WAREHOUSE frame.

guide:_collect:13.zh: 整件放进货舱里松开，装满就起航。
guide:_collect:13.en: Let go with the whole piece inside the hold; it sails when loaded.

guide:_collect:14.zh: 飞到出货台，抓住一件货
guide:_collect:14.en: GRAPPLE A PIECE ON THE LOADING TABLE

guide:_collect:15.zh: 飞到 %d 号船位，抓住一件货
guide:_collect:15.en: FLY TO BERTH %d, GRAPPLE A PIECE

guide:_collect:16.zh: 飞到码头空地，抓住一件货
guide:_collect:16.en: FLY TO THE APRON, GRAPPLE A PIECE

guide:_collect:17.zh: 码头在货运区下方仓库院子的东边。
guide:_collect:17.en: The pier runs east from the warehouse yard under the cargo district.

guide:_next:1.zh: 黑色料已经在电弧炉里，去炉台测温、出钢
guide:_next:1.en: the ferrous is in the furnace: sample and tap

guide:_next:2.zh: 黑色炉料还没评级，要先化验
guide:_next:2.en: the feed is unrated: assay it

guide:_next:5.en: the feed is in: run a heat

guide:act:1.zh: 钢锭出库了：%.2f t 正送往炉口
guide:act:1.en: THE INGOTS ARE ON THEIR WAY: %.2f t

mainline:顶层:4.en: THE RECYCLER PAYS SIXTY PER CENT

mainline:顶层:10.zh: 让中央转运环重新转起来
mainline:顶层:10.en: GET THE TRANSFER RING TURNING AGAIN

mainline:trigger_text:1.en: Once the first hulk is stripped

mainline:trigger_text:3.zh: 仓库里钢锭攒到 %.0f 吨时
mainline:trigger_text:3.en: When %.0f t of ingots are in store

mainline:trigger_text:5.zh: 第一次电力不足（功率低于 100%）时
mainline:trigger_text:5.en: The first time the power falls under 100 %

mainline:trigger_text:6.zh: 星图扫到超过 %d m 的船时
mainline:trigger_text:6.en: When the star map finds a hulk over %d m

mainline:trigger_text:7.zh: 扫到超过 %d m、船坞放不下的船时
mainline:trigger_text:7.en: When a hulk over %d m turns up, too long for the berth

mainline:trigger_text:8.en: Once the districts before it are mended

mainline:opens_text:2.zh: 修船坞照明 → 看得清、切得快
mainline:opens_text:2.en: Mend the berth's lights: clear readings, faster cutting

mainline:opens_text:3.zh: 修熔炉和接碎料的网 → 碎料炼成钢锭
mainline:opens_text:3.en: Mend the furnace and the net: scrap becomes ingots

mainline:opens_text:4.zh: 修贸易港一期 → 交易行、订单板（即将开放）
mainline:opens_text:4.en: Mend the trade port: exchange and order board (opening soon)

mainline:opens_text:5.zh: 修加工区一期 → 钢锭炼成钢坯
mainline:opens_text:5.en: Mend the processing district: ingots into billets

mainline:opens_text:6.zh: 修货运区 → 仓库 8×32 变 8×48
mainline:opens_text:6.en: Mend the cargo district: the stores grow 8×32 → 8×48

mainline:opens_text:7.zh: 修动力区 → 自家发电，炉子和叉车不再变慢
mainline:opens_text:7.en: Mend the power district: your own power, no more slowdowns

mainline:opens_text:8.zh: 修拖船站 → 能拖超过 %d m 的船
mainline:opens_text:8.en: Mend the tug station: tow hulks over %d m

mainline:opens_text:9.zh: 把船坞扩到 88 m → 能拆更大的船
mainline:opens_text:9.en: Extend the berth to 88 m for bigger hulks

mainline:_repair_step:1.zh: 先飞去看「%s」坏在哪（飞近就记下）。
mainline:_repair_step:1.en: Fly over and look at the %s (close up logs it).

mainline:_repair_step:2.en: Mend %s: parts and money are there.

mainline:_build_step:4.zh: 修%s：飞到它的业务终端按 %s，点“修”。%s
mainline:_build_step:4.en: Mend the %s: %s at its business console, then MEND. %s

mainline:_build_step:5.zh: 修%s：%s。先拆船攒钱，或者卖掉仓库里的东西。
mainline:_build_step:5.en: Mend the %s: %s. Strip hulks or sell from the stores first.

mainline:_build_step:7.en: To mend the %s (part %s) you still need: %s.

mainline:_next_ship:2.zh: 打开终端，查看能接的船。
mainline:_next_ship:2.en: Open the terminal to see available ships.

mainline:_next_ship:4.zh: 按 %s 打开终端，在“找船”里开工。
mainline:_next_ship:4.en: Press %s to open the terminal and start under Find Ships.

mainline:_next_ship:6.en: The ship arrives in about %d s.

mainline:_next_ship:8.zh: 打开星图，查看船况和拖运条件。
mainline:_next_ship:8.en: Open the star map to check the ship and its tow requirements.

mainline:_next_ship:10.zh: 去星图扫描，或到二手船市挑一艘。
mainline:_next_ship:10.en: Sweep the star map or pick a ship on the used market.

mainline:waiting_step:3.zh: 腾出位置入库，或卖给回收站回款，再接下一艘。
mainline:waiting_step:3.en: Make room in the stores or sell the goods to the recycler before taking another ship.

mainline:step:1.zh: 施工暂停：无人机在吊装区（%d m 内）。飞远些就接着干（还要约 %d 秒）。
mainline:step:1.en: WORK STOPPED: THE DRONE IS IN THE LIFT ZONE (%d m). MOVE AWAY (~%d s LEFT).

mainline:step:4.zh: 开始拆 %s：%s 开终端，在“找船”里开工。
mainline:step:4.en: Start on %s: %s, pick it under Find Ships.

mainline:step:5.zh: %s 开终端，在“找船”里接一单。
mainline:step:5.en: %s: take a job under Find Ships.

mainline:step:7.zh: 照明坏了：看不清读数、切得慢。
mainline:step:7.en: The lights are out: poor readings, slow cutting.

mainline:step:8.zh: 钢坯已入库：按 F3 打开仓库，可以卖给回收站或留着。
mainline:step:8.en: Billets in store: F3 opens the warehouse — sell to the recycler or keep.

mainline:step:9.zh: 有钢坯了：去交易行挂价卖。
mainline:step:9.en: Billets in stock: list them on the exchange.

mainline:step:10.zh: 去加工区炉台，把钢锭炼成钢坯。
mainline:step:10.en: To the furnace desk: melt the ingots into billets.

mainline:step:11.zh: 去加工区化验台，测废铁杂质。
mainline:step:11.en: To the assay bench: test the scrap.

mainline:step:12.zh: 去加工区分选台，把混合金属分开。
mainline:step:12.en: To the sorting desk: separate the mixed metal.

mainline:step:13.zh: 仓库没有钢锭：再拆一艘船，碎料会炼成钢锭。
mainline:step:13.en: No ingots: strip another ship; its scrap becomes ingots.

mainline:step:14.zh: 远航者工程还没做好，以后的版本开放。
mainline:step:14.en: The Ark project comes in a later version.

ops:_grid:1.en: WE MAKE %.0f · GIVEN OUT %.1f · FREE %.1f MW

ops:_shipping:2.en: TOWING: PAID WHEN THE TUG GOES, HALF WITH YOUR OWN TUG

ops:decisions:1.zh: 欠了 %s 电费，机器停了
ops:decisions:1.en: %s OF POWER UNPAID: THE MACHINES STOPPED

ops:decisions:2.zh: 去那台机器的面板上把电费交了，再开机。
ops:decisions:2.en: Pay at the machine's panel, then start it again.

ops:decisions:3.zh: 下次结算要还 %s 欠款，现在的钱不够
ops:decisions:3.en: %s OF DEBT IS DUE AT THE NEXT SETTLEMENT: NOT ENOUGH CASH

ops:decisions:4.zh: 拆完下一艘船结算时会自动扣。先拆一艘船，或者把仓库里的东西卖掉。
ops:decisions:4.en: It is taken when the next ship is settled. Strip a ship, or sell what is in the warehouse.

ops:decisions:6.en: HEAT %s NEEDS YOU AT THE FURNACE

ops:decisions:7.zh: 测温取样、倾炉出钢要在现场亲手做。
ops:decisions:7.en: Sampling and tapping are done by hand on site.

ops:decisions:8.zh: 分选批次 %s 原料已到
ops:decisions:8.en: SORTING BATCH %s IS AT THE LINE

ops:decisions:9.zh: 在分选台启动驱动，粉碎、磁选后两路产物返仓。
ops:decisions:9.en: Start the drives at the sorting desk.

ops:decisions:10.zh: 加急：%s 收 %.2f t 钢坯 %s/t，还剩 %d 分钟
ops:decisions:10.en: RUSH: %s WANTS %.2f t BILLET AT %s / t, %d MIN

ops:decisions:11.zh: 你库里有 %.2f t：到工业客户页按加急价挂牌，当场到账。
ops:decisions:11.en: You have %.2f t: list at the rush price, paid at once.

ops:decisions:12.zh: 库里没有钢坯；赶在到期前炼一炉。过期不扣钱。
ops:decisions:12.en: No billets in stock; a heat might make it. No penalty if it lapses.

ops:decisions:13.zh: 可以给炉子装自动装置了（%s）
ops:decisions:13.en: THE FURNACE CAN TAKE AN AUTO UNIT NOW (%s)

ops:decisions:14.zh: 你已经亲手炼了 %d 炉钢。花 %s 给炉子装上自动装置，以后炉子烧到温度会自己测温、自己把钢水倒出来。去炉台点“更多”安装。
ops:decisions:14.en: You have melted %d heats by hand. For %s the furnace can take the temperature and pour by itself. Install it under More at the furnace desk.

ops:decisions:17.zh: 够卖一批：到客户页按客户价挂牌，当场到账。
ops:decisions:17.en: Enough to sell: list it at the client's price, paid at once.

ops:decisions:19.en: THE QUEUED BIG SHIP IS IN

ops:decisions:20.zh: 它在合同页最后一张，可以直接接。
ops:decisions:20.en: It is the last card on the contracts page.

ops:decisions:22.zh: 炉台在加工区公司炉左侧，按 E 装炉。
ops:decisions:22.en: The furnace desk is beside the company furnace in the processing district; press E there.

ops:decisions:23.zh: 仓库有 %.2f t 未分选金属
ops:decisions:23.en: %.2f t OF MIXED METAL IN STOCK

ops:decisions:24.zh: 到分选台按『完整加工流程』：分选后黑色料直接进电弧炉炼成钢坯；或者直接挂牌卖。
ops:decisions:24.en: Run the line: sorted and straight into the arc furnace; or list it as is.

ops:decisions:25.zh: %.2f t 未评级黑色炉料可以化验
ops:decisions:25.en: %.2f t OF UNRATED FERROUS FEED TO ASSAY

ops:decisions:26.zh: 化验位在分选台右侧 12 m；杂质够低就整批升为等级 1，能进炉。
ops:decisions:26.en: The assay bench is 12 m right of the sorting desk; low enough impurity makes it grade 1.

ops:decisions:27.en: %.2f t OF OLD STOCK WITH NO RECORD

ops:decisions:28.zh: 分选台不收来路不明的料；先到化验位测一次。
ops:decisions:28.en: The sorting line refuses it until the assay bench has read it.

ops:decisions:29.zh: 码头有 %d 件货等你搬

ops:decisions:30.zh: 货船靠在货运区码头；拖进仓库收货口才算入库。
ops:decisions:30.en: A freighter is at the cargo pier; stock once inside the receiver.

ops:decisions:32.zh: 到库后才能投料；星图上看货船沿轨道飞到哪了。
ops:decisions:32.en: Usable once received; the star map shows each freighter on its arc.

ops:decisions:34.zh: 出价 %s/t：挂牌卖给他，当场到账。
ops:decisions:34.en: %s / t: list to it, paid at once.

ops:site_text:1.zh: 炉台在加工区公司炉左侧（中央枢纽往左的走廊进去）。关掉终端飞过去，按 %s 打开炉体操作。
ops:site_text:1.en: The furnace desk is left of the company furnace in the processing district (the corridor left of the hub). Close the terminal, fly there and press %s.

ops:site_text:2.zh: 分选台在加工区，炉台右侧 12 m。关掉终端飞过去，按 %s 打开分选操作。
ops:site_text:2.en: The sorting desk is in the processing district, 12 m right of the furnace desk. Close the terminal, fly there and press %s.

ops:site_text:3.zh: 化验位在加工区，分选台右侧 12 m。关掉终端飞过去，按 %s 打开化验。
ops:site_text:3.en: The assay bench is in the processing district, 12 m right of the sorting desk. Close the terminal, fly there and press %s.

ops:next_step:1.zh: 炉次在炉里：到炉台测温取样、倾炉出钢。
ops:next_step:1.en: A heat is on: sample and tap at the furnace desk.

ops:next_step:2.zh: 设备在搬运或加工，等它把货送回仓库。
ops:next_step:2.en: The plant is moving or working stock; wait for it to reach the warehouse.

ops:next_step:3.zh: 仓库有 %.2f t 合格钢坯：按 F3 打开仓库，可以卖给回收站或留着。
ops:next_step:3.en: %.2f t of grade 1 billets in store: F3 to sell to the recycler or keep.

ops:next_step:4.zh: 仓库有 %.2f t 合格钢坯：去交易行“工业客户”承接或发运。
ops:next_step:4.en: %.2f t of grade 1 billets: take or ship a client order on the exchange.

ops:next_step:5.zh: 仓库有 %.2f 吨钢锭：去加工区炉台，炼成钢坯。
ops:next_step:5.en: %.2f t of grade 1 feed: charge the furnace.

ops:next_step:6.zh: 化验位正在读样品，读完自动入账。
ops:next_step:6.en: The assay bench is reading a sample; the result books itself.

ops:next_step:7.zh: 仓库有未评级黑色炉料：到化验位定级，合格的整批升为等级 1。
ops:next_step:7.en: Unrated ferrous feed in stock: grade it at the assay bench.

ops:next_step:8.zh: 仓库有 %.2f t 未分选金属：到分选台分成黑色炉料和有色混合。
ops:next_step:8.en: %.2f t of mixed metal: sort it at the sorting desk.

ops:next_step:9.zh: 仓库有缺材料描述的旧料：先到化验位测一次，再能分选。
ops:next_step:9.en: Old stock with no record: read it at the assay bench before sorting.

ops:next_step:10.zh: 接下一单时在配装页打开“废金属留作原料”，拆下的结构钢就成了公司自己的原料；也可以在交易行买料。
ops:next_step:10.en: On the next job, switch on \"keep the scrap as raw material\" on the loadout page, or buy feed on the exchange.

guidepage:M01:body.zh:
拆船时，船壳、甲板这些废料掉进船坞熔炉，炼成钢锭。

结算时把钢锭拖进“我的仓库”。F3 看有多少吨。

交易行里也能买钢锭（等级 1 黑色炉料）。
guidepage:M01:body.en: Scrap from the hull goes into the berth furnace and comes out as ingots. Keep them at settlement and they go to the cargo warehouse (row A1); F3 shows how many tonnes. The exchange sells ingots too.

guidepage:M02:title.en: Send the ingots to the furnace

guidepage:M02:body.zh:
加工区要先修好一期。

在引导卡上按「送料到炉口」，或者到加工区炉台按 E，填好这一炉的吨数（0.25～2 吨），点「把仓库炉料送到炉口」。

料自己送过去，大约 20 秒。在哪按都行。
guidepage:M02:body.en: The processing district must be mended first. Press Send the feed on the guide card, or at the furnace desk set 0.25–2 t and send it. The forklift and the rail trolley bring it in about 20 s; it travels while you fly over.

guidepage:M03:body.zh:
料到了，按「通电熔化」。温度它自己管。

熔得多快，看炉台上的功率百分比，旁边写着大约多久能出钢。

动力区没修时，全港只有一台旧主机，约 6 兆瓦，电弧炉功率只有 15% 左右，一炉 2 吨要十几分钟。
guidepage:M03:body.en: At the desk, Strike the arcs: it charges, strikes and holds the temperature by itself. How fast depends on the power it gets; the desk shows what it draws, what it is given and how long is left. With the power district unmended the port has about 6 MW, and the furnace gets 3–4 of its 24 MW: a 2 t heat takes over ten minutes.

guidepage:M04:body.zh:
三条路：

· 买块电池顶着；
· 在供电屏把加工区排到拆船区前面，拆船现场功率会降；
· 修动力区：一期能发 30 兆瓦，从此够用。

拆船时，船坞熔炉排在前面会把电拿走，电弧炉功率掉到 0% 就停下降温；拆完再回来，它接着熔。
guidepage:M04:body.en: Three ways, each with a price: buy power (five times dearer than our own), move processing ahead of salvage at the power control screen (salvage slows), or mend the power district (30 MW at stage 1). While you strip a ship the berth furnace comes first and the arc furnace may stop and cool; it carries on afterwards.

guidepage:M05:body.zh: 全部熔化、温度到 1640 °C 以后，炉台按「测量温度并采集样本」。等测温探头完全收回，再按「倾斜炉体，排出钢水」。\n\n超过 1710 °C 会把成品烧成低等级。装了自动测温出钢以后，这两步由机器自己做。
guidepage:M05:body.en: Once all is melted at 1640 °C, Take a sample; when the probe is up, Tilt and tap. Over 1710 °C downgrades the product. With the auto unit fitted, the machine does both.

guidepage:M06:title.en: Billets cool and go to the warehouse

guidepage:M06:body.zh:
出完钢炉子空了，温度往下掉。

钢坯凉两三分钟，吊轨车运回仓库。完成时弹出“本次加工完成”，写着多少吨、放在哪一排。

连续轧开着的话，钢坯一入库就直接轧成钢板。
guidepage:M06:body.en: After tapping the furnace is empty and draws nothing; its temperature falls, as it should. The billets cool on the line for two or three minutes and the trolley takes them home. A card says how many tonnes and which row; F3 shows them under Products. With the mill rolling on, billet is rolled into plate as soon as it comes in.

guidepage:M07:body.zh:
按 F8 打开交易行，在「出售」里选货、填数量和价格挂牌；有人买就成交，钱当场到账，货由叉车和码头送走。

也可以在公司仓库（F3）点那样东西，按「去交易行挂牌卖」。

完整设备不用挂牌：在公司仓库或零件架上直接出售。
guidepage:M07:body.en: F8 opens the exchange: under Sell, pick the goods, quantity and price; when someone buys, the cash is there at once and the goods ship. From the stores (F3), a thing's List it button does the same. Whole equipment sells straight from the stores or the parts rack.

guidepage:M08:body.zh: 船壳、甲板、龙骨这些废料进熔炉，炼成钢锭；完整设备走设备口，结算时放进“我的仓库”就进了零件架，也可以当场卖掉；危险品走危险品口。\n\n没分选的废金属要先在分选台分开、化验位定级，才能当炉料。
guidepage:M08:body.en: Hull, decks and keel become scrap and then ingots in the furnace; whole equipment goes in by the equipment mouth and, kept at settlement, onto the parts rack (or sold there and then); hazards use theirs. Unsorted scrap must be sorted and assayed before it is furnace feed.

codex:cx_bolt_a.zh: 螺栓用来固定船上的零件，可以使用维护工具拧下来。这样拆除不会损坏零件，设备也能保持完整。
codex:cx_bolt_a.en: Bolts hold parts onto the ship and can be undone with the maintenance tool. Removing a part this way does not damage it, so the equipment stays whole.

codex:cx_bolt_b.zh: 拧下最后一颗螺栓以后，零件就失去了固定。如果没有提前固定好，零件可能会带着惯性漂走。
codex:cx_bolt_b.en: Once the last bolt is out, nothing holds the part any more. If it has not been secured beforehand, it can drift away with whatever motion it had.

codex:cx_bolt_c.zh: 拆除之前，先用抓钩固定住零件，确认不会漂走以后，再拧下最后一颗螺栓。
codex:cx_bolt_c.en: Before removing it, secure the part with the grapple. Once you are sure it will not drift off, take out the last bolt.

codex:cx_bolt_x.zh: 船上常用的是 M12–M24 高强度螺栓，拧紧以后会产生预紧力，把连接的两个零件压在一起。连接处主要依靠接触面的摩擦力防止零件滑动，螺栓本身也能承受一定的拉力和剪切力。\n拆除螺栓不会损坏设备，所以能用维护工具拆下来的零件，就尽量不要使用切割工具。完整拆下来的设备可以保留全部价值，一旦切开，就只能按照废金属的价格回收。\n还要注意，失重环境下没有地板帮你接住松开的零件。一块重达 0.5 吨的金属板，即使只有 0.1 米每秒的剩余速度，经过 10 秒也会漂出去 1 米，所以拆除最后一颗螺栓之前，一定要先把零件固定好。
codex:cx_bolt_x.en: Ship bolts are mostly high-strength M12–M24. Tightening them creates a preload that presses the two joined parts together. The joint mainly relies on friction between the contact faces to stop the parts sliding, and the bolt itself can also carry some tension and shear.\nRemoving a bolt does not damage the equipment, so use the maintenance tool rather than the cutting tool wherever a part can be unbolted. Equipment removed whole keeps its full value; once it is cut, it can only be recovered at scrap-metal price.\nAlso note that in weightlessness there is no floor to catch a part you have loosened. A 0.5 t metal plate with just 0.1 m/s of residual speed drifts 1 m away in 10 seconds, so always secure the part before removing the last bolt.

codex:cx_weld_a.zh: 两块金属通过焊接连在一起，已经成为一个整体，没办法用扳手拆开。
codex:cx_weld_a.en: Two pieces of metal are joined by welding and have become one body. A wrench cannot undo it.

codex:cx_weld_b.zh: 焊缝只能通过切割拆除，切割时如果损坏了旁边的设备，还会影响回收价值。
codex:cx_weld_b.en: A weld can only be removed by cutting. If the cut damages the equipment beside it, the recovery value drops.

codex:cx_weld_c.zh: 沿着焊缝或者标记好的切割线慢慢切开，注意不要切到设备本体。
codex:cx_weld_c.en: Cut slowly along the weld seam or the marked cutting line, and take care not to cut into the equipment itself.

codex:cx_weld_x.zh: 结构焊缝的强度和连接的金属差不多，所以激光需要切透整个截面，才能把两边彻底分开。\n不同材料的切割速度也不一样，普通钢板比较容易切开，装甲和厚梁需要更长时间，冰和复合材料则有各自的切割要求。\n切割时，激光会按照材料允许的速度跟随光标移动。尽量贴着切割线缓慢移动，等激光把材料完全切透以后再继续向前。如果移动得太快，激光就只能在表面留下浅浅的切痕，需要重新切割。
codex:cx_weld_x.en: A structural weld is about as strong as the metal it joins, so the laser has to cut through the whole cross-section before the two sides come apart.\nCutting speed also varies with the material. Ordinary steel plate is fairly easy to cut, armour and heavy beams take longer, and ice and composites each have their own cutting requirements.\nWhile cutting, the laser follows the cursor at whatever speed the material allows. Move slowly along the cutting line and wait until the laser has cut right through before moving on. If you move too fast, the laser only leaves a shallow groove on the surface and you have to cut again.

codex:cx_lock_a.zh: 锁扣是一种带有锁销的固定零件，拆卸起来比较方便，通常安装在检修盖或其他零件的背面。由于安装位置比较隐蔽，需要仔细检查才能找到。
codex:cx_lock_a.en: A lock is a fixing part with a locking pin. It is easy to remove and is usually fitted on the back of a service cover or another part. Because it is hidden, you need to look carefully to find it.

codex:cx_lock_b.zh: 如果还有锁扣没有拆除，就直接使用抓钩拉扯零件，可能会损坏零件的连接位置，拉力过大时还会把锁扣直接扯断。
codex:cx_lock_b.en: If a lock has not been removed and you pull the part with the grapple anyway, you may damage the part’s mounting point, and with too much pull the lock snaps outright.

codex:cx_lock_c.zh: 使用抓钩拉扯零件之前，先查看光标上的提示，确认还有多少个固定点没有拆除，全部处理完成后再进行拆卸。
codex:cx_lock_c.en: Before pulling a part with the grapple, check the hint on the cursor to see how many fixing points are still left, and pull only after all of them are dealt with.

codex:cx_lock_x.zh: 锁扣通常安装在需要经常拆卸的地方，像检修盖、可更换的设备和货物托盘，都可能使用锁扣固定。拆卸方法和螺栓差不多，使用维护工具就可以将锁扣打开。\n如果没有提前拆除锁扣，就直接使用抓钩强行拉扯，拉力超过锁扣的承受范围后，锁扣就会断裂，零件的安装位置也可能受到损坏。\n抓钩可以强行扯断锁扣和管线，但无法扯断螺栓。如果零件还有螺栓固定，就需要先使用维护工具将螺栓拆除，才能继续拆卸零件。
codex:cx_lock_x.en: Locks are usually fitted where parts need to be removed often. Service covers, replaceable equipment and cargo pallets may all be held by locks. They are removed much like bolts: the maintenance tool opens them.\nIf a lock has not been removed and you pull with the grapple anyway, the lock breaks once the pull exceeds what it can take, and the part’s mounting position may also be damaged.\nThe grapple can forcibly break locks and lines, but it cannot break bolts. If a part is still held by bolts, remove them with the maintenance tool first before you can continue taking the part off.

codex:cx_clamp_a.zh: 船坞里的液压夹具，用来把整艘船固定在泊位上，防止船体在拆解过程中发生移动。
codex:cx_clamp_a.en: The hydraulic clamps in the berth hold the whole ship in its bay so the hull cannot move during dismantling.

codex:cx_clamp_b.zh: 夹具只固定着船体上的几处结构，如果提前把这些结构拆掉，船体就会失去固定，可能在泊位里发生漂移。
codex:cx_clamp_b.en: The clamps grip only a few structures on the hull. If you remove those structures too early, the hull comes loose and may drift inside the bay.

codex:cx_clamp_c.zh: 拆解船体的时候，先保留被夹具固定的结构，等其他部分都拆得差不多了，再处理这些位置。
codex:cx_clamp_c.en: When dismantling the hull, keep the structures held by the clamps until last. Deal with those positions only when most of the rest has been taken apart.

codex:cx_clamp_x.zh: 船坞夹具一般固定在龙骨或底板上，虽然船体的移动速度可能很慢，但一艘几百吨重的船就算只以 0.05 m/s 的速度撞上泊位端墙，也可能因为撞击而损坏舱内没有固定好的设备。\n蓝图上会标出夹具固定的位置，拆解进入后半段以后，记得检查剩下的船体是否还被夹具固定，确认安全以后再继续拆解。
codex:cx_clamp_x.en: Berth clamps are usually fixed to the keel or the floor plates. The hull may move slowly, but even a ship of several hundred tonnes hitting the end wall of the bay at only 0.05 m/s can damage any loose equipment inside the rooms.\nThe positions held by the clamps are marked on the blueprint. Once the job is in its second half, check whether the remaining hull is still held by the clamps, and carry on only when it is safe.

codex:cx_hull_a.zh: 外壳板是船体外侧的金属板，负责保护内部结构，同时保持舱室密封，防止舱内气体泄漏。
codex:cx_hull_a.en: Hull plates are the metal plates on the outside of the hull. They protect the internal structure and keep the rooms sealed so that gas cannot leak out.

codex:cx_hull_b.zh: 如果舱室里面还有气压就直接切开外壳板，内部的高压气体会从切口快速喷出，可能把切开的板材和舱内没有固定好的设备一起冲出去。
codex:cx_hull_b.en: If you cut a hull plate while a room still holds air pressure, the high-pressure gas inside shoots out through the cut and can blow the cut plate out together with any loose equipment in the room.

codex:cx_hull_c.zh: 拆除外壳板之前，先检查舱室的气压，等气压降低到 5 kPa 以下以后，再开始切割。
codex:cx_hull_c.en: Before removing a hull plate, check the pressure in the room, and start cutting only after it has dropped below 5 kPa.

codex:cx_hull_x.zh: 一个标准大气压大约是 101 kPa，相当于每平方米承受约 10 吨的压力作用力。如果一块长 2 米、宽 1 米的外壳板承受着 100 kPa 的压差，那么整块板受到的推力就相当于 20 吨重物产生的重力。\n这种情况下直接切开外壳板，高压气体就会从切口快速喷出，气流速度甚至可能达到音速，几秒钟内就能把舱室里没有固定好的零件和碎屑冲出去。\n所以拆解之前一定要先完成泄压，确认舱室气压已经降低到 5 kPa 以下，再进行切割。
codex:cx_hull_x.en: One standard atmosphere is about 101 kPa, which is a force of about 10 tonnes on every square metre. If a hull plate 2 m long and 1 m wide has a pressure difference of 100 kPa across it, the thrust on the whole plate equals the weight of a 20 t load.\nCutting the plate in that state lets the high-pressure gas shoot out through the cut, at speeds that can even reach the speed of sound, and within seconds it blows out the loose parts and debris in the room.\nSo always vent the pressure before dismantling, and cut only after you have confirmed the room pressure is below 5 kPa.

codex:cx_bulkhead_a.zh: 舱壁是船体内部的隔墙，负责把船舱分成多个独立的密封区域，防止一个舱室发生事故以后影响到其他舱室。
codex:cx_bulkhead_a.en: A bulkhead is an internal wall of the hull. It divides the ship into several separate sealed areas so that an accident in one room does not affect the others.

codex:cx_bulkhead_b.zh: 如果舱壁两侧的气压不同，直接切开舱壁就会让高压一侧的气体迅速进入低压舱室，还可能把附近没有固定好的设备和零件一起冲过去。
codex:cx_bulkhead_b.en: If the pressure is different on the two sides of a bulkhead, cutting it lets gas from the high-pressure side rush into the low-pressure room, and it may sweep nearby loose equipment and parts along with it.

codex:cx_bulkhead_c.zh: 切割舱壁之前，先检查两侧舱室的气压，如果存在压差，就先进行泄压或者平衡两侧的气压，确认安全以后再开始拆除。
codex:cx_bulkhead_c.en: Before cutting a bulkhead, check the pressure in the rooms on both sides. If there is a pressure difference, vent or equalise the two sides first, and start removal only when it is safe.

codex:cx_bulkhead_x.zh: 舱壁可以把不同舱室隔开，这样即使其中一个舱室发生泄漏，也不会直接影响整艘船。拆解的时候也要注意，即使你已经把一个舱室的气体排空，隔壁的舱室也可能还保持着原来的气压。\n真正需要注意的是两侧的压差。如果两个舱室都是 100 kPa，切开中间的舱壁一般不会因为气压差而发生喷气，但两个舱室也会从此连通。\n如果之后还需要泄压，就得把连通的舱室一起处理，所以切割之前最好确认两侧的气压，避免增加后面的拆解工作。
codex:cx_bulkhead_x.en: Bulkheads separate the rooms, so even if one room leaks, the whole ship is not directly affected. Remember this when dismantling too: even after you have emptied one room of gas, the next room may still hold its original pressure.\nWhat really matters is the pressure difference between the two sides. If both rooms are at 100 kPa, cutting the bulkhead between them generally will not cause a blast of gas, but the two rooms become connected from then on.\nIf you still need to vent afterwards, you have to treat the connected rooms together, so it is best to check the pressure on both sides before cutting, to avoid adding to the dismantling work later.

codex:cx_frame_a.zh: 船体内部的龙骨、肋骨、纵梁和支撑杆都属于承力结构，它们组成了船体的主要骨架，负责支撑和固定其他设备。
codex:cx_frame_a.en: The keel, ribs, longitudinals and struts inside the hull are all load-bearing structures. Together they form the main skeleton of the hull and support and hold the other equipment.

codex:cx_frame_b.zh: 有些承力结构还在支撑其他设备，如果直接把它们切断，原本固定好的设备和船体结构就可能突然移动，甚至发生弹开、扭曲或断裂的情况。
codex:cx_frame_b.en: Some load-bearing structures are still supporting other equipment. If you cut them directly, equipment and hull structure that were held firmly may suddenly move, and may even spring off, twist or break.

codex:cx_frame_c.zh: 拆解之前，先检查承力结构连接着哪些设备，把它支撑的重量卸下来，确认没有其他结构需要依靠它固定以后，再进行切割。
codex:cx_frame_c.en: Before dismantling, check what equipment the load-bearing structure is connected to. Take off the weight it supports, make sure no other structure depends on it, and then cut.

codex:cx_frame_x.zh: 虽然太空里没有正常的重力载荷，但船体内部仍然存在预紧力、惯性作用，以及船坞夹具传递过来的外力。有些梁甚至需要同时固定两台几十吨重的设备，直接切断就可能让这些设备失去支撑。\n承力结构本身通常也比较重，有些会超过抓钩 3 t 的承重上限，所以拆解时需要沿着标记好的切割线分成几段，再分别运走。
codex:cx_frame_x.en: There is no normal gravity load in space, but the hull still has preload, inertia, and external forces passed on by the berth clamps. Some beams even hold two machines weighing tens of tonnes at once, and cutting them straight through can leave those machines unsupported.\nLoad-bearing structures are usually heavy themselves, and some exceed the grapple’s 3 t load limit, so they must be cut into several sections along the marked cutting lines and carried away one by one.

codex:cx_door_a.zh: 船上的舱门用来连接不同的舱室，大部分都需要通过船体总线供电，才能正常开启和关闭。
codex:cx_door_a.en: Doors on the ship connect the different rooms. Most of them need power from the ship’s bus to open and close properly.

codex:cx_door_b.zh: 如果舱室里面还有气压，直接打开舱门可能会让舱门受到气压冲击，严重时甚至会被直接冲飞。有些舱门还需要电力才能开启，一旦提前切断电源，就可能再也无法正常打开。
codex:cx_door_b.en: If a room still holds air pressure, opening its door may subject the door to a pressure shock, and in bad cases it is blown off outright. Some doors also need power to open, so if you cut the power too early, they may never open normally again.

codex:cx_door_c.zh: 打开舱门之前，先确认舱室里面的气压已经排空。需要使用电力开启的舱门，最好在切断船体电源之前就打开。
codex:cx_door_c.en: Before opening a door, make sure the pressure in the room has been vented. For doors that need power to open, it is best to open them before cutting the ship’s power.

codex:cx_door_x.zh: 一扇面积为 2 m² 的舱门，如果两侧存在 60 kPa 的气压差，舱门就会承受相当于约 12 吨重物的压力。这种情况下，驱动电机可能无法正常开启舱门，一旦解除门锁，舱门甚至可能被气压直接冲飞。\n大型货舱门一般需要电机或者液压系统驱动，如果提前拆除了供电电池，后面可能就只能使用切割工具强行打开。不过船坞也提供了外部供电插座，即使已经切断船体电源，也可以通过外部供电临时启动舱门。
codex:cx_door_x.en: If a 2 m² door has a pressure difference of 60 kPa across it, the door bears a force equal to about 12 tonnes. In that case the drive motor may not be able to open the door, and once the latch is released, the door may even be blown off by the pressure.\nLarge cargo doors usually need a motor or a hydraulic system to drive them. If you remove the power battery too early, the only way left may be to force them open with the cutting tool. However, the berth also provides an external power socket, so even after the ship’s power is cut, a door can be started temporarily from external power.

codex:cx_rail_a.zh: 安装在船体内部的导轨，主要用来运输货物，或者让吊车和滑架沿着固定的路线移动。
codex:cx_rail_a.en: A guide rail installed inside the hull, used mainly to carry cargo, or to let cranes and cradles move along a fixed route.

codex:cx_rail_b.zh: 如果轨道上还有货物或者设备，直接切断轨道可能会让它们失去支撑，导致设备损坏，严重时还可能直接掉落。
codex:cx_rail_b.en: If a rail still carries cargo or equipment, cutting it directly may leave them unsupported, damaging the equipment, and in bad cases they may drop.

codex:cx_rail_c.zh: 拆除轨道之前，先把上面的货物和设备全部移走，确认轨道上没有剩余载荷以后，再开始拆解。
codex:cx_rail_c.en: Before removing a rail, move all the cargo and equipment off it, and start dismantling only once you have confirmed no load is left on the rail.

codex:cx_rail_x.zh: 轨道通常由多个支座共同承受重量，这样就能把货物的重量分散到不同位置。如果直接切断其中一段，原本由整条轨道承担的部分重量就会集中到断口附近的支座上，一旦超过它们的承重能力，就可能发生变形或者断裂。\n如果货物通过锁轨固定在轨道上，需要先沿着轨道把货物运出去，不能直接使用扳手拆除固定装置。具体操作可以查看对应船型的锁轨说明。
codex:cx_rail_x.en: A rail is usually carried by several mounts, which spread the weight of the cargo over different positions. If you cut one section, part of the weight the whole rail was bearing is concentrated on the mounts next to the break, and if it exceeds what they can take, they may deform or break.\nIf cargo is fixed to the rail by a rail lock, it has to be driven out along the rail first, and the fixing cannot simply be removed with the wrench. For the exact procedure, see the rail-lock entry for the ship type concerned.

codex:cx_film_a.zh: 一种只有几微米厚的聚酰亚胺薄膜，主要用在飞船的帆面、气囊外壁和遮阳膜上。
codex:cx_film_a.en: A polyimide film only a few microns thick, used mainly for sail panels, gasbag walls and sunshades on ships.

codex:cx_film_b.zh: 薄膜在绷紧的时候很容易被撕裂，如果直接使用切割工具，切口可能会在张力作用下迅速扩大，最后导致整片薄膜破裂。
codex:cx_film_b.en: Film tears easily when taut. If you use the cutting tool directly, the cut may spread rapidly under tension and eventually tear the whole film.

codex:cx_film_c.zh: 拆解薄膜之前，先解除固定装置，让薄膜完全松弛下来，再把整片薄膜拆下来。
codex:cx_film_c.en: Before dismantling film, release the fixings so the film goes completely slack, and then take the whole film off.

codex:cx_film_x.zh: 这种薄膜的抗撕裂强度只有每米几牛，而绷紧的帆面每米可能承受几十牛的张力。如果直接使用激光切割，切口就可能成为裂纹的起点，在张力作用下，裂纹甚至能以接近声速的速度扩展。\n薄膜本身非常轻，基本不会阻挡物体碰撞，也不会影响正常的移动路径，不过它仍然能够遮挡光线，而且表面容易积累静电，拆解的时候也需要注意。
codex:cx_film_x.en: The tear strength of this film is only a few newtons per metre, while a taut sail panel may carry tens of newtons per metre of tension. If you cut with the laser directly, the cut can become the start of a crack, and under tension the crack can spread at close to the speed of sound.\nThe film itself is very light. It basically does not block collisions or affect normal movement paths, but it can still block light and easily builds up static charge, so take care of this when dismantling.

codex:cx_cable_a.zh: 连接船体电网和各种设备的供电电缆，两端都有可以拆卸的接头，用来给设备提供电力。
codex:cx_cable_a.en: A power cable that connects the ship’s grid to various equipment. Both ends have removable plugs, which supply power to the equipment.

codex:cx_cable_b.zh: 如果电缆还带着电，直接拔掉接头或者使用切割工具，就可能产生电弧，损坏附近的设备，甚至伤到正在作业的无人机。
codex:cx_cable_b.en: If a cable is still live, pulling the plug or using the cutting tool directly can produce an arc, damaging nearby equipment and even hurting the drone at work.

codex:cx_cable_c.zh: 拆卸电缆之前，先用验电工具确认电压已经降到 0 V，再拔掉两端的接头，之后就可以正常搬走设备了。
codex:cx_cable_c.en: Before removing a cable, check with the voltage tester that the voltage has dropped to 0 V, then unplug the connectors at both ends. After that the equipment can be carried away as normal.

codex:cx_cable_x.zh: 30 V 以下的电压通常不会对无人机造成伤害，不过船上的供电总线一般在 28–400 V 之间，部分电容组的电压甚至能达到上千伏，拆卸之前一定要确认电路已经断电。\n直流电弧没有交流电那种周期性的电流过零点，一旦产生电弧，就可能持续放电，直到电流被切断。\n搬运设备的时候也要注意，如果连接设备的电缆还没有拔掉，抓钩就可能无法正常拖动设备。继续增加拉力的话，还可能直接把电缆接头扯坏。
codex:cx_cable_x.en: Voltages below 30 V generally do not harm the drone, but the ship’s power buses are usually between 28 and 400 V, and some capacitor banks even reach over a thousand volts, so always confirm the circuit is dead before removal.\nA DC arc has no periodic current zero crossing like AC, so once an arc forms, it can keep discharging until the current is cut off.\nAlso take care when moving equipment: if the cable connecting the equipment has not been unplugged, the grapple may be unable to drag the equipment properly. If you keep increasing the pull, it may even tear the cable plug off.

codex:cx_pipe_line_a.zh: 船上的管线主要用来输送冷却液、燃料和气体，两端都有可以拆卸的接头，方便连接设备或者其他管路。
codex:cx_pipe_line_a.en: Lines on the ship mainly carry coolant, fuel and gas. Both ends have removable couplings so they can be connected to equipment or to other pipes.

codex:cx_pipe_line_b.zh: 如果管线里面还残留着液体或者气体，直接切开就可能造成泄漏。燃料泄漏以后可能形成易燃的气体云团，而温度过高的管线还可能损坏正在作业的无人机。
codex:cx_pipe_line_b.en: If a line still holds liquid or gas, cutting it directly may cause a leak. Leaked fuel can form a flammable gas cloud, and an over-hot line can damage the drone at work.

codex:cx_pipe_line_c.zh: 拆卸管线之前，先通过低处的排放口把内部的液体抽干净，再检查管线温度，确认已经冷却到安全范围以后，才能拔掉接头或者进行切割。
codex:cx_pipe_line_c.en: Before removing a line, draw the contents off through the low-point drain, then check the line temperature, and uncouple or cut it only after confirming it has cooled to a safe range.

codex:cx_pipe_line_x.zh: 关闭阀门以后，管线里面可能仍然残留着液体，尤其是两个阀门之间的管段，即使两端都已经关闭，中间的液体也不会自动排出去，所以拆卸之前还需要单独排空。\n在失重环境下，泄漏的液体不会流到地面，而是会形成漂浮的液团。如果这些液体接触到带电设备，就可能造成短路。\n管线的温度如果超过 60°C，还可能损坏负责抓取和搬运的无人机，所以拆卸之前要先测量温度，确认安全以后再继续操作。
codex:cx_pipe_line_x.en: After a valve is closed, the line may still hold liquid. This is especially so for the length between two valves: even with both ends closed, the liquid in the middle does not drain by itself, so it needs to be drained separately before removal.\nIn weightlessness, leaked liquid does not run to the floor but forms floating globules. If these touch live equipment, they can cause a short circuit.\nIf a line is hotter than 60°C, it may also damage the drone that grips and moves it, so measure the temperature before removal and continue only when it is safe.

codex:cx_cut_line_a.zh: 一些大型设备的重量超过了抓钩的搬运上限，所以设备表面会提前标出可以安全切割的位置，方便拆解时将设备分成几个部分。
codex:cx_cut_line_a.en: Some large equipment weighs more than the grapple can carry, so safe cutting positions are marked on its surface in advance, to let you split the equipment into several parts when dismantling.

codex:cx_cut_line_b.zh: 如果随便选择位置切割，很容易损坏设备内部的零件，导致回收价值大幅下降。但如果不进行分段，整台设备又可能因为重量太大，无法使用抓钩搬运。
codex:cx_cut_line_b.en: If you pick a position at random to cut, it is easy to damage the parts inside the equipment, and the recovery value drops sharply. But if you do not split it into sections, the whole piece may be too heavy for the grapple to move.

codex:cx_cut_line_c.zh: 按照设备表面的标线进行切割，把设备分成几个部分，并确认每个部分的重量都没有超过抓钩的搬运上限。
codex:cx_cut_line_c.en: Cut along the marked lines on the equipment surface to split it into several parts, and confirm that the weight of each part does not exceed the grapple’s carrying limit.

codex:cx_cut_line_x.zh: 抓钩最初的搬运上限是 3 吨，升级以后可以提高到 5 吨。对于重量超过这个上限的设备，设计时一般都会预留能够安全分段的位置，通常位于连接法兰、模块接缝或者没有管线经过的地方。\n只要沿着标线进行切割，拆下来的每个部分仍然可以按照设备部件回收，保留原有的回收价值。如果随意切割，就可能切坏内部的线圈绕组、管束或者电路板，到时候损坏的部分就只能按照废金属的价格回收了。
codex:cx_cut_line_x.en: The grapple’s original carrying limit is 3 t, and after an upgrade it rises to 5 t. For equipment heavier than this limit, safe splitting positions are normally built in at the design stage, usually at connecting flanges, module seams, or places no line passes through.\nAs long as you cut along the marked lines, each part removed can still be recovered as equipment parts and keep its original recovery value. If you cut at random, you may ruin internal coil windings, tube bundles or circuit boards, and the damaged parts can then only be recovered at scrap-metal price.

codex:cx_glass_a.zh: 船上的舷窗和精密玻璃罩板，一般通过压条和螺栓固定在船体上，拆解时可以将整块玻璃完整取下来。
codex:cx_glass_a.en: Ship windows and precision glass cover plates are usually held to the hull by clamping strips and bolts, and can be taken off whole when dismantling.

codex:cx_glass_b.zh: 如果玻璃背后还有气压，直接拆除固定螺栓可能会让整块玻璃被气压推出去，造成玻璃破碎。在玻璃附近使用激光切割工具，也可能因为温度变化过大而导致玻璃开裂。
codex:cx_glass_b.en: If there is still pressure behind the glass, removing the fixing bolts directly may let the pressure push the whole pane out and shatter it. Using the laser cutting tool near the glass may also crack it through too large a temperature change.

codex:cx_glass_c.zh: 拆除玻璃之前，先确认舱室已经完成泄压，切割周围结构的时候也要和玻璃保持距离。等附近的拆解工作完成以后，再拧下固定压条的螺栓，把整块玻璃取出来。
codex:cx_glass_c.en: Before removing glass, make sure the room has been vented, and keep your distance from the glass when cutting the surrounding structure. Once the nearby dismantling is finished, undo the bolts of the clamping strips and take the whole pane out.

codex:cx_glass_x.zh: 玻璃能够承受较大的压力，但受到拉力或者局部温度变化时就容易出现裂纹，表面原本存在的划痕也会增加破裂的风险。\n如果在距离玻璃 0.7 m 以内使用激光切割工具，切割产生的热辐射和高温飞溅物可能让玻璃两侧的温差超过 100°C，产生的热应力足以让玻璃开裂。\n完整的光学玻璃可以卖出很高的价格，一旦发生破碎，基本就没有多少回收价值了。
codex:cx_glass_x.en: Glass can bear high compression, but it cracks easily under tension or local temperature change, and scratches already on the surface increase the risk of breaking.\nIf you use the laser cutting tool within 0.7 m of the glass, the thermal radiation and hot spatter from cutting can put a temperature difference of over 100°C between the two faces, and the resulting thermal stress is enough to crack the glass.\nIntact optical glass sells for a high price, but once it breaks, there is almost no recovery value left.

codex:cx_armor_a.zh: 船体外部安装的厚重防护板，包括分层装甲、隔热瓦和辐射屏蔽层，主要用来保护船体和内部设备。
codex:cx_armor_a.en: Thick protective plates on the outside of the hull, including layered armour, heat tiles and radiation shielding, used mainly to protect the hull and the equipment inside.

codex:cx_armor_b.zh: 装甲的厚度和硬度都比较高，使用切割工具拆除时会花费很长时间，而且切割产生的热量容易集中在切口附近。如果周围安装了其他设备，持续产生的高温就可能把这些设备损坏。
codex:cx_armor_b.en: Armour is thick and hard, so removing it with the cutting tool takes a long time, and the heat from cutting tends to collect around the cut. If other equipment is installed around it, the continuing high temperature may damage that equipment.

codex:cx_armor_c.zh: 拆解装甲之前，先检查有没有固定螺栓，能够直接拆卸的就尽量不要使用切割工具。如果必须进行切割，最好选择远离其他设备的位置，避免高温造成额外损失。
codex:cx_armor_c.en: Before dismantling armour, check for fixing bolts, and wherever it can be unbolted, avoid the cutting tool. If you must cut, choose a position away from other equipment to avoid extra losses from the heat.

codex:cx_armor_x.zh: 装甲主要依靠自身的厚度和硬度来吸收冲击能量，所以切割起来会比较困难，有些装甲的切割速度甚至只有普通钢板的十分之一。\n部分船体还安装了钨或氢化锂制成的辐射屏蔽层，这些材料主要用来阻挡辐射，通常重量较大，而且比较容易发生脆裂。\n船体外部的装甲条一般通过螺栓固定，如果能够找到固定位置，直接拆除螺栓通常会比切穿整块装甲快得多，也能减少切割过程中产生的热量。
codex:cx_armor_x.en: Armour absorbs impact energy mainly through its own thickness and hardness, so it is hard to cut, and some armour cuts at only a tenth of the speed of ordinary steel plate.\nSome hulls also carry radiation shielding made of tungsten or lithium hydride. These materials mainly block radiation, are usually heavy, and are fairly prone to brittle cracking.\nArmour strips on the outside of the hull are generally held by bolts. If you can find the fixing positions, removing the bolts is usually much faster than cutting through the whole armour plate, and also reduces the heat produced by cutting.

codex:cx_insul_a.zh: 船体内部用来隔绝热量的结构，有些是在两层金属蒙皮之间填充隔热泡沫，有些则使用多层隔热毯，主要用来保持冷藏舱和低温储罐的温度。
codex:cx_insul_a.en: Structures inside the hull that block heat. Some have insulating foam filled between two metal skins, others use multilayer insulation blankets. They mainly keep cold rooms and cryogenic tanks at temperature.

codex:cx_insul_b.zh: 如果提前拆除了隔热层，外部的热量就会更快进入冷藏舱和低温储罐，导致内部温度上升。低温储罐里的液体还可能因为受热而加快蒸发，让罐内压力不断增加。
codex:cx_insul_b.en: If the insulation is removed too early, heat from outside reaches cold rooms and cryogenic tanks faster, and the temperature inside rises. The liquid in a cryogenic tank may also boil off faster when heated, so the pressure in the tank keeps rising.

codex:cx_insul_c.zh: 拆解隔热层之前，先确认附近的冷藏设备和低温储罐已经处理完成。如果里面还有需要保持低温的货物，就暂时保留隔热层，等货物转移完成以后再拆除。
codex:cx_insul_c.en: Before dismantling insulation, make sure the nearby refrigeration equipment and cryogenic tanks have been dealt with. If there is still cargo inside that must be kept cold, leave the insulation in place for now and remove it after the cargo has been moved.

codex:cx_insul_x.zh: 真空环境中的多层隔热毯通常由几十层镀铝薄膜组成，可以通过反射热辐射来减少热量传递。隔热层保持完整时，每平方米的漏热量通常只有零点几瓦。\n如果在隔热毯上划开一道缺口，受损区域的漏热量就可能增加到原来的十倍以上，导致内部温度上升得更快。\n对于装有低温货物的储罐来说，隔热层的完整程度会直接影响货物的升温和蒸发速度，所以最好等低温货物全部处理完成以后，再开始拆除隔热结构。
codex:cx_insul_x.en: In vacuum, a multilayer insulation blanket is usually made of dozens of layers of aluminised film, which reduces heat transfer by reflecting thermal radiation. While the insulation is intact, the heat leak is usually only a fraction of a watt per square metre.\nIf you slit the blanket, the heat leak in the damaged area may rise to more than ten times the original, and the temperature inside rises faster.\nFor a tank holding cryogenic cargo, how intact the insulation is directly affects how fast the cargo warms and boils off, so it is best to start removing insulation only after all the cryogenic cargo has been dealt with.

codex:cx_cover_a.zh: 船体上用来保护设备或遮挡固定位置的盖板，有些设备和螺栓安装在盖板后面，需要拆除盖板以后才能接触到。
codex:cx_cover_a.en: Panels on the hull that protect equipment or hide fixing points. Some equipment and bolts sit behind a cover and can only be reached after it is removed.

codex:cx_cover_b.zh: 有些固定螺栓藏在盖板后面，从外面看不到，也无法直接拆卸。如果没有注意到这些位置，就可能漏掉固定螺栓，导致后面的设备无法正常拆除。
codex:cx_cover_b.en: Some fixing bolts are hidden behind covers, so they cannot be seen from outside and cannot be removed directly. If you do not notice these positions, you may miss a fixing bolt, and then the equipment behind cannot be removed properly.

codex:cx_cover_c.zh: 遇到检修盖或者护板时，可以先把盖板拆下来，再检查后面有没有隐藏的螺栓或其他固定位置，确认以后再继续拆解设备。
codex:cx_cover_c.en: When you meet a service cover or guard plate, take the cover off first, then check behind it for hidden bolts or other fixing points, and carry on dismantling the equipment only after confirming.

codex:cx_cover_x.zh: 工程蓝图通常会标出盖板后面的设备和固定位置，不过图纸记录的是船体设计时的结构，实际拆解的船只可能经过维修或者改装，所以有些位置会和图纸不一样。\n被盖板挡住的固定点不会在光标上显示，也无法直接操作。只有拆除盖板以后，才能找到并拆卸后面的固定螺栓。
codex:cx_cover_x.en: Engineering blueprints usually mark the equipment and fixing points behind a cover. However, the drawing records the structure at the time of design, and a ship being dismantled may have been repaired or modified, so some positions may differ from the drawing.\nFixing points hidden behind a cover are not shown on the cursor and cannot be operated directly. Only after the cover is removed can you find and undo the fixing bolts behind it.

codex:cx_port.zh: 接口（测压口 / 回收口）

codex:cx_port_a.zh: 船体上用来连接测量工具或者回收软管的接口，一般安装在舱室、储罐或者管路上，可以通过这些接口检查内部压力，也可以把里面的气体和液体回收出来。
