codex:cx_port_a.en: A connection on the hull for the measuring tool or the recovery hose, usually fitted on a room, tank or line. Through it you can check the internal pressure, and recover the gas and liquid inside.

codex:cx_port_b.zh: 测压口只能测量与它连通的那段管路，如果中间的阀门处于关闭状态，就算压力读数显示为零，也不能说明舱室或者储罐里面已经没有气压。
codex:cx_port_b.en: A pressure port can only measure the section of line it is connected to. If a valve in between is shut, a pressure reading of zero does not mean the room or tank has no pressure.

codex:cx_port_c.zh: 使用接口之前，先打开工程图，检查接口连接到了哪个舱室或者储罐，再确认中间的阀门已经打开，避免测量到错误的压力数据。
codex:cx_port_c.en: Before using a port, open the engineering drawing and check which room or tank it is connected to, then confirm the valves in between are open, so you do not read the wrong pressure.

codex:cx_port_x.zh: 测压口后面通常连接着一小段管路和阀门，如果阀门处于关闭状态，测量工具只能读取这段短管里面的压力，即使显示为零，阀门另一侧也可能还有大量高压气体。\n回收口则可以连接软管，通过船坞的回收泵把船内的气体或者液体抽出来，其中回收的气体会按照对应价值计入合同收益。\n回收速度主要取决于接口的口径和回收泵的工作能力，如果接口太小，就算使用更大的回收泵，也很难明显提高回收速度。
codex:cx_port_x.en: Behind a pressure port there is usually a short pipe and a valve. If the valve is shut, the measuring tool can only read the pressure in that short pipe, and even if it shows zero, there may still be a lot of high-pressure gas on the other side of the valve.\nA recovery port can take a hose, and the berth’s recovery pump draws the gas or liquid out of the ship. The gas recovered is counted into the contract income at its corresponding value.\nRecovery speed mainly depends on the port’s bore and the recovery pump’s capacity. If the port is too small, even a larger recovery pump will hardly raise the recovery speed.

codex:cx_valve_a.zh: 安装在船体管路上的手动阀门，可以控制管路的开启和关闭，也能用来切断两个舱室或容器之间的连接。
codex:cx_valve_a.en: A manual valve fitted on the ship’s lines. It opens and closes the line, and can also cut the connection between two rooms or containers.

codex:cx_valve_b.zh: 关闭的阀门会把管路隔成不同的部分，如果只测量其中一段，就可能误以为整条管路都已经排空。有些阀门还可能因为故障而卡住，导致后面无法正常连接软管。
codex:cx_valve_b.en: A closed valve splits a line into separate parts. If you measure only one section, you may wrongly think the whole line has been emptied. Some valves may also jam through a fault, so a hose cannot be connected properly afterwards.

codex:cx_valve_c.zh: 可以使用维护工具开启或关闭阀门。如果遇到卡死的阀门，就先使用扳手把它拧开，再继续处理管路。
codex:cx_valve_c.en: You can open or close a valve with the maintenance tool. If a valve is jammed, free it with the wrench first, then carry on with the line.

codex:cx_valve_x.zh: 阀门可以把整套管路分成几个独立的部分，每一段管路里面的压力和液位都可能不同，所以其中一段已经排空，并不代表其他部分也已经安全。\n检查管路的时候，可以按照工程图找到对应接口，再沿着管路逐段检查。每经过一个阀门，都要确认它当前处于开启还是关闭状态，避免遗漏仍然存在压力或残留液体的管路。
codex:cx_valve_x.en: Valves can divide a whole line system into several independent parts, and the pressure and liquid level in each section may differ, so one section being empty does not mean the other parts are safe.\nWhen checking lines, follow the engineering drawing to find the matching port, then check the line section by section. At every valve, confirm whether it is currently open or shut, so you do not miss a line that still holds pressure or leftover liquid.

codex:cx_switch_a.zh: 船上的开关可以用来切断电路、控制设备待发状态，也可以操作刹车和机械锁等装置。不同开关控制的设备和功能也会有所区别。
codex:cx_switch_a.en: Switches on the ship can cut a circuit, set equipment to standby, and operate devices such as brakes and mechanical locks. Different switches control different equipment and functions.

codex:cx_switch_b.zh: 关闭一个开关，通常只能切断它所控制的那条线路。如果船上还有备用电池、独立电源或者储能设备，其他线路就可能仍然带电，直接拆解会有危险。
codex:cx_switch_b.en: Turning off one switch usually cuts only the line it controls. If the ship also has backup batteries, independent supplies or energy storage, other lines may still be live, and dismantling them directly is dangerous.

codex:cx_switch_c.zh: 关闭开关以后，先使用测量工具检查对应线路的电压，确认电压已经降到 0 V，再继续拆解相关设备。
codex:cx_switch_c.en: After turning a switch off, use the measuring tool to check the voltage of the line concerned, confirm it has dropped to 0 V, and only then continue dismantling the related equipment.

codex:cx_switch_x.zh: 设备关闭以后，不代表内部已经完全断电。主开关一般只能切断主电源，备用电池和独立供电线路仍然可能带电，电容组也可能保留之前储存的电能。\n部分设备还需要按照指定顺序操作开关，比如先完成冷却再解除刹车，或者先释放内部压力再拔出锁销。如果操作顺序错误，可能会导致设备损坏，甚至引发危险，所以拆解之前最好先确认每个开关的作用。
codex:cx_switch_x.en: Equipment being switched off does not mean it is completely dead inside. The main switch can usually cut only the main supply, while backup batteries and independent supply lines may still be live, and capacitor banks may still hold the energy stored earlier.\nSome equipment also needs its switches operated in a set order, such as finishing cooling before releasing the brake, or releasing internal pressure before pulling the locking pin. A wrong order may damage the equipment or even cause danger, so it is best to confirm what each switch does before dismantling.

codex:cx_test_a.zh: 船体电网上专门用来测量电压的位置，可以使用测量工具读取对应线路的电压，检查这部分电路是否已经断电。
codex:cx_test_a.en: A place on the ship’s grid made for measuring voltage. You can use the measuring tool to read the voltage of that line and check whether this part of the circuit has been de-energised.

codex:cx_test_b.zh: 验电点只能显示它所在那段线路的电压，其他支路可能连接着独立电源，所以一个位置显示 0 V，并不代表整艘船的电路都已经断电。
codex:cx_test_b.en: A test point shows only the voltage of the section of line it is on. Other branches may be connected to independent supplies, so 0 V at one position does not mean the circuits of the whole ship are dead.

codex:cx_test_c.zh: 先切断相关线路的电源，再释放电容等设备中储存的电能，完成这些操作以后，重新使用测量工具检查电压，确认读数为 0 V 再开始拆解。
codex:cx_test_c.en: First cut the power to the lines concerned, then release the energy stored in capacitors and similar equipment. After that, check the voltage with the measuring tool again, and start dismantling only when the reading is 0 V.

codex:cx_test_x.zh: 验电点显示的是测量时的电压，如果测量完成以后又操作了其他开关，线路的供电状态就可能发生变化，之前的读数也就不能继续作为判断依据。\n比较安全的操作顺序是先断开电源，再释放储存的电能，随后进行验电。一定要在前两项操作完成以后重新测量，如果中途修改了开关状态，也需要再次确认电压，避免根据之前的读数进行拆解。
codex:cx_test_x.en: A test point shows the voltage at the time of measurement. If you operate other switches after measuring, the supply state of the line may change, and the earlier reading can no longer be relied on.\nThe safer order is to isolate the power first, then release the stored energy, and then test. Always measure again after the first two steps are done, and if you change any switch state in between, confirm the voltage again, so you never dismantle on the strength of an earlier reading.

codex:cx_probe_a.zh: 安装在船体和各种设备上的传感器，可以用来测量温度、液位、辐射剂量、张力和转速等数据，帮助你了解设备当前的运行状态。
codex:cx_probe_a.en: Sensors fitted on the hull and various equipment. They can measure data such as temperature, level, radiation dose, tension and rotation speed, and help you see the equipment’s current state.

codex:cx_probe_b.zh: 有些设备即使已经停止运行，内部也可能残留压力、热量或者其他危险。如果没有提前查看探头的读数，就很难判断设备是否已经达到安全的拆解条件。
codex:cx_probe_b.en: Some equipment may still hold pressure, heat or other dangers inside even after it has stopped running. If you have not read the probe beforehand, it is hard to tell whether the equipment has reached a safe condition for dismantling.

codex:cx_probe_c.zh: 开始拆解之前，先使用测量工具查看相关探头的读数，确认设备目前的状态。完成操作以后再测量一次，检查数值有没有达到安全范围。
codex:cx_probe_c.en: Before dismantling, read the relevant probes with the measuring tool to confirm the equipment’s current state. After the work, measure again and check whether the values have reached the safe range.

codex:cx_probe_x.zh: 船上的很多特殊设备都有对应的测量探头，包括线圈的储存能量、飞轮的转速、钻杆的扭矩、储罐的压力、舱室内的氧气浓度、辐射剂量率和炉芯温度等。\n这些读数可以帮助你判断设备是否已经达到安全状态。如果数值还没有降到要求的范围，就说明可能还需要继续等待，或者检查有没有遗漏的操作。拆解之前多检查一次，通常能避免后面出现不必要的事故。
codex:cx_probe_x.en: Many special pieces of equipment on the ship have matching measuring probes, including a coil’s stored energy, a flywheel’s rotation speed, a drill string’s torque, a tank’s pressure, the oxygen concentration in a room, radiation dose rate and a furnace core’s temperature.\nThese readings help you judge whether the equipment has reached a safe state. If a value has not yet dropped to the required range, you may need to keep waiting, or check for a step you missed. Checking once more before dismantling usually avoids needless accidents later.

codex:cx_socket_a.zh: 船坞外部面板上的连接接口，可以为船体提供临时电力、冷却系统和接地线路，方便在拆解过程中继续使用部分设备。
codex:cx_socket_a.en: Connection ports on the berth’s external panel. They can supply the hull with temporary power, a cooling system and an earthing line, so that some equipment can keep running during dismantling.

codex:cx_socket_b.zh: 有些设备在切断船体电源以后，仍然需要电力或者冷却才能安全关闭。如果提前断开电源，又没有接好船坞提供的外部接口，就可能导致这些设备无法正常工作。
codex:cx_socket_b.en: Some equipment still needs power or cooling to shut down safely after the ship’s power is cut. If you cut the power too early without connecting the berth’s external ports, this equipment may fail to work properly.

codex:cx_socket_c.zh: 切断船体电源之前，先找到船坞外部面板上的对应插座，把需要的供电、供冷或者接地线路连接好，再继续拆解。
codex:cx_socket_c.en: Before cutting the ship’s power, find the matching sockets on the berth’s external panel, connect the power, cooling or earthing lines you need, and then continue dismantling.

codex:cx_socket_x.zh: 船坞的外部供电可以让舱门、水泵和制冷机在船体断电以后继续工作，这样就不用担心拆除电池后，还有设备需要通电才能完成操作。\n外部供冷可以让冷链货舱继续保持低温，避免货物因为温度升高而损坏。接地线路则可以把帆面等大面积结构上积累的静电导走，减少拆解时发生静电放电的风险。\n这些接口都安装在船坞的外部面板上，需要完成连接以后才能发挥作用。
codex:cx_socket_x.en: The berth’s external power lets doors, pumps and chillers keep working after the ship’s power is cut, so you need not worry that some equipment still needs power to finish its operation after the battery is removed.\nExternal cooling lets a cold-chain hold stay cold, so cargo is not spoiled by a temperature rise. The earthing line can conduct away the static charge built up on large structures such as sail panels, reducing the risk of electrostatic discharge during dismantling.\nThese ports are all fitted on the berth’s external panel and only take effect once they are connected.

codex:cx_discharge_a.zh: 安装在设备附近接线盒上的放电开关，可以让电容组通过电阻缓慢放电，把内部储存的电能释放掉。
codex:cx_discharge_a.en: A discharge switch fitted on a junction box near the equipment. It lets a capacitor bank discharge slowly through a resistor and releases the energy stored inside.

codex:cx_discharge_b.zh: 电容即使已经断开电源，内部也可能储存着大量电能。如果没有完成放电就直接拆解，接触带电部件时可能产生高压电弧，造成严重伤害。
codex:cx_discharge_b.en: Even when disconnected from the power, a capacitor may still store a great deal of energy. If you dismantle it before discharging, touching a live part can produce a high-voltage arc and cause serious injury.

codex:cx_discharge_c.zh: 拆解电容组之前，先找到附近接线盒上的放电开关，启动放电程序。等电量显示归零以后，还需要使用检测工具确认没有残余电压，再开始拆解。
codex:cx_discharge_c.en: Before dismantling a capacitor bank, find the discharge switch on the nearby junction box and start the discharge. When the charge reading falls to zero, also check with the test tool that no residual voltage is left, and only then start dismantling.

codex:cx_discharge_x.zh: 电容可以在断电以后继续储存电能，储存的能量可以通过公式 E = ½CV² 计算。一组容量为 0.1 F 的电容，如果电压达到 400 V，内部就储存着 8 kJ 的能量，即使已经切断电源，也可能在接触时产生危险的电弧。\n通过电阻放电时，电容的电压会按照 e^(−t/RC) 的规律逐渐降低，大约经过五个时间常数以后，电压就会降到初始值的 1% 以下。\n放电开关一般安装在设备附近的接线盒上，完成放电以后还要检查剩余电压，确认安全才能继续拆解。
codex:cx_discharge_x.en: A capacitor can keep its stored energy after the power is cut, and the stored energy can be calculated with the formula E = ½CV². A bank of 0.1 F at 400 V stores 8 kJ of energy, and even after the supply is cut, touching it can produce a dangerous arc.\nWhen discharging through a resistor, the capacitor’s voltage falls gradually following e^(−t/RC), and after about five time constants it drops below 1% of its initial value.\nThe discharge switch is generally on a junction box near the equipment. After discharging, check the remaining voltage, and continue dismantling only once it is confirmed safe.

codex:cx_seal_a.zh: 用来封存船上生物危险品的装置，可以通过密封袋或者密封盖把危险品封闭起来，防止污染物在搬运过程中扩散。
codex:cx_seal_a.en: A device for sealing the ship’s biohazard items. It closes the hazardous item in with a sealing bag or sealing cap, to stop contaminants spreading while it is being moved.

codex:cx_seal_b.zh: 如果还没有完成密封就直接搬运或者切割，里面的污染物可能会进入舱室空气，并随着空气流动扩散到其他位置，导致更多设备受到污染。
codex:cx_seal_b.en: If you move or cut it before sealing is complete, the contaminants inside may get into the room’s air and spread with the air flow to other places, contaminating more equipment.

codex:cx_seal_c.zh: 处理生物危险品之前，先使用密封袋或者密封盖把危险品封好，确认不会发生泄漏以后，再把整件危险品送到专门的危险品回收口。
codex:cx_seal_c.en: Before handling a biohazard item, seal it with the sealing bag or cap, confirm it will not leak, and then take the whole item to the dedicated hazard recovery mouth.

codex:cx_seal_x.zh: 生物污染物可以随着空气流动扩散，如果舱室里面还有没有密封的危险品，直接打开舱门或者切开舱壁，就可能让污染物进入隔壁舱室。\n一旦设备受到污染，即使设备本身没有损坏，也需要先经过清洗和消毒才能回收，最终价值会降低 25%。\n所以在拆解受到生物污染的舱室之前，最好先把里面的危险品全部密封好，再继续处理周围的船体结构。
codex:cx_seal_x.en: Biological contaminants can spread with the air flow. If a room still holds unsealed hazardous items, opening its door or cutting its bulkhead directly may let the contaminants into the next room.\nOnce equipment is contaminated, it has to be cleaned and disinfected before recovery even if the equipment itself is undamaged, and its final value is reduced by 25%.\nSo before dismantling a biologically contaminated room, it is best to seal all the hazardous items inside first, and only then deal with the surrounding hull structure.

codex:cx_s_gas_a.zh: 船上的密封舱室里可能还存有空气或者其他工艺气体，这些气体会让舱室内部保持一定的压力，拆解之前需要先检查。
codex:cx_s_gas_a.en: Sealed rooms on the ship may still hold air or other process gases. These gases keep the room under some pressure, and it must be checked before dismantling.

codex:cx_s_gas_b.zh: 如果舱室里面还有较高的气压，直接打开舱门或者切开舱壁，就可能让里面的气体突然喷出，严重时甚至会把舱门、舱壁板和附近的设备一起冲出去。
codex:cx_s_gas_b.en: If a room still has high pressure, opening its door or cutting its bulkhead directly may make the gas inside burst out suddenly, and in bad cases it throws out the door, the bulkhead plate and nearby equipment together.

codex:cx_s_gas_c.zh: 拆解密封舱室之前，先通过接口检查内部气压，再连接回收软管，把舱室压力降到 5 kPa 以下，确认泄压完成以后才能打开舱门或者切割舱壁。
codex:cx_s_gas_c.en: Before dismantling a sealed room, check its internal pressure at a port, then connect the recovery hose and bring the room pressure below 5 kPa. Open the door or cut the bulkhead only after confirming the venting is complete.

codex:cx_s_gas_x.zh:
舱室里的气压与内部气体的数量、温度和舱室容积有关，可以用公式 pV = nRT 来表示。
连接回收泵以后，舱室里的气体会逐渐被抽走，内部压力也会随之降低。舱室越大，或者抽气接口越小，完成泄压需要的时间就越长，一些大型舱室可能需要几十秒才能达到安全压力。
如果直接打开舱门或者切开舱壁，里面的气体就会从开口流向压力较低的一侧。几个原本独立的舱室一旦连通，内部的气压也会相互影响。
通过回收泵抽走的气体还可以按照回收价值计入合同，所以提前完成气体回收，也能获得额外收入。
codex:cx_s_gas_x.en:
The pressure in a room depends on the amount and temperature of the gas inside and on the room volume, and can be expressed by the formula pV = nRT.
Once the recovery pump is connected, the gas in the room is gradually drawn off and the internal pressure falls with it. The larger the room, or the smaller the port, the longer venting takes, and some large rooms may need tens of seconds to reach a safe pressure.
If you open the door or cut the bulkhead directly, the gas inside flows through the opening to the lower-pressure side. Once several originally separate rooms are connected, their pressures also affect one another.
Gas drawn off by the recovery pump is also counted into the contract at its recovery value, so recovering the gas early earns extra income.

codex:cx_s_stale_a.zh: 检测工具显示的数值只代表测量时的状态。如果后面又对船上的设备进行了操作，之前测到的数值就可能不准确了。
codex:cx_s_stale_a.en: A value shown by the test tool represents only the state at the time of measurement. If you then operate other equipment on the ship, the value you measured earlier may no longer be accurate.

codex:cx_s_stale_b.zh: 打开阀门、切断电源或者修改电路连接以后，设备的实际状态可能已经发生变化。如果继续按照之前的检测结果进行拆解，就有可能误判当前的压力或者电力状态。
codex:cx_s_stale_b.en: After you open a valve, cut a supply or change a circuit connection, the actual state of the equipment may have changed. If you carry on dismantling by the earlier test result, you may misjudge the current pressure or power state.

codex:cx_s_stale_c.zh: 每次操作设备或者改变连接状态以后，最好重新检测一次，确认当前状态是否安全。已经过期的检测数值会显示成灰色，看到这种情况就需要重新测量。
codex:cx_s_stale_c.en: After every operation on equipment or change of connection state, it is best to test again and confirm the current state is safe. A stale test value is shown in grey, and when you see that, you need to measure again.

codex:cx_s_stale_x.zh: 如果舱室压力与上次测量时相比，变化超过 2 kPa 或者 4%，之前的压力读数就会被标记为过期。电路的连接关系发生改变以后，相关的电力检测结果也会失效。\n船上的控制面板和总览屏通常显示的是上一次记录的数据，这些数据也可能已经过期，所以不能完全依靠它们判断当前状态。\n拆解之前，最好使用自己的检测工具重新测量，确认设备当前的实际状态以后再继续操作。
codex:cx_s_stale_x.en: If the room pressure has changed by more than 2 kPa or 4% since the last measurement, the earlier pressure reading is marked stale. Once the circuit connections change, the related power test results also become invalid.\nControl panels and overview screens on the ship usually show the data from the last record, which may also be stale, so you cannot rely on them entirely to judge the current state.\nBefore dismantling, it is best to measure again with your own test tool, and carry on only after confirming the actual current state of the equipment.

codex:cx_s_power_a.zh: 船上的发电机、电池和电容都可以为设备提供电力，大部分设备通过船体总线供电，也有一些设备使用独立电源，所以切断主电源以后，船上仍然可能有带电的设备。
codex:cx_s_power_a.en: Generators, batteries and capacitors on the ship can all supply power to equipment. Most equipment is powered through the ship’s bus, but some uses an independent supply, so after the main power is cut, there may still be live equipment on the ship.

codex:cx_s_power_b.zh: 关闭船体主电源以后，备用电池和独立电源可能还在供电，电容里面也可能储存着没有释放的电能。如果直接拆除这些设备或者切断电缆，就有可能产生电弧。
codex:cx_s_power_b.en: After the ship’s main power is switched off, backup batteries and independent supplies may still be supplying power, and capacitors may hold energy that has not been released. If you remove this equipment or cut its cables directly, an arc may result.

codex:cx_s_power_c.zh: 拆解电力设备之前，先查看工程图，确认船上有哪些供电线路和独立电源，再逐个断开电源并完成电容放电。处理完成以后，还需要使用检测工具重新验电，确认没有残余电压才能开始拆解。
codex:cx_s_power_c.en: Before dismantling power equipment, check the engineering drawing to confirm which supply lines and independent supplies the ship has, then disconnect each supply in turn and discharge the capacitors. When that is done, test the voltage again with the test tool, and start dismantling only after confirming no residual voltage is left.

codex:cx_s_power_x.zh:
工程图的电路层会标出每条电缆的连接位置，可以通过这些线路找到对应的电源和设备。
有些设备使用自己的独立电源，包括无人机电池、舱门备用电源和仪器的不间断电源。这些电源通常只负责附近的设备，关闭船体主开关也不会切断它们的供电。
如果独立电源连接到了船体总线，还可能通过总线向其他设备供电，所以即使已经关闭主电源，也不能直接认定整条线路都已经断电。
电压超过 30 V 的设备，在拔除电缆或者进行切割时就可能产生电弧。拆解之前需要检查所有供电线路，断开剩余电源并完成放电，最后重新验电，确认安全以后再继续操作。
codex:cx_s_power_x.en:
The circuit layer of the engineering drawing marks where each cable connects, and through these lines you can find the matching supplies and equipment.
Some equipment uses its own independent supply, including drone batteries, door backup supplies and instrument UPS units. These supplies usually power only the equipment nearby, and switching off the ship’s main switch does not cut their supply.
If an independent supply is connected to the ship’s bus, it can also feed other equipment through the bus, so even after the main power is off, you cannot assume the whole line is dead.
Equipment above 30 V can produce an arc when its cable is unplugged or cut. Before dismantling, check all supply lines, disconnect the remaining supplies and discharge, then test the voltage again, and carry on only after confirming it is safe.

codex:cx_s_heat_a.zh: 发动机、反应堆和加热炉等设备即使已经停止运行，内部的管线和零件也可能保持很高的温度，需要经过一段时间的冷却才能安全拆除。
codex:cx_s_heat_a.en: Even after equipment such as engines, reactors and furnaces has stopped running, the lines and parts inside may stay very hot, and need some time to cool before they can be removed safely.

codex:cx_s_heat_b.zh: 如果设备温度还在 60°C 以上，直接使用无人机抓取可能会造成无人机损坏。如果使用不合适的方法快速降温，也可能因为温度变化太大，导致管线或设备出现裂纹。
codex:cx_s_heat_b.en: If equipment is still above 60°C, grabbing it directly with the drone may damage the drone. If you cool it quickly by an unsuitable method, the temperature change may also be so large that lines or equipment crack.

codex:cx_s_heat_c.zh: 拆解之前先测量设备温度，确认冷却系统还在正常运行，让设备慢慢降温。等温度降到安全范围以后，再开始拆除管线和其他零件。
codex:cx_s_heat_c.en: Before dismantling, measure the equipment temperature, confirm the cooling system is still running normally, and let the equipment cool slowly. Once the temperature has dropped to a safe range, start removing the lines and other parts.

codex:cx_s_heat_x.zh: 真空环境里没有空气对流，设备只能通过热辐射和接触部件之间的热传导慢慢散热。一些温度达到几百度的大型设备，如果只依靠自然冷却，可能需要几个小时才能降到安全温度。\n冷却系统需要有电力供应和足够的冷却液才能正常工作，如果设备还很热就提前切断冷却系统，剩余的热量会很难散出去，冷却时间也会变得更长。所以拆解高温设备时，最好先保持冷却系统运行，等设备充分降温以后再切断电源。
codex:cx_s_heat_x.en: There is no air convection in vacuum, so equipment can only lose heat slowly by thermal radiation and by conduction between parts in contact. A large piece of equipment at a few hundred degrees may take several hours to fall to a safe temperature by natural cooling alone.\nThe cooling system needs a power supply and enough coolant to work. If you cut the cooling system while the equipment is still hot, the remaining heat is hard to get out and cooling takes even longer. So when dismantling hot equipment, it is best to keep the cooling system running first, and cut the power only after the equipment has cooled fully.

codex:cx_s_cloud_a.zh: 燃料发生泄漏以后，挥发出来的蒸气可能会聚集在舱室里面，或者在船体外面形成一团燃料气体。
codex:cx_s_cloud_a.en: After a fuel leak, the vapour that evaporates may gather inside a room, or form a cloud of fuel gas outside the hull.

codex:cx_s_cloud_b.zh: 如果燃料蒸气达到能够燃烧的浓度，附近的激光切割就可能将其点燃。如果舱室里面聚集了大量燃料蒸气，还可能发生爆燃，损坏附近的设备。
codex:cx_s_cloud_b.en: If the fuel vapour reaches a concentration that can burn, laser cutting nearby may ignite it. If a large amount of fuel vapour has gathered in a room, it may also deflagrate and damage nearby equipment.

codex:cx_s_cloud_c.zh: 发现推进剂泄漏以后，先把剩余的燃料回收干净，等泄漏形成的气体充分扩散，确认附近没有危险以后，再继续进行切割。
codex:cx_s_cloud_c.en: After finding a propellant leak, first recover the remaining fuel, wait until the gas from the leak has dispersed fully and you have confirmed there is no danger nearby, and then continue cutting.

codex:cx_s_cloud_x.zh: 燃料蒸气需要达到一定的浓度才能燃烧，浓度太低或者太高都可能无法点燃。拿肼和氢气来说，肼在空气中的可燃浓度范围约为 4.7%～100%，氢气则约为 4%～75%。\n即使云团中心的燃料浓度太高，外围也可能存在浓度刚好适合燃烧的区域，只要接触到火源，就有可能发生燃烧。\n在真空环境下，泄漏的燃料蒸气会逐渐向周围扩散，浓度也会慢慢降低。如果泄漏发生在有空气的封闭舱室里面，燃料蒸气就可能聚集更长时间，需要先完成通风和气体清理，才能安全进行切割。
codex:cx_s_cloud_x.en: Fuel vapour has to reach a certain concentration to burn, and if it is too low or too high it may not ignite. Take hydrazine and hydrogen: hydrazine’s flammable range in air is about 4.7%–100%, and hydrogen’s is about 4%–75%.\nEven if the fuel concentration at the centre of the cloud is too high, there may be a zone at the edge where the concentration is just right for burning, and if it meets an ignition source, it can burn.\nIn vacuum, leaked fuel vapour gradually spreads outwards and its concentration slowly falls. If the leak is in a closed room with air, the fuel vapour may gather for longer, and you must finish ventilating and clearing the gas before you can cut safely.

codex:cx_s_fire_a.zh: 燃料需要接触空气中的氧气或者其他氧化剂才能燃烧。如果周围是真空环境，而且没有其他氧化剂，泄漏的燃料一般只会逐渐蒸发、冻结或者向周围扩散。
codex:cx_s_fire_a.en: Fuel needs oxygen from the air or another oxidiser to burn. If the surroundings are vacuum and there is no other oxidiser, leaked fuel generally just gradually evaporates, freezes or drifts away.

codex:cx_s_fire_b.zh: 激光切割、电弧、带电电缆产生的火花、短路、高温切口、发动机尾焰和爆炸都可能引燃附近的燃料。\n一旦舱室发生火灾，火焰就可能逐渐蔓延到其他区域。严重时，舱内压力甚至可能上升到原来的 8 倍，导致舱门被气压冲开。
codex:cx_s_fire_b.en: Laser cutting, arcs, sparks from live cables, short circuits, hot cuts, engine exhaust and explosions can all ignite nearby fuel.\nOnce a room catches fire, the flames may gradually spread to other areas. In serious cases, the pressure in the room can even rise to 8 times the original, so that the door is blown open by the pressure.

codex:cx_s_fire_c.zh: 使用激光切割工具之前，先把舱室里的空气抽干净，确认内部已经达到真空状态。\n如果舱室已经发生火灾，暂时不要打开舱门，以免外面的空气进入，让火势进一步扩大。保持舱室封闭，等内部氧气消耗到无法维持燃烧时，火焰就会逐渐熄灭。
codex:cx_s_fire_c.en: Before using the laser, pump the room’s air out and confirm it is at vacuum.\nIf a room is already on fire, keep its door shut so outside air cannot feed the fire. Once the oxygen inside is used up, the flames go out.

codex:cx_s_fire_x.zh:
燃烧需要燃料、氧气和点火源三个条件，只要缺少其中一个，火焰就无法继续维持。
在失重环境下，火焰不会像地面上一样向上燃烧，因为这里没有重力造成的自然对流。火焰可能形成一个缓慢扩散的球形区域，主要依靠周围氧气的扩散来维持燃烧。
如果舱室完全封闭，火焰会持续消耗内部的氧气，等氧气浓度下降到一定程度以后，燃烧就会停止。不过这时候燃料可能还留在舱室里面，如果重新打开舱门，让空气进入，再遇到火花就可能再次起火。
封闭舱室发生火灾时，燃烧产生的高温还会让内部气体迅速膨胀。如果气体温度上升到几千度，舱内压力就可能增加到原来的数倍，严重时甚至会损坏舱门和周围的船体结构。
codex:cx_s_fire_x.en:
Burning needs three conditions: fuel, oxygen and an ignition source. If any one is missing, the flame cannot be sustained.
In weightlessness, flames do not burn upwards as they do on the ground, because there is no natural convection caused by gravity. A flame may form a slowly spreading sphere, sustained mainly by oxygen diffusing in from around it.
If the room is completely closed, the fire keeps using up the oxygen inside, and once the oxygen concentration falls to a certain level, burning stops. By then the fuel may still be left in the room, though, and if you open the door again and let air in, a spark may start the fire again.
When a closed room is on fire, the high temperature of the burning also makes the gas inside expand rapidly. If the gas temperature rises to several thousand degrees, the pressure in the room may increase to several times the original, and in serious cases it can even damage the door and the surrounding hull structure.

codex:cx_s_liquid_a.zh: 船上的管线或储罐发生泄漏以后，里面的液体会进入失重环境，并在表面张力的作用下形成漂浮的液团。
codex:cx_s_liquid_a.en: After a line or tank on the ship leaks, the liquid inside enters weightlessness and forms floating globules under surface tension.

codex:cx_s_liquid_b.zh: 泄漏的液体如果接触到还在通电的设备，可能会造成短路。如果泄漏的是燃料，在附近使用激光切割工具还可能引起火灾。温度很低的液体也会对设备造成损伤，严重时甚至会让零件冻裂。
codex:cx_s_liquid_b.en: If leaked liquid touches equipment that is still powered, it may cause a short circuit. If the leaked liquid is fuel, using the laser cutting tool nearby may also start a fire. Very cold liquids can also damage equipment, and in serious cases even freeze-crack parts.

codex:cx_s_liquid_c.zh: 拆除管线或储罐之前，先把软管连接到对应的接口，将里面剩余的液体抽取干净，确认没有残留液体以后，再开始切割管线或者拆除储罐。
codex:cx_s_liquid_c.en: Before removing a line or tank, connect the hose to the matching port and draw off the liquid left inside. Once you have confirmed no liquid remains, start cutting the line or removing the tank.

codex:cx_s_liquid_x.zh: 在失重环境下，液体会受到表面张力的影响，逐渐聚集成球形液团。如果没有其他外力影响，这些液团就会沿着原来的运动方向继续漂浮，碰到设备表面以后，可能会溅散成更小的液滴，也可能附着在表面形成一层液膜。\n不同液体泄漏以后还会出现不同的情况。液氢和液氦会在泄漏时迅速汽化一部分，剩余液体也会继续沸腾；水在真空环境下可能在几秒内结成冰球；燃料会逐渐挥发，产生的蒸气如果聚集起来，就可能形成可燃气体区域。钻井泥浆则容易附着在接触到的设备表面，增加后续的清理工作。\n所以拆解装有液体的设备之前，最好先通过接口把液体抽取干净，避免切割过程中发生泄漏。
codex:cx_s_liquid_x.en: In weightlessness, liquid is affected by surface tension and gradually gathers into spherical globules. If no other force acts on them, these globules keep drifting in their original direction of motion, and after they hit an equipment surface, they may splash into smaller droplets, or stick to the surface as a liquid film.\nDifferent liquids also behave differently after leaking. Liquid hydrogen and liquid helium flash part of themselves into vapour as they leak, and the rest of the liquid keeps boiling; water in vacuum may freeze into an ice ball within seconds; fuel gradually evaporates, and if the vapour gathers, it may form a flammable gas zone. Drilling mud tends to stick to whatever equipment surface it touches, adding to the cleaning work afterwards.\nSo before dismantling equipment that holds liquid, it is best to draw the liquid off through a port first, to avoid leaks during cutting.

codex:cx_s_hose_a.zh: 回收软管用来抽取船上的气体和液体，将软管连接到对应的接口以后，就可以通过船坞的回收泵，把管线或储罐里面的气体和液体抽取出来。
codex:cx_s_hose_a.en: The recovery hose draws gas and liquid out of the ship. Once the hose is connected to the matching port, the berth’s recovery pump can draw the gas and liquid out of the line or tank.

codex:cx_s_hose_b.zh: 如果把软管连接到错误的接口，可能会让不同的回收物混在一起，影响回收处理。有些回收泵在抽取完成以后还继续运行，也可能因为没有液体进入而发生空转，造成设备损坏。
codex:cx_s_hose_b.en: If you connect the hose to the wrong port, different recovered substances may mix and affect recovery processing. Some recovery pumps also keep running after the draw is finished, and may run dry because no liquid is coming in, causing damage to the equipment.

codex:cx_s_hose_c.zh: 先确认接口对应的回收物，再连接软管开始抽取。抽取过程中注意查看剩余量，等气体或液体回收到指定数量以后，就可以停止回收并取下软管。
codex:cx_s_hose_c.en: First confirm what the port recovers, then connect the hose and start drawing. While drawing, watch the remaining amount, and once the gas or liquid has been recovered to the set quantity, you can stop recovery and take the hose off.

codex:cx_s_hose_x.zh: 一条回收软管每次只能连接一个接口。随着储罐里面的气压或者液位逐渐降低，回收速度也会慢慢下降，如果觉得等待时间太长，可以按住「=」键加快游戏时间。\n回收的气体和液体会按照当前市场价格计入合同收入，所以能回收的材料最好尽量保留下来。遇到危险气体或者液体时，还需要连接对应的专用回收接口，不能直接排放到太空中。
codex:cx_s_hose_x.en: One recovery hose can connect to only one port at a time. As the pressure or liquid level in the tank gradually falls, the recovery speed also slowly drops, and if the wait feels too long, you can hold the ‘=’ key to speed up game time.\nRecovered gas and liquid are counted into the contract income at the current market price, so keep as much recoverable material as you can. When you meet hazardous gas or liquid, you also need to connect the matching dedicated recovery port, and it cannot be vented straight into space.

codex:cx_s_free_a.zh: 当零件的最后一个固定点被拆除以后，零件就会完全脱离船体，开始在失重环境中自由漂浮。
codex:cx_s_free_a.en: Once a part’s last fixing point is removed, the part comes completely free of the hull and starts to float freely in weightlessness.

codex:cx_s_free_b.zh: 零件脱离以后，会继续保持原来的移动速度和旋转状态。如果没有及时控制，零件就可能撞上附近的船体结构或者其他设备，造成不必要的损坏。
codex:cx_s_free_b.en: After a part comes free, it keeps its original speed and spin. If you do not control it in time, the part may hit nearby hull structure or other equipment and cause needless damage.

codex:cx_s_free_c.zh: 拆除最后一个固定点之前，先用抓钩固定住零件。等零件完全脱离船体以后，再慢慢调整它的移动方向，将零件送进回收口。
codex:cx_s_free_c.en: Before removing the last fixing point, secure the part with the grapple. Once the part has fully come free of the hull, slowly adjust its direction of motion and send the part into a recovery mouth.

codex:cx_s_free_x.zh: 在失重环境中，如果没有受到其他外力，零件就会一直保持原来的运动状态。即使只是轻轻推动一下，零件也会继续向前移动，想让它停下来，就需要施加反方向的作用力。\n零件的质量和移动速度都会影响撞击时的动量。一件重 3 吨、以 0.5 m/s 移动的设备，和一件重 1 吨、以 1.5 m/s 移动的设备，具有相同大小的动量，失去控制后都可能造成严重损坏。\n如果零件不小心漂出了船坞范围，船坞边缘的牵引场会逐渐把它拉回来。不过拆解大型设备时，最好还是提前使用抓钩控制，避免零件发生碰撞。
codex:cx_s_free_x.en: In weightlessness, if no other force acts on it, a part keeps its original state of motion forever. Even a light push keeps the part moving on, and to stop it you need to apply a force in the opposite direction.\nA part’s mass and its speed both affect its momentum on impact. A 3 t piece of equipment moving at 0.5 m/s and a 1 t piece moving at 1.5 m/s have the same momentum, and either can cause serious damage if it gets out of control.\nIf a part accidentally drifts outside the berth area, the tractor field at the berth edge gradually pulls it back. Even so, when dismantling large equipment, it is best to control it with the grapple beforehand, to avoid collisions.

codex:cx_s_grapple_a.zh: 磁力抓钩是无人机用来固定和拖动零件的工具，可以在拆解过程中控制零件的移动方向，也能把拆下来的设备送到指定位置。
codex:cx_s_grapple_a.en: The magnetic grapple is the tool the drone uses to hold and drag parts. During dismantling it controls a part’s direction of motion, and also carries removed equipment to the place you choose.

codex:cx_s_grapple_b.zh: 磁力抓钩有一定的承重限制，如果零件超过了额定质量，就无法正常拖动。如果零件还连接着船体，强行拖动可能会扯断固定锁扣和连接管线，造成设备损坏。
codex:cx_s_grapple_b.en: The magnetic grapple has a load limit. If a part exceeds the rated mass, it cannot be dragged properly. If the part is still connected to the hull, dragging it by force may tear off the locks and connecting lines and damage the equipment.

codex:cx_s_grapple_c.zh: 使用磁力抓钩之前，先检查零件的质量和剩余固定点，确认零件已经完全脱离船体，并且没有超过抓钩的承重限制以后，再开始拖动。
codex:cx_s_grapple_c.en: Before using the magnetic grapple, check the part’s mass and the fixing points remaining, and start dragging only after you have confirmed the part has fully come free of the hull and does not exceed the grapple’s load limit.

codex:cx_s_grapple_x.zh: 磁力抓钩默认最多可以拖动 3 吨的零件，升级以后可以提高到 5 吨。\n由于无人机的推力有限，拖动较重的设备时，加速和减速都需要更长时间，所以在接近回收口或者其他船体结构之前，最好提前减速，避免因为来不及停止而发生碰撞。\n如果零件还连接着船体，使用抓钩拖动时，光标会显示剩余的固定点数量。继续增加拉力就可能扯断锁扣或者连接管线，所以最好先把这些连接全部拆除，再使用抓钩搬运零件。
codex:cx_s_grapple_x.en: The magnetic grapple can drag parts of up to 3 t by default, and after an upgrade this rises to 5 t.\nBecause the drone’s thrust is limited, accelerating and braking take longer when dragging heavy equipment, so before you approach a recovery mouth or other hull structure, it is best to start slowing down early, to avoid a collision because you could not stop in time.\nIf a part is still connected to the hull, the cursor shows the number of fixing points left when you drag with the grapple. Increasing the pull further may tear off locks or connecting lines, so it is best to remove all these connections first and then move the part with the grapple.

codex:cx_s_furnace_a.zh: 船坞底部设有专门回收废金属的熔炉入口，拆下来的金属废料可以直接送进去熔炼，处理完成后会按照回收的金属重量结算报酬。
codex:cx_s_furnace_a.en: At the bottom of the berth there is a furnace mouth made for recovering scrap metal. Scrap metal removed from the ship can be sent straight in for melting, and after processing you are paid by the weight of metal recovered.

codex:cx_s_furnace_b.zh: 不要把危险品或者还带有电压、压力的设备送进熔炉，这些东西在高温下可能发生爆炸。\n完整设备也不建议直接送进去，因为熔炉只会按照废金属的价格结算，原本还能正常使用的设备就卖不出完整回收的价格了。
codex:cx_s_furnace_b.en: Never send hazardous items, or equipment still carrying voltage or pressure, into the furnace: they may explode in the heat.\nDon’t send whole equipment in either. The furnace pays only the scrap-metal price, so working equipment loses its full-recovery price.

codex:cx_s_furnace_c.zh: 先确认准备回收的材料只有普通金属，没有残留的危险物品。然后在距离熔炉入口大约 6–8 m 的位置，用抓钩将废料对准下方的长条形入口，调整好方向后送进去就可以了。
codex:cx_s_furnace_c.en: First make sure the material to be recovered is only ordinary metal with no hazardous items left. Then, from about 6–8 m away from the furnace mouth, use the grapple to line the scrap up with the long, narrow opening below, and send it in once its direction is right.

codex:cx_s_furnace_x.zh:
废金属进入熔炉入口以后，会先经过下方的料仓压实，再由螺旋给料机送进真空感应炉进行熔炼。
熔炉内部的坩埚以每分钟 45 转的速度旋转，产生大约 1.4 g 的离心加速度，让熔融金属保持在炉衬附近。炉体外侧还安装了水冷铜线圈，线圈通电以后会产生交变磁场，使金属内部形成涡流并逐渐升温。电流在金属内部的集肤深度可以用公式 δ = 503 × √(ρ/μf) 计算。
当炉内温度达到 1640°C 后，熔融金属就会被倒入水冷铜锭模，冷却成型后作为钢锭回收。
整个熔炼过程需要在真空环境下进行，所以船坞已经为熔炉准备了相应的真空系统，不需要额外调整外部压力。
codex:cx_s_furnace_x.en:
After scrap metal enters the furnace mouth, it is first compacted in the bunker below, and then a screw feeder sends it into a vacuum induction furnace to be melted.
The crucible inside the furnace spins at 45 revolutions per minute, producing a centrifugal acceleration of about 1.4 g that keeps the molten metal against the lining. Water-cooled copper coils are fitted around the outside of the furnace body, and when the coils are energised they produce an alternating magnetic field, which sets up eddy currents inside the metal and gradually heats it. The skin depth of the current in the metal can be calculated with the formula δ = 503 × √(ρ/μf).
When the temperature in the furnace reaches 1640°C, the molten metal is poured into water-cooled copper ingot moulds, and after cooling and setting it is recovered as steel ingots.
The whole melting process has to take place in vacuum, so the berth has already provided the furnace with a matching vacuum system, and you need not adjust any external pressure.

codex:cx_s_equip_mouth_a.zh: 船坞里专门用来回收完整设备的回收口，拆下来的设备需要从下方送进去，才能按照设备的完整价值进行回收。
codex:cx_s_equip_mouth_a.en: The recovery mouth in the berth made for whole equipment. Removed equipment must be fed in from below to be recovered at its full value.

codex:cx_s_equip_mouth_b.zh: 如果设备在拆解过程中受到撞击或者切割损坏，回收价格就会按照受损程度降低。如果设备内部还有电力或者残留液体，直接送进回收口还可能引发事故。
codex:cx_s_equip_mouth_b.en: If equipment is knocked or damaged by cutting during dismantling, the recovery price drops according to the damage. If the equipment still holds power or leftover liquid inside, sending it straight into the recovery mouth may also cause an accident.

codex:cx_s_equip_mouth_c.zh: 回收设备之前，先切断电源，排空内部的液体，再拔掉连接的线路。确认设备已经安全以后，尽量保持设备完整，再用抓钩把它送进回收口。
codex:cx_s_equip_mouth_c.en: Before recovering equipment, cut its power, drain the liquid inside and unplug the connected lines. Once the equipment is confirmed safe, keep it whole as far as you can, and then send it into the recovery mouth with the grapple.

codex:cx_s_equip_mouth_x.zh: 设备的回收价格按照原本价值乘以当前成色计算。如果设备在拆解过程中受到撞击、过热、短路或者污染，成色就会下降，最后能够拿到的回收金额也会减少。\n如果合同要求回收指定设备，就必须把这些设备完整送进回收口，才能满足合同要求。\n当设备距离回收口太远时，回收口的接收环会向设备所在的位置移动，方便你把设备送进去。
codex:cx_s_equip_mouth_x.en: The recovery price of equipment is its original value multiplied by its current condition. If equipment is knocked, overheated, short-circuited or contaminated during dismantling, its condition drops, and the recovery payment you finally get is smaller.\nIf a contract requires recovery of named equipment, those items must be sent whole into the recovery mouth to meet the contract requirement.\nWhen equipment is too far from the recovery mouth, the mouth’s receiving ring moves towards where the equipment is, so it is easier to send it in.

codex:cx_s_hazard_mouth_a.zh: 船坞里专门用来回收危险品的地方，燃料罐、电池、火工品和放射源等物品都需要送到这里处理。
codex:cx_s_hazard_mouth_a.en: The place in the berth made for recovering hazardous items. Fuel tanks, batteries, pyrotechnics and radioactive sources all need to be taken here for handling.

codex:cx_s_hazard_mouth_b.zh: 危险品不能直接送进熔炉，如果把燃料罐或者其他危险物品送进去，可能会引发爆炸，也可能造成熔炉污染。
codex:cx_s_hazard_mouth_b.en: Hazardous items must not be sent straight into the furnace. If a fuel tank or another hazardous item is sent in, it may explode, and may also contaminate the furnace.

codex:cx_s_hazard_mouth_c.zh: 拆解过程中，如果光标指向的物品显示为「危险品」，就需要把它送进危险品回收口，不要送到普通的设备回收口或者熔炉里。
codex:cx_s_hazard_mouth_c.en: During dismantling, if the item the cursor points at is shown as ‘hazard’, it must go into the hazard mouth, not the ordinary equipment recovery mouth or the furnace.

codex:cx_s_hazard_mouth_x.zh: 危险品会按照危险处理津贴计算回收收入，不会按照普通金属的价格结算，所以需要把它们单独送到危险品回收口。\n危险品回收口的入口比较小，运送的时候需要慢慢调整位置和方向，确认对准以后再把物品送进去。\n如果你拖着危险品靠近熔炉，系统也会显示提醒，避免因为送错回收位置而发生事故。
codex:cx_s_hazard_mouth_x.en: Hazardous items are paid as hazard-handling allowance, not at the price of ordinary metal, so they need to be taken separately to the hazard mouth.\nThe opening of the hazard mouth is fairly small, so when carrying an item you need to adjust its position and direction slowly, and send it in once it is lined up.\nIf you drag a hazardous item near the furnace, the system also shows a warning, to avoid an accident from sending it to the wrong recovery point.

codex:cx_s_field_a.zh: 船坞开放区域边缘安装了牵引力场，可以把漂出泊位的零件和设备逐渐拉回来，防止它们继续向外漂移。
codex:cx_s_field_a.en: Tractor fields are fitted along the edges of the berth’s open areas. They gradually pull back parts and equipment that have drifted out of the bay, and stop them drifting further out.

codex:cx_s_field_b.zh: 牵引场只能改变零件的移动方向，无法直接让零件停下来。如果零件漂出去的时候速度太快，即使被牵引场拉了回来，也可能继续撞上船体或者附近的设备，造成损坏。
codex:cx_s_field_b.en: The tractor field can only change a part’s direction of motion, and cannot stop the part directly. If a part drifts out too fast, even once it is pulled back by the field, it may still hit the hull or nearby equipment and cause damage.

codex:cx_s_field_c.zh: 拆除零件的最后一个固定点之前，最好先用抓钩固定住零件，避免零件失去控制。不要完全依赖牵引场，等零件漂出去以后再处理。
codex:cx_s_field_c.en: Before removing a part’s last fixing point, it is best to secure the part with the grapple first, so it does not get out of control. Do not rely entirely on the tractor field and deal with the part only after it has drifted out.

codex:cx_s_field_x.zh: 船坞采用半开放式结构，底部设有作业平台，周围安装了塔架和悬臂，上方和右侧则保持开放，方便大型船体和拆解下来的设备进出。\n牵引场主要在船坞内部边框以外的区域发挥作用，零件漂出去的距离越远，受到的牵引力就越大，最终会被逐渐拉回泊位附近。\n如果后续扩建船坞，牵引场的作用范围也会跟着扩大，边界会移动到新建船坞的最外侧，确保扩建后的开放区域仍然受到牵引场保护。
codex:cx_s_field_x.en: The berth has a half-open structure, with a work platform at the bottom, towers and booms around it, and the top and right sides left open so that large hulls and removed equipment can go in and out.\nThe tractor field mainly acts in the area outside the berth’s inner frame. The further out a part drifts, the stronger the pull on it, and in the end it is gradually pulled back to the bay.\nIf the berth is extended later, the field’s range grows with it, and the boundary moves to the outermost edge of the newly built berth, so the open area after the extension is still covered by the field.

codex:cx_s_berth_ext_a.zh: 购买船坞扩建项目以后，施工队会直接在现有泊位旁边进行建设，按照实际的在轨施工流程安装新的桁架、平台和其他设施。
codex:cx_s_berth_ext_a.en: After you buy a berth extension, the construction crew builds right next to the existing bay, installing new trusses, platforms and other facilities in the way real in-orbit construction works.

codex:cx_s_berth_ext_b.zh: 扩建施工期间，正在施工的区域会暂时封闭。如果有零件或者设备进入施工区域，周围的牵引场就会把它们推开，避免影响正在进行的安装工作。
codex:cx_s_berth_ext_b.en: During the extension work, the area under construction is temporarily closed. If parts or equipment enter the work area, the tractor field around it pushes them away, so they do not interfere with the installation under way.

codex:cx_s_berth_ext_c.zh: 你可以留在现场观看整个施工过程，也可以按任意键跳过，直接等到船坞扩建完成。
codex:cx_s_berth_ext_c.en: You can stay on site to watch the whole construction, or press any key to skip it and wait until the berth extension is finished.

codex:cx_s_berth_ext_x.zh:
船坞扩建会按照实际的在轨施工流程进行。施工开始前，系统会先隔离施工区域，然后由拖船把装有折叠桁架的货箱运送到指定位置。
桁架通过铰接结构从储存筒内逐节展开，每节长度为 0.6 m。施工设备会在横向支撑杆展开并锁定以后，再继续安装下一节，直到整个桁架达到设计长度。
安装模块的时候，会先用机械钩爪固定接口，再使用 M20、10.9 级高强度螺栓进行连接，每颗螺栓的预紧力为 125 kN。完成固定以后，施工设备还会使用电子束焊接技术处理连接处的焊缝。由于电子束焊接需要真空环境，而船坞本身就位于太空中，所以可以直接进行焊接。
所有结构安装完成以后，还需要进行压力测试和承重测试。管路会使用氦气加压到正常工作压力的 1.5 倍，检查有没有泄漏，新安装的平台则需要承受设计载荷的 1.25 倍，测试时的最大挠度不能超过跨度的 1/800。
通过这些测试以后，施工队才会进行最后的设备调试和验收，确认没有问题后，新的船坞区域就可以正式投入使用。
如果扩建后的船坞需要停靠更高的船只，施工队还会增加塔架的高度，同时降低底部平台的位置，为大型船体留出足够的空间。
codex:cx_s_berth_ext_x.en:
A berth extension follows real in-orbit construction. The work area is isolated first, then a tug brings in the crates of folded truss.
The truss unfolds from its canister one hinged 0.6 m section at a time; each next section goes on only after the cross braces have opened and locked, until the truss reaches its design length.
Modules are held by mechanical claws, then joined with M20 grade 10.9 high-strength bolts at 125 kN preload each, and the seams are electron-beam welded. That welding needs vacuum, which space already provides.
The lines are then pressurised with helium to 1.5 times working pressure and leak-checked, and the new platform must carry 1.25 times its design load with no more than 1/800 of the span in deflection.
After final commissioning and acceptance, the new berth area goes into use.
For a taller ship, the crew also raises the tower and lowers the bottom platform to make room for the hull.

codex:cx_s_blueprint_a.zh: 工程图记录了船只原本的设计结构，包括舱室分布、管路走向、电路连接和各个设备的固定位置，拆解的时候可以用来查看船体内部的布置。
codex:cx_s_blueprint_a.en: The engineering drawing records the ship’s original design structure, including the room layout, line routes, circuit connections and the fixing position of each piece of equipment, and can be used to look at the layout inside the hull when dismantling.

codex:cx_s_blueprint_b.zh: 工程图记录的是船只最初的设计情况，但船只在使用过程中可能经历过改装、维修或者事故，所以图纸上的结构不一定和现在的船体完全一致。
codex:cx_s_blueprint_b.en: The engineering drawing records the ship’s original design, but the ship may have been refitted, repaired or in an accident during its service, so the structure on the drawing may not match the current hull exactly.

codex:cx_s_blueprint_c.zh: 拆解之前可以先查看工程图，确认设备的位置和管线的连接方式。不过实际操作的时候，还是要通过现场检查来确认设备当前的状态，不能完全按照图纸判断。
codex:cx_s_blueprint_c.en: Before dismantling you can look at the engineering drawing first to confirm the positions of equipment and how lines are connected. In actual work, though, you still need to check the equipment’s current state on site, and cannot judge entirely by the drawing.

codex:cx_s_blueprint_x.zh: 按下 Tab 键就可以打开工程图，查看船体内部的结构，包括盖板后面安装了哪些设备、阀门连接着哪条管线，以及各个设备从哪里获得电力。\n不过工程图通常不会记录船只后来发生的变化。如果船只曾经进行过改装或者维修，内部就可能出现额外安装的电源、已经堵塞的接口，或者重新修补过的管路。\n这些变化都需要在拆解现场进行检查，尤其是涉及电路和压力管线的时候，最好先测量实际状态，再决定怎么拆除。
codex:cx_s_blueprint_x.en: Press the Tab key to open the engineering drawing and see the structure inside the hull, including what equipment sits behind the covers, which line a valve is connected to, and where each piece of equipment gets its power.\nHowever, the engineering drawing usually does not record later changes to the ship. If the ship was refitted or repaired, there may be an extra power supply, a blocked port or a repaired line inside.\nThese changes all have to be checked on site during dismantling. Especially where circuits and pressure lines are involved, it is best to measure the actual state first, and then decide how to remove it.

codex:cx_s_scope_a.zh: 这类合同只要求你拆除船体的指定区域，或者回收几件指定的设备，不需要把整艘船全部拆完。
codex:cx_s_scope_a.en: This kind of contract asks you to dismantle only a specified area of the hull, or to recover a few named pieces of equipment, and you do not need to dismantle the whole ship.

codex:cx_s_scope_b.zh: 合同只允许你处理指定范围内的零件，如果拆除了范围以外的结构，或者在操作过程中造成损坏，都会被视为违反合同，需要从报酬中扣除相应的费用。
codex:cx_s_scope_b.en: The contract allows you to handle only the parts inside the specified scope. If you remove structures outside the scope, or cause damage during the work, it counts as a breach of contract and the matching cost is deducted from your payment.

codex:cx_s_scope_c.zh: 开始拆解之前，先查看界面上标记的合同范围，确认哪些区域和设备可以处理。范围以外的部分尽量不要碰，避免因为误拆或者损坏而被扣钱。
codex:cx_s_scope_c.en: Before dismantling, check the contract scope marked on the screen to confirm which areas and equipment you may handle. Try not to touch anything outside the scope, so you are not charged for wrongly removing or damaging it.

codex:cx_s_scope_x.zh: 分段拆解合同只会收购指定区段内的零件，船体里面剩余的气体和液体不属于收购范围，所以即使把它们回收下来，也不会计入合同收入。\n抢救合同则按照指定设备支付固定报酬，只要把合同要求的设备全部送进回收口，就可以直接完成任务，剩下的船体会由拖船负责运走，不需要继续拆解。\n拆解时可以通过光标确认零件是否属于合同范围，如果光标指向的零件显示「范围外」，就说明合同没有授权拆除这个零件，最好保留原样。
codex:cx_s_scope_x.en: A section dismantling contract buys only the parts inside the specified section. The gas and liquid left in the hull are not within the purchase scope, so even if you recover them, they are not counted into the contract income.\nA salvage contract pays a fixed fee for the named equipment. As soon as all the equipment the contract asks for has been sent into the recovery mouth, the task is complete, and the rest of the hull is towed away by a tug, so you need not dismantle any further.\nWhen dismantling, you can use the cursor to check whether a part is within the contract scope. If the part under the cursor shows ‘out of scope’, the contract does not authorise removing this part, and it is best left as it is.

codex:cx_s_hauler_a.zh: 船坞悬臂上安装的辅助搬运设备，可以自动把你标记好的零件运送到对应的回收口，省去手动搬运的过程。
codex:cx_s_hauler_a.en: A helper handling machine fitted on the berth boom. It automatically carries the parts you have marked to the matching recovery mouth, saving you the manual carrying.

codex:cx_s_hauler_b.zh: 搬运无人机只会按照你的标记执行任务，不会主动检查零件是否安全。即使零件内部还有残留液体，或者设备尚未断电，无人机也会直接进行搬运，可能在运输过程中发生事故。
codex:cx_s_hauler_b.en: The hauling drone only carries out your marks and does not check on its own whether a part is safe. Even if the part still holds leftover liquid, or the equipment has not been de-energised, the drone moves it anyway, and an accident may happen in transit.

codex:cx_s_hauler_c.zh: 标记零件之前，先检查并处理好内部的电力和液体等危险，确认零件已经可以安全回收以后，再点击鼠标右键进行标记，让无人机负责搬运。
codex:cx_s_hauler_c.en: Before marking a part, check and deal with dangers inside such as power and liquid, and mark the part with a right click only after confirming it is safe to recover, to let the drone carry it.

codex:cx_s_hauler_x.zh: 搬运无人机会按照你标记零件的先后顺序安排运输任务，并自动规划搬运路线，选择对应的回收口。\n有了无人机以后，你就不用每次都亲自把零件拖到回收口了，不过无人机不会替你判断零件是否已经处理安全，也不会检查零件应该如何分类回收。\n所以在标记之前，你仍然需要确认零件已经完成断电、排液等必要处理，并检查回收目标是否正确，之后再交给无人机搬运。
codex:cx_s_hauler_x.en: The hauling drone arranges its transport jobs in the order you marked the parts, plans its own carrying routes automatically, and chooses the matching recovery mouth.\nWith the drone, you no longer have to drag every part to a recovery mouth yourself. However, the drone does not judge for you whether a part has been made safe, and does not check how a part should be sorted for recovery.\nSo before marking, you still need to confirm that the part has had the necessary handling such as power-off and draining, and check that the recovery target is right, and only then hand it to the drone to carry.

codex:cx_s_impact_a.zh: 在失重环境中，漂浮的零件、无人机或者整段船体，都有可能在移动过程中撞上附近的设备或其他船体结构。
codex:cx_s_impact_a.en: In weightlessness, floating parts, the drone or a whole section of hull may hit nearby equipment or other hull structure as they move.

codex:cx_s_impact_b.zh: 发生撞击以后，游戏会根据碰撞时的速度变化和零件的易损程度，降低双方的完好度。精密设备比较容易受到损坏，即使碰撞速度不快，也可能造成很大的损失。
codex:cx_s_impact_b.en: After an impact, the game lowers the condition of both sides according to the change in speed at the collision and how easily each part is damaged. Precision equipment is easily damaged, and even a slow collision can cause great loss.

codex:cx_s_impact_c.zh: 使用抓钩拖运零件的时候，尽量控制移动速度，接近目标位置之前就提前减速。尤其是搬运大型设备时，要避免零件脱离控制后继续漂移。
codex:cx_s_impact_c.en: When towing parts with the grapple, keep your speed under control and start slowing down before you reach the target position. Especially when carrying large equipment, do not let a part get out of control and keep drifting.

codex:cx_s_impact_x.zh:
撞击造成的损坏主要取决于碰撞前后的速度变化（Δv），以及零件本身的易损程度。
同样是以 1 m/s 的速度发生碰撞，普通钢结构通常不会受到太大影响，但光学玻璃、芯片等精密设备就可能出现严重损坏，甚至直接失去回收价值。
拖运重型设备的时候，还要注意它们的惯性。设备的质量越大，想要让它停下来就越困难。如果发现自己来不及减速，直接松开抓钩只会让情况更加危险，因为设备还会保持原来的动量继续移动，直到受到其他外力影响。
所以搬运大型零件时，最好提前减速，并且一直保持抓钩连接，直到设备安全进入回收区域。
codex:cx_s_impact_x.en:
The damage an impact causes mainly depends on the change in speed (Δv) before and after the collision, and on how easily the part is damaged.
In a collision at the same 1 m/s, ordinary steel structure is usually not much affected, but precision equipment such as optical glass and chips may be seriously damaged, and may even lose all recovery value.
When towing heavy equipment, also watch its inertia. The greater the mass of the equipment, the harder it is to stop. If you find you cannot slow down in time, simply releasing the grapple only makes things more dangerous, because the equipment keeps its original momentum and carries on moving until some other force acts on it.
So when carrying large parts, it is best to slow down early and keep the grapple attached until the equipment is safely inside the recovery area.

codex:cx_swb_a.zh: 配电盘负责把船上的电力分配到不同设备和线路，内部装有母排、仪表和一排断路器，可以分别控制各条线路的供电。
codex:cx_swb_a.en: A switchboard distributes the ship’s power to different equipment and lines. Inside it are busbars, meters and a row of circuit breakers, which control the supply to each line separately.

codex:cx_swb_b.zh: 配电盘连接着船上的多条供电线路，只要还有一路电源没有切断，内部就可能仍然带电。即使已经关闭了所有断路器，也不能直接拆除配电盘。
codex:cx_swb_b.en: A switchboard is connected to many of the ship’s supply lines, and as long as one supply is not cut, the inside may still be live. Even after all the circuit breakers are switched off, the switchboard cannot be removed directly.

codex:cx_swb_c.zh: 拆除配电盘之前，先切断船上所有的电源，再通过配电盘上的验电点检查电压。确认读数已经降到 0 V 以后，才能开始拆解。
codex:cx_swb_c.en: Before removing a switchboard, cut all the ship’s supplies first, then check the voltage at the switchboard’s test point. Start dismantling only after the reading has dropped to 0 V.

codex:cx_swb_x.zh:
配电盘的上半部分是三相母排室，负责连接和分配电力。下半部分分成多个区域，每个区域都安装了仪表板和断路器，供电电缆则通过底部的电缆密封板接入。
需要注意的是，断路器通常只能切断通往设备的负载侧线路。如果母排上游还有任何一路电源没有关闭，配电盘内部就仍然可能带电，所以不能只看断路器是否关闭，还要检查所有电源有没有彻底断开。
带电拆解配电盘非常危险，如果工具导致母排之间发生短路，就可能产生温度高达上万摄氏度的电弧，严重损坏周围设备。
拆解之前一定要完成断电和验电，确认电压为 0 V 以后再动手。
codex:cx_swb_x.en:
The upper half of a switchboard is the three-phase busbar chamber, which connects and distributes power. The lower half is divided into several sections, each fitted with a meter panel and circuit breakers, and the supply cables come in through the cable gland plate at the bottom.
Note that a circuit breaker can usually cut only the load-side line to the equipment. If any supply upstream of the busbar has not been switched off, the inside of the switchboard may still be live, so do not go by whether the breakers are off alone, but also check that all supplies are completely disconnected.
Dismantling a switchboard while live is very dangerous. If a tool shorts the busbars together, it may produce an arc at temperatures of over ten thousand degrees Celsius, seriously damaging the surrounding equipment.
Always complete the power-off and the voltage test before dismantling, and start work only after confirming the voltage is 0 V.

codex:cx_battery_a.zh: 船上的电池组由多个串联的电芯模块组成，内部还安装了汇流排、冷却板和电池管理板，主要负责储存电能，并在需要的时候为船上设备供电。
codex:cx_battery_a.en: The ship’s battery pack is made of several cell modules in series, and inside it also has busbars, cooling plates and a battery management board. It mainly stores electrical energy and supplies the ship’s equipment when needed.

codex:cx_battery_b.zh: 电池组即使已经关闭了外部电源，内部仍然储存着大量电能。切断电源只能让电池停止向外供电，无法消除电芯内部的能量，如果直接切割或者拆开电池组，就可能引发短路甚至起火。
codex:cx_battery_b.en: Even with the external supply switched off, a battery pack still stores a great deal of energy inside. Cutting the connection only stops the battery supplying power outward and cannot remove the energy inside the cells, and cutting or opening the pack directly may cause a short circuit or even a fire.

codex:cx_battery_c.zh: 拆除电池组之前，先关闭对应的隔离开关，再拔掉连接到船体的输出电缆。确认电池组已经与船体电路断开以后，将整组电池完整拆下来，送进危险品回收口处理。
codex:cx_battery_c.en: Before removing a battery pack, switch off its isolator first, then unplug the output cable connected to the hull. Once the pack is confirmed disconnected from the ship’s circuits, take the whole pack off intact and send it to the hazard mouth for handling.

codex:cx_battery_x.zh:
一组容量为 50 kWh 的锂电池，在充满电以后可以储存约 180 MJ 的能量，即使已经切断了外部电源，这些能量也仍然保存在电芯内部。
如果拆解时刺穿电芯，或者让内部电路发生短路，就可能引发热失控。在严重的情况下，电芯温度可能在几秒内升高到 600°C 以上，同时释放大量可燃气体，甚至引燃附近的其他电芯。
电池组的主接触器一般安装在模块的一端，断开以后可以停止向外部设备供电，但电池内部的正负极之间仍然存在电压。
所以拆解电池组的时候，一定要先断开隔离开关和输出电缆，之后再将整个电池组送去回收，不要直接切割内部结构。
codex:cx_battery_x.en:
A lithium battery pack with a capacity of 50 kWh can store about 180 MJ of energy when fully charged, and even after the external supply is cut, this energy is still kept inside the cells.
If a cell is punctured during dismantling, or the internal circuit is shorted, thermal runaway may result. In serious cases the cell temperature can rise above 600°C within seconds, releasing a lot of flammable gas and even igniting other cells nearby.
The pack’s main contactor is usually fitted at one end of the module. Once opened, it stops supplying power to external equipment, but there is still voltage between the pack’s own positive and negative terminals.
So when dismantling a battery pack, always disconnect the isolator and the output cable first, and then send the whole pack for recovery, and do not cut the internal structure directly.

codex:cx_cap_a.zh: 电容组由多个电容罐、汇流排和放电电阻组成，主要用来储存电能，在发射系统等设备需要大量电力的时候，可以在短时间内释放储存的能量。
codex:cx_cap_a.en: A capacitor bank is made of several capacitor cans, busbars and a discharge resistor. It mainly stores electrical energy, and can release the stored energy in a short time when equipment such as launch systems needs a lot of power.

codex:cx_cap_b.zh: 即使已经切断了船体电源，电容组内部也可能保留着很高的电压。如果没有提前放电就直接拆解，工具接触到带电部位时可能产生电弧，造成严重损坏。
codex:cx_cap_b.en: Even after the ship’s power is cut, a capacitor bank may keep a very high voltage inside. If you dismantle it without discharging first, a tool touching a live part may produce an arc and cause serious damage.

codex:cx_cap_c.zh: 拆除电容组之前，先找到对应的放电接口，使用放电装置把剩余电压降到 0 V，再通过验电点确认没有残余电压。完成放电和验电以后，才能开始拆解。
codex:cx_cap_c.en: Before removing a capacitor bank, find its discharge port, use the discharge device to bring the remaining voltage down to 0 V, and then confirm at the test point that no residual voltage is left. Start dismantling only after discharging and testing are done.

codex:cx_cap_x.zh:
电容组储存的能量可以通过 E = ½CV² 计算，其中 C 是电容，V 是电压。一组电容为 0.1 F、电压为 400 V 的设备，就可以储存 8 kJ 的能量，而大型发射系统使用的电容组，储存的能量甚至可以达到兆焦级别。
电容组和普通用电设备有所不同，关闭电源以后，已经储存的电能不会立即消失，必须通过放电才能降低内部电压。
放电电阻可以让电容组逐渐释放电能，并将这些能量转化成热量。放电速度取决于电阻和电容形成的 RC 时间常数，通常经过大约五个时间常数以后，剩余电压就会降到初始值的 1% 以下。
所以即使船上的电源已经全部关闭，也要单独检查电容组的电压，确认完成放电以后再进行拆解。
codex:cx_cap_x.en:
The energy a capacitor bank stores can be calculated with E = ½CV², where C is the capacitance and V is the voltage. A unit of 0.1 F at 400 V can store 8 kJ of energy, and the capacitor banks used by large launch systems can store energy even on the megajoule scale.
A capacitor bank differs from ordinary electrical equipment: after the power is switched off, the energy already stored does not vanish at once, and it has to be discharged to bring the internal voltage down.
A discharge resistor lets the capacitor bank release its energy gradually and turns that energy into heat. The discharge speed depends on the RC time constant formed by the resistor and the capacitor, and usually after about five time constants the remaining voltage drops below 1% of its initial value.
So even when all the ship’s power is off, check the capacitor bank’s voltage separately, and dismantle it only after confirming the discharge is complete.

codex:cx_gen_a.zh: 发电机组通过发动机带动发电机运转，为船上的设备提供电力。整套机组还安装了散热器、励磁机和控制屏，用来维持发电机的正常运行。
codex:cx_gen_a.en: A generator set uses an engine to drive a generator and supplies power to the ship’s equipment. The whole set also has a radiator, an exciter and a control panel, which keep the generator running properly.

codex:cx_gen_b.zh: 发电机停止运行以后，出线端仍然可能带电。如果船上的其他电源还连接着供电总线，电流就可能通过总线反向进入发电机的线路，所以不能只看发动机有没有停止运行。
codex:cx_gen_b.en: After a generator stops running, its output terminals may still be live. If other supplies on the ship are still connected to the supply bus, current may flow back through the bus into the generator’s lines, so do not go only by whether the engine has stopped.

codex:cx_gen_c.zh: 拆除发电机组之前，先确认发动机已经完全停止运行，再断开连接供电总线的输出线路。完成断电以后，还需要检查出线端的电压，确认没有残余电压后再进行拆解。
codex:cx_gen_c.en: Before removing a generator set, first confirm the engine has stopped completely, then disconnect the output line to the supply bus. After the power is cut, also check the voltage at the output terminals, and dismantle only after confirming no residual voltage.

codex:cx_gen_x.zh:
发电机内部的转子装有凸极磁极，定子槽内则安装了用于发电的绕组。发动机带动转子旋转以后，发电机就可以产生电力。
即使已经关闭了励磁系统，转子内部仍然可能保留一定的剩余磁性。如果转子继续旋转，发电机就可能产生几十伏的电压，所以停机以后还要等待转子完全停止，并检查线路是否带电。
一套发电机组通常重达 1–3 吨，底座上还安装了减振器，用来减少运行时产生的振动。固定螺栓一般集中在机组底座上，拆解时需要先找到这些连接位置。
由于整套设备的重量比较大，拆除底座螺栓之前，最好先用抓钩固定住机组，避免最后一个固定点松开以后，发电机组失去控制并撞上附近的设备。
codex:cx_gen_x.en:
Inside the generator, the rotor carries salient magnetic poles, and the stator slots hold the windings used to generate power. Once the engine drives the rotor round, the generator can produce electricity.
Even with the excitation system switched off, the rotor may keep some residual magnetism. If the rotor keeps turning, the generator may produce tens of volts, so after shutdown you also need to wait until the rotor has stopped completely and check whether the lines are live.
A generator set usually weighs 1–3 t, and the base also carries anti-vibration mounts to reduce vibration while running. The fixing bolts are generally concentrated on the base of the set, and you need to find these connection points first when dismantling.
Because the whole unit is heavy, before removing the base bolts it is best to secure the set with the grapple first, so that once the last fixing point is loose, the generator set does not get out of control and hit nearby equipment.

codex:cx_panel_a.zh: 安装在墙上的电气控制箱，外面有箱门和指示灯观察窗，里面装着端子排，电缆通过格兰头接入箱体。
codex:cx_panel_a.en: An electrical control box mounted on a wall. It has a door and an indicator viewing window on the outside, terminal blocks inside, and cables enter the box through glands.

codex:cx_panel_b.zh: 控制箱虽然不大，但可能连接了好几路电源。就算断开了其中一路，其他线路也可能还带着电。
codex:cx_panel_b.en: A control box is not large, but it may be connected to several supplies. Even if one of them is disconnected, other lines may still be live.

codex:cx_panel_c.zh: 先对照工程图，找到所有接入控制箱的电源线路，把每一路电源都断开并确认没有电压以后，再开始拆除控制箱。
codex:cx_panel_c.en: First check the engineering drawing to find all the supply lines coming into the control box, disconnect every supply and confirm there is no voltage, and then start removing the control box.

codex:cx_panel_x.zh: 控制箱里面一般装着继电器、PLC 和端子排，这些设备本身的回收价值不算高，但连接的线路比较多。最好在拆除控制箱之前就把所有进线处理好，这样拆下来以后也不用再花时间逐一查找线路。
codex:cx_panel_x.en: A control box generally holds relays, a PLC and terminal blocks. The recovery value of this equipment is not high, but it has many connected lines. It is best to deal with all the incoming lines before removing the control box, so that you need not spend time looking for the lines one by one after it is removed.

codex:cx_junction_a.zh: 接线盒一般装在电缆连接的位置，盒盖四角有固定螺钉，内部有接地螺柱，电缆通过格兰头接入和引出。
codex:cx_junction_a.en: A junction box is usually fitted where cables connect. The lid has fixing screws at the four corners, there is an earth stud inside, and cables enter and leave through glands.

codex:cx_junction_b.zh: 多条电缆会在这里连接和分支，接线盒上通常还设有验电点或放电点。拆除之前要确认所有相关线路都已经断电。
codex:cx_junction_b.en: Several cables connect and branch here, and the junction box usually also has a test point or discharge point. Before removal, confirm that all the related lines are de-energised.

codex:cx_junction_c.zh: 先找到接线盒对应的验电点和放电点，按照操作要求完成验电和放电，确认安全以后，再处理与它连接的设备。
codex:cx_junction_c.en: First find the test point and discharge point for the junction box, complete the voltage test and discharge as required, and after confirming it is safe, deal with the equipment connected to it.

codex:cx_junction_x.zh: 接线盒主要用来连接和分配电缆线路，一台设备的电源可能要经过好几个接线盒才能接到供电端。如果不清楚设备的电源从哪里接入，可以先找到对应的接线盒，再沿着电缆逐段往回查找，这样通常更容易找到供电线路。
codex:cx_junction_x.en: A junction box is mainly used to connect and distribute cable lines, and the supply of one piece of equipment may pass through several junction boxes before it reaches the supply end. If you do not know where a piece of equipment’s power comes in, first find the matching junction box and trace back along the cable section by section, which usually makes it easier to find the supply line.

codex:cx_transformer_a.zh: 这是一台干式变压器，主要由三柱铁芯、高低压绕组和外部的夹紧框架组成，铁芯和绕组都固定在框架里面。
codex:cx_transformer_a.en: This is a dry-type transformer. It mainly consists of a three-limb core, high- and low-voltage windings and an outer clamping frame, and the core and windings are fixed inside the frame.

codex:cx_transformer_b.zh: 变压器的高低压两侧都可能带电，即使高压侧已经断开，如果低压侧还有电源接入，变压器仍然可能把低压升成高压，所以不能只断开其中一侧。
codex:cx_transformer_b.en: Both the high-voltage and low-voltage sides of a transformer may be live. Even if the high-voltage side is disconnected, if a supply is still connected on the low-voltage side, the transformer may step the low voltage up to high voltage, so you cannot disconnect only one side.

codex:cx_transformer_c.zh: 拆除之前，要把高压侧和低压侧的电源全部断开，分别验电并确认没有电压，完成必要的隔离和放电以后，再开始拆除。
codex:cx_transformer_c.en: Before removal, disconnect all the supplies on both the high-voltage and low-voltage sides, test each for voltage and confirm there is none, and start removal after the necessary isolation and discharge are done.

codex:cx_transformer_x.zh: 变压器通过高低压绕组的匝数比例来改变电压。拿匝数比为 10:1 的变压器来说，如果从低压侧接入 400 V，高压侧就可能产生约 4 kV 的电压。\n干式变压器通常比较重，其中铁芯占了很大一部分重量。拆除的时候可以根据夹紧框架的结构，把铁芯和其他部件分开处理，方便后续搬运。
codex:cx_transformer_x.en: A transformer changes voltage through the turns ratio of its high- and low-voltage windings. Take a transformer with a turns ratio of 10:1: if 400 V is fed in from the low-voltage side, the high-voltage side may produce about 4 kV.\nA dry-type transformer is usually heavy, and the core makes up a large part of the weight. When removing it, you can use the structure of the clamping frame to separate the core from the other parts, which makes later carrying easier.

codex:cx_inverter_a.zh: 逆变器内部主要装着 IGBT 功率模块、散热器、直流母线电容和输出电抗器，这些部件共同负责把直流电转换成电机需要的交流电。
codex:cx_inverter_a.en: An inverter mainly contains IGBT power modules, a heat sink, DC-link capacitors and an output choke. Together these parts convert DC into the AC that a motor needs.

codex:cx_inverter_b.zh: 逆变器断开电源以后，内部的直流母线电容可能还存有高压电，需要经过几分钟才能逐渐放电。即使设备已经停止运行，也不能直接拆除。
codex:cx_inverter_b.en: After an inverter is disconnected from the power, the DC-link capacitors inside may still hold high voltage, and take a few minutes to discharge gradually. Even if the equipment has stopped running, it must not be removed directly.

codex:cx_inverter_c.zh: 先断开逆变器的所有输入电源，等待电容完成放电，必要时通过指定的放电点进行放电。确认直流母线没有残余电压以后，再开始拆除设备。
codex:cx_inverter_c.en: First disconnect all the inverter’s input supplies and wait for the capacitors to discharge, and if needed discharge them through the designated discharge point. Start removing the equipment only after confirming the DC bus has no residual voltage.

codex:cx_inverter_x.zh: 逆变器通过 IGBT 模块的快速开关，把直流电转换成交流电，用来控制电机运行。内部的直流母线电容负责储存电能，让供电电压保持稳定。\n这类设备的直流母线电压经常达到 600–800 V，即使已经断开电源，电容里也可能残留危险电压。设备通常装有泄放电阻，但一般需要等待几分钟才能完成放电，具体时间要看设备型号，拆除前仍然需要实际测量确认。
codex:cx_inverter_x.en: An inverter converts DC into AC by fast switching of its IGBT modules, and uses it to control motor running. The DC-link capacitors inside store the electrical energy and keep the supply voltage steady.\nThe DC bus voltage of this kind of equipment often reaches 600–800 V, and even after the supply is disconnected, a dangerous voltage may remain in the capacitors. The equipment usually has bleed resistors, but it generally takes a few minutes to finish discharging, and the exact time depends on the model, so you still need to measure and confirm before removal.

codex:cx_fuelcell_a.zh: 燃料电池内部有上百片双极板，整组电池由两端的端板和拉杆固定在一起，旁边还配有鼓风机和加湿器，用来维持电池运行时需要的空气供应和湿度。
codex:cx_fuelcell_a.en: Inside a fuel cell there are hundreds of bipolar plates. The whole stack is held together by end plates and tie rods at the two ends, and beside it are a blower and a humidifier that keep up the air supply and humidity the cell needs while running.

codex:cx_fuelcell_b.zh: 只要内部还有氢气和氧气，燃料电池就可能继续发电。即使已经断开了主电源线路，电池本身也可能带电，里面残留的氢气还有泄漏和起火的危险。
codex:cx_fuelcell_b.en: As long as hydrogen and oxygen remain inside, a fuel cell can keep generating power. Even after the main supply line is disconnected, the cell itself may be live, and the hydrogen left inside can leak and catch fire.

codex:cx_fuelcell_c.zh: 拆除之前，先断开燃料电池自己的电源开关，关闭燃料供应阀门，再按照设备要求排出内部残留的氢气。确认燃料供应已经隔离、内部没有危险的氢气残留，并完成验电以后，才能开始拆除。
codex:cx_fuelcell_c.en: Before removal, switch off the fuel cell at its own power switch, shut the fuel supply valve, then vent the hydrogen left inside as the equipment requires. Start removal only after confirming the fuel supply is isolated, no dangerous hydrogen remains inside, and the voltage test is done.

codex:cx_fuelcell_x.zh: 燃料电池通过氢气和氧气发生电化学反应来产生电能，每片电池工作时的电压大约是 0.7 V，几百片串联起来以后，总电压就可能达到几百伏。\n即使关闭了燃料阀门，电池内部仍然可能残留氢气。如果氢气泄漏到舱室里面，浓度达到空气体积的 4% 到 75% 时就可能燃烧，而且只需要很小的点火能量就能引燃，所以拆除之前一定要确认氢气已经安全排出。
codex:cx_fuelcell_x.en: A fuel cell produces electricity through an electrochemical reaction between hydrogen and oxygen. Each cell works at about 0.7 V, and with several hundred in series the total voltage can reach several hundred volts.\nEven with the fuel valve closed, hydrogen may remain inside the cell. If hydrogen leaks into a room and its concentration reaches 4% to 75% of the air by volume, it can burn, and a very small ignition energy is enough to light it, so always confirm the hydrogen has been safely vented before removal.

codex:cx_charger_a.zh: 充电桩主要用来给无人机或车辆充电，通常配有充电枪头和连接线缆，可以将外部电源接入需要充电的设备。
codex:cx_charger_a.en: A charging unit is mainly used to charge drones or vehicles. It usually comes with a charging connector and cable, and can feed an external supply into the equipment to be charged.

codex:cx_charger_b.zh: 充电桩连接着充电设备时，充电线缆的两端都可能带电。即使已经断开充电桩的电源，被充电设备内部的电池也可能还有电压。
codex:cx_charger_b.en: While a charging unit is connected to equipment being charged, both ends of the charging cable may be live. Even after the charging unit’s supply is disconnected, the battery inside the equipment being charged may still have voltage.

codex:cx_charger_c.zh: 先关闭充电开关，断开充电桩的供电并确认已经停止充电，再按照要求拔下充电线缆。确认连接已经断开以后，才能继续处理被充电的设备。
codex:cx_charger_c.en: First switch off the charging switch, disconnect the charging unit’s supply and confirm charging has stopped, then unplug the charging cable as required. Carry on with the equipment that was being charged only after confirming the connection is cut.

codex:cx_charger_x.zh: 充电桩从供电总线获取电能，再通过充电线缆把电能输送给连接的设备。如果设备内部装有电池，即使充电桩已经断电，电池本身仍然储存着电能，所以拔掉充电线缆以后，设备的电池一侧也可能继续带电，拆除时需要单独检查。
codex:cx_charger_x.en: A charging unit takes power from the supply bus and sends it to the connected equipment through the charging cable. If the equipment has a battery inside, that battery still stores energy even after the charging unit loses power, so after the charging cable is unplugged, the battery side of the equipment may remain live, and it needs to be checked separately during removal.

codex:cx_dump_res_a.zh: 泄能电阻由一排排反复折叠的不锈钢电阻带组成，连接在超导磁体的泄能回路上，主要用来消耗磁体储存的能量。
codex:cx_dump_res_a.en: A dump resistor is made of rows of stainless steel resistor ribbon folded back and forth. It is connected to the dump circuit of a superconducting magnet and mainly consumes the energy the magnet has stored.

codex:cx_dump_res_b.zh: 磁体泄能时，大量电能会通过电阻转化成热量，满负荷运行时，电阻带甚至会被加热到发红。如果提前拆除泄能电阻，磁体就会失去正常的泄能通道，可能造成严重事故。
codex:cx_dump_res_b.en: When a magnet dumps its energy, a great deal of electrical energy is turned into heat in the resistor, and at full load the resistor ribbon can even be heated until it glows red. If the dump resistor is removed too early, the magnet loses its normal dump path, which may cause a serious accident.

codex:cx_dump_res_c.zh: 先确认磁体已经完成泄能，等回路电流降到安全范围，并按照要求完成隔离、验电和放电以后，才能拆除泄能电阻及其连接的母排。
codex:cx_dump_res_c.en: First confirm the magnet has finished dumping its energy and the circuit current has dropped to a safe range, and complete the isolation, voltage test and discharge as required, and only then remove the dump resistor and the busbars connected to it.

codex:cx_dump_res_x.zh: 磁体泄能时，线圈中的电流会经过泄能电阻逐渐减小，计算公式为 I = I₀·e^(−t/τ)，其中 τ = L/R。电阻越大，电流下降得越快，但泄能时产生的电压也会更高，可以用 U = I·R 计算。在大型超导磁体中，几十吉焦的储能可能在几十秒内转化成热量，电阻带的温度也可能升高到几百度。
codex:cx_dump_res_x.en: When a magnet dumps its energy, the current in the coil gradually falls through the dump resistor, calculated as I = I₀·e^(−t/τ), where τ = L/R. The larger the resistance, the faster the current falls, but the voltage produced during the dump is also higher, and can be calculated as U = I·R. In a large superconducting magnet, tens of gigajoules of stored energy may be turned into heat within tens of seconds, and the temperature of the resistor ribbon may also rise to several hundred degrees.

codex:cx_slip_ring_a.zh: 滑环由安装在旋转部分的一组铜环和固定部分的电刷组成，主要用来给不断旋转的居住环供电，让居住环在转动的时候也能正常使用电力。
codex:cx_slip_ring_a.en: A slip ring is made of a set of copper rings on the rotating part and brushes on the fixed part. It mainly supplies power to a habitat ring that keeps rotating, so the habitat ring can use electricity normally while it turns.

codex:cx_slip_ring_b.zh: 如果居住环还在通电，就直接启动刹车，电机在减速时产生的回馈电流可能会经过滑环。电流过大时，滑环内部可能出现电弧，严重时还会烧坏铜环和电刷。
codex:cx_slip_ring_b.en: If you start the brake while the habitat ring is still powered, the regenerated current the motor produces while slowing down may pass through the slip ring. If the current is too large, an arc may form inside the slip ring, and in serious cases it burns out the copper rings and brushes.

codex:cx_slip_ring_c.zh: 先断开居住环上的用电负载，确认相关电路已经安全隔离以后，再启动制动系统，让居住环逐渐停止旋转。
codex:cx_slip_ring_c.en: First disconnect the electrical loads on the habitat ring, and after confirming the related circuits are safely isolated, start the braking system and let the habitat ring gradually stop rotating.

codex:cx_slip_ring_x.zh: 滑环依靠电刷与铜环之间的接触来传输电流，即使居住环一直旋转，也能保持电力连接。不过电刷能够承受的电流密度有限，如果回馈电流过大，接触位置就可能产生电弧，在铜环表面留下烧蚀和凹坑。滑环还是这座旋转居住环唯一的供电通路，一旦损坏，整个居住环就可能失去电力供应。
codex:cx_slip_ring_x.en: A slip ring carries current through contact between the brushes and the copper rings, so the electrical connection holds even while the habitat ring keeps rotating. However, the current density the brushes can bear is limited, and if the regenerated current is too large, an arc may form at the contact point and leave burn marks and pits on the copper ring surface. The slip ring is also the only supply path for this rotating habitat ring, and if it is damaged, the whole habitat ring may lose its power supply.

codex:cx_tray_a.zh: 安装在顶板下方的梯式电缆桥架，里面铺设着成捆的电缆，附近通常还安装着照明灯具和消防喷头。
codex:cx_tray_a.en: A ladder-type cable tray mounted under the deckhead, with bundles of cable laid in it, and lamps and fire sprinklers usually fitted nearby.

codex:cx_tray_b.zh: 桥架里面可能有多条不同的供电线路，只要其中还有一根电缆带电，就不能直接切割整捆电缆，否则可能造成短路或触电事故。
codex:cx_tray_b.en: A tray may hold several different supply lines, and as long as one cable in it is still live, you cannot cut the whole bundle directly, or it may cause a short circuit or an electric shock.

codex:cx_tray_c.zh: 先找到桥架内所有电缆对应的电路，逐一断开电源并确认没有电压以后，再拆除电缆和桥架。
codex:cx_tray_c.en: First find the circuits that all the cables in the tray belong to, disconnect each supply and confirm there is no voltage, and then remove the cables and the tray.

codex:cx_tray_x.zh: 电缆桥架本身只是用来固定和支撑电缆的金属结构，真正需要注意的是里面的线路。动力电缆、信号电缆和控制电缆可能铺设在同一座桥架里，所以拆除之前要按照工程图逐一确认每条线路的连接情况，完成必要的断电和安全检查以后，再进行拆除。
codex:cx_tray_x.en: The cable tray itself is only a metal structure that holds and supports the cables, and what really needs care is the lines inside. Power cables, signal cables and control cables may be laid in the same tray, so before removal, check the connections of every line against the engineering drawing, and remove them after the necessary power-off and safety checks.

codex:cx_module_a.zh: 可更换单元是一种可以整体拆卸和更换的密封设备箱，外面装有两个方便抓握的把手，通过自锁螺钉固定在安装位置上，背面还有可以直接插拔的连接接头。
codex:cx_module_a.en: A replaceable unit is a sealed equipment box that can be removed and replaced as a whole. It has two easy-to-grip handles on the outside, is held in place by captive screws, and has plug-in connectors on the back that can be pulled out directly.

codex:cx_module_b.zh: 设备背面的接头直接连接着安装背板，如果还没有解除固定就强行拔出，可能会损坏背板上的接头，影响后续设备的安装和使用。
codex:cx_module_b.en: The connectors on the back of the equipment connect straight into the mounting backplane. If you pull it out by force before releasing it, you may damage the connectors on the backplane, affecting later installation and use of equipment.

codex:cx_module_c.zh: 先断开设备电源，确认安全以后，再松开固定设备的自锁螺钉，握住把手将整个单元拔出来，尽量保持设备和接头的完整。
codex:cx_module_c.en: First disconnect the equipment’s power, and once it is safe, loosen the captive screws that hold the equipment, grip the handles and pull the whole unit out, keeping the equipment and its connectors intact as far as possible.

codex:cx_module_x.zh: ORU采用的是航天器上常见的整体更换设计，宇航员即使戴着厚重的手套，也能通过把手和自锁螺钉完成拆装，部分设备还可以直接由机械臂操作。由于不需要拆开内部零件，整个单元就能取下来，所以这类设备通常比较容易拆卸，只要没有损坏，完整回收的价值也比较高。
codex:cx_module_x.en: The ORU uses the whole-unit replacement design common on spacecraft. Even an astronaut in thick gloves can fit and remove it with the handles and captive screws, and some units can also be handled directly by a mechanical arm. Because the internal parts need not be taken apart, the whole unit can be lifted out, so this kind of equipment is usually fairly easy to remove, and if it is undamaged, its value when recovered whole is also fairly high.

codex:cx_pump_a.zh: 离心泵组一般由泵壳、轴承架、联轴器和电机组成，这些部件都安装在同一个底座上。泵壳通常采用蜗壳结构，用来输送管道里的液体。
codex:cx_pump_a.en: A centrifugal pump set generally consists of a pump casing, a bearing frame, a coupling and a motor, all mounted on the same baseplate. The pump casing is usually a volute, used to move the liquid in the line.

codex:cx_pump_b.zh: 泵组虽然已经停止运行，但进出口管道里可能还存有液体，电机也可能没有断电。直接切断管道会造成液体泄漏，带电拆除电线还可能产生电弧。
codex:cx_pump_b.en: Although the pump set has stopped running, the inlet and outlet lines may still hold liquid, and the motor may not be de-energised. Cutting a line directly causes a liquid leak, and removing the wires while live may also produce an arc.

codex:cx_pump_c.zh: 先切断电机电源，再通过排放口把泵组和连接管道里的液体排空，确认没有残余压力以后，断开电缆和进出口管道，最后把整套泵组从底座上拆下来。
codex:cx_pump_c.en: First cut the motor’s power, then drain the liquid in the pump set and the connected lines through the drain, confirm there is no residual pressure, disconnect the cable and the inlet and outlet lines, and finally take the whole pump set off its baseplate.

codex:cx_pump_x.zh: 离心泵通过电机带动叶轮旋转，让液体向泵壳外侧流动，再利用蜗壳把液体的部分流动速度转化成压力。运行时需要有液体提供冷却和润滑，如果泵内没有液体还继续运转，机械密封可能在几十秒内就因为过热而损坏。完整泵组的回收价值通常比直接拆成废金属高得多。
codex:cx_pump_x.en: A centrifugal pump has a motor turn an impeller, which throws the liquid towards the outside of the pump casing, and the volute then turns part of the liquid’s speed into pressure. While running it needs liquid for cooling and lubrication, and if the pump keeps running with no liquid inside, the mechanical seal may be damaged by overheating within tens of seconds. A whole pump set is usually worth much more when recovered than when broken down into scrap metal.

codex:cx_hx_a.zh: 管壳式换热器里面装着一组换热管，一种液体从管子内部流过，另一种液体则从管子外面的壳体空间流过。两种液体通过管壁传递热量，正常情况下不会直接混合。
codex:cx_hx_a.en: A shell-and-tube heat exchanger holds a bundle of heat exchange tubes. One liquid flows through the inside of the tubes, and another flows through the shell space outside the tubes. The two liquids pass heat through the tube walls, and normally do not mix directly.

codex:cx_hx_b.zh: 换热器内部有两套独立的液体管路，分别叫作管程和壳程。就算其中一侧已经排空，另一侧也可能还存有液体和压力，如果直接拆除管道，就可能造成液体泄漏。
codex:cx_hx_b.en: A heat exchanger has two independent sets of liquid lines inside, called the tube side and the shell side. Even if one side has been emptied, the other side may still hold liquid and pressure, and removing the pipes directly may cause a liquid leak.

codex:cx_hx_c.zh: 先分别检查管程和壳程，确认两侧都已经隔离并完成泄压，再把内部残留的液体全部排空。确认安全以后，逐一拆除连接的管道，最后再拆下整台换热器。
codex:cx_hx_c.en: First check the tube side and the shell side separately, confirm both sides are isolated and vented, and then drain all the liquid left inside. Once it is safe, remove the connected pipes one by one, and finally take off the whole heat exchanger.

codex:cx_hx_x.zh: 换热器内部装有折流板，可以改变壳程液体的流动方向，让液体反复经过换热管束，提高热量传递的效率。由于管程和壳程的压力、温度以及内部介质可能各不相同，拆除时需要把四个管口分别检查和处理，不能因为其中一侧已经排空，就认为整台换热器都已经安全。
codex:cx_hx_x.en: A heat exchanger has baffles inside which change the flow direction of the shell-side liquid and make it cross the tube bundle repeatedly, raising the efficiency of heat transfer. Because the pressure, temperature and medium inside the tube side and the shell side may all differ, the four nozzles need to be checked and handled separately when removing it, and you cannot assume the whole heat exchanger is safe just because one side has been emptied.

codex:cx_radiator_a.zh: 散热板的两端装有集管，中间排列着大量冷却液流道管。冷却液经过这些管道时，会把热量传递到散热板表面，再通过热辐射把热量排放到太空中。
codex:cx_radiator_a.en: A radiator panel has headers at both ends and a large number of coolant flow tubes arranged in between. As coolant passes through these tubes, it passes heat to the panel surface, and the heat is then radiated into space.

codex:cx_radiator_b.zh: 散热板的管道里可能还存有冷却液，刚停止运行时，板面温度也可能很高。如果还没有完成冷却就直接收拢或者拆除，散热板可能因为受热不均而发生变形。
codex:cx_radiator_b.en: The tubes of a radiator panel may still hold coolant, and just after it stops running, the panel surface may also be very hot. If you fold or remove it before it has cooled, the radiator panel may deform from uneven heating.

codex:cx_radiator_c.zh: 先让冷却回路继续运行一段时间，等散热板的温度降下来以后，再把管道里的冷却液排空。确认温度和管道状态都正常以后，就可以拆除散热板了。
codex:cx_radiator_c.en: First let the cooling loop keep running for a while, and once the radiator panel’s temperature has dropped, drain the coolant out of the tubes. After confirming the temperature and the state of the tubes are both normal, you can remove the radiator panel.

codex:cx_radiator_x.zh: 太空中没有空气，散热板只能依靠热辐射把热量排出去，散热功率可以用 P = εσAT⁴ 计算。在理想条件下，温度为 300 K 的散热板，每平方米大约能辐射 400 W 的热量，所以航天器通常需要安装面积很大的散热板。\n散热板本身比较薄，重量也比较轻，一般通过铰链固定在支撑吊杆上。拆卸和搬运的时候要控制好力度，避免把板面或者连接部位弄坏。
codex:cx_radiator_x.en: There is no air in space, so a radiator panel can only shed heat by thermal radiation, and the radiated power can be calculated as P = εσAT⁴.
