codex:cx_arm_x.en: When a mechanical arm is folded, its joints may still be under hydraulic pressure or preload. Even if the power is already off, these forces do not disappear at once. When removing it, release the stored energy first, then release the joint locks, and only then remove the connecting structure.

codex:cx_dock_a.zh: 对接口由环形法兰、固定螺栓、捕获锁、导向瓣和舱门组成，用来连接两艘飞船。
codex:cx_dock_a.en: A docking port is made up of a ring flange, fixing bolts, capture latches, guide petals and a hatch, and is used to connect two ships.

codex:cx_dock_b.zh: 对接口后面的舱室可能还保持着内部气压，如果直接拆卸，舱内气体可能突然喷出。
codex:cx_dock_b.en: The compartment behind the docking port may still be under internal pressure. If it is removed directly, the gas inside may suddenly burst out.

codex:cx_dock_c.zh: 先检查对接口后面的舱室压力，确认已经完成泄压以后，再拆卸对接口。
codex:cx_dock_c.en: First check the pressure in the compartment behind the docking port, and remove the port only after confirming it has been vented.

codex:cx_dock_x.zh: 对接口既要承受两艘飞船连接时的受力，也要保证舱室不会漏气，所以连接处通常有几十颗固定螺栓和两道密封圈。对接时，导向瓣可以帮助两艘飞船对准位置，方便后续锁定。
codex:cx_dock_x.en: A docking port has to take the load when two ships are connected and also keep the compartment airtight, so the joint usually has several tens of fixing bolts and two seal rings. During docking, the guide petals help the two ships line up, making it easier to lock them together afterwards.

codex:cx_brake_a.zh: 盘式制动器由卡钳、活塞、刹车片和油管组成，卡钳安装在制动盘边缘，通过夹紧制动盘来减慢转速。
codex:cx_brake_a.en: A disc brake is made up of a caliper, pistons, brake pads and a hydraulic line. The caliper is mounted on the edge of the brake disc and slows the rotation by clamping the disc.

codex:cx_brake_b.zh: 没有开启冷却就直接刹车，刹车片很容易因为温度过高而损坏。而且制动器连接的设备可能还在旋转，直接拆卸会有危险。
codex:cx_brake_b.en: If you brake without turning on cooling, the brake pads are easily damaged by excessive temperature. The equipment the brake is connected to may also still be rotating, so removing it directly is dangerous.

codex:cx_brake_c.zh: 先开启制动冷却系统，再启动刹车，等设备完全停止旋转以后，才能拆卸制动器。
codex:cx_brake_c.en: First turn on the brake cooling system, then apply the brake. Remove the brake only after the equipment has stopped rotating completely.

codex:cx_brake_x.zh: 制动器通过刹车片和制动盘之间的摩擦，把旋转产生的动能转化成热量。就拿转速达到 20,000 rpm 的飞轮来说，要让它完全停下来，刹车片就得承受大量的热量。如果冷却效果不够好，刹车片的温度超过承受极限以后，制动器就可能失效，导致飞轮无法正常停止旋转。
codex:cx_brake_x.en: A brake turns kinetic energy from rotation into heat through friction between the brake pads and the brake disc. Take a flywheel spinning at 20,000 rpm: to bring it to a complete stop, the brake pads have to absorb a large amount of heat. If cooling is not good enough, once the pad temperature exceeds its limit the brake may fail, and the flywheel cannot be stopped properly.

codex:cx_lift_a.zh: 升降台由剪叉式支架、升降平台和底座组成，通过液压缸控制平台的升降。
codex:cx_lift_a.en: A lift table is made up of scissor supports, a lifting platform and a base. The platform is raised and lowered by hydraulic cylinders.

codex:cx_lift_b.zh: 升降台升起来以后，液压缸里面可能还保持着很高的压力，如果直接拆卸，平台可能突然下降。
codex:cx_lift_b.en: Once a lift table is raised, the hydraulic cylinders may still hold very high pressure. If the table is removed directly, the platform may suddenly drop.

codex:cx_lift_c.zh: 先把升降台降到最低位置，再释放液压系统里的压力，确认卸压完成以后才能开始拆卸。
codex:cx_lift_c.en: First lower the lift table to its lowest position, then release the pressure in the hydraulic system. Start removal only after confirming the pressure has been relieved.

codex:cx_lift_x.zh: 剪叉式支架通过液压缸推动来升降平台，支架接近折叠状态时，液压缸需要很大的推力才能把平台抬起来。拆卸前要让平台完全降到底部，再释放剩余压力，避免拆卸过程中发生意外。
codex:cx_lift_x.en: A scissor mechanism raises the platform by being pushed by the hydraulic cylinders. When the supports are close to folded, the cylinders need a very large thrust to lift the platform. Before removal, lower the platform fully to the bottom and then release the remaining pressure, to avoid accidents during removal.

codex:cx_hold_crane_a.zh: 货舱吊车由桥轨上的移动小车、卷扬电机和吊钩组成，可以沿着轨道移动，用来调整货物的位置。
codex:cx_hold_crane_a.en: A hold crane is made up of a trolley on a bridge rail, a hoist motor and a hook. It moves along the rail and is used to adjust the position of cargo.

codex:cx_hold_crane_b.zh: 如果吊钩上还挂着货物，直接拆卸吊车可能导致货物掉落。拉杆如果还处于受力状态，直接切断也可能导致部件突然弹开。
codex:cx_hold_crane_b.en: If the hook is still holding cargo, removing the crane directly may make the cargo drop. If a tie rod is still under load, cutting it directly may also make parts suddenly spring apart.

codex:cx_hold_crane_c.zh: 先把吊着的货物放下来，再松开受力的拉杆，确认没有剩余拉力以后，就可以拆卸吊车了。
codex:cx_hold_crane_c.en: First set down the cargo being held, then release the tie rods that are under load. Once you have confirmed there is no remaining tension, you can remove the crane.

codex:cx_hold_crane_x.zh: 在失重环境下，货物虽然没有重量，但仍然具有惯性。吊车主要用来控制大型货物的移动方向和速度，避免货物在搬运过程中发生碰撞。
codex:cx_hold_crane_x.en: In weightlessness, cargo has no weight but still has inertia. A crane is mainly used to control the direction and speed of large cargo, so that it does not collide with anything while being moved.

codex:cx_machine_tool_a.zh: 机床主要分为车床和铣床，通常由床身、主轴、刀架或工作台等部分组成，可以用来加工金属零件。
codex:cx_machine_tool_a.en: Machine tools are mainly divided into lathes and mills. They usually consist of a bed, a spindle, and a tool post or table, and are used to machine metal parts.

codex:cx_machine_tool_b.zh: 机床本身非常重，底部通常有多颗地脚螺栓固定，而且电机可能还带着电，直接拆卸容易发生危险。
codex:cx_machine_tool_b.en: A machine tool is very heavy, and is usually fixed at the bottom with many hold-down bolts. Its motor may also still be live, so removing it directly is dangerous.

codex:cx_machine_tool_c.zh: 先切断电源，再拆除底部的地脚螺栓。如果整台机床太重，就按照标记的位置分段拆卸。
codex:cx_machine_tool_c.en: First cut the power, then undo the hold-down bolts at the bottom. If the whole machine tool is too heavy, split it into sections along the marked positions.

codex:cx_machine_tool_x.zh: 机床值钱的地方主要在加工精度，所以拆卸的时候要尽量保护导轨和主轴。如果导轨磨损严重，或者在拆卸时受到撞击发生变形，机床就很难继续使用，最后可能只能按照废铁的价格回收。
codex:cx_machine_tool_x.en: A machine tool is valuable mainly for its machining accuracy, so protect the ways and the spindle as much as possible during removal. If the ways are badly worn, or are deformed by a knock during removal, the machine tool can hardly be used any more, and may end up recovered only at the price of scrap iron.

codex:cx_vehicle_a.zh: 固定在甲板上的汽车、叉车、牵引车或者其他作业车辆，通常会使用绑带和轮挡来固定位置。
codex:cx_vehicle_a.en: Cars, forklifts, tractors and other work vehicles fixed to the deck. They are usually held in place with straps and wheel chocks.

codex:cx_vehicle_b.zh: 车辆内部可能还有电池或者燃料，如果固定车辆的绑带松开，车辆就可能在舱室里滑动，撞坏附近的设备。
codex:cx_vehicle_b.en: A vehicle may still hold a battery or fuel inside. If the straps holding it are released, the vehicle may slide around the compartment and smash nearby equipment.

codex:cx_vehicle_c.zh: 可以把整辆车直接运到回收口。如果需要拆解，就先处理车内的电池和燃料，确认安全以后再开始拆卸。
codex:cx_vehicle_c.en: You can take the whole vehicle straight to the recovery mouth. If it needs to be taken apart, deal with the battery and fuel inside first, and start removal after confirming it is safe.

codex:cx_vehicle_x.zh: 完整车辆通常比拆成废金属更值钱，所以有条件的话最好整辆回收。在失重环境下，车辆本身的重量无法让它停在甲板上，需要依靠绑带和轮挡来限制移动。
codex:cx_vehicle_x.en: A whole vehicle is usually worth more than the same vehicle broken into scrap metal, so recover it whole if you can. In weightlessness, the vehicle’s own weight cannot keep it on the deck, so straps and wheel chocks are needed to restrict its movement.

codex:cx_cargo_a.zh: 用来装运货物的标准集装箱或木框货箱，回收价格根据里面申报的货物来计算。
codex:cx_cargo_a.en: Standard shipping containers or wooden-framed crates. The recovery price is calculated from the cargo declared inside.

codex:cx_cargo_b.zh: 货箱通常比较重，搬运时很难立即停下来。冷藏货箱和居住货箱内部还可能存在压力，直接拆开会有危险。
codex:cx_cargo_b.en: Cargo boxes are usually heavy, so they are hard to stop at once when being moved. Reefer containers and accommodation boxes may also hold pressure inside, and opening them directly is dangerous.

codex:cx_cargo_c.zh: 搬运前先查看货箱的重量，太重的话可以使用搬运无人机，或者升级抓钩。有内部压力的货箱需要先释放压力，再进行搬运。
codex:cx_cargo_c.en: Before moving a box, check its mass first. If it is too heavy, use the hauler drone or upgrade the grapple. A box with internal pressure must have the pressure released before it is moved.

codex:cx_cargo_x.zh: 标准集装箱主要通过四个角上的角件来固定和承受搬运载荷，箱子之间可以用扭锁连接。货箱里面的货物通常比箱体本身更值钱，尽量保持整箱完整，可以卖出更高的价格。
codex:cx_cargo_x.en: A standard shipping container is held and takes handling loads mainly through the corner castings at its four corners, and containers can be joined to one another with twist-locks. The cargo inside a box is usually worth more than the box itself, so keep a full box intact where possible, and it will sell for a higher price.

codex:cx_uav_a.zh: 一台停放在机位里的小型维护无人机，机身装有四个旋翼，前面还有用于观察周围环境的传感器。
codex:cx_uav_a.en: A small maintenance drone parked in its bay. Its body has four rotors, and at the front there are sensors for observing its surroundings.

codex:cx_uav_b.zh: 无人机有自己的电池，即使飞船已经断电，它也可能突然启动旋翼，如果没有固定好，就有可能直接飞出去。
codex:cx_uav_b.en: The drone has its own battery. Even when the ship has lost power, it may suddenly start its rotors, and if it is not secured, it may fly straight out.

codex:cx_uav_c.zh: 先断开停机位的充电电源，再关闭无人机的电池开关，取下电池包以后，就可以把无人机搬走了。
codex:cx_uav_c.en: First disconnect the charging supply to the bay, then switch off the drone’s battery switch. Once the battery pack has been removed, you can carry the drone away.

codex:cx_uav_x.zh: 部分无人机在触发断电保护或自动返航程序时，可能会尝试启动旋翼。如果电池还连接着，机身又没有固定好，旋翼突然转动就可能让无人机直接冲出机位，所以拆卸前一定要先断开电池。
codex:cx_uav_x.en: Some drones may try to start their rotors when power-loss protection or an automatic return-home routine is triggered. If the battery is still connected and the body is not secured, the rotors suddenly spinning may make the drone shoot straight out of its bay, so always disconnect the battery before removal.

codex:cx_stator_a.zh: 直线电机的固定部分，里面有叠片铁芯和安装在凹槽里的线圈，两端还能看到露出来的线圈绕组。
codex:cx_stator_a.en: The fixed part of a linear motor. Inside are a laminated iron core and coils fitted in slots, and the end windings sticking out can be seen at both ends.

codex:cx_stator_b.zh: 定子的电源来自电容组，就算切断了主电源，电容组里也可能存着几百伏的高压电，直接拆卸会有触电危险。
codex:cx_stator_b.en: The stator is powered from a capacitor bank. Even if the main supply is cut, the capacitor bank may still hold a high voltage of several hundred volts, and removing it directly risks an electric shock.

codex:cx_stator_c.zh: 先把电容组里的电放干净，确认没有残余电压以后，再断开线路并拆卸线圈。
codex:cx_stator_c.en: First discharge the capacitor bank completely. After confirming there is no residual voltage, disconnect the wiring and remove the coils.

codex:cx_stator_x.zh: 直线电机的工作原理和普通旋转电机差不多，只是定子沿着轨道铺开，通电以后会产生沿轨道移动的磁场，推动动子向前运动。电磁弹射系统就利用这个原理，能在短短几秒内把载荷加速到每秒几百米。
codex:cx_stator_x.en: A linear motor works in much the same way as an ordinary rotary motor, except that the stator is laid out along a track. When powered, it produces a magnetic field that travels along the track and pushes the mover forward. Electromagnetic launch systems use this principle to accelerate a payload to several hundred metres per second in just a few seconds.

codex:cx_launch_cradle_a.zh: 发射滑架安装在轨道上，由滑橇、支撑托垫和释放锁组成，发射时会沿着轨道移动。
codex:cx_launch_cradle_a.en: A launch cradle is mounted on rails and is made up of a sled, support pads and release latches. It moves along the rails during launch.

codex:cx_launch_cradle_b.zh: 轨道可能还保留着预紧力，如果直接打开释放锁，滑架可能会突然弹出去。
codex:cx_launch_cradle_b.en: The rails may still hold preload. If the release latches are opened directly, the cradle may suddenly shoot out.

codex:cx_launch_cradle_c.zh: 先释放轨道上的预紧力，确认滑架不会突然移动以后，再进行拆卸。
codex:cx_launch_cradle_c.en: First release the preload on the rails, and remove the cradle only after confirming it cannot suddenly move.

codex:cx_launch_cradle_x.zh: 发射时，滑架需要承受几十倍重力加速度带来的载荷，所以整体结构比较厚重，需要有足够的强度才能承受发射时的冲击。
codex:cx_launch_cradle_x.en: During launch, the cradle has to take a load from an acceleration of several tens of g, so its overall structure is thick and heavy and needs enough strength to withstand the shock of launch.

codex:cx_flywheel_rotor_a.zh: 飞轮储能器的外壳内部是真空环境，里面装着复合材料飞轮、磁悬浮轴承，还有一套可以发电和驱动飞轮旋转的电机。
codex:cx_flywheel_rotor_a.en: The housing of a flywheel energy store is a vacuum inside. It holds a composite-material flywheel, magnetic bearings and a motor that can both generate power and drive the flywheel.

codex:cx_flywheel_rotor_b.zh: 飞轮可能还在高速旋转，这时候直接松开固定装置或者切割外壳，里面的飞轮可能会飞出去，造成严重损坏。
codex:cx_flywheel_rotor_b.en: The flywheel may still be spinning at high speed. If the fixings are released or the housing is cut at this point, the flywheel inside may fly out and cause serious damage.

codex:cx_flywheel_rotor_c.zh: 先启动刹车冷却系统，再使用刹车降低飞轮转速，等转速降到 300 rpm 以下以后，才能开始拆卸。
codex:cx_flywheel_rotor_c.en: First start the brake cooling system, then use the brake to slow the flywheel. Start removal only after its speed has dropped below 300 rpm.

codex:cx_flywheel_rotor_x.zh: 飞轮通过高速旋转来储存能量，计算公式是 E = ½Iω²，储存的能量和转速的平方成正比。拿同一个飞轮来说，转速达到 20,000 rpm 时，储存的能量就是 2,000 rpm 时的 100 倍。由于内部采用了真空环境和磁悬浮轴承，旋转阻力很小，就算不再供电，也能继续旋转好几天。
codex:cx_flywheel_rotor_x.en: A flywheel stores energy by spinning at high speed. The formula is E = ½Iω², so the stored energy is proportional to the square of the speed. For the same flywheel, at 20,000 rpm the stored energy is 100 times that at 2,000 rpm. Because of the vacuum inside and the magnetic bearings, rotational drag is very small, and even without power the flywheel can keep spinning for several days.

codex:cx_reaction_wheel_a.zh: 反作用飞轮里面装有飞轮、轴承和电机线圈，飞船可以通过调整飞轮的转速来改变自身的姿态。
codex:cx_reaction_wheel_a.en: A reaction wheel contains a flywheel, bearings and motor coils. The ship can change its attitude by adjusting the speed of the wheel.

codex:cx_reaction_wheel_b.zh: 即使已经关闭电源，里面的飞轮也可能还在高速旋转，直接拆卸可能造成设备损坏。
codex:cx_reaction_wheel_b.en: Even after the power is switched off, the wheel inside may still be spinning at high speed, and removing it directly may damage the equipment.

codex:cx_reaction_wheel_c.zh: 拆卸之前先检查飞轮的转速，确认飞轮已经完全停止旋转以后，再拆下整个设备。
codex:cx_reaction_wheel_c.en: Before removal, check the speed of the wheel first. Remove the whole unit only after confirming the wheel has stopped spinning completely.

codex:cx_reaction_wheel_x.zh: 反作用飞轮利用角动量守恒来控制飞船姿态。当电机带动飞轮向一个方向加速旋转时，飞船就会受到反方向的转动力矩，从而调整姿态。飞轮的正常工作转速通常可以达到每分钟几千转。
codex:cx_reaction_wheel_x.en: A reaction wheel uses conservation of angular momentum to control the ship’s attitude. When the motor spins the wheel up in one direction, the ship receives a torque in the opposite direction and so changes its attitude. The normal operating speed of the wheel can usually reach several thousand revolutions per minute.

codex:cx_despin_brake_a.zh: 安装在旋转居住环轮毂上的制动装置，主要由制动盘、卡钳和散热片组成，用来降低居住环的旋转速度。
codex:cx_despin_brake_a.en: A braking unit mounted on the hub of a rotating habitat ring, made up mainly of a brake disc, calipers and cooling fins. It is used to reduce the rotation speed of the ring.

codex:cx_despin_brake_b.zh: 如果居住环上的设备还在用电，直接启动刹车可能产生过大的回馈电流，烧坏供电滑环。如果没有开启冷却系统，刹车产生的高温还可能损坏制动器。
codex:cx_despin_brake_b.en: If equipment on the habitat ring is still drawing power, applying the brake directly may produce an excessive regenerated current and burn out the power slip ring. If the cooling system is not turned on, the high temperature produced by braking may also damage the brake.

codex:cx_despin_brake_c.zh: 先切断居住环上所有设备的电源，再开启制动器的冷却系统，确认准备完成以后，同时对两个居住环进行制动。
codex:cx_despin_brake_c.en: First cut the power to all equipment on the habitat ring, then turn on the brake’s cooling system. Once everything is ready, brake both habitat rings at the same time.

codex:cx_despin_brake_x.zh: 制动时，电机可以把居住环旋转产生的动能转化成电能，储存在电容器里，这个过程叫再生制动。等电容器充满以后，需要先释放里面的电能，才能继续使用这种制动方式。两个居住环需要一起减速，如果只刹住其中一个，另一个居住环的角动量可能让船体发生扭转。
codex:cx_despin_brake_x.en: During braking, the motor can convert the kinetic energy of the ring’s rotation into electrical energy and store it in a capacitor. This process is called regenerative braking. Once the capacitor is full, its energy must be released before this braking method can continue. The two habitat rings need to slow down together: if only one is braked, the angular momentum of the other ring may twist the hull.

codex:cx_rotary_seal_a.zh: 安装在旋转轮毂和固定主轴之间的密封装置，用来减少两者之间的气体泄漏。
codex:cx_rotary_seal_a.en: A sealing device fitted between the rotating hub and the fixed spine, used to reduce gas leakage between the two.

codex:cx_rotary_seal_b.zh: 如果轮毂还在旋转，就直接打开过渡气闸，可能会把里面的密封结构撕坏。
codex:cx_rotary_seal_b.en: If the transfer airlock is opened while the hub is still turning, the sealing structure inside may be torn apart.

codex:cx_rotary_seal_c.zh: 先让轮毂完全停止旋转，再锁定轴承，确认固定好以后才能开始拆卸。
codex:cx_rotary_seal_c.en: First let the hub stop turning completely, then lock the bearing. Start removal only after confirming it is secured.

codex:cx_rotary_seal_x.zh: 迷宫密封内部有很多圈密封齿，气体经过这些位置时，流动阻力会逐渐增加，从而减少泄漏。中间还有缓冲气槽，可以隔开两侧的气体。由于密封结构之间没有直接接触，所以轮毂旋转的时候也能保持密封，不过如果出现了较大的开口，气体还是会直接泄漏。
codex:cx_rotary_seal_x.en: A labyrinth seal has many rings of sealing teeth inside. As gas passes through them, the flow resistance builds up step by step, which reduces leakage. In the middle there is also a buffer-gas groove that separates the gas on the two sides. Because the sealing parts do not touch each other, the seal holds even while the hub turns, but if a large opening appears, the gas will still leak straight out.

codex:cx_spoke_lift_a.zh: 安装在旋转环轮辐上的电梯，轿厢通过导轨和齿条上下移动，配有舱门、驱动电机和防止轿厢失控的安全钳。
codex:cx_spoke_lift_a.en: A lift fitted on the spoke of a rotating ring. The car moves up and down on guide rails and a rack, and has doors, a drive motor and safety gear that stops the car running away.

codex:cx_spoke_lift_b.zh: 旋转环还在转动的时候，轿厢会受到离心力的影响。如果这时候切断导轨，轿厢可能会直接被甩出去。
codex:cx_spoke_lift_b.en: While the rotating ring is still turning, the car is affected by centrifugal force. If the guide rail is cut at this point, the car may be flung straight off.

codex:cx_spoke_lift_c.zh: 先让旋转环停止转动，确认轿厢已经停稳以后，再开始拆卸电梯。
codex:cx_spoke_lift_c.en: First stop the rotating ring from turning, and start removing the lift only after confirming the car has come to a steady stop.

codex:cx_spoke_lift_x.zh: 旋转环通过转动产生离心力，让里面的人感觉到类似重力的效果。拿半径 100 米的旋转环来说，每分钟转动 3 圈，就能产生大约 1 g 的人工重力。电梯从中央轮毂移动到外环的过程中，乘客感受到的人工重力也会从接近零逐渐增加到 1 g。
codex:cx_spoke_lift_x.en: A rotating ring produces centrifugal force by turning, which gives the people inside an effect like gravity. For a ring with a radius of 100 m, turning 3 times per minute produces about 1 g of artificial gravity. As the lift moves from the central hub out to the outer ring, the artificial gravity felt by passengers also rises gradually from nearly zero to 1 g.

codex:cx_tether_damper_a.zh: 由液压缸、弹簧和气囊组成的装置，用来减少系绳在工作时产生的振动。
codex:cx_tether_damper_a.en: A device made up of a hydraulic cylinder, a spring and a gas bag, used to reduce the vibration produced in a tether while it is working.

codex:cx_tether_damper_b.zh: 系绳如果还处于拉紧状态，阻尼器就会承受很大的拉力，内部的弹簧和气囊也可能储存着压力，直接拆卸容易发生意外。
codex:cx_tether_damper_b.en: If the tether is still taut, the damper takes a very large pulling force, and the spring and gas bag inside may also hold stored pressure, so removing it directly may cause an accident.

codex:cx_tether_damper_c.zh: 先停止系绳转动，再松开张紧器，确认系绳已经放松以后，再开始拆卸阻尼器。
codex:cx_tether_damper_c.en: First stop the tether from turning, then release the tensioner. Start removing the damper only after confirming the tether has gone slack.

codex:cx_tether_damper_x.zh: 系绳太长时容易产生振动，原理和拉紧的琴弦差不多。阻尼器可以利用液压结构吸收振动产生的能量，并将这些能量转化成热量，减少系绳的晃动。
codex:cx_tether_damper_x.en: A tether that is too long tends to vibrate, in much the same way as a taut string. The damper can use its hydraulic structure to absorb the energy of the vibration and convert it into heat, reducing the swaying of the tether.

codex:cx_hyd_clamp_a.zh: 液压夹钳由固定钳口、液压缸控制的活动钳口和底部安装板组成，主要用来夹紧和固定设备。
codex:cx_hyd_clamp_a.en: A hydraulic clamp is made up of a fixed jaw, a moving jaw controlled by a hydraulic cylinder and a base mounting plate. It is mainly used to clamp and hold equipment in place.

codex:cx_hyd_clamp_b.zh: 液压夹钳即使停止工作，内部也可能还有压力。如果没有泄压就直接拆卸，钳口可能突然弹开，撞坏附近的设备。
codex:cx_hyd_clamp_b.en: Even when a hydraulic clamp has stopped working, there may still be pressure inside. If it is removed without relieving the pressure, the jaw may suddenly spring open and smash nearby equipment.

codex:cx_hyd_clamp_c.zh: 拆卸之前先打开保压开关，把内部剩余的压力释放掉，确认泄压完成以后再拆卸夹钳。
codex:cx_hyd_clamp_c.en: Before removal, turn on the holding switch and release the remaining pressure inside. Remove the clamp only after confirming the pressure has been relieved.

codex:cx_hyd_clamp_x.zh: 液压夹钳通过液压锁保持夹紧状态，即使液压泵停止工作，内部压力也能维持很长时间。如果有多个夹钳共同固定一件设备，拆卸时还要注意松开的顺序，因为每松开一个夹钳，剩下的夹钳就需要承担更多载荷。
codex:cx_hyd_clamp_x.en: A hydraulic clamp keeps its clamping state with a hydraulic lock, so even if the hydraulic pump stops, the internal pressure can be maintained for a long time. When several clamps hold one piece of equipment together, the order of release also matters during removal, because each time a clamp is released, the remaining clamps have to carry more load.

codex:cx_iso_table_a.zh: 一种用来放置精密设备的工作台，上面是蜂窝结构的台面，下面装着气动隔振支腿，还有用来调整台面高度的水平阀。
codex:cx_iso_table_a.en: A workbench for holding precision equipment. It has a honeycomb tabletop on top, pneumatic isolation legs underneath, and levelling valves for adjusting the height of the tabletop.

codex:cx_iso_table_b.zh: 隔振台没有锁定的时候，如果在附近进行切割或者发生碰撞，台面可能会产生晃动，导致上面的精密设备受到损坏。
codex:cx_iso_table_b.en: When an isolation table is not locked, cutting or a collision nearby may make the tabletop shake, which can damage the precision equipment on it.

codex:cx_iso_table_c.zh: 先把隔振台锁定，确认台面已经固定好以后，再开始切割附近的结构。
codex:cx_iso_table_c.en: First lock the isolation table, and start cutting the nearby structure only after confirming the tabletop is secured.

codex:cx_iso_table_x.zh: 隔振台通过气动支腿减少外部振动的影响，可以把几赫兹以上的振动降低到原来的 1% 以下。锁定以后，台面会和支架固定在一起，不能继续自由晃动，可以避免拆卸时因为台面移动而损坏设备。
codex:cx_iso_table_x.en: An isolation table uses pneumatic legs to reduce the effect of outside vibration, and can cut vibration above a few hertz to less than 1% of its original level. Once locked, the tabletop is fixed to the frame and can no longer sway freely, which avoids damaging the equipment through tabletop movement during removal.

codex:cx_escape_pod_a.zh: 安装在发射架上的救生舱，外面有防热罩和侧舱门，里面装着乘员座椅，底部还有制动火箭和发射夹。
codex:cx_escape_pod_a.en: An escape pod mounted on a launch cradle. It has a heat shield and a side hatch outside, crew seats inside, and a retro-rocket pack and launch clamps at the bottom.

codex:cx_escape_pod_b.zh: 发射夹里面装有火工品，如果待发电路还在通电，救生舱就有可能意外弹出，拆卸的时候要特别注意。
codex:cx_escape_pod_b.en: The launch clamps contain pyrotechnic charges. If the arming circuit is still powered, the pod may be ejected by accident, so take special care during removal.

codex:cx_escape_pod_c.zh: 先断开待发开关，确认发射电路已经断电以后，再拆卸发射夹和里面的火工品。
codex:cx_escape_pod_c.en: First switch off the arming switch, and confirm the launch circuit is dead. Then remove the launch clamps and the pyrotechnic charges inside.

codex:cx_escape_pod_x.zh: 爆炸螺栓内部装有少量炸药，只需要几安培的电流持续几毫秒，就能完成起爆。发射电容使用独立的供电回路，即使主电源已经断开，也可能保留足够的电能来触发爆炸螺栓。
codex:cx_escape_pod_x.en: An explosive bolt contains a small amount of explosive, and a current of only a few amps lasting a few milliseconds is enough to set it off. The launch capacitor uses a separate supply circuit, so even if the main power is already disconnected, it may keep enough energy to fire the explosive bolts.

codex:cx_safe_deposit_a.zh: 一整面墙的密封保管箱，或者装有机械锁栓的厚重库门。
codex:cx_safe_deposit_a.en: A whole wall of sealed deposit boxes, or a thick vault door with mechanical locking bolts.

codex:cx_safe_deposit_b.zh: 库门的电磁锁可能还在通电，库房内部也可能存在残余气压，直接开门会有危险。
codex:cx_safe_deposit_b.en: The vault door’s electromagnetic lock may still be powered, and there may also be residual pressure inside the vault, so opening the door directly is dangerous.

codex:cx_safe_deposit_c.zh: 先切断门锁的所有供电线路，再释放库房内部的压力，确认安全以后打开库门，尽量把保管箱完整拆下来运走。
codex:cx_safe_deposit_c.en: First cut every power supply line to the door lock, then release the pressure inside the vault. Once it is confirmed safe, open the door and take the deposit boxes out whole where possible.

codex:cx_safe_deposit_x.zh: 库门使用电磁铁控制锁栓，只要还有一路电源接通，机械释放杆就无法扳动。所有电源断开以后，锁栓仍然会保持在原来的位置，需要手动扳动释放杆才能把锁栓收回去。
codex:cx_safe_deposit_x.en: The vault door uses a solenoid to control its locking bolts, and as long as any one supply is still connected, the mechanical release lever cannot be pulled. After all supplies are disconnected, the bolts still stay in their original position, and the release lever has to be pulled by hand to retract them.

codex:cx_pwr_core_a.zh: 压水堆的主体包括压力容器、顶部的螺栓环、控制棒驱动管、堆芯和下腔室。
codex:cx_pwr_core_a.en: The main body of a pressurised-water reactor includes the pressure vessel, the stud ring on top, the control rod drive housings, the core and the lower plenum.

codex:cx_pwr_core_b.zh: 即使反应堆已经停止运行，内部仍然有很强的辐射，而且会持续产生热量。一次冷却回路里的水也处于高温高压状态，拆卸时要特别小心。
codex:cx_pwr_core_b.en: Even after the reactor has stopped running, there is still strong radiation inside, and it keeps producing heat. The water in the primary cooling loop is also at high temperature and high pressure, so take special care during removal.

codex:cx_pwr_core_c.zh: 先保持冷却系统正常运行，等反应堆的温度降下来以后，再做好辐射屏蔽措施，将整个设备拆下来，通过危险品出口运走。
codex:cx_pwr_core_c.en: First keep the cooling system running normally and wait for the reactor temperature to drop. Then put radiation shielding measures in place, remove the whole unit, and send it out through the hazard mouth.

codex:cx_pwr_core_x.zh: 压水堆的一次冷却回路通常保持在 15.5 MPa 左右，水温可以达到 315℃，由于内部压力很高，水在这个温度下仍然不会沸腾。反应堆停止运行一小时后，衰变热大约还有额定热功率的 1.5%，一天后也有约 0.5%。拿一座热功率为 100 MW 的反应堆来说，即使停堆一天，内部仍然会持续产生大约 0.5 MW 的热量，所以冷却系统还得继续运行。
codex:cx_pwr_core_x.en: The primary cooling loop of a pressurised-water reactor is usually kept at about 15.5 MPa, and the water temperature can reach 315 °C. Because the internal pressure is so high, the water still does not boil at this temperature. One hour after the reactor stops, the decay heat is still about 1.5% of rated thermal power, and about 0.5% after one day. Take a reactor with a thermal power of 100 MW: even a day after shutdown it still keeps producing about 0.5 MW of heat, so the cooling system has to keep running.

codex:cx_crdm_a.zh: 用来控制反应堆控制棒位置的设备，主要由耐压外壳、提升线圈、保持线圈、棒位指示装置和驱动杆组成。
codex:cx_crdm_a.en: A unit for controlling the position of the reactor control rods, made up mainly of a pressure-tight housing, lift coils, hold coils, a rod position indicator and a drive rod.

codex:cx_crdm_b.zh: 这套机构也是反应堆一回路压力边界的一部分，如果一回路还没有泄压，直接拆卸可能导致高温冷却剂喷出。
codex:cx_crdm_b.en: This mechanism is also part of the reactor’s primary loop pressure boundary. If the primary loop has not been depressurised, removing it directly may make high-temperature coolant spray out.

codex:cx_crdm_c.zh: 先给反应堆一回路泄压，等冷却剂温度降下来以后，再拆卸控制棒驱动机构。
codex:cx_crdm_c.en: First depressurise the reactor primary loop, and remove the control rod drive mechanism after the coolant temperature has dropped.

codex:cx_crdm_x.zh: 磁力提升式驱动机构通过电磁线圈控制控制棒的位置，一旦失去电源，机构就会释放控制棒，让控制棒依靠重力落入堆芯，使反应堆自动停堆。这种设计叫作失电安全。
codex:cx_crdm_x.en: A magnetic-jack drive mechanism controls the position of the control rods with electromagnetic coils. Once power is lost, the mechanism releases the rods, and they drop into the core under gravity, so the reactor shuts down automatically. This design is called fail-safe.

codex:cx_rcp_a.zh: 负责让冷却剂在反应堆内部循环的设备，主要由屏蔽电机、飞轮、密封组件和泵壳组成。
codex:cx_rcp_a.en: A unit that circulates coolant through the reactor, made up mainly of a canned motor, a flywheel, a seal package and a pump casing.

codex:cx_rcp_b.zh: 主冷却剂泵负责维持堆芯的冷却循环，如果反应堆还没有充分冷却就切断电源，冷却剂流量会逐渐下降，堆芯温度可能再次升高。
codex:cx_rcp_b.en: The reactor coolant pump keeps the core cooling circulation going. If the power is cut before the reactor has cooled enough, the coolant flow gradually falls and the core temperature may rise again.

codex:cx_rcp_c.zh: 先让反应堆完成停堆和冷却，确认堆芯温度已经降到安全范围以后，再切断主冷却剂泵的电源。
codex:cx_rcp_c.en: First let the reactor finish shutting down and cooling, and cut the power to the reactor coolant pump only after confirming the core temperature has dropped to a safe range.

codex:cx_rcp_x.zh: 主冷却剂泵上的飞轮可以在断电以后继续带动泵转动，让冷却剂流量慢慢下降，通常能为堆芯争取几十秒的额外冷却时间。
codex:cx_rcp_x.en: The flywheel on the reactor coolant pump keeps the pump turning after a power loss, so the coolant flow falls off slowly, which usually gives the core several tens of seconds of extra cooling time.

codex:cx_pressurizer_a.zh: 用来控制反应堆一回路压力的大型容器，内部上方留有蒸汽空间，还装有喷淋头、电加热器和安全阀。
codex:cx_pressurizer_a.en: A large vessel for controlling the pressure of the reactor primary loop. Inside, there is a steam space in the upper part, and it also holds a spray head, electric heaters and relief valves.

codex:cx_pressurizer_b.zh: 稳压器内部装有高压热水和蒸汽，如果一回路还没有泄压就直接拆卸，里面的高温水和蒸汽可能会喷出来。
codex:cx_pressurizer_b.en: The pressuriser holds high-pressure hot water and steam. If it is removed directly before the primary loop has been depressurised, the hot water and steam inside may spray out.

codex:cx_pressurizer_c.zh: 先让一回路完成泄压和冷却，确认内部压力和温度都降到安全范围以后，再拆卸稳压器。
codex:cx_pressurizer_c.en: First let the primary loop finish depressurising and cooling. Remove the pressuriser only after you have confirmed that the internal pressure and temperature are both within safe limits.

codex:cx_pressurizer_x.zh: 稳压器通过加热器和喷淋系统来调整一回路的压力。需要升压时，加热器会把一部分水变成蒸汽；需要降压时，就通过喷淋冷水让部分蒸汽冷凝。在 15.5 MPa 的压力下，水的饱和温度大约是 345°C。
codex:cx_pressurizer_x.en: The pressuriser adjusts the pressure of the primary loop with heaters and a spray system. To raise the pressure, the heaters turn some of the water into steam. To lower it, cold water is sprayed in and condenses some of the steam. At a pressure of 15.5 MPa, the saturation temperature of water is about 345°C.

codex:cx_steam_turbine_a.zh: 汽轮机由高压缸和低压缸组成，内部的转子连接在同一根轴上，叶片从前到后逐渐变长。
codex:cx_steam_turbine_a.en: A steam turbine consists of a high-pressure cylinder and a low-pressure cylinder. The rotors inside are joined on the same shaft, and the blades grow longer from front to back.

codex:cx_steam_turbine_b.zh: 汽轮机通常有几十吨重，而且停机以后，转子可能还在缓慢转动，直接拆卸会有危险。
codex:cx_steam_turbine_b.en: A steam turbine usually weighs several tens of tonnes, and after shutdown the rotor may still be turning slowly, so removing it directly is dangerous.

codex:cx_steam_turbine_c.zh: 先确认转子已经完全停止，再隔离蒸汽管路，之后沿着法兰连接处把汽轮机分段拆下来。
codex:cx_steam_turbine_c.en: First confirm that the rotor has stopped completely, then isolate the steam lines, and after that take the turbine apart in sections along its flange joints.

codex:cx_steam_turbine_x.zh: 蒸汽经过汽轮机时，会在每一级叶片之间逐渐膨胀，压力降低的同时体积也会增大，所以后面需要使用更长的叶片。大型汽轮机通常重达几十吨。
codex:cx_steam_turbine_x.en: As steam passes through the turbine, it expands gradually between the stages of blades. Its pressure falls and its volume grows, so the later stages need longer blades. A large turbine usually weighs several tens of tonnes.

codex:cx_condenser_a.zh: 负责把汽轮机排出的蒸汽冷却成水的设备，主要由壳体、管束、水室和热井组成，冷凝后的水会收集在热井里。
codex:cx_condenser_a.en: This unit cools the exhaust steam from the turbine back into water. It consists mainly of a shell, a tube bundle, waterboxes and a hotwell, and the condensed water collects in the hotwell.

codex:cx_condenser_b.zh: 凝汽器的管束里还有冷却水，底部热井也可能存有凝结水，如果没有排空就直接拆卸，里面的积水可能会大量流出。
codex:cx_condenser_b.en: The tube bundle of a condenser still contains cooling water, and the hotwell at the bottom may hold condensate. If you remove the condenser without draining it, a large amount of standing water may pour out.

codex:cx_condenser_c.zh: 先把冷却水和凝结水全部排空，确认内部压力恢复正常以后，再开始拆卸凝汽器。
codex:cx_condenser_c.en: First drain all the cooling water and condensate, and confirm that the internal pressure has returned to normal, then begin removing the condenser.

codex:cx_condenser_x.zh: 凝汽器通常在接近真空的低压环境下工作，蒸汽接触冷却管束后会逐渐凝结成水，体积能够缩小上千倍，从而帮助凝汽器维持内部的低压状态。
codex:cx_condenser_x.en: A condenser normally works at a low pressure close to a vacuum. When steam touches the cooling tubes it gradually condenses into water, and its volume shrinks by a factor of thousands, which helps the condenser keep its internal pressure low.

codex:cx_control_drum_a.zh: 一种用来调节反应堆反应性的装置，鼓体由铍制成，一侧装有碳化硼吸收材料，可以通过电机控制旋转角度。
codex:cx_control_drum_a.en: A device for adjusting the reactivity of the reactor. The drum is made of beryllium, with boron carbide absorber material fitted on one side, and a motor controls its angle of rotation.

codex:cx_control_drum_b.zh: 如果吊装堆芯前没有固定好控制鼓，吊装过程中控制鼓可能发生转动，让吸收材料偏离原来的位置，导致反应堆反应性升高，附近的辐射剂量也可能突然增加。
codex:cx_control_drum_b.en: If the control drums are not secured before the core is lifted, a drum may turn during the lift and move the absorber away from its original position. This raises the reactivity of the reactor, and the radiation dose nearby may also rise suddenly.

codex:cx_control_drum_c.zh: 吊装堆芯之前，先用机械锁定装置固定好每一个控制鼓，确认它们不会转动以后，再开始吊装。
codex:cx_control_drum_c.en: Before lifting the core, secure every control drum with its mechanical lock, confirm that none of them can turn, and only then begin the lift.

codex:cx_control_drum_x.zh: 控制鼓通过旋转来调节堆芯的中子数量。当碳化硼吸收材料朝向堆芯时，会吸收更多中子，降低反应性；当铍制反射面朝向堆芯时，会将更多中子反射回去，提高反应性。
codex:cx_control_drum_x.en: A control drum adjusts the number of neutrons in the core by rotating. When the boron carbide absorber faces the core, it absorbs more neutrons and lowers the reactivity. When the beryllium reflecting face faces the core, it reflects more neutrons back and raises the reactivity.

codex:cx_shadow_shield_a.zh: 由钨和氢化锂交替叠放制成的屏蔽板，主要用来阻挡反应堆堆芯产生的辐射，保护屏蔽板后方的人员和设备。
codex:cx_shadow_shield_a.en: A shield plate made of alternating layers of tungsten and lithium hydride. It mainly blocks the radiation produced by the reactor core, protecting the people and equipment behind it.

codex:cx_shadow_shield_b.zh: 屏蔽板后方的辐射水平比较低，如果提前把它拆走，原本受到保护的工作区域就会直接暴露在堆芯辐射下。
codex:cx_shadow_shield_b.en: The radiation level behind the shield plate is low. If you remove the plate too early, the work area it used to protect is exposed directly to the radiation from the core.

codex:cx_shadow_shield_c.zh: 先用吊装设备固定好屏蔽板，让它继续挡在堆芯前方，工作人员可以在屏蔽板后面的低辐射区域进行拆卸。
codex:cx_shadow_shield_c.en: First secure the shield plate with lifting equipment so that it stays in front of the core. The crew can then work on the removal in the low-radiation area behind the plate.

codex:cx_shadow_shield_x.zh: 屏蔽板里的钨主要负责阻挡伽马射线，氢化锂则负责减慢并吸收中子。在设计条件下，屏蔽板后方的辐射剂量率可以降低到原来的约 1%。航天反应堆通常只在乘员所在的方向设置这种屏蔽板，这样可以减少整套设备的重量。
codex:cx_shadow_shield_x.en: The tungsten in the shield plate mainly blocks gamma rays, and the lithium hydride slows and absorbs neutrons. Under design conditions, the radiation dose rate behind the plate can be reduced to about 1% of the original. A space reactor usually carries this kind of shield plate only in the direction where the crew are, which reduces the weight of the whole installation.

codex:cx_tf_coil_a.zh: 线圈外面有一层钢制外壳，里面是用铠装超导导体绕成的线圈，每一匝导体内部都有液氦流过，用来维持超导所需的低温。
codex:cx_tf_coil_a.en: The coil has a steel case on the outside. Inside is a winding of armoured superconducting conductor, and liquid helium flows through the inside of every turn of conductor to keep the low temperature that superconductivity needs.

codex:cx_tf_coil_b.zh: 线圈内部储存着几十亿焦耳的磁场能量，如果冷却系统失效，或者提前拆掉支撑结构，就可能发生失超，让储存的能量在短时间内大量释放，造成严重损坏。
codex:cx_tf_coil_b.en: The coil stores several gigajoules of magnetic energy. If the cooling system fails, or the support structure is removed too early, the coil may quench and release a large amount of the stored energy in a short time, causing serious damage.

codex:cx_tf_coil_c.zh: 先打开泄能开关，同时保持冷却系统正常运行，等线圈储存的磁场能量全部释放以后，再开始拆卸。
codex:cx_tf_coil_c.en: First open the dump switch while keeping the cooling system running normally. Begin removal only after all the magnetic energy stored in the coil has been released.

codex:cx_tf_coil_x.zh: Nb₃Sn 超导材料在适当条件下，温度低于约 18 K 时可以进入超导状态，电阻降到零。实际运行时通常会用约 4.5 K 的液氦进行冷却。如果线圈发生失超，部分导体就会恢复电阻，电流经过这些位置时会产生大量热量，导致附近的导体也逐渐失去超导状态。严重时，整个过程只需要几秒钟，大量磁场能量就会转化成热量，并产生很大的机械作用力。
codex:cx_tf_coil_x.en: Under suitable conditions, Nb₃Sn superconducting material enters the superconducting state below about 18 K, and its resistance drops to zero. In actual operation it is usually cooled with liquid helium at about 4.5 K. If the coil quenches, part of the conductor regains resistance, and the current passing through those places produces a large amount of heat, so the neighbouring conductor gradually loses superconductivity too. In serious cases the whole process takes only a few seconds, and a large amount of magnetic energy turns into heat and produces a great mechanical force.

codex:cx_cs_stack_a.zh: 由多层饼式线圈叠加组成，线圈中间留有通孔，外面装有拉紧板，上下两端还有预压法兰，用来固定整个结构。
codex:cx_cs_stack_a.en: It is built from many pancake windings stacked together, with a through bore in the middle, tie plates on the outside, and pre-compression flanges at the top and bottom ends to hold the whole structure.

codex:cx_cs_stack_b.zh: 中心螺线管内部同样储存着大量磁场能量，如果冷却系统失效，就可能发生失超，导致储存的能量在短时间内大量释放。
codex:cx_cs_stack_b.en: The central solenoid also stores a large amount of magnetic energy. If its cooling system fails, it may quench and release the stored energy in a short time.

codex:cx_cs_stack_c.zh: 先通过泄能系统释放线圈储存的磁场能量，确认泄能完成以后，再拆卸预压法兰和其他固定结构。
codex:cx_cs_stack_c.en: First release the magnetic energy stored in the coil through the dump system, and confirm that the discharge is complete. Then remove the pre-compression flanges and the other holding structures.

codex:cx_cs_stack_x.zh: 中心螺线管通过改变磁场，在等离子体内部感应出电流，工作原理和变压器类似。运行时，线圈需要承受很大的电磁力，所以必须提前使用预压结构将线圈固定好，防止线圈在受力时发生变形或位移。
codex:cx_cs_stack_x.en: The central solenoid induces a current inside the plasma by changing the magnetic field, on a principle similar to a transformer. In operation the coil has to withstand very large electromagnetic forces, so a pre-compression structure must be fitted in advance to hold the coil and prevent it from deforming or shifting under load.

codex:cx_grav_support_a.zh: 由两端的固定块和中间多层柔性薄板组成，主要用来支撑线圈，同时允许线圈在冷却收缩时产生少量位移，避免底座受到过大的拉力。
codex:cx_grav_support_a.en: It consists of fixed blocks at the two ends and several layers of thin flexible plates in between. It mainly supports the coil while allowing it a small displacement as it contracts on cooling, so that the base is not subjected to excessive tension.

codex:cx_grav_support_b.zh: 如果线圈还没有完成泄能，就直接切割或者拆卸支撑结构，可能导致线圈发生位移或变形，严重时还会引起失超，释放大量储存的磁场能量。
codex:cx_grav_support_b.en: If you cut or remove the support structure before the coil has been discharged, the coil may shift or deform, and in serious cases it may quench and release a large amount of stored magnetic energy.

codex:cx_grav_support_c.zh: 先确认线圈已经完成泄能，再拆卸两端的固定块和中间的柔性支撑板。
codex:cx_grav_support_c.en: First confirm that the coil has been discharged, then remove the fixed blocks at the two ends and the flexible support plates in the middle.

codex:cx_grav_support_x.zh: 钢结构从室温冷却到约 4 K 时会发生收缩，几米长的部件可能缩短几毫米。中间的柔性板可以沿一个方向产生少量弯曲，同时在另一个方向保持足够的刚度，这样既能承受线圈的重量，也能适应冷却时产生的收缩，避免底座和连接部位受到损坏。
codex:cx_grav_support_x.en: A steel structure shrinks when it is cooled from room temperature to about 4 K, and a part several metres long may shorten by several millimetres. The flexible plates in the middle can bend slightly in one direction while staying sufficiently stiff in the other. This lets them carry the weight of the coil and also accommodate the contraction during cooling, preventing damage to the base and the joints.

codex:cx_vv_wall_a.zh: 真空室壁由内外两层金属外壳组成，中间装有加强肋，用来支撑整个结构。两层外壳之间还有冷却水通道，里面的屏蔽水可以减少中子辐射对外部设备的影响。
codex:cx_vv_wall_a.en: A vacuum vessel wall consists of an inner and an outer metal shell, with stiffening ribs between them to support the whole structure. There are also cooling water channels between the two shells, and the shielding water in them reduces the effect of neutron radiation on external equipment.

codex:cx_vv_wall_b.zh: 真空室的夹层里可能还残留着冷却水，而且内壁长期受到聚变中子的照射，部分金属材料已经带有放射性，拆卸时需要注意辐射风险。
codex:cx_vv_wall_b.en: Cooling water may still remain in the gap of the vacuum vessel, and the inner wall has been exposed to fusion neutrons for a long time, so some of the metal is already radioactive. Take care over the radiation risk during removal.

codex:cx_vv_wall_c.zh: 先把夹层里面残留的冷却水全部排空，确认排水完成以后，再沿着标记好的切割线，将真空室壁分段拆除。
codex:cx_vv_wall_c.en: First drain all the cooling water remaining in the gap and confirm that the draining is complete. Then cut the vacuum vessel wall into sections along the marked cutting lines.

codex:cx_vv_wall_x.zh: 真空室负责将等离子体与外部环境隔开，同时也能防止氚向外泄漏。聚变反应产生的中子会持续照射真空室内壁，让部分结构钢产生放射性。反应堆退役以后，这些受到活化的材料需要按照放射性水平进行分类处理，其中一部分可以作为低放射性废物处置。
codex:cx_vv_wall_x.en: The vacuum vessel separates the plasma from the outside environment and also stops tritium from leaking out. The neutrons produced by the fusion reaction keep irradiating the inner wall of the vessel, making part of the structural steel radioactive. After the reactor is decommissioned, this activated material has to be sorted according to its radioactivity level, and some of it can be disposed of as low-level radioactive waste.

codex:cx_blanket_a.zh: 安装在真空室内壁上的防护模块，主要由面向等离子体的第一壁和后方的屏蔽块组成，用来承受热量并保护后面的设备。
codex:cx_blanket_a.en: A protective module mounted on the inner wall of the vacuum vessel. It consists mainly of a first wall facing the plasma and a shield block behind it, and it takes the heat and protects the equipment behind.

codex:cx_blanket_b.zh: 第一壁表面的铍瓦比较容易受到撞击损坏，内部冷却管还装有冷却水，如果直接拆卸，可能造成冷却水泄漏。
codex:cx_blanket_b.en: The beryllium tiles on the surface of the first wall are easily damaged by impacts, and the cooling pipes inside still hold cooling water. If you remove the module directly, the cooling water may leak.

codex:cx_blanket_c.zh: 先排空冷却管里面的水，确认没有残留压力以后，再拆下固定螺栓，把整个包层模块取出来。
codex:cx_blanket_c.en: First drain the water from the cooling pipes and confirm that no pressure remains. Then remove the fixing bolts and take out the whole blanket module.

codex:cx_blanket_x.zh: 包层模块的第一壁直接面对高温等离子体，表面需要承受每平方米几兆瓦的热流，所以必须依靠冷却系统带走热量。第一壁使用的铍材料具有毒性，切割时可能产生含铍粉尘，因此尽量保持模块完整，避免直接切割铍瓦。
codex:cx_blanket_x.en: The first wall of a blanket module faces the hot plasma directly. Its surface has to withstand a heat flux of several megawatts per square metre, so the cooling system must carry the heat away. The beryllium used in the first wall is toxic and cutting it may produce beryllium-bearing dust, so keep the module intact as far as possible and avoid cutting the beryllium tiles directly.

codex:cx_divertor_a.zh: 偏滤器由钢制主体、内外两侧的靶板和中间的穹顶组成。靶板表面安装了很多钨块，内部还有冷却管道，用来带走运行时产生的热量。
codex:cx_divertor_a.en: A divertor consists of a steel body, target plates on the inner and outer sides, and a dome in the middle. Many tungsten blocks are mounted on the surface of the target plates, and there are cooling pipes inside to carry away the heat produced in operation.

codex:cx_divertor_b.zh: 偏滤器本身非常重，而且冷却管道里面可能还存有高压水。如果没有提前排空，拆卸时可能发生高压水喷出，整套设备也需要做好承重固定。
codex:cx_divertor_b.en: The divertor itself is very heavy, and the cooling pipes may still hold high-pressure water. If they have not been drained beforehand, high-pressure water may spray out during removal, and the whole unit must also be properly secured to carry its weight.

codex:cx_divertor_c.zh: 先排空冷却管道里的水，确认内部压力已经释放，再把整套偏滤器从安装位置拆下来。
codex:cx_divertor_c.en: First drain the water from the cooling pipes and confirm that the internal pressure has been released. Then remove the whole divertor from its mounting position.

codex:cx_divertor_x.zh: 偏滤器主要负责接收等离子体边缘排出的热量和杂质，并把它们集中到靶板上。运行时，靶板每平方米可能承受 10–20 MW 的热功率，热负荷接近火箭发动机喉部，所以需要持续使用冷却水来控制温度。
codex:cx_divertor_x.en: The divertor receives the heat and impurities exhausted from the edge of the plasma and concentrates them on the target plates. In operation the target plates may take 10–20 MW of heat power per square metre, a heat load close to that at a rocket throat, so cooling water must be used continuously to control the temperature.

codex:cx_gyrotron_a.zh: 回旋管是一种用来产生高功率微波的设备，主要由电子枪、超导磁体中的谐振腔、输出窗和顶部的电子收集极组成。
codex:cx_gyrotron_a.en: A gyrotron is a device that produces high-power microwaves. It consists mainly of an electron gun, a cavity inside a superconducting magnet, an output window, and an electron collector at the top.

codex:cx_gyrotron_b.zh: 回旋管自带超导磁体，内部可能还储存着大量磁场能量。电子枪和收集极使用几十千伏的高压电，即使设备已经停止运行，也可能有残余电荷，直接拆卸会有触电危险。
codex:cx_gyrotron_b.en: A gyrotron has its own superconducting magnet, which may still store a large amount of magnetic energy. The electron gun and the collector use high voltage of several tens of kilovolts, and even after the device has stopped, residual charge may remain, so removing it directly carries a risk of electric shock.

codex:cx_gyrotron_c.zh: 先切断高压电源并完成放电，再把超导磁体储存的能量释放掉，确认设备已经断电后，将整台回旋管拆下来。
codex:cx_gyrotron_c.en: First cut off the high-voltage supply and complete the discharge, then release the energy stored in the superconducting magnet. After confirming that the device is de-energised, remove the whole gyrotron.

codex:cx_gyrotron_x.zh: 回旋管利用强磁场让高速电子进行回旋运动，再把电子的部分能量转换成毫米波。一台大型回旋管可以输出约 1 MW、频率为 170 GHz 的微波，用来加热聚变反应堆中的等离子体。输出窗通常使用人造金刚石制造，因为这种材料能够承受较高的热负荷，同时让微波顺利通过。
codex:cx_gyrotron_x.en: A gyrotron uses a strong magnetic field to make fast electrons move in circles, and then converts part of the electrons’ energy into millimetre waves. One large gyrotron can output about 1 MW of microwave power at a frequency of 170 GHz, which is used to heat the plasma in a fusion reactor. The output window is usually made of synthetic diamond, because this material can withstand a high heat load while letting the microwaves pass through.

codex:cx_ech_a.zh: 这套设备由波纹波导、固定聚焦镜和可以调整方向的反射镜组成，主要负责把微波输送到等离子体内部。
codex:cx_ech_a.en: This equipment consists of corrugated waveguides, a fixed focusing mirror and a mirror whose direction can be adjusted. It mainly delivers the microwaves into the plasma.

codex:cx_ech_b.zh: 反射镜属于精密部件，很容易在拆卸过程中损坏。波导里面还可能存有绝缘气体，直接切割可能导致气体泄漏。
codex:cx_ech_b.en: The mirrors are precision parts and are easily damaged during removal. The waveguides may also hold insulating gas, and cutting them directly may let the gas leak.

codex:cx_ech_c.zh: 先确认波导已经泄压，再避开反射镜和波导进行切割，尽量保持设备完整，最后把整套天线拆下来。
codex:cx_ech_c.en: First confirm that the waveguides have been depressurised, then cut while keeping clear of the mirrors and the waveguides, keep the equipment intact as far as possible, and finally remove the whole antenna.

codex:cx_ech_x.zh: 这套设备通过调整反射镜的角度，把高功率微波送到等离子体内部指定的磁面上。微波可以把能量传递给电子，用来提高等离子体温度，也可以帮助维持等离子体内部的电流。
codex:cx_ech_x.en: By adjusting the angle of the mirror, this equipment sends the high-power microwaves to a chosen magnetic surface inside the plasma. The microwaves can pass their energy to the electrons to raise the plasma temperature, and can also help to sustain the current inside the plasma.

codex:cx_nbi_a.zh: 用来给等离子体加热的设备，主要由离子源、加速栅极、中和室、偏转磁铁和低温泵组成。
codex:cx_nbi_a.en: A device for heating the plasma. It consists mainly of an ion source, accelerator grids, a neutraliser, a bending magnet and cryopumps.

codex:cx_nbi_b.zh: 加速栅极的工作电压接近一百万伏，断电以后也可能残留高压。低温泵内部还冷凝着氢气，如果温度升高，这些氢就会重新变成气体，导致内部压力上升。
codex:cx_nbi_b.en: The accelerator grids operate at a voltage close to a million volts, and high voltage may remain even after the power is cut. Hydrogen is also condensed inside the cryopumps, and if their temperature rises, this hydrogen turns back into gas and the internal pressure goes up.

codex:cx_nbi_c.zh: 先切断高压电源，释放栅极上的残余电荷，再让低温泵逐渐恢复到常温，排出内部积存的气体，确认安全以后再开始拆卸。
codex:cx_nbi_c.en: First cut off the high-voltage supply and discharge the residual charge on the grids. Then let the cryopumps warm up gradually to room temperature and vent the gas stored inside, and begin removal only after confirming that it is safe.

codex:cx_nbi_x.zh: 中性束注入器会先把氘离子加速到上百 keV，再通过中和室将其转化为不带电的中性原子。这样就能让它们穿过磁场进入等离子体，通过碰撞把能量传递给等离子体，达到加热的目的。低温泵则负责在运行时冷凝并收集气体，一旦停止冷却，原本冷凝在内部的氢就会重新变成气体，所以拆卸前必须先完成回温和排气。
codex:cx_nbi_x.en: A neutral beam injector first accelerates deuterium ions to hundreds of keV, and then converts them into uncharged neutral atoms in the neutraliser. This lets them pass through the magnetic field into the plasma, where collisions transfer their energy to the plasma and heat it. The cryopumps condense and collect gas during operation. Once cooling stops, the hydrogen that was condensed inside turns back into gas, so the pumps must be warmed up and vented before removal.

codex:cx_pellet_a.zh: 这套设备用来制作和发射氘冰弹丸，里面有负责冷冻氘燃料的冷头、制作弹丸的螺杆挤出机，还有切刀和气枪发射管。
codex:cx_pellet_a.en: This equipment makes and fires deuterium ice pellets. Inside are a cold head that freezes the deuterium fuel, a screw extruder that forms the pellets, and a cutter and a gas gun barrel.

codex:cx_pellet_b.zh: 设备内部存有低温冻结的氘燃料，温度升高以后，氘冰会逐渐变成可燃气体。如果没有提前排放，拆卸时就可能发生气体泄漏。
codex:cx_pellet_b.en: The equipment holds deuterium fuel frozen at low temperature. When the temperature rises, the deuterium ice gradually turns into a flammable gas. If it has not been vented beforehand, gas may leak during removal.

codex:cx_pellet_c.zh: 先让设备逐渐恢复到正常温度，排放内部剩余的氘气，确认没有残余压力以后再进行拆卸。
codex:cx_pellet_c.en: First let the equipment warm up gradually to normal temperature and vent the remaining deuterium gas. Remove it only after confirming that no residual pressure remains.

codex:cx_pellet_x.zh: 弹丸注入器会把氘燃料冷冻成几毫米大小的冰弹丸，再通过气枪以每秒几百米的速度发射进等离子体内部。这样就能直接向等离子体内部补充燃料，让反应堆维持运行。
codex:cx_pellet_x.en: A pellet injector freezes deuterium fuel into ice pellets a few millimetres across and fires them with a gas gun into the plasma at several hundred metres per second. This adds fuel directly inside the plasma and keeps the reactor running.

codex:cx_port_plug_a.zh: 安装在反应堆观察窗口里的大型屏蔽组件，内部有多组反射镜，可以让诊断光线经过多次反射后进入观测设备。
codex:cx_port_plug_a.en: A large shielding assembly fitted in an observation port of the reactor. It contains several sets of mirrors, which let the diagnostic light enter the observing instruments after several reflections.

codex:cx_port_plug_b.zh: 整个组件非常重，而且正面长期受到中子照射，部分材料可能已经被活化，拆卸时需要注意辐射和吊装安全。
codex:cx_port_plug_b.en: The whole assembly is very heavy, and its front face has been exposed to neutrons for a long time, so some of the material may be activated. Take care over radiation and lifting safety during removal.

codex:cx_port_plug_c.zh: 先确认吊装设备已经固定好，再按照组件上的分段标记，依次把各个部分吊出来。
codex:cx_port_plug_c.en: First confirm that the lifting equipment is secured, then lift out the sections one after another according to the section marks on the assembly.

codex:cx_port_plug_x.zh: 内部的反射镜会让诊断光线经过几次转弯，最终到达观测设备。这样可以减少中子沿着窗口直接向外传播，让工作人员和外部设备受到的辐射更少。
codex:cx_port_plug_x.en: The mirrors inside turn the diagnostic light several times before it reaches the observing instruments. This reduces the neutrons travelling straight out through the port, so the crew and external equipment receive less radiation.

codex:cx_coldbox_a.zh: 一套安装在真空容器里的低温制冷设备，内部装有板翅式换热器和透平膨胀机，可以把氦冷却到约 4.5 K，用来给超导线圈提供低温冷却。
codex:cx_coldbox_a.en: A cryogenic refrigeration unit installed in a vacuum vessel. Inside are plate-fin heat exchangers and turboexpanders, which can cool helium to about 4.5 K to supply low-temperature cooling to the superconducting coils.

codex:cx_coldbox_b.zh: 超导线圈需要持续保持低温，如果提前关闭冷箱，线圈的温度就会逐渐升高，严重时还可能发生失超。
codex:cx_coldbox_b.en: The superconducting coils must be kept cold continuously. If the cold box is shut down too early, the coil temperature gradually rises, and in serious cases a quench may occur.

codex:cx_coldbox_c.zh: 先保持冷箱正常供电和制冷，等超导磁体储存的能量全部释放以后，再关闭冷箱并开始拆卸。
codex:cx_coldbox_c.en: First keep the cold box powered and refrigerating normally. Shut it down and begin removal only after all the energy stored in the superconducting magnets has been released.

codex:cx_coldbox_x.zh: 冷箱需要经过多级换热和膨胀，才能把氦从室温冷却到约 4.5 K。维持这种低温需要消耗大量电力，在约 4 K 的温度下，每带走 1 W 的热量，室温端通常就需要消耗几百瓦的电力。
codex:cx_coldbox_x.en: The cold box needs several stages of heat exchange and expansion to cool helium from room temperature to about 4.5 K. Keeping this low temperature takes a great deal of electric power: at about 4 K, for every 1 W of heat removed, the room-temperature end usually needs several hundred watts of electric power.

codex:cx_cold_box_h2_a.zh: 氢冷箱内部有一套低温制冷设备，包括安装在真空夹套里的板翅式换热器、透平和节流阀，主要用来把氢气冷却成液氢。
codex:cx_cold_box_h2_a.en: A hydrogen cold box contains a cryogenic refrigeration unit, including plate-fin heat exchangers, turbines and a throttle valve mounted in a vacuum jacket. It is mainly used to cool hydrogen gas into liquid hydrogen.

codex:cx_cold_box_h2_b.zh: 氢冷箱还负责处理储罐里蒸发出来的氢气，如果提前关闭，蒸发的氢气就会在罐内不断积累，导致储罐压力逐渐升高。
codex:cx_cold_box_h2_b.en: The hydrogen cold box also handles the hydrogen that boils off in the storage tanks. If it is shut down too early, the boiled-off hydrogen keeps accumulating in the tanks and the tank pressure gradually rises.

codex:cx_cold_box_h2_c.zh: 抽取液氢期间，需要让氢冷箱继续运行，等液氢抽取完成并确认储罐压力安全以后，再关闭设备电源。
codex:cx_cold_box_h2_c.en: While the liquid hydrogen is being drawn off, keep the hydrogen cold box running. Cut its power only after the drawing is finished and the tank pressure is confirmed safe.

codex:cx_cold_box_h2_x.zh: 氢气在常压下需要冷却到大约 −253°C 才能液化。液氢储罐即使有保温层，也会不断吸收外部热量，导致一部分液氢蒸发。氢冷箱可以把这些蒸发出来的氢气重新冷却成液体，减少罐内的气体积累，帮助维持储罐压力。
codex:cx_cold_box_h2_x.en: At normal pressure, hydrogen has to be cooled to about −253°C to liquefy. Even with insulation, a liquid hydrogen tank keeps absorbing heat from outside, and some of the liquid evaporates. The hydrogen cold box can cool this evaporated gas back into liquid, which reduces the gas accumulating in the tank and helps maintain the tank pressure.

codex:cx_dr_stage_a.zh: 制冷机内部装着多层镀金铜板，从上到下依次是 50 K 级、4 K 级、蒸馏室、冷板和混合室，每一层都有不同的工作温度。
codex:cx_dr_stage_a.en: The refrigerator contains several layers of gold-plated copper plates. From top to bottom they are the 50 K stage, the 4 K stage, the still, the cold plate and the mixing chamber, and each layer works at a different temperature.

codex:cx_dr_stage_b.zh: 如果混合室还处于毫开尔文级的低温状态，直接移动或者拆卸冷板，可能会导致下方的芯片开裂。
codex:cx_dr_stage_b.en: If you move or remove the cold plate while the mixing chamber is still at millikelvin temperature, the chip below it may crack.

codex:cx_dr_stage_c.zh: 先按照顺序让各级冷板逐渐恢复温度，等所有部件都回到接近室温的状态以后，再开始拆卸。
codex:cx_dr_stage_c.en: First let the cold plates warm up gradually in order, and begin removal only after all the parts have returned to a state close to room temperature.

codex:cx_dr_stage_x.zh: 稀释制冷机利用氦-3（³He）进入稀相时需要吸收热量的原理进行制冷，可以让混合室的温度降低到约 10 mK。各层冷板之间通过细同轴线连接，并使用导热能力较低的支撑结构隔开，减少不同温度层之间的热量传递，让越往下的冷板保持越低的温度。
codex:cx_dr_stage_x.en: A dilution refrigerator cools by the principle that ³He must absorb heat when it enters the dilute phase, which can bring the mixing chamber down to about 10 mK. The plates are connected by thin coaxial lines and separated by supports of low thermal conductivity, which reduces heat transfer between the temperature layers, so the lower a plate is, the colder it stays.

codex:cx_qpu_a.zh: 一个铜制样品盒，里面装着超导量子芯片，盒子边缘还有一排 SMA 接头，用来连接外部的信号线路。
codex:cx_qpu_a.en: A copper sample box containing a superconducting quantum chip, with a row of SMA connectors along the edge of the box to connect the external signal lines.

codex:cx_qpu_b.zh: 芯片在极低温环境下很容易受到损坏，如果突然改变温度，或者在拆卸时发生振动和碰撞，都可能导致芯片开裂。
codex:cx_qpu_b.en: The chip is easily damaged at extremely low temperature. A sudden change of temperature, or vibration and knocks during removal, may crack the chip.

codex:cx_qpu_c.zh: 先按照规定顺序让设备逐渐恢复到室温附近，再固定好隔振台，确认没有明显振动以后，才能取出量子处理器。
codex:cx_qpu_c.en: First let the equipment warm up gradually to near room temperature in the prescribed order, then lock the vibration isolation table. Take out the quantum processor only after confirming that there is no noticeable vibration.

codex:cx_qpu_x.zh: 超导量子比特通常需要在约 10 mK 的极低温环境下运行，温度变化、机械振动和外界杂散光都可能干扰量子态，影响计算结果。这类芯片的制造成本很高，也是整艘船上最值钱的单件设备之一。
codex:cx_qpu_x.en: Superconducting qubits usually have to operate at an extremely low temperature of about 10 mK. Temperature changes, mechanical vibration and stray light from outside can all disturb the quantum state and affect the results of a calculation. Such chips are very expensive to make, and this is one of the most valuable single items on the whole ship.

codex:cx_pulse_tube_a.zh: 制冷系统由旋转阀、回热器、脉管和两级冷台组成，可以把设备预冷到约 4 K，为后面的稀释制冷提供低温环境。
codex:cx_pulse_tube_a.en: The cooling system consists of a rotary valve, regenerators, pulse tubes and a two-stage cold platform. It can pre-cool the equipment to about 4 K, providing a low-temperature environment for the dilution cooling that follows.

codex:cx_pulse_tube_b.zh: 如果提前关闭脉管制冷机，整套稀释制冷系统就会逐渐回温，可能影响还在低温状态下运行的设备。
codex:cx_pulse_tube_b.en: If the pulse tube cooler is shut down too early, the whole dilution refrigeration system gradually warms up, which may affect equipment still operating at low temperature.

codex:cx_pulse_tube_c.zh: 先完成稀释制冷机内部的混合气回收，确认回收结束以后，再关闭脉管制冷机。
codex:cx_pulse_tube_c.en: First finish recovering the gas mixture inside the dilution refrigerator and confirm that the recovery is complete. Then shut down the pulse tube cooler.

codex:cx_pulse_tube_x.zh: 脉管制冷机利用氦气的周期性压力变化进行制冷，冷端没有需要来回运动的机械部件，所以运行时产生的振动比较小，适合用在量子计算设备上。压缩机通过柔性氦气管路与冷头连接，可以进一步减少传到设备上的振动。
codex:cx_pulse_tube_x.en: A pulse tube cooler refrigerates using periodic pressure changes of helium gas. Its cold end has no mechanical parts moving back and forth, so it produces little vibration in operation and is suitable for quantum computing equipment. The compressor is connected to the cold head by flexible helium lines, which further reduces the vibration passed on to the equipment.

codex:cx_ghs_a.zh: 这套系统负责管理氦-3（³He）和氦-4（⁴He）的混合气体，主要包括控制面板、压力表、冷阱和循环泵。
codex:cx_ghs_a.en: This system manages the mixed gas of helium-3 (³He) and helium-4 (⁴He). It consists mainly of a control panel, pressure gauges, a cold trap and circulation pumps.

codex:cx_ghs_b.zh: 循环回路里有价格很高的氦-3，如果还没有回收气体就直接停机，温度升高后可能造成气体损失。
codex:cx_ghs_b.en: The circulation loop holds very expensive ³He. If you shut down before the gas has been recovered, the gas may be lost as the temperature rises.

codex:cx_ghs_c.zh: 先停止气体循环，把回路里的混合气体全部回收到储罐中，确认回收完成以后，再关闭制冷机的冷头。
codex:cx_ghs_c.en: First stop the gas circulation and recover all the gas mixture in the loop into the storage tank. After confirming that the recovery is complete, shut down the cold head of the refrigerator.

codex:cx_ghs_x.zh: 一台稀释制冷机通常需要使用几十升标准状态下的氦-3，每升价格可能达到数千美元，所以拆卸之前一定要把气体回收好。混合气体进入储罐以后，储罐内部的压力会逐渐升高，最后达到平衡状态。
codex:cx_ghs_x.en: A dilution refrigerator usually needs several tens of litres of ³He at standard conditions, and each litre may cost several thousand dollars, so the gas must be recovered before removal. Once the gas mixture has entered the storage tank, the pressure inside the tank gradually rises and finally reaches equilibrium.

codex:cx_instrument_rack_a.zh: 机柜里面装着任意波形发生器和数字化仪等测控设备，面板上还有一排 SMA 接口，用来连接制冷机的控制和测量线路。
codex:cx_instrument_rack_a.en: The rack contains measurement and control equipment such as arbitrary waveform generators and digitisers, and its panel has a row of SMA ports for connecting the control and measurement lines of the refrigerator.

codex:cx_instrument_rack_b.zh: 机柜里的仪器价格很高，也容易因为碰撞而损坏。部分设备还通过同轴线连接着制冷机，直接搬动可能会扯坏接口和线路。
codex:cx_instrument_rack_b.en: The instruments in the rack are very expensive and easily damaged by knocks. Some of them are also connected to the refrigerator by coaxial lines, and moving them directly may tear off the ports and lines.

codex:cx_instrument_rack_c.zh: 先关闭机柜电源，拔掉所有连接线，确认机柜已经完全断开以后，再把整套设备运送到设备出口。
codex:cx_instrument_rack_c.en: First cut the power to the rack and unplug all the connecting lines. After confirming that the rack is completely disconnected, send the whole unit to the equipment mouth.

codex:cx_instrument_rack_x.zh: 量子计算机需要通过微波信号控制和读取量子比特，每个量子比特通常都需要多条控制和读出线路。对于采用大量独立线路的系统，几十个量子比特就可能需要数百根同轴线，所以拆卸机柜之前要把这些线路全部断开。
codex:cx_instrument_rack_x.en: A quantum computer controls and reads its qubits with microwave signals, and each qubit usually needs several control and readout lines. In a system with many independent lines, a few tens of qubits may need hundreds of coaxial lines, so all of these lines must be disconnected before the rack is removed.

codex:cx_mirror_a.zh: 望远镜使用的高精度镜片，表面有一层很薄的反射镀膜，背面则采用带有加强肋板的轻量化结构，用来减轻镜片的重量。
codex:cx_mirror_a.en: A high-precision mirror segment used in a telescope. Its surface carries a very thin reflective coating, and its back is a lightweight structure with stiffening ribs to reduce the weight of the mirror.

codex:cx_mirror_b.zh: 附近切割金属时产生的粉尘可能落到镜面上，影响镜片的反射效果。如果支撑镜片的促动器还没有锁定，直接拆卸也可能导致镜片掉落或碎裂。
codex:cx_mirror_b.en: Dust produced by cutting metal nearby may land on the mirror face and impair its reflectivity. If you remove the mirror before the actuators that support it have been locked, the mirror may also fall or shatter.

codex:cx_mirror_c.zh: 先给镜面装好防尘罩，再锁定支撑镜片的促动器，确认镜片已经固定好以后，从外圈开始逐块拆卸。
codex:cx_mirror_c.en: First fit the dust cover over the mirror face, then lock the actuators that support the mirror. After confirming that the mirror is secured, remove the segments one by one, starting from the outer ring.

codex:cx_mirror_x.zh: 望远镜的镜面需要保持很高的精度，表面形状的误差通常只有几十纳米，铝或金制成的反射镀膜也只有大约 100 纳米厚。即使只有一粒金属粉尘落在镜面上，也可能造成光线散射。每块镜片通常由 3 到 6 个促动器支撑，外圈镜片的边缘还搭在内圈上，所以拆卸时需要按照顺序进行。
codex:cx_mirror_x.en: A telescope mirror has to keep a very high precision. The error of its surface shape is usually only a few tens of nanometres, and the reflective coating of aluminium or gold is only about 100 nm thick. Even a single grain of metal dust on the mirror face may scatter the light. Each segment is usually supported by 3 to 6 actuators, and the edges of the outer-ring segments also rest on the inner ring, so the removal has to follow a set order.

codex:cx_hexapod_a.zh: 由上下两个平台和中间 6 根交叉安装的直线作动器组成，可以通过调整每根作动器的长度，改变上方平台的位置和角度。
codex:cx_hexapod_a.en: It consists of an upper and a lower platform with 6 crossed linear actuators between them. By adjusting the length of each actuator, it can change the position and angle of the upper platform.

codex:cx_hexapod_b.zh: 这套机构负责支撑望远镜的副镜，如果还没有固定好副镜就直接拆卸，副镜可能失去支撑，发生倾斜或者掉落。
codex:cx_hexapod_b.en: This mechanism supports the secondary mirror of the telescope. If you remove it before the secondary mirror has been secured, the mirror may lose its support and tilt or fall.

codex:cx_hexapod_c.zh: 先把副镜固定好，确认重量已经由其他支撑结构承担，再切断调整机构的电源，最后将整套机构拆卸下来。
codex:cx_hexapod_c.en: First secure the secondary mirror and confirm that its weight is carried by other supporting structures. Then cut the power to the adjusting mechanism, and finally remove the whole mechanism.

codex:cx_hexapod_x.zh: 这种结构也叫 Stewart 平台，通过改变 6 根作动器的长度，可以精确调整上方平台的前后、左右、上下位置，以及三个方向的旋转角度，总共有 6 个自由度。高精度型号的位置调整精度可以达到微米级，所以经常用在需要精确调整方向的光学设备上。
codex:cx_hexapod_x.en: This structure is also called a Stewart platform. By changing the lengths of the 6 actuators, you can precisely adjust the front-back, left-right and up-down position of the upper platform, as well as its rotation about three axes, giving 6 degrees of freedom in total. The positioning accuracy of high-precision models can reach the micrometre level, so they are often used in optical equipment that needs precise pointing adjustment.

codex:cx_aft_optics_a.zh: 平台上安装了三镜、折转镜和精密指向镜，这些镜子按照光路的位置排列，把接收到的光线引导到后面的观测仪器。
codex:cx_aft_optics_a.en: The bench carries a tertiary mirror, fold mirrors and a fine steering mirror. These mirrors are arranged along the light path and guide the light they receive to the observing instruments behind.

codex:cx_aft_optics_b.zh: 平台上的镜子都经过精密校准，安装位置要求很高。如果拆卸时发生碰撞，就可能让整套光学系统失去原来的对准精度。
codex:cx_aft_optics_b.en: All the mirrors on the bench have been precisely aligned, and their mounting positions are very demanding. If a knock occurs during removal, the whole optical system may lose its original alignment accuracy.

codex:cx_aft_optics_c.zh: 不要在平台附近进行切割，拆卸时尽量保持整体完整，再把整个平台慢慢搬运出去。
codex:cx_aft_optics_c.en: Do not cut near the bench. Keep it intact as far as possible during removal, and then carry the whole bench out slowly.

codex:cx_aft_optics_x.zh: 平台使用碳化硅、殷钢等热膨胀较小的材料制造，可以减少温度变化造成的结构变形，让镜子之间的位置保持稳定，避免影响光路的对准精度。
codex:cx_aft_optics_x.en: The bench is made of materials with low thermal expansion, such as silicon carbide and Invar. This reduces the structural deformation caused by temperature changes and keeps the positions of the mirrors stable, so the alignment accuracy of the light path is not affected.

codex:cx_fsm_a.zh: 一面安装在柔性铰链上的小型反射镜，背面装有三组压电驱动器，可以对镜面的角度进行精细调整。
codex:cx_fsm_a.en: A small mirror mounted on a flexure hinge, with three sets of piezo drivers behind it that can adjust the angle of the mirror face finely.

codex:cx_fsm_b.zh: 压电驱动器工作时需要高电压，断电前直接拆卸可能发生触电。镜面也很容易受到污染，接触或划伤后会影响光学性能。
codex:cx_fsm_b.en: The piezo drivers need high voltage when working, so removing them before the power is cut may cause electric shock. The mirror face is also easily contaminated, and touching or scratching it affects the optical performance.

codex:cx_fsm_c.zh: 先切断电源，确认设备已经断电，再把精密指向镜完整拆下来，搬运时注意保护镜面。
codex:cx_fsm_c.en: First cut the power and confirm that the equipment is de-energised. Then remove the whole fine steering mirror, and protect the mirror face while carrying it.

codex:cx_fsm_x.zh: 精密指向镜通过压电驱动器快速调整镜面角度，每秒可以修正上千次，用来抵消船体振动造成的光路偏移。镜面的调整范围通常只有几毫弧度，但已经足够完成精密指向修正。
codex:cx_fsm_x.en: A fine steering mirror adjusts the angle of its mirror face quickly with piezo drivers, correcting it more than a thousand times a second, to cancel the light path shift caused by vibration of the hull. The adjustment range of the mirror is usually only a few milliradians, but this is enough for precise pointing correction.

codex:cx_fgs_a.zh: 用来帮助望远镜保持指向精度的设备，内部装有取光镜、中继光学系统和两个导星探测器，可以持续测量导星的位置。
codex:cx_fgs_a.en: A device that helps the telescope keep its pointing accuracy. Inside are a pick-off mirror, relay optics and two guide detectors, and it can measure the position of a guide star continuously.

codex:cx_fgs_b.zh: 内部的光学零件非常精密，拆卸时如果发生碰撞，或者让灰尘进入设备，都可能影响后续的测量精度。
codex:cx_fgs_b.en: The optical parts inside are very precise. If a knock occurs during removal, or dust gets into the device, the accuracy of later measurements may be affected.

codex:cx_fgs_c.zh: 拆卸时要避开附近的切割作业，尽量把整套设备完整拆下来，搬运时也要避免碰撞。
codex:cx_fgs_c.en: During removal, keep clear of cutting work nearby, remove the whole device intact as far as possible, and avoid knocks while carrying it.

codex:cx_fgs_x.zh: 精密导星仪会持续测量一颗导星的位置，再根据位置变化帮助望远镜修正指向，可以将指向误差控制在毫角秒级。
codex:cx_fgs_x.en: A fine guidance sensor measures the position of a guide star continuously and uses changes in that position to help the telescope correct its pointing, holding the pointing error to the milliarcsecond level.

codex:cx_wfs_a.zh: 内部装有微透镜阵列和相机，光线经过微透镜阵列后会形成许多光点，相机通过测量这些光点的位置变化，判断光线发生了多大的偏移。
codex:cx_wfs_a.en: Inside are a lenslet array and a camera. After the light passes through the lenslet array it forms many spots, and the camera measures how the positions of these spots shift to determine how far the light has been deflected.

codex:cx_wfs_b.zh: 内部的微透镜和相机都属于精密设备，如果拆卸时发生碰撞，可能损坏光学零件，影响测量精度。
codex:cx_wfs_b.en: The lenslets and the camera inside are both precision equipment. If a knock occurs during removal, the optical parts may be damaged and the measurement accuracy affected.

codex:cx_wfs_c.zh: 先切断设备电源，确认断电以后，再把整套传感器完整拆下来，搬运时注意避免碰撞。
codex:cx_wfs_c.en: First cut the power to the equipment and confirm that it is de-energised. Then remove the whole sensor, and avoid knocks while carrying it.

codex:cx_wfs_x.zh: 这种设备使用的是夏克-哈特曼测量原理，微透镜会把进入的光线分成许多光点，相机测出每个光点偏离正常位置的距离，就能计算出对应位置的波前倾斜程度，再根据测量结果调整镜面，减少光学系统产生的误差。
codex:cx_wfs_x.en: This device works on the Shack-Hartmann principle. The lenslets split the incoming light into many spots, and the camera measures how far each spot is from its normal position. From this the local slope of the wavefront can be calculated, and the mirror is then adjusted according to the result to reduce the errors of the optical system.

codex:cx_recoater_a.zh: 用来给镜片表面镀反射膜的设备，内部有真空腔、蒸发源和挡板，镜片安装在夹具上，镀膜的一面朝下。
codex:cx_recoater_a.en: Equipment for coating the surface of a mirror with a reflective film. Inside are a vacuum chamber, evaporation sources and a shutter, and the mirror is mounted on a fixture with the side to be coated facing down.

codex:cx_recoater_b.zh: 真空腔里面可能还装着镜片，拆卸时要小心碰撞。蒸发源工作时需要通电，直接拆卸可能发生触电。
codex:cx_recoater_b.en: A mirror may still be inside the vacuum chamber, so take care not to knock it during removal. The evaporation sources need electric power when working, and removing them directly may cause electric shock.

codex:cx_recoater_c.zh: 先切断设备电源，确认真空腔已经恢复正常气压，再打开舱体，把里面的镜片单独取出来，最后拆卸镀膜舱。
codex:cx_recoater_c.en: First cut the power to the equipment and confirm that the vacuum chamber has returned to normal air pressure. Then open the chamber, take out the mirror inside separately, and finally remove the recoating chamber.

codex:cx_recoater_x.zh: 镀膜时，设备会在真空环境中加热铝，让铝蒸发成气体，随后铝原子会沉积在镜片表面，形成一层大约 100 纳米厚的反射膜。
codex:cx_recoater_x.en: During coating, the equipment heats aluminium in a vacuum and makes it evaporate into gas. The aluminium atoms then deposit on the surface of the mirror and form a reflective film about 100 nm thick.

codex:cx_ir_camera_a.zh: 用来接收红外光线的观测设备，内部装有真空杜瓦、冷指、滤光轮和镜筒，后面还连接着一台制冷机，用来降低探测器的温度。
codex:cx_ir_camera_a.en: An observing instrument for receiving infrared light. Inside are a vacuum dewar, a cold finger, a filter wheel and a lens barrel, and a cryocooler is connected at the back to lower the temperature of the detector.

codex:cx_ir_camera_b.zh: 探测器工作时处于极低温状态，杜瓦内部保持真空，制冷机也需要通电运行。如果没有提前断电和回温，直接拆卸可能损坏设备。
codex:cx_ir_camera_b.en: The detector is at an extremely low temperature while working, the inside of the dewar is kept under vacuum, and the cryocooler also needs power to run. If you remove the camera without cutting the power and warming it up first, the equipment may be damaged.

codex:cx_ir_camera_c.zh: 先关闭制冷机并切断电源，等待探测器逐渐恢复到安全温度，再把整台红外相机完整拆下来。
codex:cx_ir_camera_c.en: First shut down the cryocooler and cut the power, wait for the detector to warm up gradually to a safe temperature, and then remove the whole infrared camera.

codex:cx_ir_camera_x.zh: 红外探测器需要在很低的温度下工作，有些设备甚至要冷却到几十开尔文以下，因为探测器本身也会产生热辐射。如果温度太高，这些热辐射就会干扰相机接收到的红外信号，影响观测结果。
codex:cx_ir_camera_x.en: An infrared detector has to work at a very low temperature, and some must be cooled to below a few tens of kelvin, because the detector itself also produces thermal radiation. If the temperature is too high, this thermal radiation interferes with the infrared signal the camera receives and affects the observations.

codex:cx_spectrograph_a.zh: 用来分析光线的观测设备，内部装有入射狭缝、准直镜、衍射光栅、相机镜头和探测器，可以把接收到的光线按照波长分开。
codex:cx_spectrograph_a.en: An observing instrument for analysing light. Inside are an entrance slit, a collimator, a diffraction grating, camera optics and a detector, and it can separate the light it receives by wavelength.

codex:cx_spectrograph_b.zh: 内部的衍射光栅非常精密，表面有大量密集的刻线，如果拆卸时直接接触或者发生碰撞，就可能损坏光栅，影响后续的测量精度。
codex:cx_spectrograph_b.en: The diffraction grating inside is very precise, and its surface carries a great many closely spaced lines. If you touch it directly or knock it during removal, the grating may be damaged and the accuracy of later measurements affected.

codex:cx_spectrograph_c.zh: 拆卸之前先盖好遮光罩，保护内部的光学零件，然后把整台光谱仪完整拆下来，搬运时注意避免碰撞。
codex:cx_spectrograph_c.en: Before removal, first put on the light cover to protect the optical parts inside. Then remove the whole spectrograph, and avoid knocks while carrying it.

codex:cx_spectrograph_x.zh: 衍射光栅每毫米可以有上千条刻线，不同波长的光经过光栅后会沿不同方向传播，探测器就能分别记录这些光线。通过分析得到的光谱线，可以判断观测目标含有哪些元素，还能根据谱线的偏移计算目标的运动速度。
codex:cx_spectrograph_x.en: A diffraction grating can have thousands of lines per millimetre. After passing through the grating, light of different wavelengths travels in different directions, and the detector can record each of them separately. By analysing the resulting spectral lines you can tell which elements the target contains, and you can also calculate the target’s velocity from the shift of the lines.

codex:cx_coronagraph_a.zh: 镜筒入口装有一块遮挡盘，可以挡住恒星本体发出的强光，让仪器能够观察到恒星周围亮度很低的日冕。
codex:cx_coronagraph_a.en: An occulting disc at the entrance of the tube blocks the strong light from the star itself, so that the instrument can observe the very dim corona around the star.

codex:cx_coronagraph_b.zh: 飞船刚经过近日点，设备可能还没有完全冷却，表面温度会很高。内部的光学零件也很精密，拆卸时要避免碰撞。
codex:cx_coronagraph_b.en: The ship has just passed perihelion, so the instrument may not have cooled completely and its surface temperature may be very high. The optical parts inside are also precise, so avoid knocks during removal.

codex:cx_coronagraph_c.zh: 先测量设备温度，等温度降下来以后，再把整套日冕仪完整拆下来。
codex:cx_coronagraph_c.en: First measure the temperature of the equipment, wait for it to cool down, and then remove the whole coronagraph.

codex:cx_coronagraph_x.zh: 日冕的亮度大约只有太阳表面的百万分之一，要观察到这么微弱的光线，就得尽量减少其他光线的干扰。所以镜筒内部安装了很多层挡光环，用来阻挡多余的杂散光。
codex:cx_coronagraph_x.en: The brightness of the corona is only about one millionth of that of the solar surface. To observe light this faint, interference from other light must be reduced as far as possible. So many layers of baffle rings are fitted inside the tube to block the unwanted stray light.

codex:cx_particle_det_a.zh: 用来检测粒子种类和能量的设备，准直器后面安装着多层硅探测器和吸收板，可以测量粒子穿过不同材料时损失的能量。
codex:cx_particle_det_a.en: A device for detecting the kind and energy of particles. Behind the collimator are several layers of silicon detectors and absorber plates, which can measure the energy a particle loses as it passes through different materials.

codex:cx_particle_det_b.zh: 内部的硅探测器属于精密零件，受到碰撞可能损坏。偏压电源还会产生高电压，设备没有断电时不能直接拆卸。
codex:cx_particle_det_b.en: The silicon detectors inside are precision parts and may be damaged by knocks. The bias supply also produces high voltage, so do not remove the device directly while it is still powered.

codex:cx_particle_det_c.zh: 先关闭偏压电源，确认设备已经断电以后，再把整个粒子探测器完整拆下来，搬运时注意避免碰撞。
codex:cx_particle_det_c.en: First switch off the bias supply and confirm that the equipment is de-energised. Then remove the whole particle detector, and avoid knocks while carrying it.

codex:cx_particle_det_x.zh: 粒子每穿过一层硅探测器，都会损失一部分能量。通过测量粒子在每一层损失了多少能量，以及它最终能穿透多深，就可以判断粒子的种类和能量大小。
codex:cx_particle_det_x.en: Each time a particle passes through a layer of silicon detector, it loses some of its energy. By measuring how much energy the particle loses in each layer, and how deep it finally penetrates, you can determine the kind of the particle and its energy.

codex:cx_magnetometer_a.zh: 一套用来测量磁场的设备，由三个互相垂直的磁通门传感绕组和配套的电子箱组成，可以测量不同方向的磁场强度。
codex:cx_magnetometer_a.en: A set of equipment for measuring magnetic fields. It consists of three mutually perpendicular fluxgate sensor windings and a matching electronics box, and it can measure the field strength in different directions.

codex:cx_magnetometer_b.zh: 磁强计属于精密测量设备，传感头安装在伸杆末端，拆卸时如果发生碰撞，可能会影响测量精度。
codex:cx_magnetometer_b.en: The magnetometer is a precision measuring instrument, and its sensor head is mounted at the end of a boom. If a knock occurs during removal, the measurement accuracy may be affected.

codex:cx_magnetometer_c.zh: 拆卸时注意保护传感头和连接线，把整套设备完整拆下来，再送到设备回收口。
codex:cx_magnetometer_c.en: During removal, take care to protect the sensor head and the connecting lines. Remove the whole set intact and then send it to the equipment recovery mouth.

codex:cx_magnetometer_x.zh: 船上的金属材料和电气设备都会产生磁场，影响磁强计的测量结果，所以传感头一般会安装在远离船体的长杆末端，配套的电子箱则安装在伸杆根部，这样可以减少船体对测量结果的干扰。
codex:cx_magnetometer_x.en: The metal materials and electrical equipment on the ship all produce magnetic fields that affect the magnetometer’s measurements, so the sensor head is usually mounted at the end of a long pole away from the hull, and the matching electronics box is mounted at the root of the boom. This reduces the interference of the hull with the measurements.

codex:cx_lab_a.zh: 实验室里使用的各种分析设备，包括气相色谱仪、质谱仪和显微镜，主要用来检测样本中的物质成分，或者观察样本的内部结构。
codex:cx_lab_a.en: Various analytical instruments used in a laboratory, including gas chromatographs, mass spectrometers and microscopes. They are mainly used to detect the substances in a sample or to observe its internal structure.

codex:cx_lab_b.zh: 这些仪器通常比较昂贵，内部还有不少精密零件，拆卸时需要避免碰撞。质谱仪还装有真空泵和高压部件，断电前不要直接拆卸。
codex:cx_lab_b.en: These instruments are usually expensive and contain many precision parts, so avoid knocks during removal. A mass spectrometer also has vacuum pumps and high-voltage parts, so do not remove it directly before the power is cut.

codex:cx_lab_c.zh: 先切断设备电源，再把仪器完整拆下来，小心搬运到设备回收口，尽量不要损坏内部零件。
codex:cx_lab_c.en: First cut the power to the equipment, then remove the whole instrument, carry it carefully to the equipment recovery mouth, and try not to damage the parts inside.

codex:cx_lab_x.zh: 气相色谱仪可以利用不同物质沸点和极性的差异，把混合气体中的各种成分分离出来。质谱仪则会测量离子的质荷比，用来分析样本中有哪些物质，以及它们的相对含量。
codex:cx_lab_x.en: A gas chromatograph can separate the components of a mixed gas by using the differences in boiling point and polarity between substances. A mass spectrometer measures the mass-to-charge ratio of ions, which is used to analyse which substances are in a sample and their relative amounts.

codex:cx_immersion_rack_a.zh: 刀片服务器竖直插放，整台服务器浸在装有绝缘冷却液的槽里。
codex:cx_immersion_rack_a.en: Blade servers are inserted upright, and each whole server is immersed in a tank of dielectric coolant.

codex:cx_immersion_rack_b.zh: 如果槽内还有冷却液就吊出机柜，冷却液会泼洒出来，导致相邻机柜短路。
codex:cx_immersion_rack_b.en: If you lift out the rack while the tank still holds coolant, the coolant spills out and short-circuits the neighbouring racks.

codex:cx_immersion_rack_c.zh: 先通过槽上的接口抽干冷却液，再吊出机柜。
codex:cx_immersion_rack_c.en: Drain the coolant through the port on the tank first, then lift out the rack.

codex:cx_immersion_rack_x.zh: 绝缘液使用氟化液或合成油，能够直接接触芯片并带走热量，冷却效率比风冷高得多。绝缘液价格很高，泼洒会造成损失；在失重环境中，泼出的液团还会漂到相邻机柜上。
codex:cx_immersion_rack_x.en: The dielectric fluid is a fluorinated fluid or a synthetic oil. It touches the chips directly and carries away heat, with much higher cooling efficiency than air. The fluid itself is very expensive, so spilling it causes a loss. In free fall, the spilt globules also drift onto the neighbouring racks.

codex:cx_storage_array_a.zh: 存储阵列由多层硬盘托架和控制器组成；核心交换机则配有线卡。
codex:cx_storage_array_a.en: A storage array consists of several shelves of drive carriers and controllers. A core switch has line cards instead.

codex:cx_storage_array_b.zh: 硬盘中可能存有客户的监管数据。
codex:cx_storage_array_b.en: The drives may hold the client’s data under custody.

codex:cx_storage_array_c.zh: 先把监管硬盘锁进运输箱，再拆卸阵列。
codex:cx_storage_array_c.en: Latch the custody drives into their transport bays first, then remove the array.

codex:cx_storage_array_x.zh: 数据价值与硬件价值无关：一块硬盘的硬件价值只有几百块，硬盘内的数据却可能涉及合同违约。
codex:cx_storage_array_x.en: The value of the data has nothing to do with the value of the hardware. A drive may be worth only a few hundred, but the data on it may involve a breach of contract.

codex:cx_drive_carrier_a.zh: 硬盘安装在托架中，托架上有锁扣把手和活动灯。
codex:cx_drive_carrier_a.en: A drive is mounted in a carrier, which has a latch handle and an activity light.

codex:cx_drive_carrier_b.zh: 如果没有把硬盘锁进屏蔽运输箱就带走，会被判定为违约并受到罚款。
codex:cx_drive_carrier_b.en: If you take a drive away without latching it into a shielded transport bay, it counts as a breach of contract and you are fined.

codex:cx_drive_carrier_c.zh: 先拨开硬盘的监管锁扣，再将整件硬盘运走。
codex:cx_drive_carrier_c.en: Throw the drive’s custody latch first, then take the whole drive away.

codex:cx_drive_carrier_x.zh: “监管链”要求从硬盘离开机柜到交给客户的每个步骤都能证明数据没有被读取或复制。
codex:cx_drive_carrier_x.en: ‘Chain of custody’ means that every step from the drive leaving the rack to its handover to the client must prove that the data was never read or copied.

codex:cx_top_drive_a.zh: 顶驱是吊在游车下方的钻井电机，由齿轮箱、主轴、两个内防喷阀和吊卡组成。
codex:cx_top_drive_a.en: A top drive is a drilling motor hung below the travelling block. It consists of a gearbox, a main shaft, two inside BOP valves and an elevator.

codex:cx_top_drive_b.zh: 顶驱连接着钻杆，钻杆内可能仍有扭矩和泥浆压力。
codex:cx_top_drive_b.en: The top drive is connected to the drill string, which may still hold torque and mud pressure.

codex:cx_top_drive_c.zh: 先释放钻杆内的扭矩和压力，再处理顶驱。
codex:cx_top_drive_c.en: Release the torque and pressure in the drill string first, then deal with the top drive.

codex:cx_top_drive_x.zh: 顶驱从上方直接带动钻杆旋转，同时通过鹅颈管注入泥浆。顶驱的功率通常在 1 MW 以上。
