codex:cx_top_drive_x.en: A top drive turns the drill string directly from above, and injects mud through its gooseneck at the same time. The power of a top drive is usually above 1 MW.

codex:cx_drawworks_a.zh: 绞车由缠绕大绳的卷筒、盘式刹车、电机和齿轮箱组成。
codex:cx_drawworks_a.en: A drawworks consists of a drum wound with the drill line, disc brakes, a motor and a gearbox.

codex:cx_drawworks_b.zh: 大绳承受着整串钻具的拉力。
codex:cx_drawworks_b.en: Its line carries the whole string's pull.

codex:cx_drawworks_c.zh: 先卸下全部钻具，等大绳松弛后再拆卸绞车。
codex:cx_drawworks_c.en: Take out all the drilling tools first, and remove the drawworks only after the line has gone slack.

codex:cx_drawworks_x.zh: 大绳穿过天车和游车，形成多股滑轮组。绞车拉动其中一股大绳，就能吊起几百吨的重量。
codex:cx_drawworks_x.en: The drill line is reeved through the crown block and the travelling block to form a multi-line pulley system. By pulling one line, the drawworks can lift a weight of hundreds of tonnes.

codex:cx_blocks_a.zh: 天车是井架顶部的一排滑轮，游车是可以上下移动的滑轮组。
codex:cx_blocks_a.en: The crown block is a row of sheaves at the top of the derrick, and the travelling block is a pulley assembly that can move up and down.

codex:cx_blocks_b.zh: 大绳绷紧时，天车和游车共同构成一套张紧的滑轮组。
codex:cx_blocks_b.en: While the line is taut, the crown block and the travelling block together form a tensioned pulley system.

codex:cx_blocks_c.zh: 先松开大绳，再拆卸天车和游车。
codex:cx_blocks_c.en: Slacken the line first, then remove the crown block and the travelling block.

codex:cx_blocks_x.zh: 对于使用 10 股大绳的滑轮组，绞车拉力乘以约 10 就是吊重。
codex:cx_blocks_x.en: For a pulley system with 10 lines strung, the drawworks pull multiplied by about 10 gives the hook load.

codex:cx_rotary_table_a.zh: 转盘位于钻台上，由齿圈、方补心和驱动小齿轮组成。
codex:cx_rotary_table_a.en: The rotary table sits on the drill floor. It consists of a ring gear, a master bushing and a drive pinion.

codex:cx_rotary_table_b.zh: 转盘的刹车锁住了钻杆内的残余扭矩。
codex:cx_rotary_table_b.en: The rotary table’s brake holds the residual torque in the drill string.

codex:cx_rotary_table_c.zh: 关闭转盘刹车并释放扭矩，直到扭矩表的读数接近 0。
codex:cx_rotary_table_c.en: Release the rotary brake and bleed the torque until the torque gauge reads close to 0.

codex:cx_rotary_table_x.zh: 几千米长的钻杆可以储存扭转产生的弹性能。转盘停下时，钻杆可能仍处于扭转了几圈的状态。
codex:cx_rotary_table_x.en: Several kilometres of drill pipe can store elastic energy from twisting. When the rotary table stops, the drill string may still be twisted by several turns.

codex:cx_drillpipe_a.zh: 钻杆每三根组成一立，接头处有耐磨带。排放架上分层码放着钻杆。
codex:cx_drillpipe_a.en: Drill pipe is made up in stands of three joints, with hardbanding at the tool joints. The pipe is racked in layers on the pipe rack.

codex:cx_drillpipe_b.zh: 仍在井内的钻杆承受着扭矩和泥浆压力。
codex:cx_drillpipe_b.en: Pipe that is still in the hole holds torque and mud pressure.

codex:cx_drillpipe_c.zh: 先释放扭矩和压力，再从上到下逐节卸开接头。
codex:cx_drillpipe_c.en: Release the torque and pressure first, then break out the connections one joint at a time from the top down.

codex:cx_drillpipe_x.zh: 钻杆接头使用锥形螺纹，上扣扭矩达到几万牛·米。排放架上的钻杆属于普通货物。
codex:cx_drillpipe_x.en: Tool joints use tapered threads, made up to a torque of tens of thousands of newton-metres. Pipe racked on the pipe rack counts as ordinary cargo.

codex:cx_bha_a.zh: 钻具组合包括钻铤、扶正器、随钻测量工具、取芯筒和钻头。
codex:cx_bha_a.en: The bottom hole assembly includes drill collars, a stabiliser, an MWD tool, a core barrel and a bit.

codex:cx_bha_b.zh: 这部分是最重的一段钻具。随钻工具内有电池，取芯筒内有岩芯。
codex:cx_bha_b.en: This is the heaviest section of the drilling tools. The MWD tool contains batteries, and the core barrel contains a core.

codex:cx_bha_c.zh: 按照危险品要求处理电池，单独回收岩芯。
codex:cx_bha_c.en: Handle the batteries according to the hazard requirements, and recover the core separately.

codex:cx_bha_x.zh: 钻铤向钻头施加压力，扶正器使井眼保持笔直。岩芯是钻井取得的产品，通常是合同指定件。
codex:cx_bha_x.en: The drill collars put weight on the bit, and the stabiliser keeps the hole straight. The core is the product that drilling obtains, and is usually a named item in the contract.

codex:cx_mud_pump_a.zh: 泥浆泵是三缸往复泵，由动力端、十字头、液力端和脉动阻尼器组成。
codex:cx_mud_pump_a.en: A mud pump is a triplex reciprocating pump. It consists of a power end, crossheads, a fluid end and a pulsation dampener.

codex:cx_mud_pump_b.zh: 排出管和阻尼器内有高压泥浆，阻尼器内还预充了氮气。
codex:cx_mud_pump_b.en: The discharge line and the dampener hold high-pressure mud, and the dampener is also precharged with nitrogen.

codex:cx_mud_pump_c.zh: 先释放排出管内的压力和阻尼器内的氮气，再拆卸泥浆泵。
codex:cx_mud_pump_c.en: Release the pressure in the discharge line and the nitrogen in the dampener first, then remove the mud pump.

codex:cx_mud_pump_x.zh: 泥浆泵的排出压力可达 35 MPa。脉动阻尼器内的氮气囊可以吸收每个冲程产生的压力波动。
codex:cx_mud_pump_x.en: The discharge pressure of a mud pump can reach 35 MPa. The nitrogen bladder inside the pulsation dampener absorbs the pressure fluctuation produced by each stroke.

codex:cx_shaker_a.zh: 振动筛由安装在弹簧上的倾斜筛箱和两台振动电机组成，用于筛出钻屑。
codex:cx_shaker_a.en: A shaker consists of a tilted screen basket mounted on springs and two vibrator motors. It screens out the drill cuttings.

codex:cx_shaker_b.en: The basket is full of sticky mud.

codex:cx_shaker_c.zh: 先断开电源，再将振动筛整件拆下。
codex:cx_shaker_c.en: Cut the power first, then remove the shaker as a whole.

codex:cx_shaker_x.zh: 在失重环境中，钻屑无法依靠重力滑下筛面。船上的振动筛通过控制振动方向将钻屑抛出。
codex:cx_shaker_x.en: In free fall, cuttings cannot slide off the screen under gravity. A ship’s shaker throws the cuttings off by controlling the direction of vibration.

codex:cx_mud_clean_a.zh: 泥浆净化设备包括除砂器、除气器、离心机、液气分离器和搅拌器。
codex:cx_mud_clean_a.en: Mud cleaning equipment includes a desander, a degasser, a centrifuge, a mud-gas separator and an agitator.

codex:cx_mud_clean_b.zh: 设备内有泥浆，除气器和液气分离器中还可能有可燃气体。
codex:cx_mud_clean_b.en: The equipment holds mud, and the degasser and the mud-gas separator may also hold flammable gas.

codex:cx_mud_clean_c.zh: 先排空设备并通风，再进行拆卸。
codex:cx_mud_clean_c.en: Drain the equipment and ventilate it first, then remove it.

codex:cx_mud_clean_x.zh: 钻头进入含气地层时，返回的泥浆会携带天然气。除气器在真空状态下分离出气体，再将气体送去燃烧或放空。
codex:cx_mud_clean_x.en: When the bit enters a gas-bearing formation, the returning mud carries natural gas. The degasser separates the gas out under vacuum, then sends the gas off to be flared or vented.

codex:cx_roughneck_a.zh: 铁钻工由轨道上的小车、折叠臂和上下两套扳手头组成。
codex:cx_roughneck_a.en: An iron roughneck consists of a carriage on a rail, a folding arm, and two sets of wrench heads, upper and lower.

codex:cx_roughneck_b.zh: 铁钻工使用液压驱动，系统仍有压力时，设备可能发生剧烈动作。
codex:cx_roughneck_b.en: The iron roughneck is hydraulically driven. If the system still holds pressure, the equipment may make violent movements.

codex:cx_roughneck_c.zh: 先释放液压系统的压力，再拆卸铁钻工。
codex:cx_roughneck_c.en: Release the pressure in the hydraulic system first, then remove the iron roughneck.

codex:cx_roughneck_x.zh: 铁钻工代替人安装和拆卸钻杆螺纹。上方扳手头负责旋扣，下方扳手头使用几万牛·米的扭矩紧扣或松扣。
codex:cx_roughneck_x.en: An iron roughneck makes up and breaks out the pipe threads in place of a crew. The upper wrench head spins the connection, and the lower wrench head tightens or loosens it with a torque of tens of thousands of newton-metres.

codex:cx_bop_a.zh: 防喷器组包括环形防喷器、三道闸板防喷器和侧出口阀；其中一道闸板是剪切闸板。
codex:cx_bop_a.en: A BOP stack includes an annular preventer, three ram preventers and side outlet valves. One of the rams is a shear ram.

codex:cx_bop_b.zh: 关闭的闸板下方可能仍有井压。
codex:cx_bop_b.en: There may still be well pressure below the closed rams.

codex:cx_bop_c.zh: 先通过节流管线或压井管线泄压，确认没有压力后再拆卸防喷器组。
codex:cx_bop_c.en: Bleed the pressure through the choke line or the kill line first, and remove the BOP stack only after confirming there is no pressure.

codex:cx_bop_x.zh: 发生井涌时，防喷器可在几秒内封住井口；剪切闸板可以剪断钻杆并封井。防喷器组是井控的最后一道屏障，也是钻井船上最昂贵的设备之一。
codex:cx_bop_x.en: In a kick, the BOP can shut in the wellhead within a few seconds, and the shear rams can cut the drill pipe and seal the well. The BOP stack is the last barrier of well control, and also one of the most expensive items on a drillship.

codex:cx_well_manifold_a.zh: 这套设备包括立管、闸阀、节流阀、压力表和防喷器蓄能器组。
codex:cx_well_manifold_a.en: This equipment includes a standpipe, gate valves, an adjustable choke, pressure gauges and the BOP accumulator unit.

codex:cx_well_manifold_b.zh: 管汇和蓄能器内都有高压。
codex:cx_well_manifold_b.en: Both the manifold and the accumulators hold high pressure.

codex:cx_well_manifold_c.zh: 先通过泄压阀释放压力，等蓄能器压力降到 0 后再拆卸。
codex:cx_well_manifold_c.en: Release the pressure through the bleed valves first, and remove the equipment only after the accumulator pressure has dropped to 0.

codex:cx_well_manifold_x.zh: 防喷器蓄能器（Koomey）在 21 MPa 压力下储存足以关闭全部闸板的液压能，断电后仍能工作。
codex:cx_well_manifold_x.en: The BOP accumulators (Koomey unit) store, at a pressure of 21 MPa, enough hydraulic energy to close every ram, and still work after power is lost.

codex:cx_ortho_para_a.zh: 换热器通道内填有氧化铁催化剂，通道浸在冷浴中。
codex:cx_ortho_para_a.en: The passages of the heat exchanger are packed with iron oxide catalyst, and the passages are immersed in a cold bath.

codex:cx_ortho_para_b.en: The converter holds very cold hydrogen.

codex:cx_ortho_para_c.zh: 先让转化器回温并释放压力，再进行拆卸。
codex:cx_ortho_para_c.en: Let the converter warm up and release the pressure first, then remove it.

codex:cx_ortho_para_x.zh: 常温下的氢有 75% 是正氢。氢液化后，正氢会自发转化为仲氢并释放热量，足以蒸发掉一罐液氢的大半。因此，液化时需要使用催化剂完成转化。
codex:cx_ortho_para_x.en: Hydrogen at room temperature is 75% ortho-hydrogen. After hydrogen is liquefied, the ortho-hydrogen converts spontaneously to para-hydrogen and gives off heat, enough to boil away most of a tank of liquid hydrogen. So a catalyst is used to complete the conversion during liquefaction.

codex:cx_precooler_a.zh: 液氮浴槽内装有盘管，工艺气通过盘管时会被预冷。
codex:cx_precooler_a.en: A liquid nitrogen bath contains a coiled tube bundle, and the process gas is pre-cooled as it passes through the coil.

codex:cx_precooler_b.zh: 浴槽内有液氮，液氮会持续蒸发。
codex:cx_precooler_b.en: The bath holds liquid nitrogen, which keeps boiling off.

codex:cx_precooler_c.zh: 先抽空液氮并放出蒸发气体，再拆卸预冷器。
codex:cx_precooler_c.en: Draw off the liquid nitrogen and vent the boil-off gas first, then remove the pre-cooler.

codex:cx_precooler_x.zh: 系统先使用 77 K 的液氮预冷气体，后续透平才能高效地将气体冷却到 20 K。
codex:cx_precooler_x.en: The system first pre-cools the gas with 77 K liquid nitrogen, so that the turbines downstream can then efficiently cool the gas to 20 K.

codex:cx_arc_furnace_a.zh: 电弧炉炉芯由带耐火衬里的炉壳、三根石墨电极和水冷炉顶组成。
codex:cx_arc_furnace_a.en: An arc furnace core consists of a refractory-lined shell, three graphite electrodes and a water-cooled roof.

codex:cx_arc_furnace_b.zh: 停机并不代表炉芯已经冷却。如果几百度的炉芯失去冷却，耐火材料会因热震开裂。
codex:cx_arc_furnace_b.en: Stopped does not mean the core has cooled. If a core still at several hundred degrees loses its cooling, the refractory cracks from thermal shock.

codex:cx_arc_furnace_c.zh: 保持冷却，直到炉芯完全冷却后再将其整件吊出。
codex:cx_arc_furnace_c.en: Keep the cooling on until the core is completely cold, then lift it out as a whole.

codex:cx_arc_furnace_x.zh: 耐火材料的导热性较差，内外温差较大时，热应力会使材料开裂。冷却回路正常工作时，炉芯从 760 °C 降至 150 °C 约需两分半。
codex:cx_arc_furnace_x.en: Refractory conducts heat poorly, and when the temperature difference between inside and outside is large, thermal stress cracks the material. With the cooling loop working normally, the core takes about two and a half minutes to drop from 760 °C to 150 °C.

codex:cx_sorter_a.zh: 分选机采用涡电流分选机或磁选滚筒，按金属种类进行分选。
codex:cx_sorter_a.en: The sorter is an eddy-current separator or a magnetic drum. It sorts metals by kind.

codex:cx_sorter_b.zh: 转子内有强永磁体，会吸引铁屑和无人机。
codex:cx_sorter_b.en: The rotor contains strong permanent magnets, which attract steel swarf and the drone.

codex:cx_sorter_c.zh: 先断开电源，等转子停止后再拆卸分选机。
codex:cx_sorter_c.en: Cut the power first and wait for the rotor to stop, then remove the sorter.

codex:cx_sorter_x.zh: 高速旋转的磁极会在铝和铜中感应出涡流，产生的斥力将有色金属弹过分料板，铁则会被磁力吸走。
codex:cx_sorter_x.en: The fast-spinning magnetic poles induce eddy currents in aluminium and copper, and the repulsion this produces flicks the non-ferrous metals over the splitter, while iron is pulled away by the magnet.

codex:cx_scrubber_a.zh: 尾气洗涤塔由填料床、喷淋头、除雾器和循环泵组成。
codex:cx_scrubber_a.en: An off-gas scrubber consists of a packed bed, a spray header, a mist eliminator and a recirculation pump.

codex:cx_scrubber_b.zh: 塔底液体吸收了有害气体，具有腐蚀性。
codex:cx_scrubber_b.en: The liquid in the sump has absorbed the harmful gases and is corrosive.

codex:cx_scrubber_c.zh: 先排空塔底液体，再拆卸洗涤塔。
codex:cx_scrubber_c.en: Drain the sump liquid first, then remove the scrubber.

codex:cx_scrubber_x.zh: 喷淋的碱液可以吸收尾气中的酸性气体，包括 SO₂ 和 HCl。
codex:cx_scrubber_x.en: The sprayed alkaline solution can absorb the acid gases in the off-gas, including SO₂ and HCl.

codex:cx_crusher_a.zh: 圆锥破碎机的动锥在碗形衬板内偏心摆动。
codex:cx_crusher_a.en: In a cone crusher, the mantle gyrates eccentrically inside a bowl liner.

codex:cx_crusher_b.zh: 如果料仓内还有矿石，破碎头仍承受着矿堆的重量。
codex:cx_crusher_b.en: If there is still ore in the hopper, the crusher head still bears the weight of the ore pile.

codex:cx_crusher_c.zh: 先卸空料仓，再拆卸破碎头。
codex:cx_crusher_c.en: Empty the hopper first, then remove the crusher head.

codex:cx_crusher_x.zh: 偏心轴使动锥反复张合，将矿石挤碎在狭缝内。破碎头很重，通常需要分段拆卸。
codex:cx_crusher_x.en: An eccentric shaft makes the mantle open and close repeatedly, crushing the ore in the narrow gap. The crusher head is heavy and usually has to be removed in sections.

codex:cx_turret_a.zh: 炮塔与炮座包括多面体炮室、炮管、耳轴、回转座圈，以及下方的弹药提升机。
codex:cx_turret_a.en: The turret and its mount include a faceted gunhouse, a barrel, trunnions, a slewing ring, and an ammunition hoist below.

codex:cx_turret_b.zh: 弹药提升机和炮膛内可能还有弹药。
codex:cx_turret_b.en: There may still be ammunition in the ammunition hoist and the breech.

codex:cx_turret_c.zh: 先清空弹药，再沿标线拆卸炮塔。
codex:cx_turret_c.en: Clear the ammunition first, then take the turret apart along the marked lines.

codex:cx_turret_x.zh: 炮塔重量很大，座圈滚道承受炮塔的全部重量和后坐力；炮管采用厚壁高强钢。
codex:cx_turret_x.en: A turret is very heavy, and the roller race of the ring carries the turret’s whole weight and the recoil. The barrel is made of thick-walled high-strength steel.

codex:cx_launcher_a.zh: 箱式发射架由并排的发射箱组成，每个发射箱都有易碎盖；也可能是诱饵弹发射筒。
codex:cx_launcher_a.en: A box launcher consists of canisters side by side, each with a frangible cover. It may also be a decoy launcher tube.

codex:cx_launcher_b.zh: 发射箱内可能有弹药。切割、加热或撞击都可能引爆弹药。
codex:cx_launcher_b.en: A canister may still hold ammunition. Cutting, heating or knocks can set the ammunition off.

codex:cx_launcher_c.zh: 不要在发射架附近切割；将弹药整件送往危险品处理处。
codex:cx_launcher_c.en: Do not cut near the launcher. Send the ammunition, as a whole, to hazard handling.

codex:cx_launcher_x.zh: 导弹的固体发动机和战斗部都含有含能材料，加热到一定温度后会自燃，这种现象称为烤燃。
codex:cx_launcher_x.en: A missile’s solid motor and warhead both contain energetic materials, which ignite on their own once heated to a certain temperature. This is called cook-off.

codex:cx_ciws_a.zh: 近防炮由旋转多管炮、上方的雷达罩和底座组成。
codex:cx_ciws_a.en: A close-in weapon system consists of a rotary multi-barrel cannon, a radome above it and a mount.

codex:cx_ciws_b.zh: 弹鼓内可能还有弹药，电容也可能带电。
codex:cx_ciws_b.en: The drum may still hold ammunition, and the capacitors may also be charged.

codex:cx_ciws_c.zh: 先给电容放电并清空弹鼓，再拆卸近防炮。
codex:cx_ciws_c.en: Discharge the capacitors and empty the drum first, then remove the close-in weapon system.

codex:cx_ciws_x.zh: 近防炮每分钟可以发射几千发弹药，弹鼓可装上千发弹药，因此一个弹鼓相当于一座小型弹药库。
codex:cx_ciws_x.en: A close-in weapon system can fire thousands of rounds a minute, and its drum can hold over a thousand rounds, so one drum is equivalent to a small magazine.

codex:cx_m_munitions_a.zh: 弹库中的炮弹和导弹受到加热或撞击时会起爆。一发弹药起爆后，可能引发一连串爆炸。
codex:cx_m_munitions_a.en: The shells and missiles in a magazine explode when heated or knocked. Once one round explodes, it may set off a chain of explosions.

codex:cx_m_munitions_b.zh: 在弹药附近切割会持续加热弹药，直至弹药起爆；一发弹药爆炸后，附近的弹药会接连殉爆。
codex:cx_m_munitions_b.en: Cutting near a round keeps heating it until it explodes. After one round explodes, the rounds near it go off one after another in sympathetic detonation.

codex:cx_m_munitions_c.zh: 可以先打开注水阀淹没弹库，使弹药报废并消除危险；也可以远离弹药作业。
codex:cx_m_munitions_c.en: You can open the flood valve first to flood the magazine, which makes the rounds scrap and removes the danger. You can also work far away from the rounds.

codex:cx_m_munitions_x.zh: 激光在弹药一定范围内工作时会持续加热弹药，温度达到烤燃温度后，弹药就会起爆。弹药以超过一定速度撞击物体时也会起爆。弹库的热测点显示温度最高的那发弹药的读数。注水后的弹药不再受加热或撞击影响，但也失去价值。
codex:cx_m_munitions_x.en: When the laser works within a certain range of a round, it keeps heating the round, and once the temperature reaches the cook-off temperature the round explodes. A round also explodes if it hits an object faster than a certain speed. The magazine’s heat test point shows the reading of the hottest round. Rounds that have been flooded are no longer affected by heating or knocks, but they also lose their value.

codex:cx_m_quench_a.zh: 八组超导线圈储存着磁能，液氦和冷箱负责维持超导状态。
codex:cx_m_quench_a.en: Eight coil packs store magnetic energy, and liquid helium and the cold box keep them superconducting.

codex:cx_m_quench_b.zh: 如果线圈失去冷却并升温超过临界温度，或在线圈仍有磁场时切断支撑，线圈就会失超，瞬间释放能量，并引发相邻线圈连锁失超。
codex:cx_m_quench_b.en: If a coil loses its cooling and warms above the critical temperature, or a support is cut while the coil still carries a field, the coil quenches and releases its energy instantly, and triggers a chain quench of the neighbouring coils.

codex:cx_m_quench_c.zh: 先合上泄能开关，保持冷箱供电。等储能读数降到安全值后，再断开冷却并拆卸线圈。
codex:cx_m_quench_c.en: Close the dump switch first and keep the cold box powered. When the stored-energy reading has dropped to a safe value, then switch off the cooling and remove the coils.

codex:cx_m_quench_x.zh: 泄能时，电流经泄能电阻按 e^(−t/τ) 衰减，经过几个时间常数后会降到安全值以下。此时线圈升温也不会造成危害。如果先断开冷却，线圈会在储存全部能量时升温超过临界温度。失超释放的热量和电磁力会损毁线圈与周围设备，还会烧掉一部分昂贵的液氦。
codex:cx_m_quench_x.en: When dumping, the current decays through the dump resistor as e^(−t/τ), and after a few time constants it falls below the safe value. At that point the coil can warm up without causing harm. If you switch off the cooling first, the coil warms above the critical temperature while still holding all its energy. The heat and electromagnetic forces released by the quench destroy the coil and the surrounding equipment, and also boil off some of the expensive liquid helium.

codex:cx_m_flywheel_a.zh: 飞轮在开局时的转速为 20,000 rpm，设备配有刹车、冷却系统和转速表。
codex:cx_m_flywheel_a.en: The flywheel starts at 20,000 rpm. The equipment comes with a brake, a cooling system and a tachometer.

codex:cx_m_flywheel_b.zh: 如果不开启冷却就直接刹车，卡钳会在 8 秒后烧坏，飞轮此后无法停下。如果在转速达到或超过 300 rpm 时松开飞轮，飞轮会甩出去。
codex:cx_m_flywheel_b.en: If you brake without turning on the cooling, the caliper burns out after 8 s and the flywheel can no longer be stopped. If you free the flywheel at 300 rpm or above, it is thrown out.

codex:cx_m_flywheel_c.zh: 先开启刹车冷却，再使用刹车。等转速降到 300 rpm 以下后拆卸飞轮；轨道预紧机构则从尾部向头部逐个松开。
codex:cx_m_flywheel_c.en: Turn on the brake cooling first, then use the brake. Remove the flywheel once the speed has dropped below 300 rpm. Release the rail preload mechanisms one by one from the tail towards the head.

codex:cx_m_flywheel_x.zh: 开启冷却后，刹车每秒降低 250 rpm，飞轮从 20,000 rpm 降下来约需 80 秒；不开冷却时，降速减半。飞轮能量与转速的平方成正比，转速降至 300 rpm 时，能量只剩开局时的 0.02%。断开主电源后，两组电容仍带有 400 V 电压，并为上轨的直线电机供电，拆卸前需要先放电。
codex:cx_m_flywheel_x.en: With cooling on, the brake takes 250 rpm off every second, so it takes about 80 s to bring the flywheel down from 20,000 rpm. Without cooling, the slowdown is half as fast. Flywheel energy is proportional to the square of its speed, so at 300 rpm only 0.02% of the starting energy is left. After the main supply is disconnected, the two capacitor banks still hold 400 V and supply the linear motor on the upper rail, so they must be discharged before removal.

codex:cx_m_pyro_a.zh: 每个救生舱有两个发射夹。前方发射夹装有爆炸螺栓，并连接独立的发射电容。
codex:cx_m_pyro_a.en: Each pod has two launch clamps. The front launch clamp carries an explosive bolt and is connected to its own launch capacitor.

codex:cx_m_pyro_b.zh: 如果待发电路仍然带电时拆卸发射夹或火工品，爆炸螺栓会走火，将救生舱弹出。
codex:cx_m_pyro_b.en: If you remove a launch clamp or a pyrotechnic charge while the arming circuit is still live, the explosive bolt fires and throws the pod out.

codex:cx_m_pyro_c.zh: 先在竖井的救生舱控制面板上断开待发开关，再拆卸发射夹；将火工品送往危险品口。
codex:cx_m_pyro_c.en: Switch off the arming switch at the pod control panel in the shaft first, then remove the launch clamps. Send the pyrotechnic charges to the hazard mouth.

codex:cx_m_pyro_x.zh: 发射电容是独立电源，主开关无法切断它。爆炸螺栓本身属于危险品，不能送入熔炉。某些合同中，一个救生舱的发射电路仍会带电，这就是“救生舱待发”事故。
codex:cx_m_pyro_x.en: The launch capacitor is a separate supply, and the main switch cannot cut it off. The explosive bolts themselves are hazardous goods and must not be put into the furnace. In some contracts, the launch circuit of one escape pod is still live. This is the ‘armed pod’ incident.

codex:cx_m_magnet_a.zh: 磁力牵引头断电后仍会保留磁场。
codex:cx_m_magnet_a.en: The magnetic towing head keeps its magnetic field after the power is switched off.

codex:cx_m_magnet_b.zh: 磁场会吸引范围内的无人机和散落钢件，导致它们发生碰撞。
codex:cx_m_magnet_b.en: The magnetic field attracts drones and loose steel parts within range, making them collide with the head.

codex:cx_m_magnet_c.zh: 先断开线圈电源，再使用退磁控件消磁，然后靠近牵引头。
codex:cx_m_magnet_c.en: Disconnect the coil supply first, then use the degauss control to demagnetise the head, and only then go near the towing head.

codex:cx_m_magnet_x.zh: 铁磁材料被磁化后会保留剩磁。退磁时，逐渐衰减的交变磁场会打乱磁畴。退磁前必须断开线圈电源，否则线圈会重新磁化。
codex:cx_m_magnet_x.en: Ferromagnetic material keeps some remanent magnetisation after being magnetised. In degaussing, a decaying alternating field scrambles the magnetic domains. The coil supply must be disconnected before degaussing, otherwise the coil magnetises the material again.

codex:cx_m_preload_a.zh: 这些臂、轴、铰链和缆索依靠液压蓄能器或锁销保持支撑，并储存着力。
codex:cx_m_preload_a.en: These arms, shafts, hinges and cables are held in support by hydraulic accumulators or locking pins, and they store force.

codex:cx_m_preload_b.zh: 如果锁销尚未拔出或液压系统仍有压力就拆卸枢轴，机构会弹开，损坏自身和撞上的物体。
codex:cx_m_preload_b.en: If you remove a pivot while a locking pin is still in or the hydraulic system is still under pressure, the mechanism springs open and damages itself and whatever it hits.

codex:cx_m_preload_c.zh: 先释放蓄能器内的压力，再拔出全部锁销。确认张力表归零后，最后拆卸枢轴。
codex:cx_m_preload_c.en: Release the pressure in the accumulator first, then pull out all the locking pins. Once the tension gauge reads zero, remove the pivot last.

codex:cx_m_preload_x.zh: 预紧机构储存弹性能和液压能：拉缆的能量 E = F²L/2EA，蓄能器的能量 E ≈ pV·ln(p/p₀)。卸能顺序始终是“能量—锁—结构”。如果拆除锁销后没有泄压，全部作用力会集中在枢轴上，松开枢轴时就会释放。
codex:cx_m_preload_x.en: A preload mechanism stores elastic energy and hydraulic energy. For a pulled cable, the energy is E = F²L/2EA; for an accumulator, E ≈ pV·ln(p/p₀). The order of unloading is always energy, then locks, then structure. If you remove the locking pins without releasing the pressure, all the force acts on the pivot, and it is released as soon as the pivot is loosened.

codex:cx_m_drones_a.zh: 机库里的每个机位和每架无人机都配有独立电池。
codex:cx_m_drones_a.en: Every bay and every drone in the hangar has its own battery.

codex:cx_m_drones_b.zh: 断开主电池后，机位和无人机仍然带电。如果机身电池尚未拆除就松开无人机，无人机会启动并撞上机位。
codex:cx_m_drones_b.en: After the main battery is disconnected, the bays and drones are still live. If you release a drone while its onboard battery is still fitted, the drone starts up and crashes into its bay.

codex:cx_m_drones_c.zh: 先断开机位充电开关和机身电池开关，再拔掉两根线、拆下电池包，最后将无人机整机运走。
codex:cx_m_drones_c.en: Switch off the bay charging switch and the airframe battery switch first, then unplug the two leads and remove the battery pack, and finally move the whole drone away.

codex:cx_m_drones_x.zh: 无人机的飞控系统失去链路后会尝试自主起飞。只有物理断开电池，才能确认安全。将无人机整机交付到设备口，比将其熔成废料的价值高得多。
codex:cx_m_drones_x.en: When a drone’s flight controller loses its link, it tries to take off on its own. Only a physically disconnected battery is safe. A drone delivered whole to the equipment bay is worth much more than one melted down for scrap.

codex:cx_m_cryo_tank_a.zh: 低温货罐安装在真空夹套内，罐内压力会随着温度变化。
codex:cx_m_cryo_tank_a.en: The cryogenic cargo tanks are fitted inside vacuum jackets, and the pressure in a tank changes with its temperature.

codex:cx_m_cryo_tank_b.zh: 货罐回温后，内部压力会升高。如果安全阀冻住，压力可能持续升高，最终导致货罐爆裂。真空夹套破损后，漏热速度会加快十倍。
codex:cx_m_cryo_tank_b.en: When a tank warms up, the pressure inside rises. If the relief valve is frozen, the pressure can keep rising until the tank bursts. When the vacuum jacket is damaged, heat leaks in ten times faster.

codex:cx_m_cryo_tank_c.zh: 保持制冷机运行，从货罐接口抽走液体。如果安全阀已经冻住，先加热解冻。
codex:cx_m_cryo_tank_c.en: Keep the chillers running and draw the liquid off through the tank ports. If a relief valve is frozen, heat it to thaw it first.

codex:cx_m_cryo_tank_x.zh: 货罐里有液体时，蒸气压大约每升高 20 °C 翻一倍。真空夹套完好时，漏热速度很慢，在一份合同的作业时间内温度升幅不到 10 °C；夹套破损后，温度上升会快得多。
codex:cx_m_cryo_tank_x.en: With liquid in the tank, the vapour pressure roughly doubles for every 20 °C rise. While the vacuum jacket is intact, heat leaks in slowly, and the temperature rises by less than 10 °C within the working time of one contract. Once the jacket is damaged, the temperature rises much faster.

codex:cx_m_boiloff_a.zh: 低温罐里的液体会持续蒸发，使罐内压力升高。制冷系统运行时，罐压能够保持稳定。
codex:cx_m_boiloff_a.en: The liquid in the cryogenic tanks keeps boiling off, which raises the tank pressure. While the refrigeration system is running, the tank pressure stays stable.

codex:cx_m_boiloff_b.zh: 如果先切断电源，制冷系统停止运行，罐压就会升高，可能导致安全阀放空、货物损失，甚至引发爆罐。
codex:cx_m_boiloff_b.en: If you cut the power first, the refrigeration system stops running and the tank pressure rises. This may make the relief valve vent, losing cargo, or even make the tank burst.

codex:cx_m_boiloff_c.zh: 保持制冷系统运行，同时用软管抽走液体；抽出的液体越多，罐压越低。最后再切断电源。
codex:cx_m_boiloff_c.en: Keep the refrigeration system running and draw the liquid off through the hose at the same time. The more you draw off, the lower the tank pressure. Cut the power last.

codex:cx_m_boiloff_x.zh: 蒸发后的气体体积是液体的几百倍，因此少量漏热也会使罐压明显升高。保温层破损后，压力上升得更快；安全阀排出的气体也是货物的一部分。
codex:cx_m_boiloff_x.en: Boiled-off gas takes up hundreds of times the volume of the liquid, so even a small heat leak raises the tank pressure noticeably. When the insulation is damaged, the pressure rises faster. The gas vented by the relief valve is part of the cargo too.

codex:cx_m_frozen_valve_a.zh: 安全阀出口结了冰，阀门被冻住，无法正常泄压。
codex:cx_m_frozen_valve_a.en: One tank's relief valve has an ice plug in its outlet and won't lift.

codex:cx_m_frozen_valve_b.zh: 罐内压力超过安全值，阀门也打不开。压力继续升高，可能导致爆罐。
codex:cx_m_frozen_valve_b.en: Past its set pressure it doesn't relieve; the tank climbs on until it bursts.

codex:cx_m_frozen_valve_c.zh: 先测阀门温度。如果结冰，就加热解冻；也可以先抽走罐内气体，降低压力。
codex:cx_m_frozen_valve_c.en: Read each relief valve's temperature: thaw the abnormally cold one with its heater, or draw its tank down first.

codex:cx_m_frozen_valve_x.zh: 泄放的低温气体在出口膨胀降温，空气或水汽在出口冻成冰塞。测温探针能发现它：冻住的阀比其它阀冷得多。
codex:cx_m_frozen_valve_x.en: Cold gas venting through the outlet expands and chills it, freezing moisture into an ice plug. The probe shows it: the frozen valve reads far colder than the rest.

codex:cx_m_antimatter.zh: 【占位】反物质储存阱：断电即湮灭

codex:cx_m_antimatter_a.zh: 【占位】储存阱里是几微克反物质，靠环形磁体的磁约束悬在真空里。
codex:cx_m_antimatter_a.en: [PLACEHOLDER] A few micrograms of antimatter held in vacuum by the ring magnets' field.

codex:cx_m_antimatter_b.zh: 【占位】约束只靠主电：拉主闸、切到供电链、拆掉磁体电源或电池，正反物质当场湮灭。
codex:cx_m_antimatter_b.en: [PLACEHOLDER] The confinement runs on the main bus only: the main switch, the chain cut, the supply or the battery out, and it annihilates.

codex:cx_m_antimatter_c.zh: 【占位】先接便携约束电源，读数变成“双路供电”后再断主电，拧下支架，吊车整件送反物质回收架。
codex:cx_m_antimatter_c.en: [PLACEHOLDER] The portable supply first; once it reads dual supply the bus may go; unbolt the cradle, crane it whole to the antimatter cradle.

codex:cx_m_dilution_a.zh: 量子芯片放在混合室里，温度接近绝对零度。外面有好几层冷板，靠制冷机一直降温。
codex:cx_m_dilution_a.en: The qubit chip sits in the mixing chamber at millikelvin, hung under stage after stage.

codex:cx_m_dilution_b.zh: 混合气还没回收就停冷头，气体受热沸腾，可能损坏冷板。芯片温度太低时直接加热，也可能裂开。
codex:cx_m_dilution_b.en: Stop the cold head before recovering the mixture and it boils off; heat it or touch it while still at millikelvin and the chip cracks.

codex:cx_m_dilution_c.zh: 先停循环泵，回收混合气，再停脉管冷头。等冷板自然回温后再加热，拆卸前锁住隔振台。
codex:cx_m_dilution_c.en: Stop circulation → recover the mixture → stop the pulse tube → let the stages warm, heaters only past the coldest → lock the isolation table before any cutting.

codex:cx_m_dilution_x.zh: 混合室最冷、回温最慢。在低于热震温度时打开加热器，芯片表面和内部温差太大，硅片会裂；低于脆性温度时任何振动都能让它碎。隔振台没锁，附近的切割会通过台面震到芯片。
codex:cx_m_dilution_x.en: The mixing chamber is coldest and warms slowest. Heaters switched on below the shock temperature put too much difference between the chip's surface and its body and the silicon cracks; below the brittle temperature any shake breaks it. With the isolation table unlocked, a nearby cut shakes the chip.

codex:cx_m_coldchain_a.zh: 三个冷舱的温度保持在 −25 °C，由冷机和制冷主机提供冷却。
codex:cx_m_coldchain_a.en: The temperature of the three cold holds is kept at −25 °C, with cooling supplied by the chillers and the refrigeration plant.

codex:cx_m_coldchain_b.zh: 如果切断电源或损坏制冷系统，冷舱就会逐渐回温。温度超过 −5 °C 后，货物会解冻，价值只剩原来的 45%。
codex:cx_m_coldchain_b.en: If you cut the power or damage the refrigeration system, the cold holds gradually warm up. Once the temperature goes above −5 °C, the cargo thaws and keeps only 45% of its value.

codex:cx_m_coldchain_c.zh: 先在外部面板接通“船坞临时供冷”，然后再切断电源，拆除原有制冷系统。
codex:cx_m_coldchain_c.en: First connect ‘berth temporary cooling’ at the outside panel, then cut the power and remove the original refrigeration system.

codex:cx_m_coldchain_x.zh: 冷冻货物需要始终保持低温；一旦解冻，价值损失无法挽回。制冷剂需要从储液罐的回收口闭环回收。打开舱顶货舱口之前，还要先给舱室放气。
codex:cx_m_coldchain_x.en: Frozen cargo must be kept cold at all times. Once it thaws, the loss of value cannot be recovered. The refrigerant must be recovered in a closed loop at the receiver’s recovery port. Before opening a hold’s roof hatch, also vent the hold first.

codex:cx_m_ice_a.zh: 整座冰山都是需要回收的货物。每块冰含有 0.6 m³ 的水，可以用加热垫逐块融化。
codex:cx_m_ice_a.en: The whole iceberg is cargo to be recovered. Each block contains 0.6 m³ of water and can be melted block by block with the heater pads.

codex:cx_m_ice_b.zh: 如果融水积累到 3 m³ 仍未抽走，而且总线还带电，发动机舱就会发生短路。如果鞍座仍夹住冰体时切割裂纹处，冰体就会裂开。
codex:cx_m_ice_b.en: If 3 m³ of melt water has built up without being drawn off and the bus is still live, the engine room shorts out. If you cut along a crack while the saddles are still clamping the ice, the ice splits.

codex:cx_m_ice_c.zh: 启动加热垫，融化冰块的同时，从水总管接口抽走融水。等剩余冰体不到一半时，再松开鞍座。
codex:cx_m_ice_c.en: Switch on the heater pads, and draw the melt water off at the water header port as the blocks melt. Release the saddles only once less than half of the ice is left.

codex:cx_m_ice_x.zh: 融化 1 kg 的冰需要 334 kJ 的能量。冰的切割速度很慢，因为切口会重新冻结。应变表显示冰体裂纹的扩展程度，初始读数为 90%。
codex:cx_m_ice_x.en: Melting 1 kg of ice takes 334 kJ of energy. Ice cuts very slowly, because the kerf freezes over again. The strain gauge shows how far the crack in the ice has spread, and its initial reading is 90%.

codex:cx_m_drill_torque.zh: 钻杆残余扭矩与泥浆压力

codex:cx_m_drill_torque_a.zh: 八节立根仍然带有残余扭矩，钻杆内部也有受压的泥浆。
codex:cx_m_drill_torque_a.en: The eight stands still hold residual torque, and the inside of the drill pipe holds pressurised mud.

codex:cx_m_drill_torque_b.zh: 钻杆带有扭矩时卸扣，钻杆可能反弹、扭断并甩打钻台；带压卸扣则会使泥浆喷出，污染设备。
codex:cx_m_drill_torque_b.en: If you break out a connection while the pipe is under torque, the pipe may spring back, twist off and whip against the drill floor. If you break it out under pressure, mud sprays out and contaminates the equipment.

codex:cx_m_drill_torque_c.zh: 关闭转盘刹车释放扭矩，等扭矩表读数低于 5%。再打开泄压阀排出可回收的泥浆，最后拆卸钻杆接头。
codex:cx_m_drill_torque_c.en: Release the rotary brake to bleed the torque, until the torque gauge reads below 5%. Then open the relief valve to drain off the recoverable mud, and finally break out the tool joints.

codex:cx_m_drill_torque_x.zh: 扭矩按照时间常数呈指数下降。通过泄压阀排到回收口的泥浆可以作为货物回收。扭矩表和压力表都安装在钻台上。
codex:cx_m_drill_torque_x.en: The torque decays exponentially according to a time constant. The mud drained through the relief valve to the recovery port can be recovered as cargo. The torque gauge and the pressure gauge are both mounted on the drill floor.

codex:cx_m_drill_slips_a.zh: 每节立根下方都有一副卡瓦，用来托住该节立根和下面的整串钻杆。
codex:cx_m_drill_slips_a.en: Under each stand there is a set of slips, which holds that stand and the whole drill string below it.

codex:cx_m_drill_slips_b.zh: 如果先卸下面的钻杆，上面的钻杆会因失去支撑而掉落。如果卡瓦没有安装到位就卸扣，下方整串钻杆会掉进井内。
codex:cx_m_drill_slips_b.en: If you break out a lower stand first, the pipe above loses its support and drops. If you break out a connection while the slips are not properly set, the whole drill string below falls into the hole.

codex:cx_m_drill_slips_c.zh: 从最上面一节开始拆卸。每拆一节之前，都要确认下方的卡瓦已经安装到位，再逐节向下拆卸。
codex:cx_m_drill_slips_c.en: Start with the top stand. Before breaking out each stand, check that the slips below it are set, then work downwards stand by stand.

codex:cx_m_drill_slips_x.zh: 卡瓦由楔形牙块组成，钻杆越重，卡瓦夹得越紧。拆卸期间，必须始终使用卡瓦或吊卡固定钻杆。
codex:cx_m_drill_slips_x.en: Slips are wedge-shaped dies, and the heavier the pipe, the tighter they grip. During the work, the drill string must always be held by the slips or the elevator.

codex:cx_m_tanknet_a.zh: 三个储罐通过交叉阀连接到同一根总管，大型泵通过泵房回收口抽取总管里的液体。
codex:cx_m_tanknet_a.en: Three tanks are connected to one header through crossover valves, and the big pump draws the liquid from the header through the pump room’s recovery port.

codex:cx_m_tanknet_b.zh: 如果提前断电，回收泵就无法运行。液体抽干后继续运行水泵，会因空转而损坏水泵；如果先排掉罐顶气体再抽液，储罐可能被吸瘪。
codex:cx_m_tanknet_b.en: If you cut the power early, the recovery pump cannot run. If the pump keeps running after the liquid has been drawn off, it runs dry and is damaged. If you vent the ullage gas from the tank tops before drawing the liquid, the tank gets sucked flat.

codex:cx_m_tanknet_c.zh: 打开交叉阀，在保持增压的情况下抽完液体并关闭回收口，再关闭增压阀、排出罐顶气体。支管中的残液需要从低点排放口抽走。
codex:cx_m_tanknet_c.en: Open the crossover valves, draw the liquid off while keeping the pressurisation on, and close the recovery port. Then close the pressurisation valve and vent the ullage gas from the tank tops. Draw the residual liquid in the branch lines off at the low-point drains.

codex:cx_m_tanknet_x.zh: 交叉阀打开后，各储罐的液位会通过总管逐渐趋于一致。增压阀打开时，氮气球罐会维持储罐压力，避免抽液时产生真空。有些合同中的交叉阀虽然显示关闭，但实际存在内漏，关闭后相应储罐的液位仍会下降。
codex:cx_m_tanknet_x.en: With the crossover valves open, the liquid levels in the tanks gradually even out through the header. While the pressurisation valve is open, the nitrogen sphere keeps up the tank pressure and prevents a vacuum forming during drawing. In some contracts, a crossover valve reads closed but actually leaks internally, so the level in the corresponding tank keeps falling even with it closed.

codex:cx_m_immersion_a.zh: 十二个机柜分别安装在装有绝缘冷却液的液槽中。
codex:cx_m_immersion_a.en: Twelve racks each stand in a tank of dielectric coolant.

codex:cx_m_immersion_b.zh: 如果液槽中还有冷却液就吊出机柜，液体会洒出，导致同一排的相邻机柜短路。
codex:cx_m_immersion_b.en: If you lift out a rack while its tank still holds coolant, the liquid spills and short-circuits the neighbouring racks in the same row.

codex:cx_m_immersion_c.zh: 先通过每个液槽的接口抽干冷却液，再吊出机柜。
codex:cx_m_immersion_c.en: Draw each tank dry through its port first, then lift out the rack.

codex:cx_m_immersion_x.zh: 冷却液本身价值较高，按回收体积计价。在失重环境中，洒出的液体会形成液团，并漂向相邻机柜。
codex:cx_m_immersion_x.en: The coolant itself is valuable and is paid by recovered volume. In free fall, the spilt liquid forms globules and drifts onto the neighbouring racks.

codex:cx_m_custody_a.zh: 存储阵列中的硬盘属于客户的监管物品，需要装入屏蔽运输箱。
codex:cx_m_custody_a.en: The drives in the storage array are the client’s items held in custody, and must be latched into shielded transport bays.

codex:cx_m_custody_b.zh: 如果没有拨动监管锁扣就拔出硬盘，会被判定为违约并受到罚款。
codex:cx_m_custody_b.en: If you pull a drive without throwing its custody latch, it counts as a breach of contract and you are fined.

codex:cx_m_custody_c.zh: 先拨动每块硬盘的监管锁扣，再将运输箱完整送到设备回收口。
codex:cx_m_custody_c.en: Throw each drive’s custody latch first, then take the transport bays, complete, to the equipment bay.

codex:cx_m_custody_x.zh: 运输箱本身也是合同指定物品。锁好锁扣后，硬盘作为客户封存的财产，按完整物品计价。
codex:cx_m_custody_x.en: The transport bays are themselves items named in the contract. Once latched, the drives are the client’s sealed property and are paid as whole items.

codex:cx_m_waterball_a.zh: 网罩内有几十立方米的水，水中养着鱼。
codex:cx_m_waterball_a.en: The net holds tens of cubic metres of water, with fish living in it.

codex:cx_m_waterball_b.zh: 如果切割或拆除网罩和支架，水球会散开，造成水资源损失，并使舱内电气设备进水。如果总线仍带电，还会发生短路，鱼也会死亡。
codex:cx_m_waterball_b.en: If you cut or remove the net or its frame, the water ball bursts. Water is lost, and the room’s electrical equipment is soaked. If the bus is still live, it also shorts out, and the fish die.

codex:cx_m_waterball_c.zh: 先用泵抽走部分水，直到剩余水量降到安全范围，再拆除网罩。鱼苗箱属于合同指定物品。
codex:cx_m_waterball_c.en: Pump out part of the water first, until the remaining amount is down to the safe range, then remove the net. The fish holding tank is an item named in the contract.

codex:cx_m_waterball_x.zh: 在失重环境中，表面张力使水聚集成球，网罩负责托住水球。30 m³ 水的质量为 30 吨；水球散开后，水团会保持原有速度并向各处漂移。
codex:cx_m_waterball_x.en: In free fall, surface tension pulls the water into a ball, and the net only cradles it. 30 m³ of water has a mass of 30 tonnes. When the ball bursts, the water drifts apart in all directions, keeping its original speed.

codex:cx_m_media_a.zh: 三只储罐分别装有溶剂、酸液和乙二醇。三路管道外观相同，并且在途中交叉。
codex:cx_m_media_a.en: Solvent, acid and glycol are in three separate tanks. The three pipes look identical and cross each other on the way.

codex:cx_m_media_b.zh: 抽取其中一种液体时，如果没有关闭另外两路阀门，三种介质会混合成废液，失去回收价值，还会产生处理费用。
codex:cx_m_media_b.en: If you draw one of the liquids without closing the valves of the other two branches, the three media mix into waste liquid, which has no recovery value and also incurs a disposal fee.

codex:cx_m_media_c.zh: 先在总管各个接口旁的取样点检查介质，再关闭另外两路阀门，最后抽取对应液体。
codex:cx_m_media_c.en: First check each medium at the sampling point beside each header port, then close the valves of the other two branches, and finally draw the corresponding liquid.

codex:cx_m_media_x.zh: 总管 1 号口连接 3 号罐，2 号口连接 1 号罐，3 号口连接 2 号罐；不取样就可能接错。如果支管里仍有液体就拆除总管，各路液体都会泄漏，并按泄漏量罚款。分离器可能有残余压力，需要通过塔上的接口泄压。
codex:cx_m_media_x.en: Header port 1 connects to tank 3, port 2 connects to tank 1, and port 3 connects to tank 2. Without sampling, you may connect the wrong one. If you remove the header while the branch lines still hold liquid, all the liquids leak and you are fined by the leaked volume. The separator may hold residual pressure, which must be relieved at the port on the tower.

codex:cx_m_o2_flash_a.zh: 各个舱室的氧气浓度不同，部分舱室的氧气浓度远高于普通空气中的 21%。
codex:cx_m_o2_flash_a.en: The oxygen concentration differs between rooms, and in some rooms it is far above the 21% of ordinary air.

codex:cx_m_o2_flash_b.zh: 舱室有气压且氧气浓度超过阈值时，在附近使用激光会引发全舱闪燃，烧坏设备并损伤无人机。
codex:cx_m_o2_flash_b.en: When a room has pressure and its oxygen concentration is over the threshold, using the laser nearby causes a flash fire in the whole room, burning the equipment and damaging the drone.

codex:cx_m_o2_flash_c.zh: 先检查各舱室的氧气浓度，分别通过各自的接口放气，再使用激光。
codex:cx_m_o2_flash_c.en: First check the oxygen concentration in each room and vent each room through its own port, then use the laser.

codex:cx_m_o2_flash_x.zh: 氧气浓度从 21% 升至 35% 以上时，可燃物的点燃温度会明显下降，燃烧速度也会成倍提高，织物和塑料更容易被点燃。打开舱门后，两侧舱室的空气会混合。
codex:cx_m_o2_flash_x.en: When oxygen rises from 21% to over 35%, the ignition temperature of combustible materials falls markedly and burning rates increase several times over, so fabrics and plastics ignite more easily. After a door is opened, the air in the rooms on both sides mixes.

codex:cx_m_composite_a.zh: 机身板件由碳纤维复合材料制成，并通过螺栓固定。
codex:cx_m_composite_a.en: The airframe panels are made of carbon-fibre composite and are fixed with bolts.

codex:cx_m_composite_b.zh: 在有气体的舱室附近用激光切割板件，会产生有毒烟雾，使电子设备价值降低、玻璃起雾。
codex:cx_m_composite_b.en: If you cut a panel with the laser near a room that holds air, it produces toxic smoke, which lowers the value of electronics and fogs glass.

codex:cx_m_composite_c.zh: 拧下螺栓，整块拆除板件；也可以先将舱室抽成真空，再进行切割。
codex:cx_m_composite_c.en: Unbolt the panels and remove them whole. Alternatively, vent the room to vacuum first and then cut.

codex:cx_m_composite_x.zh: 环氧树脂基体受激光加热后会发生热解，产生一氧化碳、氰化氢和细碳纤维粉尘。将舱室抽成真空时，烟雾会随空气一同排出。
codex:cx_m_composite_x.en: The epoxy resin matrix pyrolyses when heated by the laser, producing carbon monoxide, hydrogen cyanide and fine carbon-fibre dust. When the room is vented to vacuum, the smoke leaves with the air.

codex:cx_m_radiation_a.zh: 反应堆虽然已经停止运行，但堆芯附近仍然有很强的辐射，距离堆芯 1 米的位置，辐射剂量率还有 3.2 Sv/h。屏蔽板、掩蔽间和液氢罐都可以阻挡辐射，在它们后面会形成相对安全的区域。
codex:cx_m_radiation_a.en: Although the reactor has stopped running, the area near the core still has strong radiation. At 1 metre from the core, the radiation dose rate is still 3.2 Sv/h. The shield, the shelter and the liquid hydrogen tanks can all block radiation, and the area behind them is relatively safe.

codex:cx_m_radiation_b.zh: 无人机受到的累计辐射剂量超过 150 mSv 后，电子设备就会开始出现故障。如果使用激光切割设备直接切到堆芯，还会引发核爆炸。
codex:cx_m_radiation_b.en: Once the drone’s accumulated radiation dose exceeds 150 mSv, its electronics start to fail. If you cut the equipment with the laser straight into the core, it also causes a nuclear explosion.

codex:cx_m_radiation_c.zh: 先用吊车把屏蔽板移动到堆芯前面，利用屏蔽板挡住辐射，再让无人机进入后方区域进行拆卸。操作之前还要锁定控制鼓，最后把整个堆芯从危险品出口运走，不要直接切割堆芯。
codex:cx_m_radiation_c.en: First use the crane to move the shield in front of the core, use it to block the radiation, then let the drone enter the area behind it to work. Before working, also lock the control drums, and finally send the whole core out through the hazard mouth. Do not cut the core directly.

codex:cx_m_radiation_x.zh: 距离堆芯越远，受到的辐射就越少，剂量率会按照距离平方的反比下降。在距离堆芯 7 米的位置，剂量率大约还有 65 mSv/h，停留一分多钟就可能超过安全剂量。游戏里每经过 1 秒，都会按照现实中的 2 分钟计算辐射剂量。\n屏蔽板可以阻挡辐射，只要把屏蔽板放在堆芯和无人机之间，无人机就能利用后面的辐射阴影进行作业。屏蔽板即使还吊在吊车上，也一样能够发挥作用。剂量探头显示的是当前位置的辐射剂量率，可以根据读数判断作业区域是否安全。
codex:cx_m_radiation_x.en: The farther you are from the core, the less radiation you receive, and the dose rate falls with the inverse square of the distance. At 7 metres from the core, the dose rate is still about 65 mSv/h, and staying a little over a minute there may exceed the safe dose. In the game, every 1 second that passes counts as 2 minutes of real time for the radiation dose.\nThe shield can block radiation. As long as you put the shield between the core and the drone, the drone can work in the radiation shadow behind it. The shield works even while it is still hanging from the crane. The dose probe shows the radiation dose rate at its current position, and you can judge from the reading whether the work area is safe.

codex:cx_m_decay_heat_a.zh: 炉芯或堆芯停止运行后，温度仍可能达到几百度，需要依靠冷却回路降温。
codex:cx_m_decay_heat_a.en: After a furnace core or reactor core stops running, its temperature may still reach several hundred degrees, and it must be cooled down by its cooling loop.

codex:cx_m_decay_heat_b.zh: 高温时切断冷却，热冲击可能使炉芯或堆芯开裂。尚未冷却完成时吊出炉芯或收起散热瓣，也可能造成开裂或变形。
codex:cx_m_decay_heat_b.en: If you cut the cooling while it is hot, thermal shock may crack the furnace core or reactor core. Lifting out the core, or folding the radiator petals, before cooling is complete can also cause cracking or deformation.

codex:cx_m_decay_heat_c.zh: 保持冷却泵供电，并确保冷却回路充满冷却液。观察温度，等炉芯或堆芯充分冷却后，再断电并吊出。
codex:cx_m_decay_heat_c.en: Keep the cooling pump powered and make sure the cooling loop is full of coolant. Watch the temperature, and once the furnace core or reactor core has cooled enough, cut the power and lift it out.

codex:cx_m_decay_heat_x.zh: 冷却回路运行时，温度约每秒下降 4 °C。MF-126 炉芯在 350 °C 以上停止冷却会开裂，在 150 °C 以上吊出会开裂；NR-95 堆芯在 60 °C 以上收起散热瓣会变形。
codex:cx_m_decay_heat_x.en: While the cooling loop is running, the temperature falls by about 4 °C per second. The MF-126 furnace core cracks if cooling is stopped above 350 °C, and cracks if lifted out above 150 °C. The NR-95 reactor core deforms if the radiator petals are folded above 60 °C.

codex:cx_m_thermal_a.zh: 飞船刚刚掠过太阳，各区域的隔热瓦和前部壳体温度达到 300–800 °C。
codex:cx_m_thermal_a.en: The ship has just passed close to the sun, and the heat tiles and forward hull in each zone are at 300–800 °C.

codex:cx_m_thermal_b.zh: 在高温区域切割隔热瓦会导致隔热瓦破碎；从高温区域取出的设备可能被高温损坏；无人机进入最热区域也会受到损伤。
codex:cx_m_thermal_b.en: Cutting a heat tile in a hot zone makes the tile shatter. Equipment taken out of a hot zone may be damaged by the heat. The drone is also damaged if it enters the hottest zone.

codex:cx_m_thermal_c.zh: 接通船坞冷却回路，加快降温。使用测温探针检查各区域的温度，冷却后再开始拆除。
codex:cx_m_thermal_c.en: Connect the berth cooling loop to speed up the cooling. Check the temperature of each zone with the temperature probe, and start the removal once it has cooled.

codex:cx_m_thermal_x.zh: 在真空环境中，设备只能通过热辐射散热，各区域会以不同速度自然冷却。冷却回路能够接入的区域降温更快。
codex:cx_m_thermal_x.en: In vacuum, equipment can only lose heat by thermal radiation, and each zone cools naturally at a different rate. Zones that the cooling loop can reach cool faster.

codex:cx_m_bio_a.zh: 隔离舱的压力低于相邻舱室，舱内的生物废物箱、滤芯和废液罐都带有污染物。
codex:cx_m_bio_a.en: The pressure in an isolation room is lower than in the neighbouring rooms, and the biohazard boxes, filters and waste tanks inside it are contaminated.

codex:cx_m_bio_b.zh: 如果切开危险品或在未密封时搬运，污染物会进入舱内空气并随气流扩散。干净舱室受到污染后，设备价值会降低四分之一。
codex:cx_m_bio_b.en: If you cut a hazardous item open, or move it without sealing it, the contaminant gets into the room air and spreads with the airflow. When a clean room is contaminated, the value of its equipment drops by a quarter.

codex:cx_m_bio_c.zh: 先密封每件生物危险品，再通过回收软管的滤芯放气，最后打开舱门。
codex:cx_m_bio_c.en: Seal every biohazard item first, then vent through the filter on the recovery hose, and finally open the doors.

codex:cx_m_bio_x.zh: 负压使空气流向隔离舱，限制污染物向外扩散。如果打开舱门或切开舱壁，负压条件就会消失，气流方向可能反转。回收软管的过滤器可以过滤空气中的污染物。
codex:cx_m_bio_x.en: Negative pressure makes air flow towards the isolation room, which limits contaminants from spreading outwards. If a door is opened or a wall is cut, the negative pressure is lost and the airflow may reverse. The filter on the recovery hose removes contaminants from the air.

codex:cx_m_balance_a.zh: 卷扬机缆绳仍然绷紧，两台外挂吊舱分别安装在舰尾的上方和下方。
codex:cx_m_balance_a.en: The winch cable is still taut, and the two outboard pods are mounted aft, one above and one below the stern.

codex:cx_m_balance_b.zh: 如果没有松开刹车就拆除卷扬轴，卷筒会被甩出。如果只拆除一台吊舱，另一台吊舱的载荷会使船体扭转。
codex:cx_m_balance_b.en: If you remove the winch shaft without releasing the brake, the drum is thrown out. If you remove only one pod, the load of the other pod twists the hull.

codex:cx_m_balance_c.zh: 先拔出刹车销，确认张力表读数归零。拆除吊舱前，在舰尾设置船体支撑，或者同时拆除两台吊舱。
codex:cx_m_balance_c.en: Pull the brake pins first and make sure the tension gauge reads zero. Before removing a pod, set the hull support at the stern, or remove both pods together.

codex:cx_m_balance_x.zh: 对称安装的两个重物可以相互平衡。拆掉其中一个后，船体需要承受另一个重物产生的全部力矩；如果超过承载能力，吊梁和支柱就会扭坏。锁喉夹块受到的力来自卷扬机缆绳，需要处理刹车、锁销和蓄能器。
codex:cx_m_balance_x.en: Two weights mounted symmetrically balance each other. After one is removed, the hull has to carry the whole moment of the other weight, and if that exceeds its capacity, the beams and struts twist and fail. The load on the throat clamp block comes from the winch cable, so the brake, the locking pins and the accumulator all have to be dealt with.

codex:cx_m_sandwich_a.zh: 上下两条船体通过 8 个液压夹钳夹住中间的居住舱。
codex:cx_m_sandwich_a.en: The upper and lower hulls clamp the habitat between them with 8 hydraulic clamps.

codex:cx_m_sandwich_b.zh: 货舱没有放气就松开夹钳，夹钳会弹开。如果一侧比另一侧多松开两个夹钳，货舱会发生扭转，已经开裂的横梁 2 也会断裂。
codex:cx_m_sandwich_b.en: If you release a clamp before the hold is vented, the clamp springs open. If one side has two more clamps released than the other, the hold twists, and the already cracked beam 2 also breaks.

codex:cx_m_sandwich_c.zh: 先给货舱放气，再按以下顺序交叉成对松开夹钳：上1→下4→上4→下1→上2→下3→上3→下2。松开上1和下1后，再拆除横梁 2。
codex:cx_m_sandwich_c.en: Vent the hold first, then release the clamps in crossed pairs in this order: U1→L4→U4→L1→U2→L3→U3→L2. Remove beam 2 after U1 and L1 have been released.

codex:cx_m_sandwich_x.zh: 横梁 2 已经开裂，载荷表读数为 192 kN，其余横梁的读数为 120 kN。如果夹钳仍处于保压状态时整件拆下，钳口会弹开。三套电路相互独立：上部船体使用主电池，下部船体和货舱各有独立电池。
codex:cx_m_sandwich_x.en: Beam 2 is already cracked, and its load cell reads 192 kN, while the other beams read 120 kN. If a clamp is removed whole while it is still holding pressure, its jaw springs open. The three circuits are independent of each other: the upper hull uses the main battery, and the lower hull and the hold each have their own battery.

codex:cx_m_boxbeam_a.zh: 货柜通过四角的扭锁相互连接，整列货柜共同构成船体的承力箱梁。
codex:cx_m_boxbeam_a.en: The containers are connected to each other by twist-locks at the four corners, and each column of containers together forms a load-bearing box beam of the hull.

codex:cx_m_boxbeam_b.zh: 外侧货柜仍在时卸空内侧一列，会使该列结构弯曲。同一列货柜如果从下往上拆，上面的货柜会压下来。切断仍然绷紧的拉杆，拉杆会回弹。
codex:cx_m_boxbeam_b.en: If you empty an inner column while the outer containers are still there, that column buckles. If you remove containers in a column from the bottom up, the ones above come down. If you cut a tie rod that is still tight, the rod whips back.

codex:cx_m_boxbeam_c.zh: 从两端向中间卸货，每列从上往下拆。拆除拉杆前，先松开花篮螺丝，确认拉力计读数为 0；带压货柜需要先抽气。
codex:cx_m_boxbeam_c.en: Unload from both ends towards the middle, and work each column from the top down. Before removing a tie rod, slacken the turnbuckles and check that the tension gauge reads 0. Pump down pressurised containers first.

codex:cx_m_boxbeam_x.zh: 船坞夹具固定着第 4 列。每列的弯曲程度等于外侧仍在位货柜的数量乘以力臂，再除以本列的刚度；刚度由弦杆和在位货柜数量决定。应变片显示本列弯曲程度占极限的百分比。住人箱的压力为 60 kPa，低温箱为 450 kPa。
codex:cx_m_boxbeam_x.en: The berth clamps hold column 4. The bending of each column equals the number of containers still in place outboard of it times the lever arm, divided by the stiffness of the column itself; the stiffness is set by the chords and the number of containers in place. The strain gauges show the bending of the column as a percentage of its limit. Accommodation boxes are at 60 kPa, and cryogenic boxes at 450 kPa.

codex:cx_m_sail_a.zh: 四台绞盘的刹车分别固定四个象限的帆膜和撑索，每根撑索的张力为 12 kN。
codex:cx_m_sail_a.en: Four winch brakes hold the film and stays of the four quadrants in place, and the tension in each stay is 12 kN.

codex:cx_m_sail_b.zh: 帆膜仍然绷紧时切割，会产生向两侧扩展的裂口。切断撑索会使角梁甩向吊舱。如果没有接地就接触帆膜，静电会损伤无人机。
codex:cx_m_sail_b.en: If you cut the film while it is taut, it produces tears that spread to both sides. Cutting a stay makes the corner spar whip towards the gondola. If you touch the film without earthing, static discharge damages the drone.

codex:cx_m_sail_c.zh: 先连接接地线 GND，从右侧检修门洞进入通道，通过舱门旁的 G-G 接口抽气，再打开舱门 HT-G。随后松开绞盘刹车 W，启动收帆电机 F，将四角的帆膜卷起。
codex:cx_m_sail_c.en: First connect the GND earth lead, enter the lane through the service gate on the right, vent through the G-G port beside the hatch, then open hatch HT-G. Then release the winch brakes W and start the furling motors F to roll up the film at the four corners.

codex:cx_m_sail_x.zh: 完整收帆时，先连接左下角的接地线 GND。外框和撑索包围着吊舱，右侧外框留有检修门洞，门洞后方有一条没有帆膜的通道，可以通过这里飞到舱门，避免撞破帆膜。将软管接到舱门旁的 G-G 气口，把舱压抽到 5 kPa 以下，再打开舱门 HT-G。进入后，依次松开 W-NW、W-NE、W-SE、W-SW 四台绞盘的刹车，让四角的帆膜松弛。然后启动 F-NW、F-NE、F-SE、F-SW 四台收帆电机，将四角的帆膜逐块卷上绞盘。最后拆下四个帆卷，送往设备回收口。
codex:cx_m_sail_x.en: To furl the sail whole, first connect the earth lead GND at the bottom left. The frame and stays enclose the gondola. The right-hand frame has a service gate, and behind the gate there is a lane with no film, through which you can fly to the hatch without breaking the film. Connect the hose to the G-G port beside the hatch, pump the gondola pressure down below 5 kPa, then open hatch HT-G. Once inside, release the brakes on the four winches W-NW, W-NE, W-SE and W-SW in turn, so that the film at the four corners goes slack. Then start the four furling motors F-NW, F-NE, F-SE and F-SW, and roll the film at each corner onto its winch piece by piece. Finally, remove the four sail rolls and send them to the equipment mouth.

codex:cx_m_softshell_a.zh: 每个气囊的内部压力为 30 kPa，气囊依靠内压维持形状，并配有张紧器和束缚带。
codex:cx_m_softshell_a.en: The internal pressure of each gasbag is 30 kPa. The gasbags keep their shape by internal pressure and are fitted with tensioners and restraint straps.

codex:cx_m_softshell_b.zh: 气囊充气时直接切割，囊壁会撕裂并坍塌，砸坏附近设备。如果张紧器仍在工作就拆除束缚带，带子会回弹。
codex:cx_m_softshell_b.en: If you cut a gasbag while it is inflated, the wall tears and collapses, smashing nearby equipment. If you remove a strap while the tensioner is still working, the strap whips back.

codex:cx_m_softshell_c.zh: 依次处理每个气囊：先将气压抽到 3 kPa 以下，使气囊折叠；再松开张紧器，拆除束缚带，最后拆下气囊。
codex:cx_m_softshell_c.en: Deal with the gasbags one at a time. First pump the pressure below 3 kPa so that the bag folds, then release the tensioner and remove the restraint straps, and finally remove the bag.

codex:cx_m_softshell_x.zh: 织物壳体只能承受拉力，不能承受压力；泄气后，气囊会失去原来的形状。服务舱电池是独立电源，切断脊柱电池后仍然带电，电容也有单独的放电点。
codex:cx_m_softshell_x.en: A fabric shell can only carry tension, not compression. When it is deflated, the gasbag loses its shape. The service bay battery is an independent supply and is still live after the spine battery is cut off. The capacitor also has its own discharge point.

codex:cx_m_tether_a.zh: 两个吊舱由系绳连接，整体以 2.0 rpm 的速度旋转，张紧器还提供 8 kN 的额外张力。
codex:cx_m_tether_a.en: The two pods are joined by a tether, and the whole assembly rotates at 2.0 rpm. The tensioner adds an extra 8 kN of tension.

codex:cx_m_tether_b.zh: 旋转时切断系绳，两个吊舱会沿切线方向甩出。如果不打开冷却就制动，滚轮在 6 秒后会打滑，导致制动器永久失效。
codex:cx_m_tether_b.en: If you cut the tether while it is rotating, the two pods fly off along the tangent. If you brake without turning on the cooling, the rollers slip after 6 seconds and the brake fails permanently.

codex:cx_m_tether_c.zh: 先启动制动冷却，再进行制动。等吊舱停止旋转后，松开张紧器并拆除系绳。暂时保留推进剂：制动失效时，需要使用 B 舱的姿态控制系统反向喷射。
codex:cx_m_tether_c.en: Start the brake cooling first, then brake. Once the pods have stopped rotating, release the tensioner and remove the tether. Keep the propellant for now: if the brake fails, you have to fire the attitude control system on pod B in reverse.

codex:cx_m_tether_x.zh: 系绳张力 = 40 kN × (rpm/2)² + 张紧器提供的 8 kN。启动冷却时，制动可使转速每秒下降 0.025 rpm。磨损段只剩 5/7 股；即使吊舱已经停止旋转，如果没有松开张紧器就切割，整根系绳仍会崩断。
codex:cx_m_tether_x.en: Tether tension = 40 kN × (rpm/2)² + the 8 kN supplied by the tensioner. With cooling on, the brake can reduce the speed by 0.025 rpm per second. The worn section has only 5 of 7 strands left. Even after the pods have stopped rotating, if you cut it without releasing the tensioner, the whole tether still snaps.

codex:cx_m_train_a.zh: 七节模块通过铰接结构连接成一列，400 V 总线经过每个联轴器向后延伸。其中 K-4 联轴器卡死在弯曲状态。
codex:cx_m_train_a.en: Seven modules are joined by articulated connections into a train, and a 400 V bus runs backwards through every coupling. Coupling K-4 is jammed in a bent position.

codex:cx_m_train_b.zh: 如果切断上游总线，后方模块会失去供电，储罐泵也无法运行。如果 K-4 后方仍连接着 75 t 以上的载荷就拆除 K-4，后半列模块会弹开。
codex:cx_m_train_b.en: If you cut the upstream bus, the modules behind lose power and the tank pumps cannot run. If you remove K-4 while a load of more than 75 t is still attached behind it, the rear half of the train springs apart.

codex:cx_m_train_c.zh: 从尾部开始拆除 M7、M6，最后处理 K-4。如果后段仍需要供电，先打开 M6 的备用电池。
codex:cx_m_train_c.en: Remove M7 and M6 from the tail first, and deal with K-4 last. If the rear section still needs power, turn on M6’s backup battery first.

codex:cx_m_train_x.zh: K-4 上的弯矩计显示后方仍连接的载荷，满载时约为 160 t。如果冷却液软管的阀门仍然打开，切割时会喷出冷却液；应先关闭阀门，再从低点排放口排出残液。
codex:cx_m_train_x.en: The bending gauge on K-4 shows the load still attached behind it, about 160 t when full. If a coolant hose’s valve is still open, coolant sprays out when it is cut. Close the valves first, then drain the residual liquid at the low-point drains.

codex:cx_m_ore_a.zh: 料仓内装有细矿和几十块可见的矿块，矿石通过底部放料门排出。
codex:cx_m_ore_a.en: The hopper holds fine ore and several tens of visible lumps, and the ore is let out through the gates in its floor.

codex:cx_m_ore_b.zh: 料仓内的矿石超过一半时，如果强行撬开或切开放料门，矿石会突然倒向一侧，撕裂料仓焊缝。
codex:cx_m_ore_b.en: When the hopper is more than half full of ore, if you force open or cut open a gate, the ore suddenly dumps to one side and tears the hopper welds.

codex:cx_m_ore_c.zh: 正常打开放料门，让矿石流入长槽，按吨计价。拆除受力部件之前，先释放张力。
codex:cx_m_ore_c.en: Open the gates normally and let the ore run into the trough, paid by the tonne. Before removing load-bearing members, release the tension first.

codex:cx_m_ore_x.zh: 细矿以每秒几吨的流量排出，按矿石种类计价。矿堆下降时，上方矿块会逐渐松开，并随细矿一起流出。
codex:cx_m_ore_x.en: The fines run out at a flow of several tonnes per second and are paid by ore type. As the heap sinks, the lumps above come loose gradually and flow out with the fines.

codex:cx_m_rails_a.zh: 货物通过轨道锁固定在滑轨上，不使用螺栓，因此无法用扳手拆除。
codex:cx_m_rails_a.en: The cargo is held on its rail by rail locks, not bolts, so it cannot be removed with a wrench.

codex:cx_m_rails_b.zh: 货门没有打开时解除轨道锁，货物会撞上货门。如果前面的货物仍然锁定就释放后面的货物，两件货物会相撞。切断支撑货物的轨道也会损坏货物。
codex:cx_m_rails_b.en: If you unlock a piece while the doors are not open, the cargo hits the doors. If you release a piece while the one in front of it is still locked, the two pieces collide. Cutting the rail that carries a piece also damages the cargo.

codex:cx_m_rails_c.zh: 先给货舱放气，再打开货门。货门依靠总线供电，需要在断电之前打开。之后从最前面的货物开始依次解锁，让货物沿轨道移出。
codex:cx_m_rails_c.en: Vent the hold first, then open the cargo doors. The doors run on bus power, so open them before the power is cut. Then unlock the cargo one piece at a time from the front, letting each piece move out along its rail.

codex:cx_m_rails_x.zh: 货物离开轨道末端后会减速至 0.4 m/s，随后缓慢滑出。如果前一件货物尚未运走就释放下一件，两件货物会相撞。SV-122 的仪器安装在减振吊架上；如果还有仪器固定在吊架上就切断主梁或减振连杆，整个吊架会掉落。
codex:cx_m_rails_x.en: After cargo leaves the end of the rail, it slows to 0.4 m/s and then drifts out slowly. If you release the next piece before the previous one has been moved away, the two pieces collide. The SV-122 instruments are mounted on a damped hanger frame. If you cut the main beam or the damping links while instruments are still fixed to the frame, the whole frame drops.

codex:cx_m_rings_a.zh: 两个居住环以约 3 rpm 的速度旋转，通过轮毂上的电机和制动器停止旋转。
codex:cx_m_rings_a.en: Two habitat rings turn at about 3 rpm, and are stopped by the motors and brakes on their hubs.

codex:cx_m_rings_b.zh: 居住环上的负载仍然带电时进行制动，回馈电流会烧坏滑环。如果只制动一个居住环，船体会受到扭转；居住环仍在旋转时锁定轴承，轴承会卡死。
codex:cx_m_rings_b.en: If you brake while the loads on a ring are still live, the regenerated current burns out the slip ring. If you brake only one habitat ring, the hull is twisted. If you lock the bearing while the ring is still turning, the bearing seizes.

codex:cx_m_rings_c.zh: 先断开居住环上的负载，再启动制动冷却，并同时制动两个居住环。电容充满后需要放电；等居住环停止旋转，再锁定轴承并打开过渡气闸。
codex:cx_m_rings_c.en: Disconnect the loads on the ring first, then start the brake cooling and brake both habitat rings at the same time. Discharge the capacitor when it is full. Once the rings have stopped turning, lock the bearings and open the transfer airlocks.

codex:cx_m_rings_x.zh: 制动时，居住环的动能会转化为电能并存入电容。电容充满后，制动器会停止工作，需要先放电才能继续制动。如果两个居住环的转速差过大并持续过久，船坞夹具会过载。将环上的门朝压力低得多的一侧打开，气流冲击会打碎玻璃。
codex:cx_m_rings_x.en: During braking, the ring’s kinetic energy is converted into electrical energy and stored in a capacitor. When the capacitor is full, the brake stops working and the capacitor must be discharged before braking can continue. If the speed difference between the two habitat rings is too large for too long, the berth clamps are overloaded. If a door on a ring is opened onto a side at much lower pressure, the rush of air breaks the glass.

codex:cx_m_rings_w.zh: 【占位：侧挂转轮的盘车对位、锁销、泄放脉冲与反扭倒计时，按火星重力设计的说明】
codex:cx_m_rings_w.en: [PLACEHOLDER: the side-hung wheels: inching to the pin, the lock pin, the dump pulse, the twist countdown, built for Mars gravity]

codex:cx_m_spine_a.zh: 尾部的反应堆、发动机和推进剂安装在 440 m 长的主轴上，弦杆负责传递载荷。
codex:cx_m_spine_a.en: The reactor, engines and propellant at the tail are mounted on the 440 m long spine, and the chords carry the load.

codex:cx_m_spine_b.zh: 切断一根弦杆后，其余弦杆需要共同承担尾部的全部载荷。如果某一段的载荷超过承受能力，该段结构会撕裂，尾部会下坠并扭转。
codex:cx_m_spine_b.en: After one chord is cut, the remaining chords have to carry the whole load of the tail together. If the load on any segment exceeds what it can bear, that segment tears, and the tail sags and twists.

codex:cx_m_spine_c.zh: 先拆除尾部的重物，最后切割弦杆。
codex:cx_m_spine_c.en: Remove the heavy items from the tail first, and cut the chords last.

codex:cx_m_spine_x.zh: 主轴每一段都要承受其后方仍在船上的全部重量，并由该段仍然完整的弦杆共同分担。应变探头显示各段的受力情况。
codex:cx_m_spine_x.en: Each segment of the spine carries the whole weight still aboard behind it, shared by the chords of that segment that are still intact. The strain probes show the load on each segment.

codex:cx_m_workday_a.zh: 这艘船体积较大，无法在一个工作日内拆解完成。
codex:cx_m_workday_a.en: This ship is too big to be taken apart in one working day.

codex:cx_m_workday_b.zh: 作业每增加一天，合同就会增加一天的运营成本。
codex:cx_m_workday_b.en: Each extra day of work adds one day of running cost to the contract.

codex:cx_m_workday_c.zh: 提前规划拆解顺序，减少不必要的操作。收工时游戏会自动保存，第二天可以继续作业。
codex:cx_m_workday_c.en: Plan the order of the dismantling in advance and cut down unnecessary operations. The game saves automatically at the end of the day, and you can continue the work the next day.

codex:cx_m_workday_x.zh: 工作日按照合同的游戏时间计算。收工时会保存完整的物理状态，下一天从原来的位置继续作业。
codex:cx_m_workday_x.en: Working days are counted from the contract’s play time. At the end of the day, the complete physical state is saved, and the next day continues from where the work stopped.

codex:cx_m_mirror_dust_a.zh: 主镜的镜片非常昂贵，而且很容易损坏，镜面前方安装了一套可以升降的电动防尘罩。
codex:cx_m_mirror_dust_a.en: The primary mirror segments are very expensive and easily damaged. A motorised dust cover that can be raised and lowered sits in front of the mirror.

codex:cx_m_mirror_dust_b.zh: 如果在镜面附近进行切割，产生的金属粉尘就会落到镜片上，每次切割都会让镜片损失一部分回收价值。
codex:cx_m_mirror_dust_b.en: Cutting near the mirror sends metal dust onto the segments, and every cut costs the mirror part of its recovery value.

codex:cx_m_mirror_dust_c.zh: 切割附近的设备之前，先确认防尘罩的电机还有电，然后把防尘罩完全放下来，遮住镜面以后再开始切割。
codex:cx_m_mirror_dust_c.en: Before cutting nearby equipment, check that the dust cover's motor still has power, lower the cover all the way over the mirror, then start cutting.

codex:cx_m_mirror_dust_x.zh: 防尘罩通过电机控制升降，断电以后就无法放下。如果连同卷轴一起拆除，防尘罩也会被拆走。镜片受到的粉尘污染达到上限后，继续切割就不会再造成额外的价值损失。
codex:cx_m_mirror_dust_x.en: The cover is raised and lowered by its motor, so it cannot come down without power. Remove it together with its roller and the cover goes with it. Once the dust on the mirror reaches its limit, further cutting costs no more value.

codex:cx_m_mirror_lock.en: Locking the segments and the removal order

codex:cx_m_mirror_lock_a.zh: 每一圈镜片的促动器都有独立的锁定开关，需要通过镜面控制柜进行操作，而且控制柜必须保持通电才能完成锁定。
codex:cx_m_mirror_lock_a.en: Each ring of segments has its own actuator lock switch, worked from the mirror control cabinet, and the cabinet must stay powered for the lock to engage.

codex:cx_m_mirror_lock_b.zh: 如果没有锁定促动器就直接拆除镜片，镜片可能从镜座中掉落并摔碎。如果外圈还有镜片就开始拆除内圈，外圈镜片的边缘也会受到损坏。
codex:cx_m_mirror_lock_b.en: Remove a segment with its actuators unlocked and it can fall out of its mount and shatter. Start on an inner ring while the outer ring is still in place and the outer segments' edges are damaged too.

codex:cx_m_mirror_lock_c.zh: 切断控制柜电源之前，先把所有促动器全部锁定，然后按照从外圈到内圈的顺序，逐圈拆除镜片。
codex:cx_m_mirror_lock_c.en: Before cutting the cabinet's power, lock every actuator, then remove the segments ring by ring from the outside in.

codex:cx_m_mirror_lock_x.zh: 外圈镜片的内侧边缘搭在内圈镜片上，需要依靠内圈镜片提供支撑，所以拆除时必须先处理外圈。促动器也需要在控制柜通电时完成锁定，断电以后就无法继续操作。
codex:cx_m_mirror_lock_x.en: The inner edge of each outer segment rests on the inner ring, which supports it, so the outer ring must come out first. The actuators can only be locked while the cabinet is powered; once the power is off, nothing more can be done.

codex:cx_m_glass_a.zh: 观景玻璃、穹顶玻璃和精密设备的玻璃罩板，通常靠周围的压条和螺栓固定。只要舱内还有压力，这些玻璃就一直承受着内部气压产生的推力。
codex:cx_m_glass_a.en: Viewing windows, dome glass and the glass covers of precision equipment are usually held by the clamping strips and bolts around them. While the room holds pressure, the glass carries the push of the air inside.

codex:cx_m_glass_b.zh: 如果舱内还没有泄压就拆卸玻璃，松开固定螺栓后，玻璃可能会被内部气压直接推出去摔碎。在距离玻璃 0.7 米以内使用激光切割，也可能因为局部温度过高导致玻璃开裂。
codex:cx_m_glass_b.en: Take the glass out before the room is vented and, once the bolts are loose, the air pressure can push it straight out to shatter. Laser cutting within 0.7 m of the glass can also crack it by overheating it locally.

codex:cx_m_glass_c.zh: 拆卸之前先把舱内压力降到安全范围，使用激光切割时也要与玻璃保持足够的距离。确认安全后，再拆下固定压条和螺栓，把整块玻璃完整取出来。
codex:cx_m_glass_c.en: Before removal, bring the room's pressure down to a safe level, and keep the laser well away from the glass. Once it is safe, remove the clamping strips and bolts and take the pane out whole.

codex:cx_m_glass_x.zh: 一块面积为 2 平方米的观景玻璃，如果两侧存在 100 kPa 的压差，就要承受相当于约 20 吨重量的推力。一旦松开固定压条和螺栓，玻璃就可能被这股压力推出去。PS-12 的中央竖井还有一个需要注意的地方，如果上下两层的舱门同时打开，两层空间就会连通。这时候只要对其中一层进行泄压，另一层的空气也会一起排出去，所以拆卸之前一定要检查两层舱门的状态。
codex:cx_m_glass_x.en: A 2 m² viewing window with 100 kPa across it carries a push equal to about 20 tonnes. Loosen its strips and bolts and that pressure can push the glass out. PS-12's central shaft needs extra care: with the hatches on both levels open, the two levels are one space, and venting either one vents the other too, so check both hatches before removal.

codex:cx_m_vault_a.zh: 库门的电磁锁有两路供电，一路连接主电力总线，另一路连接舰尾检修柜里的备用电源。
codex:cx_m_vault_a.en: The vault door's solenoid lock has two supplies: one from the main bus, the other from the backup supply in the aft service cabinet.

codex:cx_m_vault_b.zh: 就算关闭了外部主开关，测量点显示电压为零，库门的电磁锁和主电力总线也可能仍然带电，因为备用电源会通过电磁铁向总线反向供电。
codex:cx_m_vault_b.en: Even with the main switch outside off and the test point reading zero, the lock and the main bus can still be live, because the backup supply feeds back into the bus through the solenoid.

codex:cx_m_vault_c.zh: 先进入舰尾检修柜，关闭门锁的备用电源。确认两路电源都断开后，再扳动释放杆，等货库完成泄压以后才能打开库门。
codex:cx_m_vault_c.en: Go into the aft service cabinet and switch off the lock's backup supply. Once both supplies are confirmed off, pull the release lever, and open the door only after the vault has been vented.

codex:cx_m_vault_x.zh: 只要电磁锁还在通电，库门就会保持锁定状态，释放杆也无法扳动。等两路电源全部断开以后，就可以扳动释放杆解除锁定，之后打开库门不需要再供电。库门打开以后，里面的保管箱可以整件运走。
codex:cx_m_vault_x.en: While the solenoid is powered the door stays locked and the release lever will not move. With both supplies off, the lever releases the lock, and the door then opens without power. Once it is open, the safe-deposit boxes inside can be taken out whole.

codex:cx_m_nested_a.zh: 货舱里面还装着一艘完整的小型飞船，按照合同要求，你需要把它整艘取出来，不能拆成零件。
codex:cx_m_nested_a.en: The hold contains a complete small spacecraft. The contract requires you to take it out whole, not in parts.

codex:cx_m_nested_b.zh: 只要切割或者拆除了小船的任何一块外壳，就会失去整船回收的资格，最后只能按照零件价格结算。如果先松开船首一侧的托架锁，小船还可能失去固定，直接撞上前面的舱门。
codex:cx_m_nested_b.en: Cut or remove any panel of its hull and it no longer counts as a whole ship; it is settled at parts prices. Release the cradle lock at the bow end first and the small ship can come loose and hit the door in front of it.

codex:cx_m_nested_c.zh: 先处理好小船内部的电池、燃料和舱压，确认安全以后，从船尾开始逐个松开托架锁，一直处理到船首。等所有固定装置都解除后，再打开船首舱门，使用绞车把小船完整拖出来。
codex:cx_m_nested_c.en: First deal with the small ship's batteries, fuel and cabin pressure. Once it is safe, release the cradle locks one by one from the stern to the bow. With every fixing released, open the bow door and winch the ship out whole.

codex:cx_m_nested_x.zh: 合同会按照整艘飞船的完整程度计算回收价格，只要外壳和主要结构没有被拆除，就能获得整船回收的额外溢价，价值大约是拆成零件出售的 7 倍。拖运的时候也要注意，小船如果撞到舱门，可能会损坏内部设备，整船回收的额外溢价也会被扣掉一部分。
codex:cx_m_nested_x.en: The contract prices the craft by how complete it is. As long as its hull and main structure are intact, it earns the whole-ship premium, about 7 times what its parts would fetch. Take care while towing too: if the small ship hits the door, its equipment can be damaged and part of the premium is deducted.

codex:cx_s_ullage_a.zh: 推进剂储罐的顶部有一层高压气体，也叫增压气。它会对罐内的液体施加压力，让推进剂能够从出口正常排出。
codex:cx_s_ullage_a.en: The top of a propellant tank holds a layer of high-pressure gas, the pressurant. It presses on the liquid so the propellant can flow out of the outlet.

codex:cx_s_ullage_b.zh: 如果储罐还带着压力就直接切开，高压气体会把里面的推进剂一起喷出来。如果把整个储罐切断，里面的推进剂可能在几秒钟内全部喷出。完成泄压以后，即使储罐出现破口，剩余的液体也只会缓慢渗出。
codex:cx_s_ullage_b.en: Cut a tank while it is still under pressure and the gas blows the propellant out with it. Sever the whole tank and the propellant can all spray out in seconds. Once the tank is vented, liquid only seeps slowly from a hole.

codex:cx_s_ullage_c.zh: 拆解之前，先关闭增压气体的供应，再通过排气口释放罐内的高压气体。确认储罐完成泄压以后，才能开始抽取推进剂，最后再拆除储罐。
codex:cx_s_ullage_c.en: Before taking it apart, shut off the pressurant supply, then release the gas through the vent. Only when the tank is confirmed vented, draw off the propellant, and remove the tank last.

codex:cx_s_ullage_x.zh: 增压系统会不断向储罐补充高压气体，所以只打开排气口还不够，只要增压系统没有关闭，罐内压力就很难降下来。正确的处理顺序是先关闭增压气源，再排出罐内的高压气体。完成泄压以后，储罐内部主要剩下推进剂自身的蒸气压，即使切开储罐，液体通常也只会从破口缓慢渗出，不会再因为增压气体的压力而大量喷射。
codex:cx_s_ullage_x.en: The pressurisation system keeps feeding gas into the tank, so opening the vent alone is not enough: while the system is on, the tank pressure barely falls. The right order is to shut off the pressurant first, then vent the gas in the tank. Once vented, mostly the propellant's own vapour pressure is left, so even if the tank is cut, the liquid usually seeps slowly from the hole instead of being driven out in a jet.

codex:cx_m_hypergolic_a.zh: 甲基肼储存在 T-1 和 T-3 罐中，四氧化二氮单独储存在 T-2 罐中。T-2 没有连接燃料总管，需要单独处理。
codex:cx_m_hypergolic_a.en: Monomethylhydrazine is stored in tanks T-1 and T-3, and nitrogen tetroxide on its own in T-2. T-2 is not connected to the fuel manifold and has to be handled separately.

codex:cx_m_hypergolic_b.zh: 这两种推进剂只要接触就会起火，不需要点火，在真空环境中也可能发生爆炸。爆燃造成的伤害范围按照 TNT 当量计算。
codex:cx_m_hypergolic_b.en: These two propellants catch fire as soon as they touch, with no ignition needed, and can explode even in vacuum. The blast's damage radius is worked out in TNT equivalent.

codex:cx_m_hypergolic_c.zh: 通过专用排放口 LD-2 单独抽空 T-2 罐，拆解时注意分开处理两种推进剂，千万不要同时切开它们的储罐或管线。
codex:cx_m_hypergolic_c.en: Empty T-2 on its own through its dedicated drain LD-2. Keep the two propellants apart while dismantling, and never cut their tanks or lines at the same time.

codex:cx_m_hypergolic_x.zh: 自燃推进剂不需要额外安装点火器，发动机即使反复启动几百次，也能保持较高的可靠性，所以经常用在航天器的姿态控制和轨道调整上。不过这两种推进剂都有很强的毒性和腐蚀性，一旦发生泄漏，蒸气混合后就可能直接起火。拆解的时候必须把两种推进剂分开排放，等一种处理完成后，再处理另一种，避免发生意外。
codex:cx_m_hypergolic_x.en: Hypergolic propellants need no igniter, so an engine stays reliable even after hundreds of restarts; that is why they are common in attitude control and orbit adjustment. But both are highly toxic and corrosive, and if they leak, their mixing vapours can catch fire at once. When dismantling, drain the two separately: finish one before starting the other.

codex:cx_s_contents_a.zh: 灭火瓶、气瓶和储罐里面通常都装着东西，使用测量工具扫描以后，就能在检测结果中看到新增的「内容物」信息。
codex:cx_s_contents_a.en: Extinguisher bottles, gas cylinders and tanks usually hold something. Scan one with the measuring tool and a new ‘CONTENTS’ line appears in the reading.

codex:cx_s_contents_b.zh: 气体容器的接口标记为「编号-V」，液体容器的接口标记为「编号-D」。装有液体的储罐通常比较重，如果里面的液体还没有排出，可能会因为重量太大而无法搬动。
codex:cx_s_contents_b.en: Gas containers' ports are marked ‘ID-V’ and liquid containers' ports ‘ID-D’. A tank holding liquid is usually heavy, and until it is drained it may be too heavy to move.

codex:cx_s_contents_c.zh: 处理容器之前，先使用测量工具检查里面装的是什么，以及当前的压力有多高。确认情况以后，再决定是排放气体、抽出液体，还是直接把整个容器运走。
codex:cx_s_contents_c.en: Before dealing with a container, check with the measuring tool what is inside and how high the pressure is. Then decide whether to vent the gas, draw off the liquid, or take the whole container away.

codex:cx_s_contents_x.zh: 灭火瓶里通常装有压力约为 5.7 MPa 的二氧化碳，氧气瓶里的氧气压力则可以达到 15 MPa。其他容器还可能装有氮气、压缩空气、氦气或氢气，部分设备还带有蓄能器。液体储罐里可能装着水、泥浆、泡沫液、润滑油或者服务推进剂。即使两个容器的外形完全一样，里面装的东西也可能不同，直接切开以后造成的后果自然也不一样。
codex:cx_s_contents_x.en: An extinguisher bottle usually holds carbon dioxide at about 5.7 MPa, and an oxygen cylinder can hold oxygen at up to 15 MPa. Other containers may hold nitrogen, compressed air, helium or hydrogen, and some equipment carries accumulators. Liquid tanks may hold water, mud, foam concentrate, lubricating oil or service propellant. Two containers that look exactly alike can hold different things, and cutting them open has different consequences.

codex:cx_s_o2_rich_a.zh: 舱内的氧气浓度超过了正常空气中的 21%，可能是氧气瓶破损造成了泄漏，也可能是舱室本身就处于富氧状态。
codex:cx_s_o2_rich_a.en: The oxygen in the room is above the 21% of normal air. A broken oxygen cylinder may have leaked, or the room may be oxygen-rich by design.

codex:cx_s_o2_rich_b.zh: 氧气浓度越高，周围的材料就越容易被点燃，起火以后也会燃烧得更快。激光切割产生的高温和火花都可能引起火灾，舱内如果还有氢气，危险就更大了。
codex:cx_s_o2_rich_b.en: The more oxygen, the more easily things around catch fire, and the faster they burn once alight. The heat and sparks of laser cutting can start a fire, and if there is hydrogen in the room too, the danger is greater.

codex:cx_s_o2_rich_c.zh: 使用激光切割前，先检测舱内的氧气浓度。如果浓度超标，就先排空舱内气体，处理完成以后再开始切割。
codex:cx_s_o2_rich_c.en: Before laser cutting, measure the oxygen in the room. If it is too high, vent the room first, then start cutting.

codex:cx_s_o2_rich_x.zh: 正常空气中的氮气能够稀释氧气，还能吸收燃烧时产生的一部分热量。当氧气浓度超过 30% 时，布料、塑料和润滑油的燃烧速度可能会增加好几倍。在纯氧环境下，就连钢丝都有可能被点燃。
codex:cx_s_o2_rich_x.en: The nitrogen in normal air dilutes the oxygen and absorbs part of the heat of burning. Above 30% oxygen, cloth, plastics and lubricating oil can burn several times faster. In pure oxygen, even steel wire can be set alight.

demo:error_text:1.zh: 这个激活码已经在另一台电脑上用过了。
demo:error_text:1.en: This code has already been used on another computer.

demo:error_text:2.zh: 没有这个激活码，请检查输入。
demo:error_text:2.en: There is no such code. Please check it.

demo:error_text:4.en: The public test is over. Thank you!

demo:error_text:5.zh: 激活码格式不对，应该是 ZP-XXXX-XXXX。
demo:error_text:5.en: That isn't a code: it looks like ZP-XXXX-XXXX.

demo:error_text:6.zh: 连不上服务器。公测版需要联网，请检查网络后再试。
demo:error_text:6.en: Can't reach the server. The public test needs the internet: check the connection and try again.

demo:error_text:7.zh: 出了点问题（%s），请稍后再试。
demo:error_text:7.en: Something went wrong (%s). Please try again.

demo_end:_ready:1.zh: 试玩到这里就结束了，谢谢你！
demo_end:_ready:1.en: That's the end of the playtest. Thank you!

demo_end:_ready:2.zh: 最后三个问题，答完就好（可以简短）：
demo_end:_ready:2.en: Three last questions (short answers are fine):

demo_end:_ready:3.en: 1. Which moment did you like most?

demo_end:_ready:4.zh: 2. 哪一刻最困惑、不知道该做什么？
demo_end:_ready:4.en: 2. When were you most lost or unsure what to do?

demo_end:_ready:5.en: 3. How would you score this playtest (1–10)?

demo_end:_ready:6.zh: 试玩记录（卡住的地方和截图）要上传给开发者吗？
demo_end:_ready:6.en: Send the playtest record (where you got stuck, with screenshots) to the developer?

demo_end:_ready:8.zh: 不上传，打开记录文件夹

demo_end:_upload:2.zh: 上传好了，谢谢！3 秒后退出。
demo_end:_upload:2.en: Uploaded. Thank you! Quitting in 3 seconds.

demo_end:_upload:3.zh: 上传没成功。记录在打开的文件夹里，可以打包发给开发者。
demo_end:_upload:3.en: The upload failed. The record is in the folder that opened; zip it and send it over.

demo_end:_keep:1.zh: 记录在打开的文件夹里，打包发给开发者就好。谢谢！
demo_end:_keep:1.en: The record is in the folder that opened: zip it and send it over. Thank you!

demo_feedback:_ready:2.zh: 遇到了什么？卡住、出错、想法都可以写。会自动附上打开菜单前的画面截图和运行日志。
demo_feedback:_ready:2.en: What happened? Stuck, broken, an idea: anything. A picture of the moment before the menu and the log go with it.

demo_feedback:_ready:3.en: Write here… (Shift+Enter for a new line)

demo_feedback:send:3.zh: 已发送，谢谢！按 Enter 或 Esc 回到菜单。
demo_feedback:send:3.en: Sent. Thank you! Enter or Esc goes back.

demo_feedback:send:6.zh: 发得太快了，每分钟最多 3 条
demo_feedback:send:6.en: too fast: 3 a minute at most

demo_feedback:send:7.zh: 没发出去（%s）。已经存在本机，下次启动游戏会自动补发。
demo_feedback:send:7.en: Not sent (%s). It's kept on this computer and goes up on the next start.

demo_gate:_ready:4.zh: 这台电脑的试玩已经结束，谢谢你！
demo_gate:_ready:4.en: This computer's playtest is over. Thank you!

demo_gate:_draw:1.zh: 零压拆船厂 · 公测版

demo_gate:_draw:3.zh: 有问题随时按 Esc，在菜单里点“反馈”告诉我们。
demo_gate:_draw:3.en: Anything wrong? Press Esc and pick Feedback at any time.

demo_gate:_draw:4.zh: 请输入你拿到的激活码。一个码只能在一台电脑上用。
demo_gate:_draw:4.en: Enter the code you were given. A code works on one computer only.

demo_gate:_draw:5.zh: 这个试玩版会在你自己的电脑上记录你卡住、出事故的地方并截图；
demo_gate:_draw:5.en: This build records, on your own computer, where you get stuck or have accidents, with screenshots;

demo_gate:_draw:6.zh: 结束时会问你要不要上传，不同意就只留在本机。设置里可以关掉记录。
demo_gate:_draw:6.en: at the end it asks whether to upload them; say no and they stay here. The settings can turn it off.

drone_skins:lcore:1.zh: 原版机体。箭头底盘托着旋转环核，翼尖双主推，口器式双爪。
drone_skins:lcore:1.en: The stock airframe: an arrow chassis round a turning ring core, twin mains at the wing tips, mandible claws.

drone_skins:lcore:2.zh: 重型工业拖曳。方厚装甲箱体、黄黑警示推杆、液压臂配三指重爪，双方灯照得宽。
drone_skins:lcore:2.en: Heavy tow rig: an armoured box with a striped push bumper, hydraulic arms with three-finger grabs, twin floodlamps.

drone_skins:lcore:3.zh: 轻量竞速。针形机身、后掠翼，尾部单大主推带激波环，铅笔光束照得远。
drone_skins:lcore:3.en: Light racer: a needle fuselage and swept wings, one big main with shock diamonds, a pencil beam that reaches far.

drone_skins:lcore:4.zh: 军用退役改装。多面机身涂装磨掉、炮管锯断封口，矢量喷口和反推门，红色缝隙面罩灯。
drone_skins:lcore:4.en: Ex-military refit: a faceted airframe sanded bare, the gun cut and capped, vectoring nozzles and reverser doors, a red slit visor.

drone_skins:lcore:5.zh: 科研探测。仪器圆盘带扫描环，前置抛物面天线兼环形灯，离子主推、冷气微推，伸缩采样臂。
drone_skins:lcore:5.en: Survey craft: an instrument disc with a scan ring, a dish with a ring lamp, ion mains and cold-gas puffers, telescoping arms.

drone_skins:lcore:6.zh: 老式手工拼装。拼接板、铆钉、胶带和外露管线，两台不一样大的发动机会咳嗽，老车灯，一边吊钩一边钳子。
drone_skins:lcore:6.en: Home-built: riveted patches, tape and bare pipes, two mismatched engines that cough, an old car headlamp, a hook and a pair of pliers.

freight_view:_items:4.zh: 机车加两节滚道平板车：在各区走廊里装卸，到中央环停在舱口旁，车厢滚道把货箱推进舱口，机械臂送上转盘；反过来把舱口降下的货接上车。
freight_view:_items:4.en: A locomotive and two roller-bed wagons: they load in the districts' corridors, stand by the ring's hatches and roll crates onto the lifts for the arms, and take the ones handed down.

freight_view:_items:5.zh: 自动调度，载人接驳车优先；拉的是仓库里真实的入库、出售和炼钢的货。
freight_view:_items:5.en: Runs itself, the shuttle first; it carries what really moves in the warehouse.
