guide_cards:顶层:2.en: The port's power comes from here.

guide_cards:顶层:3.zh: 电力不足时，炉子、吊车、叉车都按功率百分比干活。
guide_cards:顶层:3.en: Underpowered, the furnace, cranes and forklifts work at that per cent.

guide_cards:顶层:4.zh: 修好发电机，或者先买块电池顶着。
guide_cards:顶层:4.en: Mend the sets, or buy a battery block meanwhile.

guide_cards:顶层:7.zh: 没修好以前，东西只能卖给回收站，打六折。
guide_cards:顶层:7.en: Until it is mended, goods go to the recycler at sixty per cent.

guide_cards:顶层:8.en: Mend it and sell at market.

guide_cards:顶层:10.zh: 钢锭在这儿炼成钢坯，再轧成钢板。
guide_cards:顶层:10.en: Ingots become billets here, billets become plate.

guide_cards:顶层:11.en: Worked steel pays more than raw.

guide_cards:顶层:12.zh: 先去最左边的炉台，排一炉。
guide_cards:顶层:12.en: Go to the furnace desk at the far left and queue a heat.

guide_cards:顶层:14.zh: 拆回来的东西都放这儿。
guide_cards:顶层:14.en: Everything you salvage is kept here.

guide_cards:顶层:15.zh: 格子满了，下一艘就拆不了。
guide_cards:顶层:15.en: When the cells are full, the next ship cannot be taken.

guide_cards:顶层:16.zh: 到两边货架口按 E 看库存。
guide_cards:顶层:16.en: Press E at a rack mouth to see the stock.

guide_cards:顶层:18.zh: 拖船从这儿出去，把船拖回来。
guide_cards:顶层:18.en: Tugs leave from here and bring hulks home.

guide_cards:顶层:19.zh: 租的拖船只拖得动 44 米以下的。
guide_cards:顶层:19.en: A rented tug tows nothing over 44 m.

guide_cards:顶层:20.en: Mend it and tow the big ones yourself.

guide_cards:顶层:23.zh: 坐接驳车，去哪个区都是 10 秒左右。
guide_cards:顶层:23.en: The shuttle takes you to any district in about 10 s.

guide_cards:顶层:24.zh: 最后要让它重新转起来。
guide_cards:顶层:24.en: In the end it has to turn again.

guide_cards:顶层:26.zh: 【占位：先断负载、开冷却，两轮按配比一起刹】
guide_cards:顶层:26.en: [PLACEHOLDER: loads off, cooling on, brake both wheels together]

guide_cards:顶层:27.zh: 【占位：电容满了按一下泄放，泄放时刹车松开】
guide_cards:顶层:27.en: [PLACEHOLDER: dump the capacitor when full; the brakes let go meanwhile]

guide_cards:顶层:28.zh: 【占位：停住后盘车对准锁销孔，再插锁销】
guide_cards:顶层:28.en: [PLACEHOLDER: stopped, inch it to the pin hole, then the pin]

guide_cards:顶层:30.zh: 【占位：这艘船不能先断电，储存阱只靠主电】
guide_cards:顶层:30.en: [PLACEHOLDER: not the power first here: the trap runs on the main bus only]

guide_cards:顶层:31.zh: 【占位：先给储存阱接便携约束电源，读数变成双路供电】
guide_cards:顶层:31.en: [PLACEHOLDER: the portable supply on the trap first, till it reads dual supply]

guide_cards:顶层:32.zh: 【占位：再断主电，吊车整件送反物质回收架】
guide_cards:顶层:32.en: [PLACEHOLDER: then the bus off, and crane it whole to the antimatter cradle]

guide_cards:顶层:34.zh: 先断电，再泄压，最后动刀。
guide_cards:顶层:34.en: Power off, then vent, then cut.

guide_cards:顶层:35.zh: 左上角一条一条告诉你下一步。
guide_cards:顶层:35.en: The top left tells you each next step.

guide_cards:顶层:36.en: Breaking things costs money. Slow is fine.

guide_cards:顶层:38.zh: 整件拆下来的比碎料值钱。
guide_cards:顶层:38.en: A machine taken off whole is worth more than scrap.

guide_cards:顶层:39.zh: 送设备回收口，按设备价算。
guide_cards:顶层:39.en: The equipment mouth pays the machine's price.

guide_cards:顶层:40.zh: 结算时留着修港，或者直接卖。
guide_cards:顶层:40.en: At settlement keep it for mending, or sell it.

guide_cards:顶层:43.en: The next ship may not fit.

guide_cards:顶层:44.zh: 卖掉一些，或者修货运区扩仓。
guide_cards:顶层:44.en: Sell some, or mend the cargo district for more room.

guide_cards:顶层:47.zh: 有人买就成交，钱当场到账。
guide_cards:顶层:47.en: When someone buys, the cash is in at once.

guide_cards:顶层:48.zh: 价挂太高没人买，看旁边的市价。
guide_cards:顶层:48.en: Asked too high, nobody buys. Watch the market price beside it.

guide_cards:顶层:50.zh: 发电机顶不住，全港功率只有 {n}%。
guide_cards:顶层:50.en: The sets cannot keep up: the port has {n}% of its power.

guide_cards:顶层:51.zh: 去动力区，买块电池，或者修发电机。
guide_cards:顶层:51.en: Go to the power district: buy a battery, or mend the sets.

guide_cards:顶层:54.zh: 过期这单就没了，长期合同还扣信誉。
guide_cards:顶层:54.en: Lapsed, it is gone; a standing contract also costs reputation.

guide_cards:顶层:55.zh: 仓库有货就去交，没货就排一炉。
guide_cards:顶层:55.en: Deliver from stock, or queue a heat.

guide_cards:顶层:57.zh: 下一炉要的模具不一样，吊车在换。
guide_cards:顶层:57.en: The next heat wants another mould; the crane is changing it.

guide_cards:顶层:58.en: Each change stops the furnace about ten seconds.

guide_cards:顶层:59.zh: 同一种排在一起炼，少换几次。
guide_cards:顶层:59.en: Queue the same mould together and change less.

guide_cards:顶层:61.zh: 超载太久，发电机烧热停了。
guide_cards:顶层:61.en: Overloaded too long, the set overheated and stopped.

guide_cards:顶层:62.en: It will not come back by itself.

guide_cards:顶层:63.zh: 飞过去，拿维护工具（4）修一下。
guide_cards:顶层:63.en: Fly there and use the maintenance tool (4) on it.

guide_cards:顶层:65.zh: 接驳车开着相位层，和货运列车不在同一个相位里。
guide_cards:顶层:65.en: The shuttle runs phase-shifted: it is not in the freight trains' phase.

guide_cards:顶层:66.zh: 碰到货车，它直接隧穿过去，谁也不用让谁。
guide_cards:顶层:66.en: Meeting a freight train, it tunnels straight through. Nobody gives way.

guide_cards:顶层:67.zh: 上车就走，最短的路，不用等车。
guide_cards:顶层:67.en: Get on and it goes, the shortest way. No waiting for trains.

guide_cards:顶层:69.en: Visitors at the pier are dealt with here.

guide_cards:顶层:70.zh: 三家公司的长期合同，也在这儿签。
guide_cards:顶层:70.en: The three companies' standing contracts are signed here.

guide_cards:顶层:71.zh: 顶上那行说“用得上”再来，平时不用管。
guide_cards:顶层:71.en: Come when the top line says it is worth it. Otherwise leave it.

guide_cards:顶层:73.zh: 卖货、买零件、交订单，都在这儿。
guide_cards:顶层:73.en: Sell, buy parts and fill orders here.

guide_cards:顶层:74.en: Sell: pick it, set the price, list it.

guide_cards:顶层:75.zh: 订单是别人点名要的货，比市价高。
guide_cards:顶层:75.en: Orders are goods someone asks for, above market.

guide_cards:顶层:77.zh: 炉子按这张单子一炉一炉炼。
guide_cards:顶层:77.en: The furnace works down this list, heat by heat.

guide_cards:顶层:78.zh: 排一炉，炉子自己装料、熔化、浇铸。
guide_cards:顶层:78.en: Queue a heat: it charges, melts and casts by itself.

guide_cards:顶层:79.zh: 拖动换先后，同一种模具排一起。
guide_cards:顶层:79.en: Drag to reorder; keep the same mould together.

guide_cards:顶层:81.zh: 拆船抽回来的气，在这儿分离、液化。
guide_cards:顶层:81.en: Gas drawn from ships is separated and liquefied here.

guide_cards:顶层:82.zh: 液氧、液氢在交易行卖，接订单也行。
guide_cards:顶层:82.en: LOX and LH2 are sold on the exchange, or to orders.

guide_cards:顶层:83.zh: 平时不用管，顶上那行亮了再来。
guide_cards:顶层:83.en: Leave it until the top line lights up.

guide_cards:顶层:86.zh: 排好的炉子自己炼，这儿看温度、出钢。
guide_cards:顶层:86.en: Queued heats run by themselves; here you watch the heat and tap.

guide_cards:顶层:87.zh: 第一炉要你在这儿亲手出一次钢。
guide_cards:顶层:87.en: The first heat is tapped by hand, here.

guide_cards:顶层:89.zh: 钢坯在这儿轧成钢板或型材。
guide_cards:顶层:89.en: Billets are rolled into plate or sections here.

guide_cards:顶层:90.zh: 点一种，按 Enter 开轧。
guide_cards:顶层:90.en: Pick one and press Enter to roll.

guide_cards:顶层:91.zh: 开着连续轧，钢坯一到就轧。
guide_cards:顶层:91.en: With rolling on, each billet is rolled as it comes.

listing_face:顶层:18.zh: 星盾保险 · 理赔处置部

listing_face:顶层:21.zh: 环带海事法院 · 执行处

listing_face:seller:1.zh: 零压港 · 新拆法推广处

listing_face:seller:2.zh: 这艘是港口提供的拆解示范船，已经按照新的拆解流程做好了准备。船体和设备的实际情况都有记录，可以查看相关资料。
listing_face:seller:2.en: This is a demonstration hull the port provides for dismantling, already prepared for the new method. The hull and equipment are fully documented, and the records are open to view.

listing_face:seller:4.zh: 司法处置 · 不提供担保

listing_face:seller:5.zh: 这艘船我自己开了十几年，现在不干这行了，就想着把船卖掉。手续都齐全，有意向的话可以联系。
listing_face:seller:5.en: I flew this ship myself for over ten years. I've left the trade now and just want to sell her. The paperwork is all in order; get in touch if you're interested.

listing_face:seller:6.zh: 跑完最后一趟就一直停在港口，到现在也没再用过，每个月还得交泊位费。想早点处理掉，价格可以商量。
listing_face:seller:6.en: She has sat in port since her last run and hasn't been used since, and the berth fees come every month. I'd like to sell soon; the price is open to discussion.

listing_face:seller:7.zh: 公司最近在更换船队，这艘船已经列入资产出售名单。相关账目都能查到，也可以正常开具发票。
listing_face:seller:7.en: The company is renewing its fleet, and this ship is on the asset sale list. The accounts can all be checked, and an invoice can be issued as usual.

listing_face:seller:8.zh: 这艘船的运营合同已经到期，公司决定不再继续使用。之前的维护记录都有保存，目前由公司统一挂牌出售。
listing_face:seller:8.en: This ship's operating contract has ended and the company won't keep using her. Past maintenance records are kept; she is listed for sale by the company.

listing_face:seller:9.zh: 受船东委托公开拍卖，船舶按照目前的实际状况出售。买家需要自行检查船况，拍卖行不提供额外担保。
listing_face:seller:9.en: Auctioned publicly on the owner's behalf; the ship is sold in her present condition. Buyers must check her condition themselves; the auction house gives no further warranty.

listing_face:seller:10.zh: 委托方希望尽快完成出售，这次拍卖按照船舶现状成交。有意向的买家请提前安排看船，拍卖结束后就不再接受报价了。
listing_face:seller:10.en: The consignor wants a quick sale, and this auction sells the ship as is. Interested buyers should arrange a viewing early; no offers are taken once the auction ends.

listing_face:seller:11.zh: 这艘船已经按照全损完成理赔，目前出售的是剩余船体和设备。船舶按照现状处理，具体情况请买家自行检查确认。
listing_face:seller:11.en: This ship has been settled as a total loss; what is for sale is the remaining hull and equipment. She is sold as is; buyers should check and confirm the details themselves.

listing_face:seller:12.zh: 相关保险理赔已经结案，现在准备出售剩余船体和设备。船上的实际情况以现场检查结果为准。
listing_face:seller:12.en: The insurance claim is closed, and the remaining hull and equipment are now for sale. The inspection on site decides what is actually on board.

listing_face:seller:13.zh: 这艘船属于法院强制执行的拍卖资产，按照现状出售。原船东没有配合办理交接，部分船舶资料缺失，买家需要提前了解情况。
listing_face:seller:13.en: This ship is an asset auctioned under a court enforcement order and is sold as is. The former owner did not cooperate with the handover and some of the ship's records are missing; buyers should look into this beforehand.
